531 // Aspectos de la Tienda: solo cambian los colores del modelo (vida, daño y velocidad iguales).
532 const SKIN_LOOKS = {
533   selva: { name: 'Selva', tints: [0x4e6b34, 0x6b5a3a, 0x3d5530], mix: 0.55 },
534   artico: { name: 'Ártico', tints: [0xeef4f7, 0xc9dde8], mix: 0.62, teamDark: 0xdfe9ef },
535   castillo: { name: 'Castillo', tints: [0x8c7b63, 0x6e6252, 0xa39478], mix: 0.6 },
536   neon: { name: 'Neón', tints: [0x1b1830, 0x231d3d], mix: 0.8, glow: true },
537   dorado: { name: 'Dorado', tints: [0xf2c14e, 0xd9a638], mix: 0.72, teamDark: 0xb8862a },
538   // v1.2: colecciones nuevas.
539   frente: { name: 'Frente 1940', tints: [0x5b5a3a, 0x8a7f55, 0x5a4632], mix: 0.62 },
540   marea: { name: 'Marea', tints: [0x2a6f9e, 0xf08a7a, 0x7fd0d8], mix: 0.58 },
541   // Brigada Tóxica: cambia la forma (capucha y máscara de gas), no solo el color.
542   toxico: { name: 'Tóxico', tints: [], mix: 0, geo: true },
543 };

545 function _skinColor(base, look, i) {
546   const L = SKIN_LOOKS[look];
547   if (!L || !L.tints.length) return base;
548   return base.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(L.tints[i % L.tints.length]), L.mix);
549 }
550 
551 function _buildPart(entry, color, look) {
552   const pos = [];
553   const nor = [];
554   const col = [];
555   const L = SKIN_LOOKS[look];
556   const team = new THREE.Color(color);
557   const teamDark = new THREE.Color(shade(color, -0.3));
558   if (L && L.glow) {
559     team.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 0.25);
560     teamDark.copy(team);
561   } else if (L && L.teamDark) teamDark.set(L.teamDark);
562   entry.chunks.forEach((ch, idx) => {
563     const pa = ch.g.attributes.position;
564     const na = ch.g.attributes.normal;
565     const c = ch.team === 1 ? team : ch.team === 2 ? teamDark : L ? _skinColor(ch.base, look, idx) : ch.base;
566     for (let i = 0; i < pa.count; i++) {
567       pos.push(pa.getX(i), pa.getY(i), pa.getZ(i));
568       if (na) nor.push(na.getX(i), na.getY(i), na.getZ(i));
569       col.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
570     }
571   });
572   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
573   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
574   if (nor.length) geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
575   else geo.computeVertexNormals();
576   geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
577   geo.computeBoundingSphere();
578   return geo;
579 }

581 const _modelCache = new Map();
582 function getModel(type, color, look) {
583   const key = type + ':' + color + ':' + (look || '');
584   let m = _modelCache.get(key);
585   if (m) return m;
586   // Algunos aspectos traen su propio modelo (por ejemplo «rifle@toxico»).
587   const gk = look && GLB[type + '@' + look] ? type + '@' + look : glbKey(type);
588   if (gk) {
589     const src = GLB[gk];
590     m = { glb: true, partPos: {} };
591     for (const [part, entry] of Object.entries(src.parts)) {
592       m[part] = _buildPart(entry, color, look);
593       m.partPos[part] = entry.pos;
594     }
595   } else {
596     const base = type.replace(/_\d+$/, '');
597     const fn = UNIT_MODEL[type] || MODEL_BUILDERS[type] || UNIT_MODEL[base] || MODEL_BUILDERS[base];
598     m = fn ? fn(color) : MODEL_BUILDERS.house(color);
599   }
600   _modelCache.set(key, m);
601   return m;
602 }

604 function _partMesh(geo, mat, out, group, name, pos) {
605   const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
606   mesh.castShadow = true;
607   if (pos) mesh.position.copy(pos);
608   group.add(mesh);
609   out[name] = mesh;
610   return mesh;
611 }

613 // Crea el grupo 3D de una entidad. Devuelve { group, main, turret, rotor, blades, rocker, crystal }.
614 function createVisual(type, color, look) {
615   const m = getModel(type, color, look);
616   const group = new THREE.Group();
617   const out = { group, main: null, turret: null, rotor: null, crystal: null, rocker: null, blades: null, type };
618   const mat = fastMat(m.glb ? GLB_MAT : MODEL_MAT, FAST_MATS);
619   _partMesh(m.main, mat, out, group, 'main', null).receiveShadow = true;
620   const pp = m.partPos || {};
621   if (m.blades) _partMesh(m.blades, mat, out, group, 'blades', pp.blades || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.bladesY, m.bladesZ));
622   if (m.rocker) _partMesh(m.rocker, mat, out, group, 'rocker', pp.rocker || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.rockerY, m.rockerZ || 0));
623   if (m.turret) {
624     _partMesh(m.turret, mat, out, group, 'turret', pp.turret || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.turretY || 0, m.turretZ || 0));
625     out.turretBaseY = out.turret.position.y;
626   }
627   if (m.rotor) _partMesh(m.rotor, mat, out, group, 'rotor', pp.rotor || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.rotorY, 0));
628   // Piernas de los soldados (se mueven al caminar).
629   if (m.legl) _partMesh(m.legl, mat, out, group, 'legl', pp.legl);
630   if (m.legr) _partMesh(m.legr, mat, out, group, 'legr', pp.legr);
631   // La pierna cuelga del muslo: gira en la rodilla y sigue a la cadera.
632   if (m.shinl && out.legl) _partMesh(m.shinl, mat, out, out.legl, 'shinl', pp.shinl.clone().sub(pp.legl));
633   if (m.shinr && out.legr) _partMesh(m.shinr, mat, out, out.legr, 'shinr', pp.shinr.clone().sub(pp.legr));
634   if (m.crystal) {
635     const cmat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
636       color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.55, flatShading: true, roughness: 0.4,
637     });
638     _partMesh(m.crystal, cmat, out, group, 'crystal', pp.crystal || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.crystalY, 0));
639     out.crystalBaseY = out.crystal.position.y;
640   }
641   if (m.scale) group.scale.setScalar(m.scale);
642   return out;
643 }

646 const NEUTRAL = 0xd9dcdf;
647 function createPointVisual(type) {

713   init() {
714     try {
715       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
716       this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
717       this.renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
718       this.renderer.setSize(112, 112);
719       this.scene = new THREE.Scene();
720       this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x445566, 0.9));
721       const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
722       sun.position.set(3, 5, 4);
723       this.scene.add(sun);
724       this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 1, 0.1, 50);
725     } catch (err) {

731   get(type, color, look) {
732     const key = type + ':' + color + ':' + (look || '');
733     if (this.cache.has(key)) return this.cache.get(key);
734     let url = '';
735     if (this.renderer) {
736       const isPoint = type === 'faro' || type === 'flag';
737       const v = isPoint ? createPointVisual(type) : createVisual(type, color, look);
738       if (isPoint) {
739         v.own.color.set(color);
740         if (v.beam) v.beam.visible = false;
741       }
742       v.group.scale.setScalar(1);
743       this.scene.add(v.group);
744       const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(v.group);
745       const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length();
746       const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
747       const d = size * 1.75;
748       this.camera.position.set(center.x + d * 0.62, center.y + d * 0.55, center.z + d * 0.62);
749       this.camera.lookAt(center);
750       this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
751       url = this.renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
752       this.scene.remove(v.group);
753     }
754     this.cache.set(key, url);
755     return url;
756   },

  68       const point = {
  69         id: i, type: pt.type, def: POINTS[pt.type], cell: pt.cell, x: c.x, z: c.z, y: c.h, alive: true, kind: 'point',
  70         owner: -1, prog: 0, capTeam: -1, contested: false,
  71       };
  72       c.point = point;
  73       return point;
  74     });
  75     this._pointT = 0;
  76     this.chat = [];
  77     this._alertT = {};
  78     this.fights = [];
  79     this._fightCell = new Map();
  80     // Inicio: Núcleo, 1 Granja, 2.000 monedas y (desde la v0.6) 1 Constructor para arrancar rápido.
  81     for (const p of this.players) {
  82       const home = this.cells[this.map.homes[p.id]];
  83       p.core = this.addBuilding(p.id, 'core', home.i, true);
  84       const sf = this.map.startFarms[p.id];
  85       if (sf >= 0 && !this.cells[sf].bld) this.addBuilding(p.id, 'farm', sf, true);
  86       const spawn = this.freeCellsNear(home.i, 'land', p.id, START_UNITS.length + 1);
  87       START_UNITS.forEach((t, k) => { if (spawn[k] !== undefined) this.addUnit(p.id, t, spawn[k]); });
  88       if (this.mode.tutorial && p.id !== 0) {
  89         // Tutorial: un bot lento con un Núcleo débil para practicar.
  90         p.core.maxHp = 3000;
  91         p.core.hp = 3000;
  92         p.core._w = { ...BUILDINGS.core.weapon, dmg: 8, range: 3 };
  93         p.core._wLv = 1;
  94       }
  95     }
  96     this.recomputeTerritory();
  97     this.refreshEconomy();
  98     // Personalidades repartidas según la semilla del mapa: cada bot es distinto.
  99     const order = PERSONALITY_ORDER.slice();
 100     const rng = mulberry32(opts.seed + 77);
 101     for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 102       const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
 103       [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]];
 104     }
 105     this.bots = this.players.filter((p) => !p.human).map((p, i) => {
 106       p.persona = opts.personas && opts.personas[p.id] ? opts.personas[p.id] : order[i % order.length];
 107       return new Bot(this, p.id);
 108     });
 109     // Campaña (v0.7): preparación de la misión y seguimiento de su meta.
 110     this.camp = null;
 111     if (opts.mission) Campaign.setup(this);
 112   }
 113 
 114   // ---------- consultas básicas ----------
 115   isEnemy(a, b) {
 116     return this.players[a].team !== this.players[b].team;
 117   }
 118 
 119   // ---------- alianzas (v1.1, modos de todos contra todos) ----------
 120   alliancesAllowed() {
 121     return !!this.mode.alliances && !this.camp && !this.mode.tutorial;
 122   }
 123 
 124   // Fuerza aproximada de un imperio: vida de su ejército y de sus edificios.
 125   strengthOf(pid) {
 126     let s = 0;
 127     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.owner === pid && u.def.weapon) s += u.hp;
 128     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid) s += b.hp * 0.25;
 129     return s;
 130   }
 131 
 132   // El bot decide si acepta la alianza; devuelve { ok, text } con su respuesta.
 133   proposeAlliance(from, to) {
 134     const A = this.players[from];
 135     const B = this.players[to];
 136     if (!this.alliancesAllowed()) return { ok: false, text: 'En este modo no hay alianzas' };
 137     if (!B || !B.alive || !A.alive || from === to) return { ok: false, text: 'Ese imperio ya no está' };
 138     if (A.team === B.team) return { ok: false, text: `${B.name} ya es tu aliado` };
 139     A.allyAsk = A.allyAsk || {};
 140     if (this.time - (A.allyAsk[to] ?? -999) < 60) return { ok: false, text: `${B.name}: «Ya te contesté. Pregúntame más tarde.»` };
 141     A.allyAsk[to] = this.time;
 142     const teams = new Set(this.players.filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.team));
 143     if (teams.size <= 2) return this.allyNo(to, 'Solo quedamos nosotros: uno tiene que ganar.');
 144     if (this.time - ((B.hurtBy || {})[from] ?? -999) < 90) return this.allyNo(to, 'Hace poco me atacaste. No confío en ti.');
 145     // Ganas de aliarse: según su forma de ser, si tienen un rival en común más fuerte y si está en apuros.
 146     const base = { aggro: 0.3, admiral: 0.45, builder: 0.65, keeper: 0.55 }[B.persona] ?? 0.5;
 147     const sA = this.strengthOf(from);
 148     const sB = this.strengthOf(to);
 149     let score = base;
 150     const strongest = this.players.filter((p) => p.alive && p.team !== A.team && p.team !== B.team)
 151       .reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, this.strengthOf(p.id)), 0);
 152     if (strongest > Math.max(sA, sB)) score += 0.25;
 153     if (this.time - (B.underAttackAt ?? -999) < 45) score += 0.2;
 154     if (sA > sB * 2.2) score -= 0.25;
 155     if (score < 0.6) return this.allyNo(to, B.persona === 'aggro' ? 'Yo peleo solo.' : 'Todavía no. Muéstrame que vale la pena.');
 156     this.formAlliance(from, to);
 157     this.say(to, 'Trato hecho: ahora somos aliados. ¡Vamos por los demás!', { force: true, toMe: true });
 158     return { ok: true, text: `${B.name} aceptó la alianza` };
 159   }
 160 
 161   allyNo(pid, text) {
 162     this.say(pid, text, { force: true, toMe: true });
 163     return { ok: false, text: `${this.players[pid].name}: «${text}»` };
 164   }
 165 
 166   // Une a «b» (y a sus aliados) al equipo de «a».
 167   formAlliance(a, b) {
 168     const ta = this.players[a].team;
 169     const tb = this.players[b].team;
 170     for (const p of this.players) if (p.team === tb) p.team = ta;
 171     this.allianceChanged();
 172     this.emit('alliance', { a, b, ok: true });
 173   }
 174 
 175   // «pid» sale de su alianza y vuelve a su equipo de siempre.
 176   breakAlliance(pid, by = pid) {
 177     const p = this.players[pid];
 178     if (!this.alliancesAllowed()) return 'En este modo no hay alianzas';
 179     const mates = this.players.filter((q) => q.id !== pid && q.team === p.team);
 180     if (!mates.length) return 'No tienes aliados';
 181     p.team = p.team0;
 182     // Si su equipo era el de la alianza, los demás toman el equipo del primero de ellos.
 183     if (mates.some((q) => q.team === p.team0)) {
 184       const t = mates[0].team0;
 185       for (const q of mates) q.team = t;
 186     }
 187     this.allianceChanged();
 188     this.emit('alliance', { a: pid, ok: false, by });
 189     return null;
 190   }
 191 
 192   allianceChanged() {
 193     // Nadie sigue atacando a un nuevo aliado; la vista compartida se recalcula.
 194     for (const u of this.units) {
 195       if (u.target && u.target.alive !== undefined && !this.isEnemy(u.owner, u.target.owner)) { u.target = null; if (u.state === 'attack') u.state = 'idle'; }
 196       if (u.autoTarget && !this.isEnemy(u.owner, u.autoTarget.owner)) u.autoTarget = null;
 197     }
 198     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.autoTarget && !this.isEnemy(b.owner, b.autoTarget.owner)) b.autoTarget = null;
 199     this.territoryDirty = true;
 200     this.allianceVersion = (this.allianceVersion || 0) + 1;
 201   }
 202 
 203   emit(type, data) {
 204     this.events.push({ type, ...data });
 205   }

 207   toast(pid, text, kind = 'info') {
 208     if (pid === 0) this.emit('toast', { text, kind });
 209   }

 211   // Mensaje de un bot. Se guarda siempre; la interfaz muestra los que te afectan.
 212   say(pid, text, opts = {}) {
 213     const p = this.players[pid];
 214     if (!p || p.human) return false;
 215     if (!opts.force && this.time - (p.lastSay || -99) < 20) {
 216       // Guarda el mensaje más importante y lo dice en cuanto pueda.
 217       if (opts.queue && (!p.pendingSay || p.pendingSay.opts.queue <= opts.queue)) p.pendingSay = { text, opts };
 218       return false;
 219     }
 220     p.lastSay = this.time;
 221     const me = this.players[0];
 222     const msg = {
 223       pid, text, time: this.time, x: opts.x, z: opts.z, kind: opts.kind || 'info',
 224       ally: p.team === me.team, toMe: !!opts.toMe, public: !!opts.public,
 225     };
 226     this.chat.push(msg);
 227     if (this.chat.length > 60) this.chat.shift();
 228     this.emit('chat', { msg });
 229     return true;
 230   }
 231 
 232   // v1.2: mensaje tuyo al chat de aliados; los bots aliados contestan.
 233   playerSay(text) {
 234     const me = this.players[0];
 235     const msg = { pid: 0, text, time: this.time, kind: 'info', ally: true, mine: true, toMe: false, public: false };
 236     this.chat.push(msg);
 237     if (this.chat.length > 60) this.chat.shift();
 238     const replies = {
 239       '¡Gracias!': ['¡De nada!', '¡Para eso estamos!', 'Cuando quieras.'],
 240       '¡Bien hecho!': ['¡Gracias, compañero!', '¡Seguimos así!', '¡Juntos somos fuertes!'],
 241       '¡Cuidado!': ['¡Atento! Pongo defensas.', '¡Visto! Vigilo mi lado.', '¡Gracias por avisar!'],
 242     }[text];
 243     let n = 0;
 244     if (replies) {
 245       for (const p of this.players) {
 246         if (p.id === 0 || !p.alive || p.human || p.team !== me.team) continue;
 247         this.say(p.id, replies[(n + Math.floor(this.time)) % replies.length], { force: true, toMe: true });
 248         n++;
 249       }
 250     }
 251     return n;
 252   }

 254   // Alerta para el jugador con ubicación (para el botón «Ver» y el pulso del minimapa).
 255   alert(key, text, kind, x, z, every = 15) {
 256     if (this.time - (this._alertT[key] || -99) < every) return;
 257     this._alertT[key] = this.time;
 258     this.emit('toast', { text, kind, x, z });
 259     this.emit('ping', { x, z, kind });
 260   }
 261 
 262   passable(cell, mover, owner) {
 263     if (mover === 'air') return true;
 264     const T = TERRAIN[cell.t];
 265     if (mover === 'land' ? !T.land : !T.water) return false;
 266     const b = cell.bld;
 267     if (b) return b.type === 'wall' && !this.isEnemy(b.owner, owner);
 268     return true;
 269   }
 270 
 271   groundY(u, cell) {
 272     if (u.mover === 'air') return 2.3;
 273     if (u.mover === 'sea') return u.cls === 'sub' ? -0.1 : 0.02;
 274     return cell.h;
 275   }
 276 
 277   freeCellsNear(ci, mover, owner, count) {
 278     const c0 = this.cells[ci];
 279     const out = [];
 280     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 281       if (off.d === 0 && mover !== 'air') continue;
 282       const c = this.map.get(c0.q + off.q, c0.r + off.r);
 283       if (!c || !this.passable(c, mover, owner)) continue;
 284       out.push(c.i);
 285       if (out.length >= count) break;
 286     }
 287     while (out.length < count) out.push(out[0] ?? ci);
 288     return out;
 289   }
 290 
 291   // ---------- A* ----------
 292   findPath(start, goalI, mover, owner) {
 293     const cells = this.cells;
 294     const N = cells.length;
 295     if (!this._g) {
 296       this._g = new Float32Array(N);
 297       this._from = new Int32Array(N);
 298       this._stamp = new Uint32Array(N);
 299       this._closed = new Uint32Array(N);
 300       this._run = 0;
 301     }
 302     const run = ++this._run;
 303     const G = this._g;
 304     const F = this._from;
 305     const S = this._stamp;
 306     const C = this._closed;
 307     const goal = cells[goalI];
 308     const goalOk = this.passable(goal, mover, owner);
 309     const heap = new MinHeap();
 310     S[start] = run;
 311     G[start] = 0;
 312     F[start] = -1;
 313     heap.push(start, 0);
 314     let best = start;
 315     let bestH = this.map.dist(cells[start], goal);
 316     let iter = 0;
 317     while (heap.size) {
 318       const cur = heap.pop();
 319       if (C[cur] === run) continue;
 320       C[cur] = run;
 321       const hc = this.map.dist(cells[cur], goal);
 322       if (hc < bestH) { bestH = hc; best = cur; }
 323       if (cur === goalI || (!goalOk && hc <= 1)) { best = cur; break; }
 324       if (++iter > 5000) break;
 325       for (const ni of cells[cur].nb) {
 326         if (C[ni] === run) continue;
 327         const nc = cells[ni];
 328         if (!this.passable(nc, mover, owner)) continue;
 329         const slow = mover === 'land' ? TERRAIN[nc.t].slow || 1 : 1;
 330         const ng = G[cur] + slow;
 331         if (S[ni] !== run || ng < G[ni]) {
 332           S[ni] = run;
 333           G[ni] = ng;
 334           F[ni] = cur;
 335           heap.push(ni, ng + this.map.dist(nc, goal) * 1.01);
 336         }
 337       }
 338     }
 339     const path = [];
 340     let c = best;
 341     while (c !== -1 && c !== start) {
 342       path.push(c);
 343       c = F[c];
 344     }
 345     path.reverse();
 346     return path;
 347   }
 348 
 349   // ---------- niveles ----------
 350   bMaxHp(def, lv) {
 351     return def.levels ? def.levels[lv].hp : Math.round(def.hp * lvlMult(lv));
 352   }
 353 
 354   bIncome(b) {
 355     const d = b.def;
 356     if (d.levels) return d.levels[b.level].income;
 357     return Math.round((d.income || 0) * lvlMult(b.level));
 358   }
 359 
 360   bEnergy(b) {
 361     return Math.round((b.def.energy || 0) * lvlMult(b.level));
 362   }
 363 
 364   bPop(b) {
 365     const d = b.def;
 366     if (d.levels) return d.levels[b.level].pop;
 367     if (d.popLevels) return d.popLevels[b.level] || 0;
 368     return (d.pop || 0) * b.level;
 369   }
 370 
 371   // Comunidad extra por pelear (v0.9): por tropas enemigas eliminadas y Núcleos destruidos.
 372   popBonus(p) {
 373     return Math.floor(p.stats.kills / POP_BONUS.perKills) * POP_BONUS.killPop + p.coresKilled * POP_BONUS.corePop;
 374   }
 375 
 376   // Arma según el nivel: láser del Núcleo, Air Defense más fuerte, etc.
 377   // Escudo propio de cada edificio (v0.9): 20 % de su vida máxima.
 378   resetShield(b) {
 379     b.shieldMax = Math.round(b.maxHp * BLD_SHIELD.pct);
 380     b.shield = b.shieldMax;
 381   }
 382 
 383   weaponOf(b) {
 384     const d = b.def;
 385     if (!d.weapon) return null;
 386     if (b._wLv === b.level && b._w) return b._w;
 387     let w = d.weapon;
 388     if (d.aaLevel && b.level >= d.aaLevel) {
 389       // Torreta nivel 4: también es antiaérea.
 390       w = { ...w, mult: { ...w.mult, ...d.aaMult } };
 391     }
 392     if (d.levels && d.levels[b.level].laser) {
 393       const L = d.levels[b.level].laser;
 394       w = { ...w, dmg: L.dmg, range: L.range, beams: L.beams };
 395     } else if (b.level > 1) {
 396       w = { ...w, dmg: w.dmg * lvlMult(b.level), range: w.range + (b.type === 'aadef' ? 1 : 0) };
 397     }
 398     b._w = w;
 399     b._wLv = b.level;
 400     return w;
 401   }
 402 
 403   healOf(b) {
 404     const d = b.def;
 405     if (!d.heal) return null;
 406     if (d.healLevels) return { cls: d.heal.cls, pct: d.healLevels[b.level].pct, range: d.healLevels[b.level].range };
 407     if (d.heal.rate) return { ...d.heal, rate: d.heal.rate * lvlMult(b.level) };
 408     return d.heal;
 409   }
 410 
 411   // v0.9: cada nivel entrena un 40 % más rápido.
 412   prodRate(b) {
 413     return 1 + 0.4 * (b.level - 1);
 414   }

 416   // ---------- creación de entidades ----------
 417   addBuilding(owner, type, ci, instant = false) {
 418     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 419     const cell = this.cells[ci];
 420     const built = instant || def.build === 0;
 421     const hp0 = this.bMaxHp(def, 1);
 422     const b = {
 423       id: _nextId++, kind: 'bld', type, def, owner, cell: ci, x: cell.x, z: cell.z, y: cell.h, level: 1, upgrading: null,
 424       hp: built ? hp0 : hp0 * 0.1, maxHp: hp0, built, progress: built ? 1 : 0, workAcc: 0, lastWork: -99,
 425       miniCd: [0, 0, 0], shield: 0, shieldMax: 0,
 426       coastal: !!TERRAIN[cell.t].water || cell.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water),
 427       queue: [], rally: -1, alive: true, cd: 0, scanT: Math.random() * 0.3, autoTarget: null,
 428       onWater: !!TERRAIN[cell.t].water, healT: 0, aimYaw: 0, lastHit: -99, visible: true,
 429       rot: Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) * (Math.PI / 3),
 430     };
 431     if (type === 'core' || type === 'harbor') b.rot = 0;
 432     if (built) this.resetShield(b);
 433     cell.bld = b;
 434     this.buildings.push(b);
 435     if (def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
 436     // Aparta a las unidades que estaban sobre la casilla.
 437     for (const u of this.units) {
 438       if (!u.alive || u.cell !== ci || u.mover === 'air') continue;
 439       const free = this.freeCellsNear(ci, u.mover, u.owner, 1)[0];
 440       const fc = this.cells[free];
 441       u.x = fc.x + u.offX;
 442       u.z = fc.z + u.offZ;
 443       u.cell = free;
 444       if (u.state !== 'idle') this.setPath(u, u.dest >= 0 ? u.dest : free);
 445     }
 446     return b;
 447   }
 448 
 449   addUnit(owner, type, ci) {
 450     const def = UNITS[type];
 451     const cell = this.cells[ci];
 452     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
 453     const rr = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.33;
 454     const u = {
 455       id: _nextId++, kind: 'unit', type, def, owner, cls: def.cls, mover: def.mover, cell: ci,
 456       offX: Math.cos(a) * rr, offZ: Math.sin(a) * rr, x: 0, z: 0, y: 0, hp: def.hp, maxHp: def.hp,
 457       alive: true, state: 'idle', path: [], pathI: 0, dest: -1, target: null, autoTarget: null,
 458       aggroTarget: null, cd: Math.random() * 0.5, scanT: Math.random() * 0.3, yaw: Math.random() * 6,
 459       aimYaw: 0, moveYaw: 0, moving: false, repathT: 0, resume: -1, foundCell: -1, role: 'home',
 460       lastHit: -99, visible: true, inside: null, cargo: def.capacity || def.hangar ? [] : null, boardTarget: null,
 461       buildTarget: null, shield: 0, shieldMax: 0,
 462     };
 463     u.x = cell.x + u.offX;
 464     u.z = cell.z + u.offZ;
 465     u.y = this.groundY(u, cell);
 466     this.units.push(u);
 467     return u;
 468   }
 469 
 470   // ---------- territorio ----------
 471   recomputeTerritory() {
 472     for (const c of this.cells) {
 473       c.owner = -1;
 474       c.ownerD = 99;
 475       c.ownerId = 0;
 476     }
 477     const claimers = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.def.claim)
 478       .map((b) => ({ owner: b.owner, cell: b.cell, claim: b.def.claim, id: b.id }));
 479     for (const pt of this.points) {
 480       if (pt.owner >= 0) claimers.push({ owner: pt.owner, cell: pt.cell, claim: pt.def.claim, id: 1e6 + pt.id });
 481     }
 482     for (const b of claimers) {
 483       const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 484       for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 485         if (off.d > b.claim) break;
 486         const c = this.map.get(bc.q + off.q, bc.r + off.r);
 487         if (!c) continue;
 488         if (off.d < c.ownerD || (off.d === c.ownerD && b.id < c.ownerId)) {
 489           c.owner = b.owner;
 490           c.ownerD = off.d;
 491           c.ownerId = b.id;
 492         }
 493       }
 494     }
 495     this.territoryDirty = false;
 496     this.territoryVersion++;
 497   }
 498 
 499   // ---------- economía ----------
 500   refreshEconomy() {
 501     for (const p of this.players) {
 502       p.income = 0;
 503       p.popCap = 0;
 504       p.popUsed = 0;
 505       p.energyRate = 0;
 506       p.bonus = 0;
 507     }
 508     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 509       if (!b.alive) continue;
 510       const p = this.players[b.owner];
 511       if (b.built) {
 512         p.income += this.bIncome(b);
 513         p.popCap += this.bPop(b);
 514         p.energyRate += this.bEnergy(b);
 515       }
 516       for (const q of b.queue) p.popUsed += UNITS[q.type].pop;
 517     }
 518     for (const pt of this.points) {
 519       if (pt.owner < 0) continue;
 520       const p = this.players[pt.owner];
 521       p.income += pt.def.income;
 522       p.bonus += pt.def.bonus;
 523     }
 524     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive) this.players[u.owner].popUsed += u.def.pop;
 525     for (const p of this.players) {
 526       p.popCap += this.popBonus(p);
 527       if (this.creator && p.id === 0) p.popCap = MAX_POP;
 528       p.popCap = Math.min(MAX_POP, p.popCap);
 529       p.baseIncome = p.income;
 530       p.income = Math.round(p.income * (1 + p.bonus));
 531     }
 532   }
 533 
 534   incomeMult(p) {
 535     return p.human ? 1 : this.diff.income;
 536   }
 537 
 538   count(pid, type) {
 539     let n = 0;
 540     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid && b.type === type) n++;
 541     return n;
 542   }
 543 
 544   limitFor(pid, type) {
 545     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 546     if (type === 'house') return HOUSE_LIMIT + 2 * this.players[pid].coresKilled;
 547     return def.limit || 0;
 548   }
 549 
 550   placeInvalid(pid, type, ci, ignoreCost = false) {
 551     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 552     const c = this.cells[ci];
 553     const p = this.players[pid];
 554     if (!c) return 'Casilla no válida';
 555     // v1.4: reglas del desafío semanal (solo para ti).
 556     if (pid === 0 && this.rule) {
 557       if (this.rule === 'nofactory' && type === 'factory') return 'Desafío: sin Fábrica';
 558       if (this.rule === 'noair' && (type === 'helipad' || type === 'airport')) return 'Desafío: sin Helipuerto ni Aeropuerto';
 559     }
 560     // Las estructuras de mar se ponen en su lugar del mar aunque esté fuera de tu territorio (punto 15).
 561     if (def.sea) {
 562       if (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== pid && this.isEnemy(c.owner, pid)) return 'Es territorio enemigo';
 563     } else if (c.owner !== pid) {
 564       return 'Fuera de tu territorio';
 565     }
 566     if (c.point) return `Aquí está ${c.point.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera'}`;
 567     if (c.bld) return 'Casilla ocupada';
 568     const reserved = { gold: 'Las vetas de oro son para Minas', fertile: 'La tierra fértil es para Granjas',
 569       oilland: 'El petróleo en tierra es para Bombas de petróleo' };
 570     const nearWater = c.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water);
 571     if (Array.isArray(def.on)) {
 572       if (!def.on.includes(c.t)) return 'Solo en ' + def.on.map((t) => TERRAIN[t].name.toLowerCase()).join(' o ');
 573     } else if (def.on === 'land' || def.on === 'landcoast') {
 574       if (!TERRAIN[c.t].land) return 'Debe ir sobre tierra';
 575       if (reserved[c.t]) return reserved[c.t];
 576       if (def.on === 'landcoast' && !nearWater) return 'Debe ir en tierra junto al agua';
 577     } else if (def.on === 'coast') {
 578       if (c.t !== 'shallow' || !this.map.isCoast(c)) return 'Debe ir en el agua, junto a la orilla';
 579     } else if (def.on === 'shallowcoast') {
 580       if (c.t !== 'shallow' || !this.map.isCoast(c)) return 'Debe ir en agua poco profunda junto a la costa';
 581     } else if (def.on === 'deep') {
 582       if (c.t !== 'deep') return 'Debe ir en mar profundo';
 583     }
 584     const limit = this.limitFor(pid, type);
 585     if (limit && this.count(pid, type) >= limit) return `Límite alcanzado (${limit})`;
 586     if (!ignoreCost && p.coins < def.cost) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 587     if (!ignoreCost && def.energyCost && p.energy < def.energyCost) return `Energía insuficiente (${def.energyCost}): construye energías (Solar, Eólica...)`;
 588     return null;
 589   }
 590 
 591   place(pid, type, ci, rot) {
 592     const err = this.placeInvalid(pid, type, ci);
 593     if (err) return err;
 594     const p = this.players[pid];
 595     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 596     p.coins -= def.cost;
 597     p.energy -= def.energyCost || 0;
 598     const b = this.addBuilding(pid, type, ci);
 599     if (rot !== undefined) b.rot = rot;
 600     // v1.3: el edificio cuenta para las misiones cuando se termina la obra (no al colocarlo).
 601     if (b.built) p.stats.built++;
 602     this.emit('sound', { name: 'place', pid });
 603     if (!this.assignSite(b) && pid === 0) this.warnNoBuilder(b);
 604     return null;
 605   }
 606 
 607   // ---------- obras: constructores, ingenieros y barcos constructores ----------
 608   needsWork(b) {
 609     return b.alive && ((!b.built && !b.def.selfBuild && b.type !== 'outpost') || !!b.upgrading);
 610   }
 611 
 612   canBuildSite(u, b) {
 613     const by = b.def.builtBy || 'land';
 614     if (!u.def.builds) return false;
 615     if (by === 'engineer') return u.type === 'engineer';
 616     return u.def.builds === by;
 617   }
 618 
 619   // ¿Puede la unidad llegar a una casilla junto a la obra?
 620   reachesSite(u, b) {
 621     const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 622     const comp = this.cells[u.cell].comp;
 623     if (bc.comp === comp && TERRAIN[bc.t].water === (u.mover === 'sea')) return true;
 624     return bc.nb.some((ni) => this.cells[ni].comp === comp);
 625   }
 626 
 627   builderFor(b, onlyIdle = true) {
 628     let best = null;
 629     let bd = Infinity;
 630     const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 631     for (const u of this.units) {
 632       if (!u.alive || u.inside || u.owner !== b.owner || !this.canBuildSite(u, b)) continue;
 633       if (onlyIdle && u.state !== 'idle') continue;
 634       if (u.role === 'cap' || u.role === 'wave') continue;
 635       if (!this.reachesSite(u, b)) continue;
 636       const d = this.map.dist(this.cells[u.cell], bc);
 637       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = u; }
 638     }
 639     return best;
 640   }
 641 
 642   assignSite(b) {
 643     const u = this.builderFor(b);
 644     if (!u) return false;
 645     this.orderBuild([u], b);
 646     return true;
 647   }
 648 
 649   warnNoBuilder(b) {
 650     const by = b.def.builtBy || 'land';
 651     const has = this.units.some((u) => u.alive && u.owner === b.owner && this.canBuildSite(u, b));
 652     const who = by === 'sea' ? 'un Barco constructor (en el Puerto)' : by === 'engineer' ? 'un Ingeniero (en el Cuartel)'
 653       : 'un Constructor (en el Núcleo o el Cuartel)';
 654     const text = has ? 'Obra en espera: tu constructor está ocupado; irá al terminar.' : `Obra en espera: necesitas ${who}.`;
 655     this.alert('nobuilder' + by, text, 'bad', b.x, b.z, 8);
 656   }
 657 
 658   orderBuild(units, b) {
 659     let n = 0;
 660     for (const u of units) {
 661       if (!u.alive || u.inside || !this.canBuildSite(u, b)) continue;
 662       u.state = 'build';
 663       u.buildTarget = b;
 664       u.target = null;
 665       u.repairTarget = null;
 666       u.repathT = 0;
 667       n++;
 668     }
 669     return n;
 670   }
 671 
 672   // Cada segundo: las obras sin nadie reciben al constructor libre más cercano.
 673   assignBuilders() {
 674     const busy = new Set();
 675     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.state === 'build' && u.buildTarget) busy.add(u.buildTarget);
 676     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 677       if (!this.needsWork(b) || busy.has(b)) continue;
 678       if (this.assignSite(b)) busy.add(b);
 679     }
 680   }
 681 
 682   // Trabajo de un constructor junto a la obra (se aplica en el siguiente paso del edificio).
 683   workOn(u, b, dt) {
 684     b.workAcc += (u.def.buildRate || 1) * dt;
 685     b.lastWork = this.time;
 686     u.workingAt = this.time;
 687     u.aimYaw = Math.atan2(b.x - u.x, b.z - u.z);
 688     // Martilleo de obra (solo tus constructores suenan).
 689     if (u.owner === 0 && Math.random() < dt * 1.3) this.emit('sound', { name: 'build', x: b.x, z: b.z });
 690     if (Math.random() < dt * 1.5) this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: b.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7, y: b.y + 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4, z: b.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7, s: 0.18 });
 691   }
 692 
 693   demolish(b) {
 694     if (!b.alive || b.type === 'core') return;
 695     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 696     const back = b.built ? 0.4 : 0.75;
 697     p.coins += Math.floor(b.def.cost * back);
 698     p.energy += Math.floor((b.def.energyCost || 0) * back);
 699     for (const q of b.queue) {
 700       p.coins += UNITS[q.type].cost;
 701       p.energy += UNITS[q.type].energy || 0;
 702     }
 703     b.queue = [];
 704     // v1.3: la mejora en curso se devuelve entera (se pagó y no llegó a terminarse).
 705     if (b.upgrading && b.upgrading.paid) p.coins += b.upgrading.paid;
 706     b.upgrading = null;
 707     b.alive = false;
 708     const c = this.cells[b.cell];
 709     if (c.bld === b) c.bld = null;
 710     if (b.def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
 711     this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: b.x, y: b.y + 0.3, z: b.z, s: 0.9 });
 712   }
 713 
 714   foundInvalid(pid, ci, how) {
 715     const c = this.cells[ci];
 716     if (!c || !TERRAIN[c.t].land) return 'Elige una casilla de tierra';
 717     if (c.t === 'gold') return 'No sobre vetas de oro: ponlo al lado';
 718     if (c.point) return 'Ese punto se captura con infantería';
 719     if (c.bld) return 'Casilla ocupada';
 720     if (c.owner >= 0 && this.isEnemy(c.owner, pid)) return 'Es territorio enemigo';
 721     if (how === 'sea' && !c.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water)) return 'Debe estar en la costa';
 722     return null;
 723   }
 724 
 725   enqueue(b, type) {
 726     const def = UNITS[type];
 727     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 728     if (!b.built) return 'Aún en construcción';
 729     if (!b.def.produces || !b.def.produces.includes(type)) return 'No se produce aquí';
 730     if (b.queue.length >= 5) return 'Cola llena (5)';
 731     if (def.limit) {
 732       const have = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === b.owner && u.type === type).length +
 733         this.buildings.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.owner === b.owner ? x.queue.filter((q) => q.type === type).length : 0), 0);
 734       if (have >= def.limit) return `Límite alcanzado (${def.limit})`;
 735     }
 736     if (p.coins < def.cost) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 737     if (def.energy && p.energy < def.energy) return `Energía insuficiente (${def.energy}): construye energías (Solar, Eólica...)`;
 738     this.refreshEconomy();
 739     if (p.popUsed + def.pop > p.popCap) return 'Población llena: construye o amplía Casas';
 740     p.coins -= def.cost;
 741     p.energy -= def.energy || 0;
 742     b.queue.push({ type, t: 0 });
 743     b.lastType = type;
 744     p.popUsed += def.pop;
 745     return null;
 746   }
 747 
 748   cancelQueue(b, idx) {
 749     const q = b.queue[idx];
 750     if (!q) return;
 751     b.queue.splice(idx, 1);
 752     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 753     p.coins += UNITS[q.type].cost;
 754     p.energy += UNITS[q.type].energy || 0;
 755   }
 756 
 757   // Mejoras (punto 6): todos los edificios suben a nivel 3; la Casa a 4. Las hace un constructor.
 758   upgradeCost(b) {
 759     const d = b.def;
 760     const lv = b.level;
 761     if (lv >= d.maxLevel) return 0;
 762     if (d.levels) return d.levels[lv + 1].cost;
 763     if (b.type === 'house') return HOUSE_LEVELS[lv];
 764     return Math.max(50, Math.round(d.cost * LEVEL_UP_COST[lv]));
 765   }
 766 
 767   upgradeInvalid(b) {
 768     if (!b.built) return 'Aún en construcción';
 769     if (b.upgrading) return 'Ya se está mejorando';
 770     if (b.level >= b.def.maxLevel) return b.def.maxLevel === 1 ? 'Este edificio no se mejora' : `${b.def.name}: nivel máximo`;
 771     if (b.def.l4Limit && b.level === 3) {
 772       const n = this.buildings.filter((x) => x.alive && x.owner === b.owner && x.type === b.type && (x.level >= 4 || (x.upgrading && x.upgrading.level >= 4))).length;
 773       if (n >= b.def.l4Limit) return `Solo ${b.def.l4Limit} ${b.def.name} pueden llegar a nivel 4`;
 774     }
 775     if (!this.creator || b.owner !== 0) {
 776       if (this.players[b.owner].coins < this.upgradeCost(b)) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 777     }
 778     return null;
 779   }
 780 
 781   // v1.0: «Mejorar todo» y «Mejoras automáticas», solo con el Núcleo en nivel 3.
 782   massUpgradeInvalid(pid) {
 783     const p = this.players[pid];
 784     if (!p.core || !p.core.alive || p.core.level < AUTO_UP.coreLevel) return `Necesita el Núcleo en nivel ${AUTO_UP.coreLevel}`;
 785     return null;
 786   }
 787 
 788   // Edificios que todavía se pueden mejorar (sin contar el dinero), del más barato al más caro.
 789   upgradeCandidates(pid) {
 790     const out = [];
 791     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 792       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== pid || !b.built || b.upgrading || b.level >= (b.def.maxLevel || 1)) continue;
 793       const why = this.upgradeInvalid(b);
 794       if (why && why !== 'Monedas insuficientes') continue;
 795       out.push(b);
 796     }
 797     return out.sort((a, c) => this.upgradeCost(a) - this.upgradeCost(c));
 798   }
 799 
 800   // Un clic: pone a mejorar todo lo que alcanza el dinero (del más barato al más caro).
 801   upgradeAll(pid, reserve = 0) {
 802     const why = this.massUpgradeInvalid(pid);
 803     if (why) return why;
 804     const p = this.players[pid];
 805     let n = 0;
 806     let spent = 0;
 807     for (const b of this.upgradeCandidates(pid)) {
 808       const cost = this.upgradeCost(b);
 809       if (p.coins - cost < reserve) continue;
 810       if (typeof this.upgrade(b) === 'string') continue;
 811       n++;
 812       spent += cost;
 813     }
 814     return { n, spent };
 815   }
 816 
 817   // Mejoras automáticas: siguen mejorando hasta dejar todo al máximo, como mucho tantos edificios
 818   // a la vez como Constructores tenga el imperio, y sin bajar de la reserva.
 819   updateAutoUpgrade(dt) {
 820     this._autoUpT = (this._autoUpT || 0) - dt;
 821     if (this._autoUpT > 0) return;
 822     this._autoUpT = AUTO_UP.every;
 823     for (const p of this.players) {
 824       if (!p.alive || !p.autoUpgrade || this.massUpgradeInvalid(p.id)) continue;
 825       const busy = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === p.id && b.upgrading).length;
 826       const builders = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === p.id && u.def.builds).length;
 827       if (busy >= Math.max(1, builders)) continue;
 828       const b = this.upgradeCandidates(p.id).find((x) => p.coins - this.upgradeCost(x) >= AUTO_UP.reserve);
 829       if (b && typeof this.upgrade(b) !== 'string') {
 830         p.autoUps = (p.autoUps || 0) + 1;
 831         if (p.id === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `Mejora automática: ${b.def.name} a nivel ${b.level + 1}`, kind: 'info', x: b.x, z: b.z });
 832       }
 833     }
 834   }
 835 
 836   upgrade(b) {
 837     const err = this.upgradeInvalid(b);
 838     if (err) return err;
 839     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 840     const paid = this.upgradeCost(b);
 841     p.coins -= paid;
 842     b.upgrading = { level: b.level + 1, progress: 0, paid };
 843     p.stats.upgrades++;
 844     this.emit('sound', { name: 'place', pid: b.owner });
 845     if (!this.assignSite(b) && b.owner === 0) this.warnNoBuilder(b);
 846     return b;
 847   }
 848 
 849   // Lo que da un edificio en su nivel actual (para la tarjeta «Qué mejoró»).
 850   snapshot(b) {
 851     const w = this.weaponOf(b);
 852     const heal = this.healOf(b);
 853     return {
 854       hp: b.maxHp, income: this.bIncome(b), pop: this.bPop(b), energy: this.bEnergy(b), prod: b.def.produces ? this.prodRate(b) : 0,
 855       dmg: w ? Math.round(w.dmg) : 0, range: w ? w.range : 0, beams: w && w.beams ? w.beams : 1,
 856       guns: b.def.minigun ? Math.max(0, b.level - 1) : 0, aa: !!(b.def.aaLevel && b.level >= b.def.aaLevel),
 857       heal: heal ? Math.round((heal.pct || 0) * 100) : 0, shield: b.shieldMax,
 858     };
 859   }
 860 
 861   upgradeLines(b, before, after) {
 862     const out = [];
 863     const n = (v) => fmt(Math.round(v));
 864     if (after.hp > before.hp) out.push(`Vida ${n(before.hp)} → ${n(after.hp)}`);
 865     if (after.shield > before.shield) out.push(`Escudo ${n(before.shield)} → ${n(after.shield)}`);
 866     if (after.income > before.income) out.push(`Monedas ${n(before.income)} → ${n(after.income)} por min`);
 867     if (after.pop > before.pop) out.push(`Comunidad +${after.pop - before.pop}`);
 868     if (after.energy > before.energy) out.push(`Energía ${before.energy} → ${after.energy} cada 10 s`);
 869     if (after.prod > before.prod) out.push(`Entrena ${Math.round((after.prod / before.prod - 1) * 100)} % más rápido`);
 870     if (after.dmg > before.dmg) out.push(`Daño ${before.dmg} → ${after.dmg}`);
 871     if (after.range > before.range) out.push(`Alcance ${before.range} → ${after.range}`);
 872     if (after.beams > before.beams) out.push('Doble láser');
 873     if (after.guns > before.guns) out.push(`${after.guns} minigun${after.guns > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
 874     if (after.aa && !before.aa) out.push('Ahora dispara a aeronaves');
 875     if (after.heal > before.heal) out.push(`Cura ${after.heal} % por segundo`);
 876     if (b.type === 'core' && b.level === 3) out.push('Ya puedes comprar la Cúpula');
 877     if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.level === 4) out.push('Puede lanzar el misil nuclear');
 878     if (b.def.levelNames) out.unshift(`Ahora es ${b.def.levelNames[b.level]}`);
 879     return out;
 880   }
 881 
 882   // v0.9: qué daría la próxima mejora (se muestra antes de pagar).
 883   upgradePreview(b) {
 884     if (b.level >= (b.def.maxLevel || 1)) return [];
 885     const before = this.snapshot(b);
 886     const keep = { level: b.level, maxHp: b.maxHp, shieldMax: b.shieldMax };
 887     b.level++;
 888     b.maxHp = this.bMaxHp(b.def, b.level);
 889     b.shieldMax = Math.round(b.maxHp * BLD_SHIELD.pct);
 890     const after = this.snapshot(b);
 891     const lines = this.upgradeLines(b, before, after);
 892     Object.assign(b, keep);
 893     return lines;
 894   }
 895 
 896   finishUpgrade(b) {
 897     const lv = b.upgrading.level;
 898     const before = this.snapshot(b);
 899     b.upgrading = null;
 900     const ratio = b.hp / b.maxHp;
 901     b.level = lv;
 902     b.maxHp = this.bMaxHp(b.def, lv);
 903     b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, Math.max(b.hp, b.maxHp * ratio));
 904     this.resetShield(b);
 905     this.refreshEconomy();
 906     this.emit('built', { b, upgraded: true });
 907     if (b.owner === 0) {
 908       const lines = this.upgradeLines(b, before, this.snapshot(b));
 909       this.emit('upgraded', { b, level: lv, lines });
 910       this.emit('toast', { text: `${b.def.name}: nivel ${lv}`, kind: 'good' });
 911       this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
 912     }
 913   }
 914 
 915   cargoSlots(t) {
 916     let n = 0;
 917     for (const u of t.cargo) n += u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
 918     return n;
 919   }
 920 
 921   orderRepair(units, b) {
 922     let n = 0;
 923     for (const u of units) {
 924       if (!u.alive || !u.def.repairs || u.inside) continue;
 925       u.state = 'repair';
 926       u.repairTarget = b;
 927       u.target = null;
 928       u.repathT = 0;
 929       n++;
 930     }
 931     return n;
 932   }
 933 
 934   repairBuilding(u, b, dt) {
 935     u.aimYaw = Math.atan2(b.x - u.x, b.z - u.z);
 936     if (this.time - b.lastHit < REPAIR.pause) return;
 937     b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, b.hp + REPAIR.rate * dt);
 938     if (Math.random() < dt * 2) this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: b.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, y: b.y + 0.6, z: b.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6 });
 939   }
 940 
 941   repairAround(u, dt) {
 942     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
 943     for (const ci of [uc.i, ...uc.nb]) {
 944       const b = this.cells[ci].bld;
 945       if (b && b.alive && b.built && b.owner === u.owner && b.hp < b.maxHp) {
 946         this.repairBuilding(u, b, dt);
 947         return;
 948       }
 949     }
 950   }
 951 
 952   // ¿Puede esta tropa subir a ese transporte? Jeep y Transporte blindado: solo soldados.
 953   // Portaaviones: solo Cazas (en su hangar).
 954   canBoard(u, t) {
 955     if (!u.alive || u.inside || u === t || !t.alive || this.isEnemy(u.owner, t.owner)) return false;
 956     if (t.def.hangar) return !!u.def.plane && u.type === 'fighter';
 957     if (!t.def.capacity || u.mover !== 'land') return false;
 958     if (t.def.carries === 'inf' && u.cls !== 'inf') return false;
 959     if (u.def.capacity) return false;
 960     return true;
 961   }
 962 
 963   orderBoard(units, t) {
 964     for (const u of units) {
 965       if (!this.canBoard(u, t)) continue;
 966       u.state = 'board';
 967       u.boardTarget = t;
 968       u.target = null;
 969       u.repathT = 0;
 970     }
 971   }
 972 
 973   // v1.5: recuerda por unos segundos que no puede llegar a ese objetivo.
 974   markUnreach(u, t, secs = 6) {
 975     const un = u.unreach || (u.unreach = {});
 976     for (const k of Object.keys(un)) if (un[k] <= this.time) delete un[k];
 977     un[t.id] = this.time + secs;
 978   }
 979 
 980   isUnreach(u, t) {
 981     return !!(u.unreach && u.unreach[t.id] > this.time);
 982   }
 983 
 984   // v1.4: la tropa que va a subir no llega al transporte (la orilla junto a él está tapada por
 985   // edificios, o el transporte está lejos de la costa): si el transporte está quieto, va a buscarla
 986   // a la orilla libre más cercana a la tropa.
 987   callTransport(u, t) {
 988     if (t.owner !== u.owner || t.inside || t.mover === 'air' || !t.alive) return false;
 989     if (t.state !== 'idle' || (t.path && t.pathI < t.path.length)) return false;
 990     if ((t.pickupT || 0) > this.time) return false;
 991     t.pickupT = this.time + 5;
 992     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
 993     const tc = this.cells[t.cell];
 994     let best = -1;
 995     let bd = Infinity;
 996     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 997       if (off.d > 6 || off.d * 4 > bd) break;
 998       const n = this.map.get(uc.q + off.q, uc.r + off.r);
 999       if (!n || n.comp !== uc.comp || !this.passable(n, u.mover, u.owner)) continue;
1000       for (const si of n.nb) {
1001         const s = this.cells[si];
1002         if (s.comp !== tc.comp || (si !== t.cell && !this.passable(s, t.mover, t.owner))) continue;
1003         const d = off.d * 4 + this.map.dist(s, tc) * 0.01;
1004         if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = si; }
1005       }
1006     }
1007     if (best < 0 || best === t.cell) return false;
1008     this.orderMove([t], best);
1009     return true;
1010   }
1011 
1012   board(u, t) {
1013     const need = u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
1014     if (this.cargoSlots(t) + need > (t.def.capacity || t.def.hangar)) {
1015       this.toast(u.owner, `${t.def.name}: no queda lugar`, 'bad');
1016       u.state = 'idle';
1017       return false;
1018     }
1019     t.cargo.push(u);
1020     u.inside = t;
1021     u.state = 'idle';
1022     u.path = [];
1023     u.boardTarget = null;
1024     u.target = null;
1025     u.autoTarget = null;
1026     if (u.owner === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'ready' });
1027     return true;
1028   }
1029 
1030   unload(t) {
1031     if (!t.cargo || !t.cargo.length) return `${t.def.name} va vacío`;
1032     const c0 = this.cells[t.cell];
1033     const spots = [];
1034     const mover = t.def.hangar ? 'air' : 'land';
1035     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
1036       if (off.d > 2) break;
1037       const c = this.map.get(c0.q + off.q, c0.r + off.r);
1038       if (c && this.passable(c, mover, t.owner)) spots.push(c.i);
1039     }
1040     if (!spots.length) return t.mover === 'sea' ? 'Acércate a la orilla para desembarcar' : 'No hay lugar para bajar';
1041     t.cargo.forEach((u, i) => {
1042       const ci = spots[i % spots.length];
1043       const c = this.cells[ci];
1044       u.inside = null;
1045       u.cell = ci;
1046       u.x = c.x + u.offX;
1047       u.z = c.z + u.offZ;
1048       u.y = c.h;
1049       u.state = 'idle';
1050       u.path = [];
1051     });
1052     const out = t.cargo;
1053     t.cargo = [];
1054     if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'order' });
1055     // v1.4: desembarco en otra isla (para el logro «Lobo de mar»).
1056     const home = this.players[t.owner].core && this.cells[this.players[t.owner].core.cell];
1057     if (t.mover === 'sea' && home && out.some((u) => u.mover === 'land' && this.cells[u.cell].comp !== home.comp)) {
1058       const st = this.players[t.owner].stats;
1059       st.landings = (st.landings || 0) + 1;
1060     }
1061     return out;
1062   }
1063 
1064   // ---------- órdenes ----------
1065   setPath(u, dest) {
1066     u.dest = dest;
1067     u.path = u.mover === 'air' ? [dest] : this.findPath(u.cell, dest, u.mover, u.owner);
1068     u.pathI = 0;
1069   }
1070 
1071   spreadDest(u, center, used) {
1072     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
1073       if (off.d > 7) break;
1074       const c = this.map.get(center.q + off.q, center.r + off.r);
1075       if (!c || used.has(c.i) || !this.passable(c, u.mover, u.owner)) continue;
1076       return c.i;
1077     }
1078     return center.i;
1079   }
1080 
1081   // Formación en línea (v0.7): una fila de frente al destino, perpendicular a la dirección de marcha.
1082   // Devuelve una casilla por tropa (ordenadas de izquierda a derecha) y hacia dónde miran.
1083   lineSlots(units, center) {
1084     let cx = 0;
1085     let cz = 0;
1086     for (const u of units) { cx += u.x; cz += u.z; }
1087     cx /= units.length;
1088     cz /= units.length;
1089     let dx = center.x - cx;
1090     let dz = center.z - cz;
1091     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1092     if (len < 0.5) { dx = 0; dz = 1; } else { dx /= len; dz /= len; }
1093     const px = -dz;
1094     const pz = dx;
1095     const perRow = 10;
1096     const order = [...units].sort((a, b) => (a.x * px + a.z * pz) - (b.x * px + b.z * pz));
1097     const slots = new Map();
1098     const used = new Set();
1099     order.forEach((u, k) => {
1100       const row = Math.floor(k / perRow);
1101       const inRow = Math.min(perRow, order.length - row * perRow);
1102       const off = (k % perRow) - (inRow - 1) / 2;
1103       const x = center.x + px * off * SQ3 - dx * row * SQ3;
1104       const z = center.z + pz * off * SQ3 - dz * row * SQ3;
1105       const c = this.map.atWorld(x, z) || center;
1106       const dest = this.spreadDest(u, c, used);
1107       used.add(dest);
1108       slots.set(u, dest);
1109       // Dentro de su casilla, se para justo sobre la línea (sin salirse de la casilla).
1110       const dc = this.cells[dest];
1111       let ox = x - dc.x;
1112       let oz = z - dc.z;
1113       const ol = Math.hypot(ox, oz);
1114       if (ol > 0.7) { ox *= 0.7 / ol; oz *= 0.7 / ol; }
1115       // v1.3: si con ese desplazamiento la tropa quedaría sobre una casilla que no puede pisar
1116       // (agua para las de tierra, tierra para los barcos), se queda más cerca del centro.
1117       if (u.mover !== 'air') {
1118         const over = this.map.atWorld(dc.x + ox, dc.z + oz);
1119         if (over && over.i !== dest && !this.passable(over, u.mover, u.owner)) {
1120           const k = Math.min(1, 0.33 / (Math.hypot(ox, oz) || 1));
1121           ox *= k;
1122           oz *= k;
1123         }
1124         u.offX = ox;
1125         u.offZ = oz;
1126       }
1127     });
1128     return { slots, face: Math.atan2(dx, dz) };
1129   }
1130 
1131   orderMove(units, ci, attackMove = false, formation = 'block') {
1132     const used = new Set();
1133     const center = this.cells[ci];
1134     const alive = units.filter((u) => u.alive);
1135     const line = formation === 'line' && alive.length > 1 ? this.lineSlots(alive, center) : null;
1136     for (const u of alive) {
1137       const dest = line ? line.slots.get(u) : this.spreadDest(u, center, used);
1138       used.add(dest);
1139       u.faceYaw = line ? line.face : null;
1140       u.target = null;
1141       u.autoTarget = null;
1142       u.aggroTarget = null;
1143       u.state = attackMove ? 'amove' : 'move';
1144       u.resume = attackMove ? dest : -1;
1145       u.leashCell = -1;
1146       u.patrol = null;
1147       this.setPath(u, dest);
1148     }
1149   }
1150 
1151   // v1.4: patrullar entre donde están y el punto elegido.
1152   orderPatrol(units, ci) {
1153     const alive = units.filter((u) => u.alive && !u.inside && u.def.weapon);
1154     this.orderMove(alive, ci, true);
1155     for (const u of alive) {
1156       const dest = u.path.length ? u.path[u.path.length - 1] : ci;
1157       u.patrol = { a: u.cell, b: dest, leg: 1, laps: 0 };
1158       u.state = 'patrol';
1159       u.resume = -1;
1160     }
1161     return alive.length;
1162   }
1163 
1164   // v1.4: «Mantener posición»: se quedan quietas y solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro.
1165   setHold(units, on) {
1166     for (const u of units) {
1167       if (!u.alive || !u.def.weapon) continue;
1168       u.hold = !!on;
1169       if (on) {
1170         u.patrol = null;
1171         if (u.state === 'attack' || u.state === 'amove') {
1172           u.state = 'idle';
1173           u.path = [];
1174           u.target = null;
1175           u.resume = -1;
1176         }
1177       }
1178     }
1179   }
1180 
1181   orderAttack(units, target) {
1182     for (const u of units) {
1183       if (!u.alive) continue;
1184       u.faceYaw = null;
1185       u.patrol = null;
1186       const w = u.def.weapon;
1187       if (!w || !this.canAttack(u, w, target)) continue;
1188       u.state = 'attack';
1189       u.target = target;
1190       u.resume = -1;
1191       u.repathT = 0;
1192       u.leashCell = -1;
1193     }
1194   }
1195 
1196   orderFound(u, ci) {
1197     const why = this.foundInvalid(u.owner, ci, u.def.founds);
1198     if (why) return why;
1199     u.state = 'found';
1200     u.foundCell = ci;
1201     u.target = null;
1202     this.setPath(u, ci);
1203     return null;
1204   }
1205 
1206   orderStop(units) {
1207     for (const u of units) {
1208       u.patrol = null;
1209       u.state = 'idle';
1210       u.path = [];
1211       u.target = null;
1212       u.resume = -1;
1213     }
1214   }
