1216   // ---------- combate ----------
1217   canAttack(a, w, t) {
1218     if (!t.alive || t.inside || !this.isEnemy(a.owner, t.owner)) return false;
1219     if (t.def.stealth && !(t.seenBy & (1 << this.players[a.owner].team))) return false;
1220     if (t.kind === 'bld') return w.waterOnly ? !!(t.onWater || t.coastal) : (w.mult.bld || 0) > 0;
1221     if (w.waterOnly) return t.cls === 'ship' || t.cls === 'sub';
1222     return (w.mult[t.cls] || 0) > 0;
1223   }
1224 
1225   coverBetween(a, t) {
1226     const dx = t.x - a.x;
1227     const dz = t.z - a.z;
1228     const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1229     const steps = Math.ceil(d / 0.8);
1230     for (let i = 1; i < steps; i++) {
1231       const c = this.map.atWorld(a.x + (dx * i) / steps, a.z + (dz * i) / steps);
1232       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].cover && c.i !== t.cell) return true;
1233     }
1234     return false;
1235   }
1236 
1237   // v1.2: ventaja de altura: desde una meseta se dispara 1 casilla más lejos a lo que está abajo.
1238   heightBonus(a, t) {
1239     if (a.mover === 'air' || a.cell === undefined || !this.cells[a.cell]) return 0;
1240     if (!TERRAIN[this.cells[a.cell].t].highGround) return 0;
1241     if (t && t.cell !== undefined && this.cells[t.cell] && TERRAIN[this.cells[t.cell].t].highGround) return 0;
1242     return 1;
1243   }
1244 
1245   inRange(a, w, t, extraTiles = 0) {
1246     let r = w.range + extraTiles + (w.range >= 2 ? this.heightBonus(a, t) : 0);
1247     const d = Math.hypot(t.x - a.x, t.z - a.z);
1248     const reach = (rr) => rr * SQ3 + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 0.75 : 0.35);
1249     if (d > reach(r)) return false;
1250     if (a.def.losBlock && d > reach(2) && this.coverBetween(a, t)) r = Math.min(r, 2);
1251     // Ocultación: una tropa en bosque solo se ataca de cerca, salvo desde el aire.
1252     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.mover === 'land' && a.mover !== 'air' && this.cells[t.cell].t === 'forest') r = Math.min(r, 2);
1253     return d <= reach(r);
1254   }
1255 
1256   acquire(a, w, extraTiles, exclude = null) {
1257     const maxD = (w.range + extraTiles + (w.range >= 2 ? this.heightBonus(a, null) : 0)) * SQ3 + 0.8;
1258     // Fuego concentrado (bots desde Normal, v0.8): entre lo que tienen a tiro, primero la tropa
1259     // armada con menos vida; así la eliminan antes en vez de repartir el daño.
1260     const focus = extraTiles === 0 && this.players[a.owner].focusFire;
1261     // Difícil (v1.0): entre lo que tiene a tiro, primero los Constructores y la economía.
1262     const snipe = extraTiles === 0 && this.players[a.owner].snipe;
1263     let best = null;
1264     let bs = Infinity;
1265     // v1.3: enemigos a los que esta tropa no encontró camino hace poco: no los vuelve a perseguir
1266     // (si no, en «Avanzar atacando» cambiaba de estado en cada paso y no se movía).
1267     const unreach = extraTiles > 0 && a.unreach ? a.unreach : null;
1268     const check = (t) => {
1269       if (!t.alive || t.owner === a.owner || t === exclude) return;
1270       if (unreach && (unreach[t.id] || 0) > this.time && !this.inRange(a, w, t, 0)) return;
1271       const dx = t.x - a.x;
1272       const dz = t.z - a.z;
1273       if (Math.abs(dx) > maxD || Math.abs(dz) > maxD) return;
1274       if (!this.canAttack(a, w, t)) return;
1275       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1276       if (d > maxD || !this.inRange(a, w, t, extraTiles)) return;
1277       const s = a.def && a.def.prefersBld
1278         ? d + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 0 : 8)
1279         : a.def && a.def.prefersAir
1280           ? d + (t.cls === 'air' ? 0 : 20)
1281         : focus
1282           ? (t.kind === 'bld' ? 1e6 : 0) + (t.def.weapon ? 0 : 5000) + t.hp + (t.shield || 0) + d * 4
1283           : d + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 3 : 0) + (t.def.weapon ? 0 : 1.5);
1284       let sc = s;
1285       if (snipe && !(a.def && (a.def.prefersBld || a.def.prefersAir))) {
1286         if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.def.builds) sc -= focus ? 6000 : 6;
1287         else if (t.kind === 'bld' && t.def.income) sc -= focus ? 5e5 : 1;
1288       }
1289       if (sc < bs) { bs = sc; best = t; }
1290     };
1291     for (const t of this.units) check(t);
1292     for (const t of this.buildings) check(t);
1293     return best;
1294   }
1295 
1296   muzzleY(a) {
1297     if (a.kind === 'bld') return a.y + (a.type === 'core' ? 1.3 : 0.65);
1298     if (a.mover === 'air') return a.y + 0.2;
1299     return a.y + (a.cls === 'inf' ? 0.35 : 0.35);
1300   }
1301 
1302   fire(a, w, t, gun = 0) {
1303     if (a.def.stealth) a.lastShot = this.time;
1304     const mult = t.kind === 'bld' ? w.mult.bld || 0 : w.mult[t.cls] || 0;
1305     const dmg = w.dmg * mult * (1 + (a.vet || 0) * VETERAN.dmg);
1306     let sx = a.x;
1307     const sy = this.muzzleY(a) + (gun && a.type === 'turret' ? 0.05 : 0);
1308     let sz = a.z;
1309     if (gun && a.kind === 'bld') {
1310       // Cañones laterales (miniguns o segundo láser) salen un poco a cada lado.
1311       const side = gun % 2 === 1 ? 1 : -1;
1312       const yaw = a.aimYaw || 0;
1313       sx += Math.cos(yaw) * 0.32 * side;
1314       sz -= Math.sin(yaw) * 0.32 * side;
1315     }
1316     const ty = t.kind === 'bld' ? t.y + 0.4 : t.y + (t.cls === 'inf' ? 0.25 : 0.2);
1317     const color = PLAYER_COLORS[a.owner];
1318     if (w.proj === 'laser') {
1319       this.fx.push({ k: 'laser', x1: sx, y1: sy, z1: sz, x2: t.x, y2: ty, z2: t.z });
1320       this.damage(t, dmg, a.owner, a);
1321       this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: t.x, y: ty, z: t.z, s: 0.4 });
1322     } else if (w.proj === 'bullet' || w.proj === 'bolt' || w.proj === 'flak') {
1323       this.fx.push({ k: 'tracer', x1: sx, y1: sy, z1: sz, x2: t.x, y2: ty, z2: t.z, color, heavy: w.proj !== 'bullet' });
1324       this.damage(t, dmg, a.owner, a);
1325       if (w.proj === 'flak' || w.proj === 'bolt') this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: t.x, y: ty, z: t.z, s: 0.35 });
1326     } else {
1327       const speed = w.proj === 'rocket' ? 10 : w.proj === 'shell' ? 12 : w.proj === 'missile' ? 7 : w.proj === 'bomb' ? 3 : 5;
1328       const d = Math.hypot(t.x - sx, t.z - sz);
1329       // Bengalas del Apache: esquiva un misil cada 20 s.
1330       let miss = false;
1331       if (w.proj === 'missile' && t.def.flares && this.time >= (t.flareAt || 0)) {
1332         miss = true;
1333         t.flareAt = this.time + t.def.flares;
1334         this.fx.push({ k: 'flare', x: t.x, y: t.y + 0.4, z: t.z });
1335         if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `${t.def.name}: bengalas, esquivó un misil`, kind: 'good' });
1336       }
1337       this.projectiles.push({
1338         kind: w.proj, t, dmg, owner: a.owner, src: a, sx, sy, sz, tx: t.x, ty, tz: t.z,
1339         time: 0, dur: Math.max(w.proj === 'bomb' ? 0.6 : 0.12, d / speed), color, miss,
1340       });
1341     }
1342     // Sonido: la minigun de la Torreta suena distinto al cañón.
1343     this.emit('sound', { name: gun && a.type === 'turret' ? 'minigun' : w.proj, x: sx, z: sz });
1344   }
1345 
1346   domeCovers(owner, t) {
1347     const p = this.players[owner];
1348     if (!p.dome || p.dome.hp <= 0 || !p.core.alive) return false;
1349     return Math.hypot(t.x - p.core.x, t.z - p.core.z) <= DOME_LEVELS[p.dome.level].range * SQ3 + 0.5;
1350   }
1351 
1352   unitShieldActive(pid) {
1353     const p = this.players[pid];
1354     return !!(p && p.dome && p.dome.level >= 3 && p.dome.hp > 0 && p.core && p.core.alive);
1355   }
1356 
1357   // v0.9: el escudo personal (Cúpula nivel 3) solo funciona dentro de la Cúpula.
1358   unitShielded(u) {
1359     return this.unitShieldActive(u.owner) && this.domeCovers(u.owner, u);
1360   }
1361 
1362   // Lugares con pelea reciente: la interfaz dibuja un icono de combate (documento pág. 13).
1363   noteFight(t) {
1364     const last = this._fightCell.get(t.cell) || -99;
1365     if (this.time - last < 1) return;
1366     this._fightCell.set(t.cell, this.time);
1367     this.fights.push({ x: t.x, z: t.z, y: t.y, t: this.time, cell: t.cell });
1368     if (this.fights.length > 40) this.fights.shift();
1369   }
1370 
1371   damage(t, dmg, src, srcEnt, nuke = false) {
1372     if (!t.alive || dmg <= 0) return;
1373     if (srcEnt) this.noteFight(t);
1374     // v1.1: quién atacó a quién (para las alianzas).
1375     if (src >= 0 && src !== t.owner && this.players[t.owner]) {
1376       const tp = this.players[t.owner];
1377       tp.hurtBy = tp.hurtBy || {};
1378       tp.hurtBy[src] = this.time;
1379       tp.underAttackAt = this.time;
1380     }
1381     if (t.owner === 0 && srcEnt) {
1382       const k = srcEnt.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : srcEnt.type;
1383       const hb = this.players[0].stats.hitBy;
1384       hb[k] = (hb[k] || 0) + dmg;
1385     }
1386     // Escudo personal de las tropas (Cúpula nivel 3).
1387     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.shield > 0) {
1388       const a = Math.min(t.shield, dmg);
1389       t.shield -= a;
1390       dmg -= a;
1391       t.lastHit = this.time;
1392       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1393     }
1394     // Cúpula: absorbe el daño de barcos, aeronaves y lanzamisiles cerca del Núcleo.
1395     // v1.3: también el del misil nuclear; lo que pase de la vida de la Cúpula sí llega.
1396     if (((srcEnt && (srcEnt.cls === 'ship' || srcEnt.cls === 'sub' || srcEnt.cls === 'air' || srcEnt.type === 'arty')) || nuke) &&
1397       this.domeCovers(t.owner, t)) {
1398       const dome = this.players[t.owner].dome;
1399       const took = nuke ? Math.min(dome.hp, dmg) : dmg;
1400       dome.hp -= took;
1401       dome.lastHit = this.time;
1402       if (dome.hp <= 0) {
1403         dome.hp = 0;
1404         dome.brokenAt = this.time;
1405         this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: this.players[t.owner].core.x, y: 2, z: this.players[t.owner].core.z, s: 1.2 });
1406         if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `La Cúpula se rompió. Vuelve en ${DOME.recover} s`, kind: 'bad' });
1407         for (const u of this.units) if (u.owner === t.owner) u.shield = 0;
1408       }
1409       dmg -= took;
1410       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1411     }
1412     // Escudo propio del edificio (v0.9).
1413     if (t.kind === 'bld' && t.shield > 0) {
1414       const a = Math.min(t.shield, dmg);
1415       t.shield -= a;
1416       dmg -= a;
1417       t.lastHit = this.time;
1418       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1419     }
1420     if (t.type === 'core') {
1421       if (t.shieldUntil > this.time) return;
1422       const p = this.players[t.owner];
1423       if (!p.emergencyUsed && t.hp - dmg <= t.maxHp * EMERGENCY.at) {
1424         p.emergencyUsed = true;
1425         t.hp = Math.max(1, Math.min(t.hp, t.maxHp * EMERGENCY.at));
1426         t.shieldUntil = this.time + EMERGENCY.time;
1427         this.emit('toast', { text: t.owner === 0 ? `¡Escudo de emergencia! ${EMERGENCY.time} s de protección`
1428           : `${p.name} activó su escudo de emergencia`, kind: t.owner === 0 ? 'good' : 'info' });
1429         this.emit('sound', { name: 'alarm' });
1430         return;
1431       }
1432     }
1433     t.hp -= dmg;
1434     t.lastHit = this.time;
1435     t.lastAttacker = src;
1436     const victim = this.players[t.owner];
1437     if (t.kind === 'bld' && srcEnt && (srcEnt.cls === 'ship' || srcEnt.cls === 'sub' || srcEnt.cls === 'air' || srcEnt.type === 'arty')) {
1438       victim.navalHitAt = this.time;
1439     }
1440     if (t.owner === 0) {
1441       if (t.type === 'core' && this.time - this._coreWarn > 15) {
1442         this._coreWarn = this.time;
1443         this.alert('core', '¡Tu Núcleo está bajo ataque!', 'bad', t.x, t.z, 0);
1444         this.emit('sound', { name: 'alarm' });
1445       } else if (t.kind === 'bld') {
1446         this.alert('bld', `Atacan tu ${t.def.name}`, 'bad', t.x, t.z, 20);
1447       } else if (this.cells[t.cell].owner === 0) {
1448         this.alert('units', 'Tus tropas pelean en tu territorio', 'bad', t.x, t.z, 25);
1449       }
1450     } else if (src === 0 && !victim.human && !victim.provoked && t.kind === 'bld') {
1451       victim.provoked = true;
1452       const lines = PERSONALITIES[victim.persona].lines.provoked;
1453       this.say(t.owner, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { toMe: true, force: true });
1454     }
1455     if (t.hp <= 0) {
1456       if (srcEnt && srcEnt.kind === 'unit' && srcEnt.alive && this.isEnemy(srcEnt.owner, t.owner)) this.creditKill(srcEnt, t);
1457       this.kill(t, src);
1458     }
1459   }
1460 
1461   // v1.4: eliminaciones de cada tropa y sus estrellas (veteranas).
1462   creditKill(u, t) {
1463     u.kills = (u.kills || 0) + 1;
1464     const st = this.players[u.owner].stats;
1465     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.mover === 'air') st.airKills = (st.airKills || 0) + 1;
1466     const stars = VETERAN.kills.filter((k) => u.kills >= k).length;
1467     if (stars > (u.vet || 0)) {
1468       const before = 1 + (u.vet || 0) * VETERAN.hp;
1469       const after = 1 + stars * VETERAN.hp;
1470       const add = u.maxHp * (after / before - 1);
1471       u.maxHp += add;
1472       u.hp += add;
1473       u.vet = stars;
1474       st.bestVet = Math.max(st.bestVet || 0, stars);
1475       this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: u.x, y: u.y + 0.6, z: u.z });
1476       if (u.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `${u.def.name}: ${'★'.repeat(stars)} veterano (${u.kills} eliminaciones)`, kind: 'good', x: u.x, z: u.z });
1477     }
1478   }
1479 
1480   // v1.4: un Constructor o Ingeniero libre repara solo los edificios dañados cercanos.
1481   autoRepairScan(u, dt) {
1482     const p = this.players[u.owner];
1483     if (!p.human || p.autoRepair === false) return;
1484     u.repScanT = (u.repScanT || 0) - dt;
1485     if (u.repScanT > 0) return;
1486     u.repScanT = AUTO_REPAIR.every;
1487     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
1488     let best = null;
1489     let bd = Infinity;
1490     for (const b of this.buildings) {
1491       if (!b.alive || !b.built || b.owner !== u.owner || b.hp >= b.maxHp * 0.98 || b.upgrading) continue;
1492       const d = this.map.dist(uc, this.cells[b.cell]);
1493       if (d > AUTO_REPAIR.range) continue;
1494       if (this.isUnreach(u, b)) continue;
1495       if (this.units.some((x) => x !== u && x.alive && x.state === 'repair' && x.repairTarget === b)) continue;
1496       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; }
1497     }
1498     if (best && bd > 1) {
1499       this.orderRepair([u], best);
1500       u.autoRep = true;
1501       p.stats.autoRepairs = (p.stats.autoRepairs || 0) + 1;
1502     }
1503   }
1504 
1505   kill(e, killer) {
1506     if (!e.alive) return;
1507     e.alive = false;
1508     const big = e.kind === 'bld' ? 1.5 : e.cls === 'inf' ? 0.45 : 0.95;
1509     this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: e.x, y: e.y + 0.3, z: e.z, s: big, death: true, bld: e.kind === 'bld' });
1510     this.emit('sound', { name: e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bigboom' : e.cls !== 'inf' ? 'boom' : 'hit', x: e.x, z: e.z });
1511     if (killer >= 0 && killer !== e.owner) this.players[killer].stats.kills++;
1512     if (e.kind === 'unit') this.players[e.owner].stats.lost++;
1513     if (e.kind === 'bld') this.players[e.owner].stats.lostBld = (this.players[e.owner].stats.lostBld || 0) + 1;
1514     if (e.kind === 'bld' && e.owner === 0 && this.camp && !this.over) this.camp.lostBld++;
1515     if (e.cargo) for (const c of e.cargo) this.kill(c, killer);
1516     if (e.kind === 'bld') {
1517       const c = this.cells[e.cell];
1518       if (c.bld === e) c.bld = null;
1519       if (e.def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
1520       if (e.type === 'core') this.eliminate(e.owner, killer);
1521       else if (e.owner === 0) {
1522         this.emit('toast', { text: `Perdiste: ${e.def.name}`, kind: 'bad', x: e.x, z: e.z });
1523         this.emit('ping', { x: e.x, z: e.z, kind: 'bad' });
1524       }
1525     }
1526   }
1527 
1528   eliminate(pid, killer) {
1529     const p = this.players[pid];
1530     if (!p.alive) return;
1531     p.alive = false;
1532     this.elimOrder.push({ pid, time: this.time, killer });
1533     if (killer >= 0 && killer !== pid) this.players[killer].coresKilled++;
1534     if (!p.human && p.persona) {
1535       const lines = PERSONALITIES[p.persona].lines.fall;
1536       this.say(pid, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { force: true, public: true });
1537     }
1538     for (const pt of this.points) {
1539       if (pt.owner === pid) {
1540         pt.owner = -1;
1541         pt.prog = 0;
1542         pt.capTeam = -1;
1543         this.territoryDirty = true;
1544       }
1545     }
1546     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.owner === pid) this.kill(u, -1);
1547     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid) this.kill(b, -1);
1548     this.emit('toast', { text: pid === 0 ? 'Tu Núcleo ha caído' : `${p.name} ha sido eliminado`, kind: pid === 0 ? 'bad' : 'good' });
1549     if (killer === 0 && pid !== 0) this.completeObjective('kill');
1550     this.checkEnd();
1551   }
1552 
1553   endKing(team) {
1554     if (this.over) return;
1555     this.over = true;
1556     this.result = team === this.players[0].team ? 'victory' : 'defeat';
1557     this.kingWinner = team;
1558     this.emit('over', { result: this.result, king: true });
1559   }
1560 
1561   checkEnd() {
1562     if (this.over) return;
1563     const me = this.players[0];
1564     const alive = this.players.filter((p) => p.alive);
1565     const teams = new Set(alive.map((p) => p.team));
1566     // v1.1: si solo quedan aliados de una alianza hecha en la partida, la alianza se rompe: gana uno solo.
1567     if (alive.length > 1 && teams.size <= 1 && this.alliancesAllowed() && new Set(alive.map((p) => p.team0)).size > 1) {
1568       for (const p of alive) p.team = p.team0;
1569       this.allianceChanged();
1570       const bot = alive.find((p) => !p.human);
1571       if (bot) this.say(bot.id, 'Solo quedamos nosotros: se acabó la alianza. ¡Que gane el mejor!', { force: true, public: true });
1572       this.emit('toast', { text: 'La alianza se rompió: solo puede quedar un imperio', kind: 'bad' });
1573       return;
1574     }
1575     // v1.1: espectador. Ya perdiste; la partida sigue hasta que queda un solo equipo.
1576     if (this.spectating) {
1577       if (teams.size <= 1) {
1578         this.over = true;
1579         this.spectating = false;
1580         this.spectateWinner = alive.length ? alive[0].id : -1;
1581         this.emit('over', { result: this.result, spectated: true });
1582       }
1583       return;
1584     }
1585     if (!me.alive) {
1586       this.over = true;
1587       this.result = 'defeat';
1588     } else if (teams.size <= 1) {
1589       this.over = true;
1590       this.result = 'victory';
1591     }
1592     if (this.over) this.emit('over', { result: this.result });
1593   }
1594 
1595   // Al perder, se puede seguir mirando si todavía pelean dos equipos o más.
1596   canSpectate() {
1597     if (this.result !== 'defeat' || this.camp || this.mode.tutorial) return false;
1598     return new Set(this.players.filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.team)).size > 1;
1599   }
1600 
1601   startSpectating() {
1602     if (!this.canSpectate()) return false;
1603     this.spectating = true;
1604     this.over = false;
1605     return true;
1606   }
1607 
1608   completeObjective(id) {
1609     if (this.objDone[id]) return;
1610     this.objDone[id] = true;
1611     this.emit('objective', { id });
1612   }
1613 
1614   // ---------- simulación ----------
1615   update(rawDt) {
1616     const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.1) * this.speed;
1617     if (dt <= 0) return;
1618     this.time += dt;
1619 
1620     this._slowT -= dt;
1621     if (this._slowT <= 0) {
1622       this._slowT = 0.5;
1623       this.refreshEconomy();
1624       this.checkObjectives();
1625       for (const p of this.players) {
1626         if (p.pendingSay && p.alive && this.time - (p.lastSay || -99) >= 20) {
1627           const { text, opts } = p.pendingSay;
1628           p.pendingSay = null;
1629           this.say(p.id, text, { ...opts, queue: 0 });
1630         }
1631       }
1632     }
1633     if (this.creator) {
1634       // Modo creador: monedas y energía infinitas para el jugador.
1635       this.players[0].coins = 999999;
1636       this.players[0].energy = 99999;
1637     }
1638     this._assignT -= dt;
1639     if (this._assignT <= 0) {
1640       this._assignT = 1;
1641       this.assignBuilders();
1642     }
1643     for (const p of this.players) {
1644       if (!p.alive) continue;
1645       const inc = (p.income / 60) * dt * this.incomeMult(p);
1646       p.coins += inc;
1647       p.stats.earned += inc;
1648       p.energy += (p.energyRate / 10) * dt;
1649       if (p.dome && p.dome.hp <= 0 && this.time - p.dome.brokenAt >= DOME.recover) {
1650         p.dome.hp = p.dome.maxHp;
1651         if (p.id === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: 'La Cúpula volvió a levantarse', kind: 'good' });
1652       }
1653     }
1654     this.updatePoints(dt);
1655 
1656     for (let i = 0; i < this.buildings.length; i++) {
1657       const b = this.buildings[i];
1658       if (b.alive) this.updateBuilding(b, dt);
1659     }
1660     for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) {
1661       const u = this.units[i];
1662       if (u.alive) this.updateUnit(u, dt);
1663     }
1664     this.updateProjectiles(dt);
1665     this.updateRadiation(dt);
1666     this.updateAutoUpgrade(dt);
1667     this.recordHistory(dt);
1668     if (!this.over && this.bots.length) {
1669       // Como mucho un bot piensa por paso; el turno rota para que ninguno se quede esperando.
1670       const n = this.bots.length;
1671       this._botTurn = ((this._botTurn || 0) + 1) % n;
1672       let busy = false;
1673       for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) busy = this.bots[(this._botTurn + k) % n].update(dt, busy) || busy;
1674     }
1675     if (this.camp) Campaign.update(this, dt);
1676 
1677     if (this.units.some((u) => !u.alive)) {
1678       for (const u of this.units) if (!u.alive) this.removed.push(u);
1679       this.units = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive);
1680     }
1681     if (this.buildings.some((b) => !b.alive)) {
1682       for (const b of this.buildings) if (!b.alive) this.removed.push(b);
1683       this.buildings = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive);
1684     }
1685     if (this.territoryDirty) this.recomputeTerritory();
1686 
1687     this._fogT -= dt;
1688     if (this._fogT <= 0) {
1689       this._fogT = 0.3;
1690       this.updateVisibility();
1691     }
1692   }
1693 
1694   checkObjectives() {
1695     if (this.count(0, 'farm') && this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.type === 'farm' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('farm');
1696     if (this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.type === 'barracks' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('barracks');
1697     const army = this.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.def.weapon).length;
1698     if (army >= 5) this.completeObjective('army');
1699     // v1.3: ya empiezas con un Constructor; el objetivo es entrenar otro.
1700     if ((this.players[0].stats.builders || 0) > 0) this.completeObjective('builder');
1701     if (this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.def.cat === 'energy' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('energy');
1702     if (this.points.some((pt) => pt.owner === 0)) this.completeObjective('capture');
1703     // v1.3: pasos del tutorial de tu documento.
1704     if (this.mode.tutorial) {
1705       const done = (t) => this.buildings.filter((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.alive && b.built && t(b)).length;
1706       if (done((b) => b.type === 'farm') >= 2 && done((b) => b.def.cat === 'energy') >= 1) this.completeObjective('tut_build');
1707       const soldiers = this.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon).length;
1708       if (done((b) => b.type === 'barracks') >= 1 && soldiers >= 3) this.completeObjective('tut_army');
1709     }
1710   }
1711 
1712   // Cúpula (puntos 5 y 6): pide Núcleo nivel 3; sube de nivel 1 a 3.
1713   domeCost(pid) {
1714     const p = this.players[pid];
1715     const next = p.dome ? p.dome.level + 1 : 1;
1716     return next <= 3 ? DOME_LEVELS[next].cost : 0;
1717   }
1718 
1719   domeInvalid(pid) {
1720     const p = this.players[pid];
1721     if (!p.core.alive || p.core.level < 3) return 'Mejora el Núcleo a nivel 3 para comprar la Cúpula';
1722     if (p.dome && p.dome.level >= 3) return 'La Cúpula ya está en nivel 3';
1723     if (!(this.creator && pid === 0) && p.coins < this.domeCost(pid)) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
1724     return null;
1725   }
1726 
1727   buyDome(pid) {
1728     const err = this.domeInvalid(pid);
1729     if (err) return err;
1730     const p = this.players[pid];
1731     p.coins -= this.domeCost(pid);
1732     const lv = p.dome ? p.dome.level + 1 : 1;
1733     const L = DOME_LEVELS[lv];
1734     p.dome = { level: lv, hp: L.hp, maxHp: L.hp, brokenAt: -99, lastHit: -99 };
1735     if (L.unitShield) {
1736       for (const u of this.units) {
1737         if (u.alive && u.owner === pid) {
1738           u.shieldMax = u.maxHp * L.unitShield;
1739           u.shield = u.shieldMax;
1740         }
1741       }
1742     }
1743     this.emit('sound', { name: 'done', pid });
1744     return null;
1745   }
1746 
1747   // ---------- captura de puntos ----------
1748   updatePoints(dt) {
1749     this._pointT -= dt;
1750     if (this._pointT > 0) return;
1751     const step = 0.25 - this._pointT;
1752     this._pointT = 0.25;
1753     const nearD = CAPTURE.near * SQ3 + 0.5;
1754     const clearD = CAPTURE.clear * SQ3 + 0.5;
1755     for (const pt of this.points) {
1756       const near = new Map();
1757       const close = new Set();
1758       for (const u of this.units) {
1759         if (!u.alive || u.inside) continue;
1760         const d = Math.hypot(u.x - pt.x, u.z - pt.z);
1761         if (d > clearD) continue;
1762         const team = this.players[u.owner].team;
1763         close.add(team);
1764         if (d <= nearD && u.cls === 'inf') {
1765           if (!near.has(team)) near.set(team, u.owner);
1766         }
1767       }
1768       const ownerTeam = pt.owner >= 0 ? this.players[pt.owner].team : -1;
1769       pt.contested = close.size > 1;
1770       if (pt.contested) continue;
1771       if (near.size === 1) {
1772         const [team, pid] = [...near.entries()][0];
1773         const k = step / CAPTURE.time;
1774         if (team === ownerTeam) {
1775           pt.prog = Math.min(1, pt.prog + k);
1776         } else if (pt.owner >= 0) {
1777           pt.prog -= k;
1778           if (pt.prog <= 0) {
1779             const lost = pt.owner;
1780             pt.owner = -1;
1781             pt.prog = 0;
1782             pt.capTeam = team;
1783             this.territoryDirty = true;
1784             if (this.players[lost].team === this.players[0].team) {
1785               this.alert('pt' + pt.id, `Perdiste ${pt.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera'}`, 'bad', pt.x, pt.z, 0);
1786             }
1787           }
1788         } else {
1789           if (pt.capTeam !== team) {
1790             pt.capTeam = team;
1791             pt.prog = 0;
1792           }
1793           pt.prog += k;
1794           if (pt.prog >= 1) {
1795             pt.prog = 1;
1796             pt.owner = pid;
1797             this.players[pid].stats.captures++;
1798             if (pt.type === 'faro') this.players[pid].stats.faro = (this.players[pid].stats.faro || 0) + 1;
1799             this.territoryDirty = true;
1800             this.refreshEconomy();
1801             const what = pt.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera';
1802             const capP = this.players[pid];
1803             if (!capP.human && capP.persona) {
1804               if (capP.team === this.players[0].team) {
1805                 this.say(pid, pt.type === 'faro' ? ALLY_LINES.faro : ALLY_LINES.flag, { x: pt.x, z: pt.z });
1806               } else if (pt.type === 'faro') {
1807                 const lines = PERSONALITIES[capP.persona].lines.faro;
1808                 this.say(pid, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { x: pt.x, z: pt.z, public: true, force: true });
1809               }
1810             }
1811             if (this.players[pid].team === this.players[0].team) {
1812               this.emit('toast', { text: pid === 0 ? `¡Capturaste ${what}!` : `${this.players[pid].name} capturó ${what}`, kind: 'good' });
1813               if (pid === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'capture' });
1814               this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
1815             } else if (pt.type === 'faro') {
1816               this.emit('toast', { text: `${this.players[pid].name} capturó el Faro`, kind: 'bad', x: pt.x, z: pt.z });
1817               this.emit('ping', { x: pt.x, z: pt.z, kind: 'bad' });
1818             }
1819           }
1820         }
1821       } else if (pt.owner < 0 && pt.prog > 0 && near.size === 0) {
1822         pt.prog = Math.max(0, pt.prog - step / (CAPTURE.time * 2));
1823       }
1824     }
1825     if (this.mode.king && !this.over) {
1826       const faro = this.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
1827       if (faro && faro.owner >= 0) {
1828         const team = this.players[faro.owner].team;
1829         this.kingTime[team] = (this.kingTime[team] || 0) + step;
1830         if (this.kingTime[team] >= KING_TIME) this.endKing(team);
1831       }
1832     }
1833   }
1834 
1835   updateStealth() {
1836     const detR = (3 * SQ3 + 0.5) ** 2;
1837     for (const s of this.units) {
1838       if (!s.alive || !s.def.stealth) continue;
1839       if (this.time - (s.lastShot || -99) < 3) {
1840         s.seenBy = 0xff;
1841         continue;
1842       }
1843       let mask = 1 << this.players[s.owner].team;
1844       const check = (e) => {
1845         if (!e.alive || !this.isEnemy(e.owner, s.owner)) return;
1846         const dx = e.x - s.x;
1847         const dz = e.z - s.z;
1848         if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= detR) mask |= 1 << this.players[e.owner].team;
1849       };
1850       for (const u of this.units) if (u.def.detects) check(u);
1851       for (const b of this.buildings) {
1852         if (!b.built) continue;
1853         // Puertos ven submarinos; AIR DEFENSE y Torretas de nivel 4 ven al bombardero furtivo de cerca.
1854         if (b.type === 'harbor' && s.mover === 'sea') check(b);
1855         else if (s.mover === 'air' && (b.type === 'aadef' || (b.def.aaLevel && b.level >= b.def.aaLevel))) check(b);
1856       }
1857       s.seenBy = mask;
1858     }
1859   }
1860 
1861   updateVisibility() {
1862     const fog = this.fog;
1863     const myTeam = this.players[0].team;
1864     this.updateStealth();
1865     const stealthy = (u) => u.def.stealth && !(u.seenBy & (1 << myTeam));
1866     if (!fog) {
1867       for (const u of this.units) u.visible = !u.inside && !stealthy(u);
1868       return;
1869     }
1870     const eyes = [];
1871     for (const u of this.units) {

1893   updateBuilding(b, dt) {
1894     const def = b.def;
1895     // El trabajo de los constructores llega en workAcc; el Puesto avanzado se levanta solo.
1896     const work = b.type === 'outpost' || this.creator && b.owner === 0 && this.opts.instantBuild ? dt * 3 : b.workAcc;
1897     b.workAcc = 0;
1898     b.helped = work > 0;
1899     if (b.upgrading) {
1900       b.upgrading.progress += work / (def.build * 0.5);
1901       if (b.upgrading.progress >= 1) this.finishUpgrade(b);
1902     }
1903     if (!b.built) {
1904       b.progress += work / def.build;
1905       b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, b.hp + (b.maxHp * 0.9 * work) / def.build);
1906       if (b.progress >= 1) {
1907         b.progress = 1;
1908         b.built = true;
1909         this.players[b.owner].stats.built++;
1910         this.resetShield(b);
1911         this.emit('built', { b });
1912         if (b.owner === 0) {
1913           this.emit('toast', { text: `${def.name} ${def.fem ? 'terminada' : 'terminado'}`, kind: 'good' });
1914           this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
1915         }
1916       }
1917       return;
1918     }
1919     // Escudo propio: se recarga si nadie lo ataca durante 8 s.
1920     if (b.shield < b.shieldMax && this.time - b.lastHit > BLD_SHIELD.delay) {
1921       b.shield = Math.min(b.shieldMax, b.shield + b.shieldMax * BLD_SHIELD.regen * dt);
1922     }
1923     if (b.queue.length) {
1924       const q = b.queue[0];
1925       q.t += dt * this.prodRate(b);
1926       if (q.t >= UNITS[q.type].build) {
1927         b.queue.shift();
1928         this.spawnFrom(b, q.type);
1929       }
1930     }
1931     // v1.4: producción continua: con la cola vacía vuelve a poner la última tropa si alcanza el dinero,
1932     // la energía y la comunidad; si no, espera sin gastar.
1933     if (b.loop && b.lastType && !b.queue.length) {
1934       b.loopT = (b.loopT || 0) - dt;
1935       if (b.loopT <= 0) {
1936         b.loopT = LOOP_TRAIN.every;
1937         const err = this.enqueue(b, b.lastType);
1938         b.loopWait = err || null;
1939         if (!err) this.players[b.owner].stats.looped = (this.players[b.owner].stats.looped || 0) + 1;
1940       }
1941     }
1942     const w = this.weaponOf(b);
1943     if (w) {
1944       b.cd -= dt;
1945       b.scanT -= dt;
1946       if (b.scanT <= 0) {
1947         b.scanT = 0.3;
1948         b.autoTarget = this.acquire(b, w, 0);
1949         b.autoTarget2 = w.beams > 1 ? this.acquire(b, w, 0, b.autoTarget) : null;
1950       }
1951       const t = b.autoTarget;
1952       // AIR DEFENSE (v0.9): el radar fija cada blanco nuevo antes de lanzar.
1953       if (w.lock) {
1954         if (t !== b.lockOn) {
1955           b.lockOn = t && t.alive ? t : null;
1956           b.lockT = w.lock;
1957         }
1958         b.lockT -= dt;
1959       }
1960       if (b.salvoLeft > 0) {
1961         b.salvoT -= dt;
1962         const st = b.salvoTarget;
1963         if (b.salvoT <= 0) {
1964           if (st && st.alive && this.inRange(b, w, st)) this.fire(b, w, st, b.salvoLeft);
1965           b.salvoLeft--;
1966           b.salvoT = 0.22;
1967         }
1968       }
1969       if (t && t.alive && this.inRange(b, w, t)) {
1970         b.aimYaw = Math.atan2(t.x - b.x, t.z - b.z);
1971         if (b.cd <= 0 && !(w.lock && b.lockT > 0)) {
1972           if (w.salvo > 1) {
1973             b.salvoLeft = w.salvo - 1;
1974             b.salvoT = 0.22;
1975             b.salvoTarget = t;
1976             b.lastLaunch = this.time;
1977           }
1978           this.fire(b, w, t);
1979           // Núcleo nivel 3: segundo láser (a otro enemigo si lo hay).
1980           if (w.beams > 1) {
1981             const t2 = b.autoTarget2 && b.autoTarget2.alive && this.inRange(b, w, b.autoTarget2) ? b.autoTarget2 : t;
1982             if (t2.alive) this.fire(b, w, t2, 1);
1983           }
1984           b.cd = w.cd;
1985         }
1986       }
1987     }
1988     // Torreta nivel 2: 1 minigun; nivel 3: 2; nivel 4: 3 con más daño y tiro antiaéreo.
1989     const mg = def.minigun;
1990     if (mg && b.level > 1) {
1991       const guns = b.level - 1;
1992       const aa = def.aaLevel && b.level >= def.aaLevel;
1993       const mw = aa ? { ...mg, dmg: mg.dmg * 1.5, mult: { ...mg.mult, ...def.aaMiniMult }, proj: 'bullet' } : { ...mg, proj: 'bullet' };
1994       for (let gi = 0; gi < guns; gi++) {
1995         b.miniCd[gi] = (b.miniCd[gi] || 0) - dt;
1996         if (b.miniCd[gi] > 0) continue;
1997         const mt = b.autoTarget && b.autoTarget.alive && this.canAttack(b, mw, b.autoTarget) && this.inRange(b, mw, b.autoTarget)
1998           ? b.autoTarget : this.acquire(b, mw, 0);
1999         if (!mt) continue;
2000         this.fire(b, mw, mt, gi + 1);
2001         b.miniCd[gi] = mg.cd;
2002       }
2003     }
2004     const heal = this.healOf(b);
2005     if (heal) {
2006       b.healT -= dt;
2007       if (b.healT <= 0) {
2008         b.healT = 0.5;
2009         const rr = (heal.range * SQ3 + 0.4) ** 2;
2010         for (const u of this.units) {
2011           if (!u.alive || u.inside || this.isEnemy(u.owner, b.owner) || !heal.cls.includes(u.cls) || u.hp >= u.maxHp) continue;
2012           const dx = u.x - b.x;
2013           const dz = u.z - b.z;
2014           if (dx * dx + dz * dz > rr) continue;
2015           u.hp = Math.min(u.maxHp, u.hp + (heal.rate ? heal.rate * 0.5 : heal.pct * u.maxHp * 0.5));
2016           if (Math.random() < 0.25) this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: u.x, y: u.y + 0.5, z: u.z });
2017         }
2018       }
2019     }
2020   }

2022   spawnFrom(b, type) {

2035   followPath(u, dt) {
2036     if (u.pathI >= u.path.length) return true;
2037     const cells = this.cells;
2038     const c = cells[u.path[u.pathI]];
2039     if (u.mover !== 'air' && !this.passable(c, u.mover, u.owner)) {
2040       const d = u.dest;
2041       this.setPath(u, d);
2042       if (!u.path.length) return true;
2043       return false;
2044     }
2045     const last = u.pathI === u.path.length - 1;
2046     const tx = c.x + (last ? u.offX : u.offX * 0.5);
2047     const tz = c.z + (last ? u.offZ : u.offZ * 0.5);
2048     const dx = tx - u.x;
2049     const dz = tz - u.z;
2050     const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
2051     let sp = u.def.speed * SQ3;
2052     if (u.mover === 'land') sp /= TERRAIN[cells[u.cell].t].slow || 1;
2053     const step = sp * dt;
2054     if (d <= step) {
2055       u.x = tx;
2056       u.z = tz;
2057       u.pathI++;
2058     } else {
2059       u.x += (dx / d) * step;
2060       u.z += (dz / d) * step;
2061     }
2062     if (d > 0.01) u.moveYaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
2063     u.moving = true;
2064     const nc = this.map.atWorld(u.x, u.z);
2065     // v1.3: una tropa de tierra no pasa a «estar» en una casilla de agua (ni un barco en tierra)
2066     // aunque corte camino por el borde.
2067     if (nc && (u.mover === 'air' || TERRAIN[nc.t][u.mover === 'land' ? 'land' : 'water'])) u.cell = nc.i;
2068     return u.pathI >= u.path.length;
2069   }

2356   healAround(u, aura, dt) {

2368       const dx = t.x - u.x;
2369       const dz = t.z - u.z;

2521   launchNuke(b, ci) {

2530       time: 0, dur: NUKE.flight, color: PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], cell: ci, checked: false,

2535     const R = NUKE.radius + 2;
2536     for (const q of this.players) {
2537       if (!q.alive) continue;
2538       const mine = q.id === b.owner;
2539       const near = this.buildings.some((x) => x.alive && x.owner === q.id && this.map.dist(this.cells[x.cell], c) <= R) ||
2540         this.units.some((u) => u.alive && u.owner === q.id && this.map.dist(this.cells[u.cell], c) <= R);
2541       if (q.id === 0 && (mine || near)) {
2542         this.emit('toast', { text: mine ? `Misil nuclear lanzado: llega en ${NUKE.flight} s` : `¡Misil nuclear en camino! Llega en ${NUKE.flight} s`, kind: mine ? 'info' : 'bad', x: c.x, z: c.z });
2543         this.emit('ping', { x: c.x, z: c.z, kind: 'bad' });

2545       // Una sola frase aunque lleguen varios a la vez (salva de 3, v1.0).
2546       if (!q.human && near && !mine && q.persona && this.time - (q.nukeSaidAt ?? -99) > 2) {
2547         q.nukeSaidAt = this.time;
2548         this.say(q.id, '¡Un misil nuclear! ¡Todos a cubierto!', { force: true, public: true });

2552   }

2554   updateNuke(p) {
2555     const k = p.time / p.dur;
2556     // Escudo antimisiles enemigo cerca del blanco: lo derriba a mitad de camino.
2557     if (!p.checked && k >= 0.6) {
2558       p.checked = true;
2559       const tc = this.cells[p.cell];
2560       const shield = this.buildings.find((b) => b.alive && b.built && b.def.intercept && this.isEnemy(b.owner, p.owner) &&
2561         this.time >= (b.chargeAt || 0) && this.map.dist(this.cells[b.cell], tc) <= b.def.intercept.range);
2562       if (shield) {
2563         shield.chargeAt = this.time + shield.def.intercept.recharge;
2564         p.done = true;
2565         const x = p.sx + (p.tx - p.sx) * k;
2566         const z = p.sz + (p.tz - p.sz) * k;
2567         this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x, y: 4, z, s: 1.4 });
2568         this.nukesIntercepted = (this.nukesIntercepted || 0) + 1;
2569         if (shield.owner === 0 || p.owner === 0) {
2570           this.emit('toast', { text: shield.owner === 0 ? '¡Tu Escudo antimisiles derribó el misil nuclear!' : 'El Escudo antimisiles enemigo derribó tu misil', kind: shield.owner === 0 ? 'good' : 'bad' });
2571         }
2572         return;
2573       }
2574     }
2575     if (p.time < p.dur) return;
2576     p.done = true;
2577     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
2578     this.fx.push({ k: 'nuke', x: p.tx, y: p.ty, z: p.tz });
2579     this.emit('sound', { name: 'bigboom', x: p.tx, z: p.tz });
2580     const hits = [...this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && !u.inside), ...this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive)];
2581     for (const t of hits) {
2582       // v1.3: solo daña a los enemigos de quien lo lanzó (igual que la radiación).
2583       if (!this.isEnemy(p.owner, t.owner)) continue;
2584       const d = Math.hypot(t.x - p.tx, t.z - p.tz);
2585       if (d > R) continue;
2586       this.damage(t, p.dmg * (1 - (d / R) * 0.6), p.owner, null, true);
2587     }
2588     // v1.0: queda 1 minuto de radiación que sigue quemando a los enemigos de quien lo lanzó.
2589     if (!this.radZones) this.radZones = [];
2590     this.radZones.push({ x: p.tx, y: p.ty, z: p.tz, cell: p.cell, owner: p.owner, start: this.time, until: this.time + NUKE.rad.time, tick: 0 });
2591     const zc = this.cells[p.cell];
2592     const near0 = this.buildings.some((b) => b.alive && b.owner === 0 && this.map.dist(this.cells[b.cell], zc) <= NUKE.radius + 2);
2593     if (p.owner === 0 || near0) {
2594       this.emit('toast', { text: `Radiación por ${NUKE.rad.time} s donde cayó el misil`, kind: p.owner === 0 ? 'info' : 'bad', x: p.tx, z: p.tz });
2595     }
2596   }

2598   // Gráficas del final (v1.1): una muestra cada 10 s (a lo sumo 240; si sobran, se juntan de a dos).
2599   recordHistory(dt) {
2600     if (!this.history) this.history = [];
2601     this._histT = (this._histT || 0) - dt;
2602     if (this._histT > 0) return;
2603     this._histT = 10;
2604     const army = this.players.map(() => 0);
2605     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.def.weapon) army[u.owner]++;
2606     this.history.push({ t: Math.round(this.time), inc: this.players.map((p) => (p.alive ? p.income : 0)), army });
2607     if (this.history.length > 240) this.history = this.history.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0);
2608   }

2610   // Radiación (v1.0): cada medio segundo quema a tropas y edificios enemigos dentro de la zona.
2611   updateRadiation(dt) {
2612     if (!this.radZones || !this.radZones.length) return;
2613     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
2614     for (const z of this.radZones) {
2615       z.tick += dt;
2616       if (z.tick < 0.5) continue;
2617       const step = z.tick;
2618       z.tick = 0;
2619       const burn = (t, pct) => {
2620         if (!t.alive || t.inside || !this.isEnemy(z.owner, t.owner)) return;
2621         if (Math.hypot(t.x - z.x, t.z - z.z) > R) return;
2622         this.damage(t, t.maxHp * pct * step, z.owner, null);
2623       };
2624       for (const u of this.units) burn(u, NUKE.rad.unit);
2625       for (const b of this.buildings) burn(b, b.type === 'core' ? NUKE.rad.core : NUKE.rad.bld);
2626       this.fx.push({ k: 'rad', x: z.x, y: z.y, z: z.z, r: R });
2627     }
2628     this.radZones = this.radZones.filter((z) => this.time < z.until);
2629   }

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Guardar y cargar una partida (punto 16: si sales sin querer, puedes volver).
  3 // Convierte todo el estado del juego en JSON: las referencias entre objetos (un edificio que
  4 // apunta a su objetivo, el Núcleo de cada jugador...) se guardan como números, y los datos de
  5 // configuración (BUILDINGS, UNITS...) como su nombre, para no copiarlos.
  6 
  7 const SAVE_KEY = 'faro-save-v1';
  8 const SAVE_VERSION = 1;
  9 
 10 const Save = {
 11   _paths: null,
 12   _byPath: null,
 13 
 14   // Recorre la configuración una vez y anota la ruta de cada objeto (por ejemplo «BUILDINGS.core»).
 15   _consts() {
 16     if (this._paths) return this._paths;
 17     const paths = new Map();
 18     const byPath = new Map();
 19     const roots = {
 20       BUILDINGS, UNITS, MODES, MAPS, DIFFICULTY, POINTS, PERSONALITIES, TERRAIN, DOME_LEVELS, UNIT_SHIELD,
 21       HOUSE_LEVELS, DOME, EMERGENCY, REPAIR, CAPTURE, PALETTES, BUILD_TABS, OBJECTIVES, PLAYER_COLORS,
 22       PLAYER_NAMES, LEVEL_UP_COST, PERSONALITY_ORDER, ALLY_LINES, CAT_NAMES, CAMPAIGN,
 23     };
 24     const walk = (o, path, depth) => {
 25       if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || paths.has(o) || depth > 6) return;
 26       paths.set(o, path);
 27       byPath.set(path, o);
 28       for (const k of Object.keys(o)) walk(o[k], path + '.' + k, depth + 1);
 29     };
 30     for (const [name, obj] of Object.entries(roots)) walk(obj, name, 0);
 31     this._paths = paths;
 32     this._byPath = byPath;
 33     return paths;
 34   },
 35 
 36   // v1.3: guardado más chico y rápido (cada 60 s). El mapa no se guarda: se vuelve a crear con su
 37   // semilla al cargar (una suma de control comprueba que sea el mismo). Las casillas solo guardan lo
 38   // que no se puede recalcular; los efectos visuales y avisos ya mostrados tampoco se guardan.
 39   MAP_STATIC: ['i', 'q', 'r', 'x', 'z', 't', 'h', 'land', 'nb', 'comp', 'bridge'],
 40   // Datos de las casillas que se vuelven a poner al cargar: territorio (se recalcula), edificio y punto.
 41   CELL_REBUILT: ['owner', 'ownerD', 'ownerId', 'bld', 'point'],
 42   GAME_TRANSIENT: ['fx', 'events', 'removed'],
 43 
 44   mapCheck(cells) {
 45     let h = 2166136261;
 46     for (const c of cells) {
 47       const str = `${c.q},${c.r},${c.t},${Math.round(c.h * 100)},${c.land ? 1 : 0},${c.comp},${c.bridge ? 1 : 0};`;
 48       for (let k = 0; k < str.length; k++) {
 49         h ^= str.charCodeAt(k);
 50         h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
 51       }
 52     }
 53     return h >>> 0;
 54   },
 55 
 56   serialize(game) {
 57     const consts = this._consts();
 58     const ids = new Map();
 59     const objs = [];
 60     const map = game.map;
 61     const compact = map instanceof GameMap && map.cells === game.cells;
 62     const cellIdx = compact ? new Map(map.cells.map((c, i) => [c, i])) : null;
 63     const skipGame = new Set(this.GAME_TRANSIENT);
 64     if (compact) skipGame.add('cells');
 65     const skipMap = new Set(['cells', 'lookup']);
 66     const classes = new Map([[Game.prototype, 'Game'], [Bot.prototype, 'Bot'], [GameMap.prototype, 'GameMap'], [MinHeap.prototype, 'MinHeap']]);
 67     const enc = (v) => {
 68       if (typeof v === 'function' || v === undefined) return undefined;
 69       if (typeof v === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(v)) return { $n: String(v) };
 70       if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
 71       const cp = consts.get(v);
 72       if (cp) return { $c: cp };
 73       const known = ids.get(v);
 74       if (known !== undefined) return { $r: known };
 75       if (cellIdx && cellIdx.has(v)) {
 76         // Referencia a una casilla: al cargar apunta a la casilla recreada.
 77         const cid = objs.length;
 78         ids.set(v, cid);
 79         objs.push({ cell: cellIdx.get(v) });
 80         return { $r: cid };
 81       }
 82       const id = objs.length;
 83       ids.set(v, id);
 84       objs.push(null);
 85       let rec;
 86       if (Array.isArray(v)) rec = { a: v.map((x) => { const e = enc(x); return e === undefined ? null : e; }) };
 87       else if (v instanceof Map) rec = { m: [...v].map(([k, x]) => [enc(k), enc(x)]) };
 88       else if (v instanceof Set) rec = { s: [...v].map(enc) };
 89       else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(v)) rec = { t: v.constructor.name, n: v.length };
 90       else {
 91         const o = {};
 92         const skip = v === game ? skipGame : compact && v === map ? skipMap : null;
 93         for (const k of Object.keys(v)) {
 94           if (skip && skip.has(k)) continue;
 95           const e = enc(v[k]);
 96           if (e !== undefined) o[k] = e;
 97         }
 98         rec = { o };
 99         const cls = classes.get(Object.getPrototypeOf(v));
100         if (cls) rec.k = cls;
101         if (compact && v === map) {
102           // Datos de casillas que no se recalculan solos (si los hay): se guardan aparte.
103           const fixed = new Set([...this.MAP_STATIC, ...this.CELL_REBUILT]);
104           const extra = [];
105           map.cells.forEach((c, i) => {
106             const ks = Object.keys(c).filter((k) => !fixed.has(k));
107             if (!ks.length) return;
108             const eo = {};
109             for (const k of ks) {
110               const e = enc(c[k]);
111               if (e !== undefined) eo[k] = e;
112             }
113             extra.push([i, eo]);
114           });
115           // La suma de control se calcula una vez por mapa (sus casillas fijas no cambian en la partida).
116           if (!this._checks) this._checks = new WeakMap();
117           let check = this._checks.get(map);
118           if (check === undefined) {
119             check = this.mapCheck(map.cells);
120             this._checks.set(map, check);
121           }
122           rec.gen = { seed: map.seed, kind: map.kind, n: map.n, pairs: !!map.pairs, check, extra };
123         }
124       }
125       objs[id] = rec;
126       return { $r: id };
127     };
128     enc(game);
129     let maxId = 0;
130     for (const e of game.units) maxId = Math.max(maxId, e.id || 0);
131     for (const e of game.buildings) maxId = Math.max(maxId, e.id || 0);
132     return { v: SAVE_VERSION, nextId: Math.max(maxId + 1, _nextId), objs };
133   },
134 
135   deserialize(data) {
136     if (!data || data.v !== SAVE_VERSION || !Array.isArray(data.objs)) throw new Error('Guardado no válido');
137     this._consts();
138     const byPath = this._byPath;
139     const classes = { Game, Bot, GameMap, MinHeap };
140     const typed = { Float32Array, Int32Array, Uint32Array, Uint8Array, Int16Array, Uint16Array, Float64Array };
141     let fresh = null;
142     const genRec = data.objs.find((r) => r && r.gen);
143     if (genRec) {
144       const g0 = genRec.gen;
145       fresh = new GameMap(g0.seed, g0.kind, g0.n, g0.pairs);
146       if (this.mapCheck(fresh.cells) !== g0.check) throw new Error('El mapa no coincide con esta versión del juego');
147     }
148     const made = data.objs.map((r) => {
149       if (r.cell !== undefined) return fresh.cells[r.cell];
150       if (r.a) return [];
151       if (r.m) return new Map();
152       if (r.s) return new Set();
153       // Los arreglos numéricos son memoria de trabajo del buscador de caminos: se crean vacíos.
154       if (r.t) return new (typed[r.t] || Float32Array)(r.n);
155       return r.k && classes[r.k] ? Object.create(classes[r.k].prototype) : {};
156     });
157     const dec = (v) => {
158       if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
159       if (v.$r !== undefined) return made[v.$r];
160       if (v.$c !== undefined) {
161         if (!byPath.has(v.$c)) throw new Error('Dato de configuración desconocido: ' + v.$c);
162         return byPath.get(v.$c);
163       }
164       if (v.$n !== undefined) return Number(v.$n);
165       return v;
166     };
167     data.objs.forEach((r, i) => {
168       if (r.cell !== undefined) return;
169       const t = made[i];
170       if (r.a) r.a.forEach((x) => t.push(dec(x)));
171       else if (r.m) r.m.forEach(([k, x]) => t.set(dec(k), dec(x)));
172       else if (r.s) r.s.forEach((x) => t.add(dec(x)));
173       else if (r.o) for (const k of Object.keys(r.o)) t[k] = dec(r.o[k]);
174     });
175     const game = made[0];
176     if (!(game instanceof Game)) throw new Error('Guardado no válido');
177     _nextId = Math.max(_nextId, data.nextId || 1);
178     game.events = [];
179     if (!game.fx) game.fx = [];
180     if (!game.removed) game.removed = [];
181     if (genRec) {
182       // Mapa recreado: casillas nuevas, con sus edificios, puntos y datos extra.
183       game.map.cells = fresh.cells;
184       game.map.lookup = fresh.lookup;
185       game.cells = fresh.cells;
186       for (const [ci, eo] of genRec.gen.extra || []) for (const k of Object.keys(eo)) fresh.cells[ci][k] = dec(eo[k]);
187       for (const c of fresh.cells) { c.bld = null; delete c.point; }
188       for (const b of game.buildings) if (b.alive) fresh.cells[b.cell].bld = b;
189       for (const pt of game.points || []) fresh.cells[pt.cell].point = pt;
190     }
191     // Los datos de cada edificio y tropa vuelven a apuntar a la configuración actual.
192     for (const b of game.buildings) if (BUILDINGS[b.type]) b.def = BUILDINGS[b.type];
193     for (const u of game.units) if (UNITS[u.type]) u.def = UNITS[u.type];
194     // Partidas guardadas antes de la v1.1: equipo de origen para las alianzas.
195     for (const p of game.players) if (p.team0 === undefined) p.team0 = p.team;
196     if (!game.radZones) game.radZones = [];
197     game.territoryDirty = true;
198     return game;
199   },
200 
201   // Datos para mostrar en el vestíbulo sin cargar toda la partida.
202   summary(game) {
203     const me = game.players[0];
204     return {
205       mode: game.mode.name, map: (MAPS[game.opts.mapKind] || {}).name || '', time: Math.round(game.time),
206       alive: game.players.filter((p) => p.alive).length, players: game.players.length,
207       units: game.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive).length, coins: Math.round(me.coins),
208       savedAt: Date.now(), creator: !!game.creator,
209       ranked: !!(game.mode.ranked && !game.opts.custom),
210     };
211   },
212 
213   write(game) {
214     if (!game || game.over || game.preview) return false;
215     try {
216       const data = this.serialize(game);
217       data.summary = this.summary(game);
218       localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
219       return true;
220     } catch (err) {
221       console.warn('[Guardado] No se pudo guardar la partida:', err && err.message);
222       return false;
223     }
224   },
225 
226   peek() {
227     try {
228       const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
229       if (!raw) return null;
230       const data = JSON.parse(raw);
231       return data && data.v === SAVE_VERSION ? data.summary || {} : null;
232     } catch (err) {
233       return null;
234     }
235   },
236 
237   read() {
238     try {
239       const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
240       return raw ? this.deserialize(JSON.parse(raw)) : null;
241     } catch (err) {
242       console.warn('[Guardado] No se pudo cargar la partida:', err && err.message);
243       return null;
244     }
245   },
246 
247   clear() {
248     try { localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
249   },
250 };
