  1 'use strict';
  2 // Campaña «La ruta del Faro» (v0.7): prepara cada misión, sigue su meta y calcula las estrellas.
  3 // El estado de la misión vive en game.camp (solo datos simples, para que se guarde con la partida).
  4 
  5 const Campaign = {
  6   def(id) {
  7     return CAMPAIGN.find((m) => m.id === id) || null;
  8   },
  9 
 10   // Modo de juego de una misión: todos contra todos. Las monedas extra son solo para ti.
 11   mode(id) {
 12     const m = this.def(id);
 13     const teams = [];
 14     for (let i = 0; i < m.players; i++) teams.push(i);
 15     return { name: `Misión ${m.id} · ${m.name}`, players: m.players, teams, campaign: m.id };
 16   },
 17 
 18   // Opciones para empezar una misión: mapa y semilla fijos, así siempre es la misma isla.
 19   opts(id) {
 20     const m = this.def(id);
 21     return { mode: 'campaign', mission: id, mapKind: m.mapKind, difficulty: m.difficulty, seed: m.seed, personas: m.personas.slice() };
 22   },
 23 
 24   // Una misión está abierta si es la primera, si terminaste la anterior o en modo creador.
 25   unlocked(id, P, creator) {
 26     if (creator || id === 1) return true;
 27     return !!(P && P.campaign && P.campaign.done[id - 1]);
 28   },
 29 
 30   goalText(m) {
 31     const g = m.goal;
 32     if (g.kind === 'eco') return `Llega a ${fmt(g.income)} monedas por minuto y ten ${g.army} tropas de combate.`;
 33     if (g.kind === 'survive') return `Aguanta ${Math.round(g.time / 60)} minutos con tu Núcleo en pie.`;
 34     if (g.kind === 'hold') return `Toma el Faro y mantenlo ${g.time} s en total.`;
 35     if (g.kind === 'flags') return `Captura ${g.count} Banderas de otras islas.`;
 36     return m.players > 2 ? 'Sé el último Núcleo en pie.' : 'Destruye el Núcleo enemigo.';
 37   },
 38 
 39   starText(s) {
 40     if (s.kind === 'time') return `En menos de ${Math.round(s.max / 60)} min`;
 41     if (s.kind === 'lostBld') return s.max === 0 ? 'Sin perder edificios' : `Pierdes ${s.max} edificios o menos`;
 42     if (s.kind === 'lostUnits') return `Pierdes ${s.max} tropas o menos`;
 43     if (s.kind === 'coreEnd') return `Núcleo sobre el ${Math.round(s.min * 100)} % al terminar`;
 44     return `Tu Núcleo nunca baja del ${Math.round(s.min * 100)} %`;
 45   },
 46 
 47   // ---------- preparación ----------
 48   setup(g) {
 49     const m = this.def(g.opts.mission);
 50     const me = g.players[0];
 51     g.camp = {
 52       id: m.id, lostBld: 0, minCore: 1, faroHold: 0, flags: [], won: false, checkT: 0,
 53       homeComp: g.cells[me.core.cell].comp,
 54     };
 55     if (m.coins) me.coins = m.coins;
 56     for (const bot of g.bots) {
 57       if (m.passive) bot.passive = true;
 58       if (m.firstWave) bot.nextWaveAt = m.firstWave + Math.random() * 15;
 59       if (m.waveEvery) bot.waveMult = m.waveEvery;
 60       if (m.enemyStart) this.giveStart(g, bot.pid, m.enemyStart);
 61       if (m.fortress) this.fortify(g, bot.pid);
 62       if (m.guardFlags) this.guardFlags(g, bot.pid, m.guardFlags);
 63       if (m.guardFaro) this.guardPoints(g, bot.pid, g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'faro'), m.guardFaro.units);
 64     }
 65     if (m.myStart) this.giveStart(g, 0, m.myStart);
 66     g.recomputeTerritory();
 67     g.refreshEconomy();
 68   },
 69 
 70   // Casilla libre más cercana al Núcleo donde cabe ese edificio (en su territorio o en agua libre).
 71   spotFor(g, pid, type) {
 72     const core = g.cells[g.players[pid].core.cell];
 73     let best = -1;
 74     let bd = Infinity;
 75     for (const c of g.cells) {
 76       if (c.bld || c.point || (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== pid)) continue;
 77       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 78       if (d > 8 || d < 2) continue;
 79       const why = g.placeInvalid(pid, type, c.i, true);
 80       if (why && !(why === 'Fuera de tu territorio' && c.owner < 0 && type === 'harbor')) continue;
 81       if (type === 'harbor' && (c.t !== 'shallow' || !g.map.isCoast(c))) continue;
 82       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c.i; }
 83     }
 84     return best;
 85   },
 86 
 87   giveStart(g, pid, spec) {
 88     const p = g.players[pid];
 89     let harbor = null;
 90     for (const type of spec.buildings || []) {
 91       const ci = this.spotFor(g, pid, type);
 92       if (ci < 0) continue;
 93       const b = g.addBuilding(pid, type, ci, true);
 94       if (type === 'harbor') harbor = b;
 95       g.recomputeTerritory();
 96     }
 97     const sea = (spec.units || []).filter((t) => UNITS[t].mover === 'sea');
 98     const land = (spec.units || []).filter((t) => UNITS[t].mover !== 'sea');
 99     if (sea.length && harbor) {
100       const cells = g.freeCellsNear(harbor.cell, 'sea', pid, sea.length);
101       sea.forEach((t, k) => { if (cells[k] !== undefined) g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k]); });
102     }
103     const cells = g.freeCellsNear(p.core.cell, 'land', pid, land.length + 2);
104     land.forEach((t, k) => { if (cells[k + 2] !== undefined) g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k + 2]); });
105   },
106 
107   // Cruzar el mar: el rival ya tiene las Banderas de otras islas más cercanas a ti, con guardias.
108   guardFlags(g, pid, spec) {
109     const mine = g.cells[g.players[0].core.cell];
110     const flags = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'flag' && g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== g.camp.homeComp)
111       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(g.cells[a.cell], mine) - g.map.dist(g.cells[b.cell], mine)).slice(0, spec.count);
112     this.guardPoints(g, pid, flags, spec.units);
113   },
114 
115   // El rival empieza dueño de esos puntos, con guardias a su lado.
116   guardPoints(g, pid, points, units) {
117     for (const pt of points) {
118       pt.owner = pid;
119       pt.prog = 1;
120       pt.capTeam = g.players[pid].team;
121       const cells = g.freeCellsNear(pt.cell, 'land', pid, units.length);
122       units.forEach((t, k) => {
123         const u = g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k]);
124         u.role = 'guard';
125       });
126     }
127     g.territoryDirty = true;
128   },
129 
130   // Asedio: Núcleo en nivel 2, arco de murallas, Torretas de nivel 3 y 2 y AIR DEFENSE detrás.
131   fortify(g, pid) {
132     const core = g.players[pid].core;
133     const cc = g.cells[core.cell];
134     const mine = g.cells[g.players[0].core.cell];
135     const dir = Math.atan2(mine.z - cc.z, mine.x - cc.x);
136     const off = (c) => {
137       let a = Math.atan2(c.z - cc.z, c.x - cc.x) - dir;
138       while (a > Math.PI) a -= Math.PI * 2;
139       while (a < -Math.PI) a += Math.PI * 2;
140       return Math.abs(a);
141     };
142     const free = (c) => !c.bld && !c.point && TERRAIN[c.t].land && !['gold', 'fertile', 'oilland'].includes(c.t);
143     const ring = (d) => g.cells.filter((c) => g.map.dist(c, cc) === d && free(c)).sort((a, b) => off(a) - off(b));
144     const level = (b, lv) => {
145       if (lv <= 1) return;
146       b.upgrading = { level: lv, progress: 1 };
147       g.finishUpgrade(b);
148     };
149     level(core, 2);
150     // Muralla en arco (v0.9: también sobre tierra fértil, que ahora ocupa más casillas).
151     const wallRing = g.cells.filter((c) => g.map.dist(c, cc) === 3 && !c.bld && !c.point && TERRAIN[c.t].land && !['gold', 'oilland'].includes(c.t));
152     // Los 5 tramos más de frente, como en la v0.7.
153     wallRing.filter((c) => off(c) < 1.3).sort((a, b) => off(a) - off(b)).slice(0, 5).forEach((c) => g.addBuilding(pid, 'wall', c.i, true));
154     const r2 = ring(2);
155     const picks = [];
156     const take = (ok) => {
157       const c = r2.find((x) => !picks.includes(x) && ok(x) && picks.every((p) => g.map.dist(p, x) >= 2));
158       if (c) picks.push(c);
159       return c;
160     };
161     const front = take(() => true);
162     if (front) level(g.addBuilding(pid, 'turret', front.i, true), 3);
163     for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
164       const c = take((x) => off(x) > 0.45 && off(x) < 2);
165       if (c) level(g.addBuilding(pid, 'turret', c.i, true), 2);
166     }
167     const back = [...r2].reverse().find((x) => !picks.includes(x) && off(x) > 1.8);
168     if (back) g.addBuilding(pid, 'aadef', back.i, true);
169   },
170 
171   // ---------- durante la partida ----------
172   update(g, dt) {
173     const c = g.camp;
174     if (!c || g.over || g.preview) return;
175     const core = g.players[0].core;
176     if (core.alive) c.minCore = Math.min(c.minCore, core.hp / core.maxHp);
177     c.checkT -= dt;
178     if (c.checkT > 0) return;
179     const step = 0.25 - c.checkT;
180     c.checkT = 0.25;
181     const m = this.def(c.id);
182     if (m.goal.kind === 'hold') {
183       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
184       if (faro && faro.owner === 0) c.faroHold += step;
185     } else if (m.goal.kind === 'flags') {
186       for (const pt of g.points) {
187         if (pt.type === 'flag' && pt.owner === 0 && g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== c.homeComp && !c.flags.includes(pt.id)) {
188           c.flags.push(pt.id);
189           g.emit('toast', { text: `Bandera de otra isla: ${c.flags.length} de ${m.goal.count}`, kind: 'good' });
190         }
191       }
192     }
193     if (this.goalMet(g)) this.win(g);
194   },
195 
196   army(g) {
197     return g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === 0 && u.def.weapon).length;
198   },
199 
200   goalMet(g) {
201     const c = g.camp;
202     const goal = this.def(c.id).goal;
203     const me = g.players[0];
204     if (!me.alive) return false;
205     if (goal.kind === 'eco') return me.income >= goal.income && this.army(g) >= goal.army;
206     if (goal.kind === 'survive') return g.time >= goal.time;
207     if (goal.kind === 'hold') return c.faroHold >= goal.time;
208     if (goal.kind === 'flags') return c.flags.length >= goal.count;
209     return false; // destroy: lo decide checkEnd cuando cae el último Núcleo rival
210   },
211 
212   win(g) {
213     if (g.over) return;
214     g.over = true;
215     g.result = 'victory';
216     g.camp.won = true;
217     g.emit('over', { result: 'victory', mission: true });
218   },
219 
220   // Líneas de la meta con su progreso (para el panel de objetivos).
221   goalLines(g) {
222     const c = g.camp;
223     const m = this.def(c.id);
224     const goal = m.goal;
225     const me = g.players[0];
226     if (goal.kind === 'eco') {
227       const army = this.army(g);
228       return [
229         { text: `Ingresos: ${fmt(me.income)} / ${fmt(goal.income)} por min`, done: me.income >= goal.income },
230         { text: `Tropas de combate: ${Math.min(army, goal.army)} / ${goal.army}`, done: army >= goal.army },
231       ];
232     }
233     if (goal.kind === 'survive') {
234       return [{ text: `Aguanta: ${fmtTime(Math.min(g.time, goal.time))} / ${fmtTime(goal.time)}`, done: g.time >= goal.time }];
235     }
236     if (goal.kind === 'hold') {
237       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
238       const now = faro && faro.owner === 0 ? ' · ¡es tuyo!' : '';
239       return [{ text: `Faro en tu poder: ${Math.floor(Math.min(c.faroHold, goal.time))} / ${goal.time} s${now}`, done: c.faroHold >= goal.time }];
240     }
241     if (goal.kind === 'flags') {
242       return [{ text: `Banderas de otras islas: ${Math.min(c.flags.length, goal.count)} / ${goal.count}`, done: c.flags.length >= goal.count }];
243     }
244     const rivals = g.players.filter((p) => !p.human);
245     const down = rivals.filter((p) => !p.alive).length;
246     if (rivals.length === 1) return [{ text: down ? 'Núcleo enemigo destruido' : 'Destruye el Núcleo enemigo', done: down > 0 }];
247     return [{ text: `Núcleos rivales caídos: ${down} / ${rivals.length}`, done: down >= rivals.length }];
248   },
249 
250   // Estrellas: la primera por terminar y dos por condiciones. final = al acabar la partida.
251   stars(g) {
252     const c = g.camp;
253     const m = this.def(c.id);
254     const me = g.players[0];
255     const won = c.won || (g.over && g.result === 'victory');
256     const core = me.core;
257     const coreK = core && core.alive ? core.hp / core.maxHp : 0;
258     const out = [{ text: 'Termina la misión', ok: won, live: true, why: won ? '' : 'No se cumplió la meta' }];
259     for (const s of m.stars) {
260       let ok;
261       let live;
262       let why;
263       let now;
264       if (s.kind === 'time') {
265         live = g.time < s.max;
266         ok = won && live;
267         now = live ? `quedan ${fmtTime(s.max - g.time)}` : 'se acabó el tiempo';
268         why = `Tardaste ${fmtTime(g.time)}`;
269       } else if (s.kind === 'lostBld' || s.kind === 'lostUnits') {
270         const n = s.kind === 'lostBld' ? c.lostBld : me.stats.lost;
271         live = n <= s.max;
272         ok = won && live;
273         now = `llevas ${n}`;
274         why = `Perdiste ${n} ${s.kind === 'lostBld' ? (n === 1 ? 'edificio' : 'edificios') : (n === 1 ? 'tropa' : 'tropas')}`;
275       } else if (s.kind === 'coreEnd') {
276         live = coreK >= s.min;
277         ok = won && live;
278         now = `ahora ${Math.round(coreK * 100)} %`;
279         why = `Tu Núcleo terminó al ${Math.round(coreK * 100)} %`;
280       } else {
281         live = c.minCore >= s.min;
282         ok = won && live;
283         now = `mínimo ${Math.round(c.minCore * 100)} %`;
284         why = `Tu Núcleo bajó al ${Math.round(c.minCore * 100)} %`;
285       }
286       if (!won && live) why = 'Hay que terminar la misión';
287       out.push({ text: this.starText(s), ok, live, now, why: ok ? '' : why });
288     }
289     return out;
290   },
291 };

faro/src/js/05-ai.js · 1,279 líneas

   1 'use strict';
   2 // Bots (NPC): cada uno tiene una personalidad. Construyen economía, se expanden, planifican un
   3 // ejército mixto que contrarresta al enemigo, agrupan sus oleadas, se retiran heridos, reparan,
   4 // capturan puntos (también cruzando el mar) y hablan con el jugador.
   5 
   6 const unitCat = (u) => (u.cls === 'ship' || u.cls === 'sub' ? 'sea' : u.cls);
   7 // Tropas rápidas para hostigar la economía enemiga (v0.8).
   8 // Orden de preferencia: Jeep, Lancha, Ranger (sin Fábrica ni Puerto) y Helicóptero.
   9 const FAST_UNITS = { jeep: 'veh', speedboat: 'sea', ranger: 'inf', heli: 'air' };
  10 const ECO_TYPES = ['farm', 'mine', 'pump', 'rig'];
  11 
  12 class Bot {
  13   constructor(game, pid) {
  14     this.g = game;
  15     this.pid = pid;
  16     const p = game.players[pid];
  17     this.pkey = p.persona || 'aggro';
  18     this.persona = PERSONALITIES[this.pkey];
  19     this.tac = game.diff.tactics;
  20     this.t = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
  21     this.wave = Math.max(4, Math.round(game.diff.wave * this.persona.waveSize));
  22     this.nextWaveAt = game.diff.firstWave * this.persona.firstWave + Math.random() * 30;
  23     this.claimed = new Set();
  24     this.defendT = 0;
  25     // Dos bolsas: economía (edificios, expansión) y ejército (tropas).
  26     this.ecoBank = p.coins * 0.75;
  27     this.milBank = p.coins * 0.25;
  28     this.lastT = 0;
  29     this.saveFor = null;
  30     this.raid = null;
  31     this.threatAt = -99;
  32     this.siegeAt = -99;
  33     this.ferryTrips = 0;
  34     // v0.8: fuego concentrado, hostigamiento, Torreta de defensa y ayuda a aliados.
  35     p.focusFire = !!this.tac.focus;
  36     p.snipe = !!this.tac.snipe;
  37     this.nextHarassAt = 200 + Math.random() * 60;
  38     this.wantFast = -99;
  39     this.turretAt = -99;
  40     this.helpAt = {};
  41     this.lastTarget = null;
  42     this.harassSent = 0;
  43     this.firstHarassAt = -1;
  44     this.defTurrets = 0;
  45     this.helpSent = 0;
  46     this.lastDefense = null;
  47     // Métricas para las pruebas.
  48     this.wavesSent = 0;
  49     this.waveSizes = [];
  50     this.retreats = 0;
  51     this.repairs = 0;
  52     this.firstWaveAt = -1;
  53   }
  54 
  55   get p() {
  56     return this.g.players[this.pid];
  57   }
  58 
  59   // v1.3: si otro bot ya pensó en este paso (busy), espera al siguiente: así nunca piensan dos
  60   // a la vez y el paso más lento de la simulación baja.
  61   update(dt, busy = false) {
  62     if (!this.p.alive) return false;
  63     this.t -= dt;
  64     this.defendT -= dt;
  65     if (this.t > 0 || busy) return false;
  66     this.t = this.g.diff.think * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
  67     this.think();
  68     return true;
  69   }
  70 
  71   targetArmy() {
  72     return 3 + Math.floor(this.g.time / 22);
  73   }
  74 
  75   think() {
  76     const g = this.g;
  77     const p = this.p;
  78     g.refreshEconomy();
  79     const mine = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === this.pid);
  80     const units = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid);
  81     const army = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).length;
  82 
  83     // Reparte lo ganado desde la última decisión entre las dos bolsas.
  84     const gained = (p.income * g.incomeMult(p) * (g.time - this.lastT)) / 60;
  85     this.lastT = g.time;
  86     const T = g.time;
  87     const base = T < 50 ? 0.2 : army < this.targetArmy() ? (T < 240 ? 0.45 : 0.55) : 0.38;
  88     const overdue = T > this.nextWaveAt + 60 ? 0.15 : 0;
  89     const milShare = clamp(base + overdue + (T < 50 ? 0 : this.persona.milShare), 0.1, 0.8);
  90     this.milBank += gained * milShare;
  91     this.ecoBank += gained * (1 - milShare);
  92     const total = this.milBank + this.ecoBank;
  93     if (total > p.coins) {
  94       // Gastos no anotados (puestos, barcos ingenieros): salen primero de la economía.
  95       let excess = total - p.coins;
  96       const fromEco = Math.min(this.ecoBank, excess);
  97       this.ecoBank -= fromEco;
  98       excess -= fromEco;
  99       this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - excess);
 100     } else if (total < p.coins) {
 101       this.ecoBank += p.coins - total;
 102     }
 103 
 104     this.defend(units);
 105     if (g.mode.tutorial) return;
 106     this.staffBuilders(mine, units);
 107     this.build(mine);
 108     this.expand(mine, units);
 109     this.produce(mine, units);
 110     if (this.tac.retreat) this.retreat(units, mine);
 111     this.repairBase(units, mine);
 112     // Campaña: un vecino tranquilo no ataca ni sale a capturar.
 113     if (this.passive) return;
 114     this.attack(units);
 115     this.ferry(mine, units);
 116     if (this.tac.harass) this.harass(units);
 117     if (this.tac.teamwork) this.helpAllies(units);
 118     if (this.tac.focus) this.useNuke(mine);
 119   }
 120 
 121   // Misil nuclear (v0.9, desde Normal): solo pasados 20 min, contra el Núcleo enemigo más cercano.
 122   useNuke(mine) {
 123     const g = this.g;
 124     if (g.time < (this.tac.earlyNuke ? 900 : 1200)) return;
 125     const target = this.chooseEnemyCore();
 126     if (!target) return;
 127     // Difícil (v1.0): con los 3 listos y dinero, la salva de 3 (un Escudo antimisiles solo derriba uno).
 128     if (this.tac.earlyNuke && this.p.coins >= NUKE.cost * 3 + 3000 && !g.salvoInvalid(this.pid, target.cell)) {
 129       const n = g.launchSalvo(this.pid, target.cell);
 130       if (typeof n === 'number') {
 131         this.nukes = (this.nukes || 0) + n;
 132         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - NUKE.cost * n);
 133         return;
 134       }
 135     }
 136     for (const b of mine) {
 137       if (b.type !== 'aadef' || b.level < 4) continue;
 138       if (this.p.coins < NUKE.cost + 3000) return;
 139       if (g.nukeInvalid(b, target.cell)) continue;
 140       if (!g.launchNuke(b, target.cell)) {
 141         this.nukes = (this.nukes || 0) + 1;
 142         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - NUKE.cost);
 143         return;
 144       }
 145     }
 146   }
 147 
 148   coreCell() {
 149     return this.g.cells[this.p.core.cell];
 150   }
 151 
 152   // ---------- construcción ----------
 153   build(mine) {
 154     const g = this.g;
 155     const p = this.p;
 156     const T = g.time;
 157     const n = (t) => mine.filter((b) => b.type === t).length;
 158     const ownFree = (terrain) => g.cells.some((c) => c.owner === this.pid && c.t === terrain && !c.bld);
 159     const coast = g.cells.some((c) => c.owner === this.pid && c.t === 'shallow' && !c.bld && g.map.isCoast(c));
 160     const easy = g.opts.difficulty === 'easy';
 161     const plan = this.persona.plan;
 162     const core = p.core;
 163     const want = [];
 164     const open = g.opts.mapKind === 'open';
 165     // Sin constructores no se levanta nada: obras pendientes frente a constructores disponibles.
 166     const units = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid);
 167     const builders = units.filter((u) => u.def.builds === 'land').length;
 168     const sites = mine.filter((b) => g.needsWork(b) && (b.def.builtBy || 'land') !== 'sea').length;
 169     const tooBusy = sites >= builders * 2 + 1;
 170     // Base castigada por buques, aeronaves o artillería (o Núcleo muy dañado): Cúpula primero.
 171     const shelled = p.navalHitAt !== undefined && T - p.navalHitAt < 90;
 172     if (core.level >= 3 && (!p.dome || (p.dome.level < 3 && T > 700)) && (shelled || core.hp < core.maxHp * 0.8 || T > 650)) want.push('dome');
 173     if (n('farm') < 2) want.push('farm');
 174     if (n('barracks') < 1 && T > 10) want.push('barracks');
 175     // Sin camino por tierra a ningún Núcleo enemigo: el Puerto (y la Barcaza) van primero.
 176     const landReach = g.players.some((q) => q.alive && g.isEnemy(q.id, this.pid) && q.core.alive &&
 177       g.cells[q.core.cell].comp === this.coreCell().comp);
 178     if (!landReach && coast && n('harbor') < 1 && T > 45) want.push('harbor');
 179     if (this.persona.harborFirst && coast && n('harbor') < 1 && T > 60) want.push('harbor');
 180     if (this.milBank > 2500) {
 181       if (!open && n('factory') < 2 && T > 240) want.push('factory');
 182       else if (n('barracks') < 3) want.push('barracks');
 183     }
 184     if (ownFree('fertile') && n('farm') < 4) want.push('farm');
 185     const factoryAt = plan.veh >= 3 ? 120 : 170;
 186     if (n('factory') < 1 && T > (open ? 300 : factoryAt)) want.push('factory');
 187     const energyB = mine.filter((b) => b.def.cat === 'energy').length;
 188     const heavyNow = n('factory') + n('harbor') + n('helipad');
 189     if (energyB < 1 && (heavyNow > 0 || T > 200)) want.push(n('wind') < 8 ? 'wind' : 'solar');
 190     if (p.popCap - p.popUsed < 6 && p.popCap < MAX_POP) {
 191       const houseUp = mine.find((b) => b.type === 'house' && b.built && !b.upgrading && b.level < b.def.maxLevel);
 192       if (n('house') < g.limitFor(this.pid, 'house')) want.push('house');
 193       else if (houseUp) want.push('up:house');
 194     }
 195     if (heavyNow && p.energy < 60 && energyB < Math.min(5, 1 + n('factory') + n('helipad') + n('harbor'))) {
 196       want.push(ownFree('shallow') && n('hydro') < 2 ? 'hydro' : n('wind') < 8 ? 'wind' : 'solar');
 197     }
 198     if (T > 240 && core.level < 2 && n('barracks') >= 1 && energyB >= 1) want.push('up:core');
 199     if (ownFree('gold') && n('mine') < 2) want.push('mine');
 200     if (ownFree('oilland') && n('pump') < 2) want.push('pump');
 201     if (n('harbor') < 1 && coast && open) want.push('harbor');
 202     if (ownFree('gold') && n('mine') < 3 + Math.floor(T / 300)) want.push('mine');
 203     if (n('harbor') < 1 && coast && T > (plan.sea >= 3 ? 90 : 240)) want.push('harbor');
 204     const enemyAir = g.units.some((u) => u.cls === 'air' && g.isEnemy(u.owner, this.pid));
 205     if (enemyAir && n('aadef') < 2 && T > 180) want.push('aadef');
 206     // Difícil (v1.0): en cuanto ve aviones enemigos, hasta 3 AIR DEFENSE y las mejora.
 207     if (enemyAir && this.tac.earlyAA) {
 208       if (n('aadef') < 3) want.unshift('aadef');
 209       else want.push('up:aadef');
 210     }
 211     // Mejoras: Núcleo primero (nivel 3 abre la Cúpula), luego economía y defensas.
 212     const fast = this.tac.fastUp;
 213     if (T > (fast ? 200 : 260) && core.level < 2) want.push('up:core');
 214     if (T > (fast ? 400 : 520) && core.level < 3) want.push('up:core');
 215     if (T > 300) want.push('up:farm', 'up:mine', 'up:pump', 'up:barracks');
 216     if (T > 420) want.push('up:turret', 'up:barracks');
 217     const turretCap = Math.round(4 * this.persona.turrets);
 218     if (n('turret') < Math.min(turretCap, Math.floor(((T - 60) * this.persona.turrets) / 120))) want.push('turret');
 219     if (n('harbor') && (ownFree('oil') || this.seaSpot('rig') >= 0)) want.push('rig');
 220     if (n('harbor') && heavyNow > 1 && p.energy < 80 && n('tidal') < 2 && this.seaSpot('tidal') >= 0) want.push('tidal');
 221     if (!easy && plan.air >= 1 && n('helipad') < 1 && T > (plan.air >= 2 ? 300 : 380)) want.push('helipad');
 222     if (ownFree('fertile') && n('farm') < Math.min(10, 3 + Math.floor(T / 70))) want.push('farm');
 223     if (ownFree('oilland') && n('pump') < 2 + Math.floor(T / 300)) want.push('pump');
 224     if (n('barracks') < 2 && T > 280) want.push('barracks');
 225     if (n('hospital') < 1 && T > (this.tac.retreat ? 300 : 420)) want.push('hospital');
 226     if (n('factory') < 2 && T > 480 && !open) want.push('factory');
 227     if (n('harbor') < 2 && coast && T > (plan.sea >= 3 ? 300 : 420)) want.push('harbor');
 228     // v0.9: Aeropuerto, AIR DEFENSE de nivel 4 (misil nuclear) y Escudo antimisiles si el rival tiene misiles.
 229     if (!easy && plan.air >= 1 && n('airport') < 1 && T > (plan.air >= 2 ? 540 : 720)) want.push('airport');
 230     const nukeT = this.tac.earlyNuke ? 800 : 1000;
 231     if (this.tac.focus && T > nukeT && n('aadef') >= 1) want.push('up:aadef');
 232     if (this.tac.focus && T > nukeT && n('aadef') < 1) want.push('aadef');
 233     const enemyNuke = g.buildings.some((b) => b.alive && b.type === 'aadef' && b.level >= 4 && g.isEnemy(b.owner, this.pid));
 234     // v0.9: con más de 15 000 monedas guardadas (pasados 15 min) invierte en aire y defensa antiaérea:
 235     // Aeropuerto, un segundo Helipuerto y AIR DEFENSE hasta el nivel 4 (misil nuclear).
 236     if (!easy && T > 900 && p.coins > 15000) {
 237       if (this.milBank > 8000) {
 238         this.ecoBank += this.milBank * 0.5;
 239         this.milBank *= 0.5;
 240       }
 241       const rich = [];
 242       if (n('airport') < 1) rich.push('airport');
 243       if (n('aadef') < 2) rich.push('aadef');
 244       if (n('aadef') >= 1) rich.push('up:aadef');
 245       if (n('helipad') < 2) rich.push('helipad');
 246       want.unshift(...rich);
 247     }
 248     if (enemyNuke && n('antinuke') < 1) want.unshift('antinuke');
 249 
 250     // Una mejora barata cada ~minuto (Granja, Mina, Bomba o Casa) aunque haya otras compras esperando.
 251     if (T > 300 && T - (this.cheapUpAt || 0) > (fast ? 35 : 60) && !tooBusy) {
 252       const cand = mine.filter((x) => ['farm', 'mine', 'pump', 'house'].includes(x.type) && x.built && !x.upgrading && x.level < x.def.maxLevel)
 253         .sort((x, y) => g.upgradeCost(x) - g.upgradeCost(y))[0];
 254       if (cand && this.ecoBank >= g.upgradeCost(cand)) {
 255         const uc = g.upgradeCost(cand);
 256         if (typeof g.upgrade(cand) !== 'string') {
 257           this.ecoBank -= uc;
 258           this.cheapUpAt = T;
 259         }
 260       }
 261     }
 262     if (!want.length) {
 263       this.milBank += this.ecoBank * 0.5;
 264       this.ecoBank *= 0.5;
 265       return;
 266     }
 267     let actions = 0;
 268     for (const type of want) {
 269       if (actions >= 2) break;
 270       if (type.startsWith('up:')) {
 271         const t = type.slice(3);
 272         const b = mine.find((x) => x.type === t && x.built && !x.upgrading && x.level < x.def.maxLevel);
 273         if (!b || tooBusy) continue;
 274         const uc = g.upgradeCost(b);
 275         if (this.ecoBank < uc) {
 276           if (t === 'core') break;
 277           continue;
 278         }
 279         if (typeof g.upgrade(b) !== 'string') {
 280           this.ecoBank -= uc;
 281           actions++;
 282         }
 283         continue;
 284       }
 285       if (type === 'dome') {
 286         const dc = g.domeCost(this.pid);
 287         if (this.ecoBank + this.milBank < dc) break;
 288         if (!g.buyDome(this.pid)) {
 289           const fromEco = Math.min(this.ecoBank, dc);
 290           this.ecoBank -= fromEco;
 291           this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - (dc - fromEco));
 292           actions++;
 293         }
 294         continue;
 295       }
 296       const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 297       if (!def.sea && tooBusy) continue;
 298       const cost = def.cost;
 299       if (this.ecoBank < cost || p.coins < cost) break;
 300       if (def.energyCost && p.energy < def.energyCost) continue;
 301       const ci = def.sea ? this.seaSpot(type) : this.pickCell(type);
 302       if (ci < 0) continue;
 303       if (!g.place(this.pid, type, ci)) {
 304         this.ecoBank -= cost;
 305         actions++;
 306       }
 307     }
 308   }
 309 
 310   // Estructuras de mar: el lugar libre más cercano a la base (puede estar fuera del territorio).
 311   seaSpot(type) {
 312     const g = this.g;
 313     const core = this.coreCell();
 314     let best = -1;
 315     let bd = Infinity;
 316     for (const c of g.cells) {
 317       if (c.bld || (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== this.pid)) continue;
 318       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 319       if (d > 9) continue;
 320       if (g.placeInvalid(this.pid, type, c.i, true)) continue;
 321       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c.i; }
 322     }
 323     return best;
 324   }
 325 
 326   // Constructores: 2 al empezar y más a medida que crece la base (máximo 5).
 327   // Barco constructor si hay estructuras de mar esperando.
 328   staffBuilders(mine, units) {
 329     const g = this.g;
 330     const want = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor(mine.length / 6));
 331     const have = units.filter((u) => u.def.builds === 'land').length +
 332       mine.reduce((s, b) => s + b.queue.filter((q) => UNITS[q.type].builds === 'land').length, 0);
 333     const sieged = g.time - this.siegeAt < 15;
 334     if (have < want && (!sieged || have === 0)) {
 335       const prod = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.def.produces && b.def.produces.includes('builder') && b.queue.length < 2)
 336         .sort((a, b) => a.queue.length - b.queue.length)[0];
 337       if (prod && this.p.coins >= UNITS.builder.cost && !g.enqueue(prod, 'builder')) {
 338         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - UNITS.builder.cost);
 339       }
 340     }
 341     const seaWork = mine.some((b) => g.needsWork(b) && b.def.builtBy === 'sea');
 342     if (seaWork) this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', 'boatEng');
 343   }
 344 
 345   pickCell(type) {
 346     const g = this.g;
 347     const core = this.coreCell();
 348     let best = -1;
 349     let bestS = Infinity;
 350     const toCenter = Math.hypot(core.x, core.z) || 1;
 351     for (const c of g.cells) {
 352       if (c.owner !== this.pid || c.bld || c.bridge) continue;
 353       if (g.placeInvalid(this.pid, type, c.i)) continue;
 354       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 355       if (d < 2 && type !== 'turret') continue;
 356       let s = Math.random() * 1.5;
 357       if (type === 'turret') {
 358         const dot = -(c.x * core.x + c.z * core.z) / toCenter;
 359         s += Math.abs(d - 2.5) * 2 - dot * 0.3;
 360       } else if (type === 'farm' || type === 'house') {
 361         s += Math.abs(d - 3);
 362       } else if (type === 'mine' || type === 'rig' || type === 'harbor') {
 363         s += d * 0.3;
 364       } else {
 365         s += d * 1.2;
 366       }
 367       // Evita tapar el paso: penaliza casillas con pocas vecinas libres.
 368       let free = 0;
 369       for (const ni of c.nb) {
 370         const nc = g.cells[ni];
 371         if (TERRAIN[nc.t].land && !nc.bld) free++;
 372       }
 373       if (TERRAIN[c.t].land && free < 3) s += 4;
 374       if (s < bestS) { bestS = s; best = c.i; }
 375     }
 376     return best;
 377   }
 378 
 379   // ---------- expansión ----------
 380   expand(mine, units) {
 381     const g = this.g;
 382     const T = g.time;
 383     if (T < 25) return;
 384     const outposts = mine.filter((b) => b.type === 'outpost').length;
 385     const maxOut = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor(T / 200));
 386     const busy = units.filter((u) => u.def.founds && u.state === 'found');
 387     if (outposts + busy.length >= maxOut) return;
 388     this.claimed = new Set(busy.map((u) => u.foundCell));
 389 
 390     const landEng = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'engineer' && u.state !== 'found' && u.state !== 'repair' && u.state !== 'build');
 391     const target = this.findExpansion('land');
 392     if (target >= 0) {
 393       if (landEng.length) {
 394         if (this.p.coins >= BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) g.orderFound(landEng[0], target);
 395       } else {
 396         this.queueOnce(mine, 'barracks', 'engineer');
 397       }
 398     }
 399     const harbors = mine.filter((b) => b.type === 'harbor' && b.built);
 400     if (harbors.length && T > 140) {
 401       const boats = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'boatEng' && u.state !== 'found');
 402       const st = this.findExpansion('sea');
 403       if (st >= 0) {
 404         if (boats.length) {
 405           if (this.p.coins >= BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) g.orderFound(boats[0], st);
 406         } else if ((this.boatEngs || 0) < 3 && this.ecoBank >= UNITS.boatEng.cost + BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) {
 407           if (this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', 'boatEng')) this.boatEngs = (this.boatEngs || 0) + 1;
 408         }
 409       }
 410     }
 411   }
 412 
 413   queueOnce(mine, btype, utype) {
 414     const g = this.g;
 415     const builders = mine.filter((b) => b.type === btype && b.built);
 416     if (!builders.length) return false;
 417     if (builders.some((b) => b.queue.some((q) => q.type === utype))) return false;
 418     if (g.units.some((u) => u.owner === this.pid && u.type === utype)) return false;
 419     if (g.enqueue(builders[0], utype)) return false;
 420     // Barcaza: gasto militar. Ingenieros: gasto de expansión.
 421     if (utype === 'barge' || utype === 'lander') this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - UNITS[utype].cost);
 422     else this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - UNITS[utype].cost);
 423     return true;
 424   }
 425 
 426   findExpansion(how) {
 427     const g = this.g;
 428     const core = this.coreCell();
 429     let best = -1;
 430     let bestS = Infinity;
 431     for (const r of g.cells) {
 432       if ((r.t !== 'gold' && r.t !== 'oil') || r.owner !== -1 || r.bld) continue;
 433       if (how === 'land' && r.t === 'oil') continue;
 434       for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 435         if (off.d > 2) break;
 436         const c = g.map.get(r.q + off.q, r.r + off.r);
 437         if (!c || this.claimed.has(c.i) || c.owner !== -1) continue;
 438         if (g.foundInvalid(this.pid, c.i, how)) continue;
 439         if (how === 'land' && c.comp !== core.comp) continue;
 440         const s = g.map.dist(c, core) + off.d * 0.5;
 441         if (s < bestS) { bestS = s; best = c.i; }
 442       }
 443     }
 444     return best;
 445   }
 446 
 447   // ---------- producción: plan de ejército y contrarrestos ----------
 448   enemyMix() {
 449     const g = this.g;
 450     const mix = { inf: 0, veh: 0, sea: 0, air: 0, total: 0 };
 451     for (const u of g.units) {
 452       if (!u.alive || !u.def.weapon || !g.isEnemy(u.owner, this.pid)) continue;
 453       mix[unitCat(u)]++;
 454       mix.total++;
 455     }
 456     for (const k of ['inf', 'veh', 'sea', 'air']) mix[k] = mix.total ? mix[k] / mix.total : 0;
 457     return mix;
 458   }
 459 
 460   pickUnit(producers, units) {
 461     const g = this.g;
 462     const T = g.time;
 463     const open = g.opts.mapKind === 'open';
 464     const cats = {};
 465     for (const b of producers) {
 466       if (b.type === 'barracks') cats.inf = 'barracks';
 467       else if (b.type === 'factory') cats.veh = 'factory';
 468       else if (b.type === 'harbor') cats.sea = 'harbor';
 469       else if (b.type === 'helipad') cats.air = 'helipad';
 470       else if (b.type === 'airport') cats.plane = 'airport';
 471     }
 472     const have = { inf: 0, veh: 0, sea: 0, air: 0, plane: 0 };
 473     const catOf = (d) => (d.plane ? 'plane' : unitCat(d));
 474     for (const u of units) if (u.def.weapon) have[catOf(u.def.cls ? { ...u.def, cls: u.cls } : u.def)]++;
 475     for (const b of producers) {
 476       for (const q of b.queue) if (UNITS[q.type].weapon) have[catOf(UNITS[q.type])]++;
 477     }
 478     const plan = { ...this.persona.plan, plane: Math.max(1, this.persona.plan.air) };
 479     if (open) {
 480       plan.sea += 2;
 481       plan.inf = Math.max(1, plan.inf - 1);
 482     }
 483     // v0.9: con mucho dinero guardado, más aviones (Cazas y Bombarderos).
 484     if (T > 900 && this.p.coins > 15000) plan.plane += 2;
 485     // Energía acumulada: prioriza tropas que la usan.
 486     if (this.p.energy > 120) {
 487       plan.veh += 2;
 488       plan.sea += 1;
 489       plan.air += 1;
 490     }
 491     const mix = this.enemyMix();
 492     if (this.tac.counter && mix.total >= 3) {
 493       if (mix.air >= 0.12) plan.veh += 2;
 494       if (mix.sea >= 0.25) plan.sea += 2;
 495       if (mix.veh >= 0.3) plan.inf += 1;
 496     }
 497     // Hostigamiento: si faltan tropas rápidas, entrena una (Jeep, Lancha o Helicóptero).
 498     if (this.tac.harass && T - this.wantFast < 40) {
 499       const fastHave = units.filter((u) => FAST_UNITS[u.type]).length +
 500         producers.reduce((s, b) => s + b.queue.filter((q) => FAST_UNITS[q.type]).length, 0);
 501       const opt = Object.entries(FAST_UNITS).find(([t, c]) => cats[c] && (t !== 'heli' || this.p.energy >= UNITS.heli.energy));
 502       if (opt && fastHave < 3) return { type: opt[0], btype: cats[opt[1]], since: T };
 503     }
 504     // Recién empezada la partida, o bajo ataque: infantería rápida.
 505     const urgent = T < 120 || g.time - this.threatAt < 12;
 506     let avail = Object.keys(cats);
 507     if (urgent && cats.inf) avail = ['inf'];
 508     let best = null;
 509     let bestGap = -Infinity;
 510     const planSum = avail.reduce((s, c) => s + plan[c], 0) || 1;
 511     const haveSum = avail.reduce((s, c) => s + have[c], 0) || 1;
 512     for (const c of avail) {
 513       const gap = plan[c] / planSum - have[c] / haveSum + Math.random() * 0.05;
 514       if (gap > bestGap) { bestGap = gap; best = c; }
 515     }
 516     if (!best) return null;
 517     return { type: this.unitFor(best, mix, have, units), btype: cats[best], since: T };
 518   }
 519 
 520   unitFor(cat, mix, have, units) {
 521     const T = this.g.time;
 522     const r = Math.random();
 523     const counter = this.tac.counter && mix.total >= 3;
 524     if (cat === 'plane') {
 525       // Aeropuerto: Cazas si el rival tiene aire; si no, sobre todo Bombarderos.
 526       return (mix.air >= 0.1 && r < 0.75) || r < 0.35 ? 'fighter' : 'bomber';
 527     }
 528     if (cat === 'inf') {
 529       if (T < 90) return r < 0.7 ? 'rifle' : 'shotgun';
 530       const infN = units.filter((u) => u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon).length;
 531       if (infN >= 6 && !units.some((u) => u.type === 'medic') && r < 0.25) return 'medic';
 532       if (counter && mix.veh >= 0.3) return r < 0.65 ? 'rocket' : 'rifle';
 533       if (counter && mix.inf >= 0.6) return r < 0.3 ? 'sniper' : r < 0.55 ? 'breaker' : r < 0.75 ? 'hunter' : 'rifle';
 534       return r < 0.3 ? 'rifle' : r < 0.45 ? 'ranger' : r < 0.58 ? 'shotgun' : r < 0.78 ? 'rocket' : r < 0.88 ? 'sniper' : r < 0.95 ? 'breaker' : 'hunter';
 535     }
 536     if (cat === 'veh') {
 537       const aaHave = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'aa').length;
 538       if (counter && mix.air >= 0.12 && aaHave < 3) return 'aa';
 539       if (counter && mix.veh >= 0.3) return r < 0.7 ? 'tank' : 'jeep';
 540       if (counter && mix.inf >= 0.6) return r < 0.55 ? 'jeep' : 'tank';
 541       if (mix.air > 0 && aaHave < 1) return 'aa';
 542       if (T < 300) return r < 0.5 ? 'jeep' : 'lighttank';
 543       return r < 0.16 ? 'lighttank' : r < 0.34 ? 'tank' : r < 0.5 ? 'heavytank' : r < 0.6 ? 'jeep' : r < 0.7 ? 'arty'
 544         : r < 0.8 ? 'missiletruck' : r < 0.9 ? 'launcher' : 'apc';
 545     }
 546     if (cat === 'sea') {
 547       if (counter && mix.air >= 0.15 && r < 0.4) return 'frigate';
 548       if (counter && mix.sea >= 0.25) return r < 0.5 ? 'destroyer' : 'sub';
 549       if (T > 900 && this.p.coins > UNITS.carrier.cost * 1.2 && !units.some((u) => u.type === 'carrier') && r < 0.5) return 'carrier';
 550       return r < 0.45 ? 'destroyer' : r < 0.7 ? 'speedboat' : r < 0.85 ? 'frigate' : 'sub';
 551     }
 552     // El Apache no tiene límite (v0.9): con dinero de sobra, el bot lleva tantos Apaches como Helicópteros.
 553     const nApache = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'apache').length;
 554     const nHeli = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'heli').length;
 555     return nApache <= nHeli && this.p.coins > UNITS.apache.cost * 1.2 ? 'apache' : 'heli';
 556   }
 557 
 558   produce(mine, units) {
 559     const g = this.g;
 560     const p = this.p;
 561     const producers = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.def.produces);
 562     if (!producers.length) {
 563       this.ecoBank += this.milBank;
 564       this.milBank = 0;
 565       return;
 566     }
 567     let budget = Math.min(p.coins, this.milBank);
 568     for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
 569       if (!this.saveFor || !producers.some((b) => b.type === this.saveFor.btype)) this.saveFor = this.pickUnit(producers, units);
 570       const s = this.saveFor;
 571       if (!s) return;
 572       const def = UNITS[s.type];
 573       const b = producers.filter((x) => x.type === s.btype && x.queue.length < 2)
 574         .sort((a, c) => a.queue.length - c.queue.length)[0];
 575       if (!b) return;
 576       if (def.cost > budget || p.energy < (def.energy || 0)) {
 577         // Ahorra para esta tropa; si tarda demasiado, vuelve a planificar.
 578         if (g.time - s.since > 70) this.saveFor = null;
 579         return;
 580       }
 581       const err = g.enqueue(b, s.type);
 582       this.saveFor = null;
 583       if (err) return;
 584       budget -= def.cost;
 585       this.milBank -= def.cost;
 586     }
 587   }
 588 
 589   // ---------- combate ----------
 590   defend(units) {
 591     const g = this.g;
 592     if (this.defendT > 0) return;
 593     this.defendT = 2;
 594     const core = this.coreCell();
 595     let threat = null;
 596     let td = Infinity;
 597     for (const e of g.units) {
 598       if (!e.alive || e.inside || !g.isEnemy(e.owner, this.pid)) continue;
 599       const c = g.cells[e.cell];
 600       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 601       if (c.owner === this.pid || d <= 5) {
 602         if (d < td) { td = d; threat = e; }
 603       }
 604     }
 605     if (!threat) return;
 606     // Urgencia (comprar infantería rápida) solo si el peligro está junto al Núcleo y el ejército es pequeño.
 607     const armySize = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).length;
 608     if (td <= 4 && armySize < 8) this.threatAt = g.time;
 609     if (td <= 3) this.siegeAt = g.time;
 610     // Una oleada que se estaba reuniendo vuelve a defender si el peligro está cerca del Núcleo.
 611     if (this.raid && td <= 4) {
 612       for (const u of this.raid.units) if (u.alive && u.role === 'raid') u.role = 'home';
 613       this.raid = null;
 614     }
 615     // Defensa en equipo (v0.8): van todas las tropas de casa, también las que salen de la producción,
 616     // y los hostigadores que estén cerca. Los guardias se quedan cuidando sus Banderas.
 617     const tc = g.cells[threat.cell];
 618     const near = (u) => g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], tc) <= 10;
 619     const guards = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && !u.inside && g.canAttack(u, u.def.weapon, threat) &&
 620       (u.role === 'home' || (u.role === 'harass' && near(u))) &&
 621       (u.state === 'idle' || u.state === 'move' || (u.state === 'amove' && u.role !== 'raid')));
 622     for (const u of guards) if (u.role !== 'home') u.role = 'home';
 623     const nearby = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'retreat' && near(u));
 624     this.lastDefense = { t: g.time, cell: tc.i, near: nearby.length, sent: guards.filter(near).length,
 625       fighting: nearby.filter((u) => u.state === 'attack' || guards.includes(u)).length };
 626     if (this.tac.turret && td <= 7) this.defenseTurret(tc);
 627     const byMover = { land: [], sea: [], air: [] };
 628     for (const u of guards) byMover[u.mover].push(u);
 629     if (byMover.land.length && TERRAIN[tc.t].land) g.orderMove(byMover.land, tc.i, true);
 630     if (byMover.air.length) g.orderMove(byMover.air, tc.i, true);
 631     if (byMover.sea.length) {
 632       const wc = this.waterNear(tc, byMover.sea[0]);
 633       if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove(byMover.sea, wc, true);
 634     }
 635   }
 636 
 637   // Tropas con menos del 30 % de vida vuelven a curarse y luego regresan.
 638   retreat(units, mine) {
 639     const g = this.g;
 640     const core = this.p.core;
 641     for (const u of units) {
 642       if (!u.def.weapon || u.inside) continue;
 643       if (u.role === 'retreat') {
 644         if (u.hp >= u.maxHp * 0.85) {
 645           u.role = 'home';
 646           u.state = 'idle';
 647         } else if (u.state === 'idle' && u.retreatTo >= 0 && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[u.retreatTo]) > 2) {
 648           g.orderMove([u], u.retreatTo, false);
 649         }
 650         continue;
 651       }
 652       // Difícil (v1.0): retira a los heridos antes (45 % de vida) para curarlos.
 653       if (u.hp >= u.maxHp * (this.tac.medevac ? 0.45 : 0.3)) continue;
 654       const comp = g.cells[u.cell].comp;
 655       let spot = null;
 656       let sd = Infinity;
 657       const consider = (b) => {
 658         if (!b.alive || !b.built) return;
 659         const bc = g.cells[b.cell];
 660         if (u.mover === 'land' && bc.comp !== comp) return;
 661         if (u.mover === 'sea' && !bc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === comp) && bc.comp !== comp) return;
 662         const d = g.map.dist(bc, g.cells[u.cell]);
 663         if (d < sd) { sd = d; spot = b; }
 664       };
 665       if (u.mover === 'sea') {
 666         for (const b of mine) if (b.type === 'harbor') consider(b);
 667       } else if (u.mover === 'air' && g.repairPadFor(u)) {
 668         consider(g.repairPadFor(u));
 669       } else {
 670         if (u.mover === 'land') for (const b of mine) if (b.type === 'hospital') consider(b);
 671         if (!spot || sd > 8) consider(core);
 672       }
 673       if (!spot) continue;
 674       const dest = g.freeCellsNear(spot.cell, u.mover, this.pid, 1)[0];
 675       u.role = 'retreat';
 676       u.retreatTo = dest;
 677       u.target = null;
 678       if (this.raid) this.raid.units = this.raid.units.filter((x) => x !== u);
 679       g.orderMove([u], dest, false);
 680       this.retreats++;
 681     }
 682   }
 683 
 684   // Ingenieros libres reparan los edificios dañados de la base.
 685   repairBase(units, mine) {
 686     const g = this.g;
 687     const engs = units.filter((u) => u.def.repairs && u.state === 'idle' && !u.inside);
 688     if (!engs.length) return;
 689     const damaged = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.hp < b.maxHp * 0.9 && g.time - b.lastHit > REPAIR.pause)
 690       .sort((a, b) => a.hp / a.maxHp - b.hp / b.maxHp);
 691     for (const b of damaged) {
 692       const bc = g.cells[b.cell];
 693       const e = engs.find((x) => !g.isUnreach(x, b) && (g.cells[x.cell].comp === bc.comp || bc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === g.cells[x.cell].comp)));
 694       if (!e) continue;
 695       g.orderRepair([e], b);
 696       engs.splice(engs.indexOf(e), 1);
 697       this.repairs++;
 698       if (!engs.length) return;
 699     }
 700   }
 701 
 702   waterNear(target, ship) {
 703     const g = this.g;
 704     const comp = g.cells[ship.cell].comp;
 705     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 706       if (off.d > 5) break;
 707       const c = g.map.get(target.q + off.q, target.r + off.r);
 708       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld && c.comp === comp) return c.i;
 709     }
 710     return -1;
 711   }
 712 
 713   coastNear(target, ship) {
 714     const g = this.g;
 715     const comp = g.cells[ship.cell].comp;
 716     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 717       if (off.d > 6) break;
 718       const c = g.map.get(target.q + off.q, target.r + off.r);
 719       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld && c.comp === comp && g.map.isCoast(c)) return c.i;
 720     }
 721     return -1;
 722   }
 723 
 724   // Banderas sin dueño de tu equipo a las que no se llega por tierra.
 725   farFlags() {
 726     const g = this.g;
 727     const core = this.coreCell();
 728     const team = this.p.team;
 729     return g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'flag' && (pt.owner < 0 || g.players[pt.owner].team !== team) &&
 730       g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== core.comp)
 731       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(g.cells[a.cell], core) - g.map.dist(g.cells[b.cell], core));
 732   }
 733 
 734   // Barcaza: lleva tropas a islas sin camino por tierra (Núcleos enemigos, el Faro o Banderas).
 735   ferry(mine, units) {
 736     const g = this.g;
 737     if (g.time < 200 || !mine.some((b) => b.type === 'harbor' && b.built)) return;
 738     const core = this.coreCell();
 739     const landReach = g.players.some((p) => p.alive && g.isEnemy(p.id, this.pid) && p.core.alive &&
 740       g.cells[p.core.cell].comp === core.comp);
 741     const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
 742     const faroByLand = !g.mode.king || !faro || g.cells[faro.cell].comp === core.comp;
 743     const flagsWanted = this.farFlags().length > 0 &&
 744       (!landReach || this.pkey === 'admiral' || this.pkey === 'keeper' || g.time > 420);
 745     if (landReach && faroByLand && !flagsWanted) return;
 746     // v0.9: pasados 10 minutos y con dinero, usa la Lancha de desembarco (más rápida, 10 lugares).
 747     const t = units.find((u) => u.type === 'barge' || u.type === 'lander');
 748     if (!t) {
 749       this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', g.time > 600 && this.p.coins > 4000 ? 'lander' : 'barge');
 750       return;
 751     }
 752     t.botMode = t.botMode || 'load';
 753     if (t.botMode === 'load') {
 754       if (t.state !== 'idle') return;
 755       if (g.map.dist(g.cells[t.cell], core) > 7) {
 756         const wc = this.coastNear(core, t);
 757         if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove([t], wc);
 758         return;
 759       }
 760       const boarding = units.filter((u) => u.state === 'board' && u.boardTarget === t);
 761       let slots = t.def.capacity - g.cargoSlots(t) - boarding.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1), 0);
 762       const pick = [];
 763       for (const u of units) {
 764         if (u.mover !== 'land' || !u.def.weapon || u.inside || u.role !== 'home' || u.state !== 'idle') continue;
 765         const need = u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
 766         if (need <= slots) {
 767           pick.push(u);
 768           slots -= need;
 769         }
 770       }
 771       if (pick.length) g.orderBoard(pick, t);
 772       t.loadT = (t.loadT || 0) + g.diff.think;
 773       const full = g.cargoSlots(t) >= t.def.capacity - 1;
 774       if (full || (t.cargo.length >= 3 && t.loadT > 60)) {
 775         const target = this.ferryTarget(landReach);
 776         if (!target) return;
 777         const wc = this.coastNear(g.cells[target.cell], t);
 778         if (wc < 0) return;
 779         for (const u of boarding) u.state = 'idle';
 780         t.botMode = 'sail';
 781         t.botTarget = target;
 782         t.loadT = 0;
 783         this.ferryTrips++;
 784         if (target.kind === 'bld') {
 785           this.coreRaids = (this.coreRaids || 0) + 1;
 786           if (this.firstRaidAt === undefined) this.firstRaidAt = g.time;
 787         }
 788         g.orderMove([t], wc);
 789       }
 790     } else if (t.botMode === 'sail') {
 791       if (t.state !== 'idle') return;
 792       const res = g.unload(t);
 793       if (typeof res !== 'string') {
 794         let target = t.botTarget && t.botTarget.alive ? t.botTarget : this.ferryTarget(landReach);
 795         if (target && target.kind === 'point') {
 796           const team = this.p.team;
 797           if (target.owner >= 0 && g.players[target.owner].team === team) target = null;
 798         }
 799         if (target && target.kind === 'point') {
 800           for (const u of res) {
 801             u.role = 'cap';
 802             u.capPoint = target;
 803             u.capSince = g.time;
 804           }
 805         } else {
 806           for (const u of res) u.role = 'wave';
 807         }
 808         if (target) g.orderMove(res, target.cell, true);
 809       }
 810       t.botMode = 'return';
 811       const wc = this.coastNear(core, t);
 812       if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove([t], wc);
 813     } else if (t.botMode === 'return' && t.state === 'idle') {
 814       t.botMode = 'load';
 815     }
 816   }
 817 
 818   ferryTarget(landReach = true) {
 819     const g = this.g;
 820     if (g.mode.king) {
 821       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
 822       if (faro && (faro.owner < 0 || g.players[faro.owner].team !== this.p.team)) return faro;
 823     }
 824     const flags = this.farFlags();
 825     const flagFirst = this.pkey === 'keeper' || this.pkey === 'admiral' || this.ferryTrips % 2 === 1 || landReach;
 826     if (flags.length && flagFirst) return flags[0];
 827     if (landReach) return flags[0] || null;
 828     return this.chooseEnemyCore() || flags[0] || null;
 829   }
 830 
 831   // ---------- órdenes de un aliado humano (v1.1) ----------
 832   // «¡Ayuda!»: manda hasta la mitad de su ejército (máx. 8) a defender la base del aliado.
 833   answerHelp(pid) {
 834     const g = this.g;
 835     const ally = g.players[pid];
 836     if (!this.p.alive || !ally || !ally.core || !ally.core.alive || g.isEnemy(pid, this.pid)) return 0;
 837     const home = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid && u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'guard');
 838     if (!home.length) {
 839       g.say(this.pid, 'No tengo tropas libres ahora, ¡aguanta!', { force: true, toMe: true });
 840       return 0;
 841     }
 842     const go = home.slice(0, Math.min(8, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(home.length / 2))));
 843     const sent = this.sendTo(go, { cell: ally.core.cell });
 844     for (const u of sent) u.role = 'help';
 845     this.helpAt[pid] = g.time;
 846     if (sent.length) this.helpSent++;
 847     g.say(this.pid, sent.length ? `¡Voy a ayudarte con ${sent.length} tropas!` : 'No llego a tu base desde aquí.', { force: true, toMe: true });
 848     return sent.length;
 849   }
 850 
 851   // «¡Ataquemos!»: ataca ya al rival que elegiste y lo prefiere en sus oleadas por 3 minutos.
 852   answerAttack(targetPid) {
 853     const g = this.g;
 854     const foe = g.players[targetPid];
 855     if (!this.p.alive || !foe || !foe.alive || !g.isEnemy(targetPid, this.pid)) return 0;
 856     this.focusPid = targetPid;
 857     this.focusUntil = g.time + 180;
 858     const target = foe.core && foe.core.alive ? foe.core : g.buildings.find((b) => b.alive && b.owner === targetPid);
 859     if (!target) return 0;
 860     const army = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid && u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'guard');
 861     const go = army.slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(army.length * 0.7)));
 862     const sent = go.length ? this.sendTo(go, target) : [];
 863     for (const u of sent) u.role = 'help';
 864     this.lastTarget = target;
 865     g.say(this.pid, sent.length ? `¡Vamos por ${foe.name}! Mando ${sent.length} tropas.` : `Atacaré a ${foe.name} con la próxima oleada.`, { force: true, toMe: true });
 866     return sent.length;
 867   }
 868 
 869   chooseEnemyCore() {
 870     const g = this.g;
 871     const core = this.coreCell();
 872     // v1.1: el rival que pidió el aliado humano con «¡Ataquemos!».
 873     if (this.focusPid !== undefined && g.time < this.focusUntil) {
 874       const f = g.players[this.focusPid];
 875       if (f && f.alive && f.core && f.core.alive && g.isEnemy(f.id, this.pid)) return f.core;
 876     }
 877     let cores = g.players
 878       .filter((p) => p.alive && g.isEnemy(p.id, this.pid) && p.core.alive)
 879       .map((p) => ({ p, d: g.map.dist(g.cells[p.core.cell], core) }))
 880       .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
 881     if (!cores.length) return null;
 882     // Primero los Núcleos a los que el ejército llega a pie.
 883     const byLand = cores.filter((c) => g.cells[c.p.core.cell].comp === core.comp);
 884     if (byLand.length) cores = byLand;
 885     // Aliados coordinados (v0.8): atacan al mismo rival que un aliado bot.
 886     if (this.tac.teamwork) {
 887       for (const b of g.bots) {
 888         if (b === this || b.p.team !== this.p.team || !b.p.alive) continue;
 889         const t = b.lastTarget;
 890         if (t && t.alive && cores.some((c) => c.p.core === t) && Math.random() < 0.8) {
 891           this.lastTarget = t;
 892           return t;
 893         }
 894       }
 895     }
 896     const pickI = cores.length > 1 && Math.random() < 0.3 ? 1 : 0;
 897     this.lastTarget = cores[pickI].p.core;
 898     return this.lastTarget;
 899   }
 900 
 901   sendTo(units, targetB) {
 902     const g = this.g;
 903     const tc = g.cells[targetB.cell];
 904     const land = [];
 905     const air = [];
 906     const sea = [];
 907     for (const u of units) {
 908       if (u.mover === 'air') air.push(u);

 924   defenseTurret(threatCell) {

 957       if (!b.alive || !g.isEnemy(b.owner, this.pid) || !ECO_TYPES.includes(b.type)) continue;
 958       const c = g.cells[b.cell];

1063   // Envía escuadras de infantería a capturar Banderas y el Faro; deja un guardia en cada punto.
1064   capture(units) {
1065     const g = this.g;
1066     const T = g.time;
1067     if (T < 45) return;
1068     const myTeam = this.p.team;
1069     const core = this.coreCell();

1077           u.role = 'cap';
1078           u.capSince = T;
1079         } else {
1080           guards.set(pt, u);
1081           if (u.state === 'idle' && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[pt.cell]) > 1) g.orderMove([u], pt.cell, true);
1082           continue;
1083         }
1084       }
1085       if (u.role !== 'cap') continue;
1086       const pt = u.capPoint;
1087       const held = pt && pt.owner >= 0 && g.players[pt.owner].team === myTeam;
1088       if (!pt || (held && T - (u.capSince || 0) > (king && pt.type === 'faro' ? 9999 : 90))) {
1089         if (pt && held && !guards.has(pt) && guards.size < 3) {
1090           u.role = 'guard';
1091           guards.set(pt, u);
1092         } else {
1093           u.role = 'home';
1094           u.capPoint = null;
1095         }
1096         continue;
1097       }
1098       squads.set(pt, (squads.get(pt) || 0) + 1);
1099       if (u.state === 'idle' && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[pt.cell]) > 1) g.orderMove([u], pt.cell, true);
1100     }
1101     const maxSquads = (king ? 3 : 2) + this.persona.capture;
1102     if (squads.size >= maxSquads) return;
1103     const faroBias = (king ? 30 : 6) + this.persona.capture * 6;
1104     const targets = g.points
1105       .filter((pt) => !squads.has(pt) && (pt.owner < 0 || g.players[pt.owner].team !== myTeam))
1106       .filter((pt) => g.cells[pt.cell].comp === core.comp)
1107       .map((pt) => ({ pt, d: g.map.dist(g.cells[pt.cell], core) - (pt.type === 'faro' ? faroBias : 0) }))
1108       .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
1109     if (!targets.length) return;
1110     const pt = targets[0].pt;
1111     const size = pt.type === 'faro' ? (king ? 6 : 4) : 3;
1112     const free = units.filter((u) => u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon && u.role === 'home' && !u.inside &&
1113       (u.state === 'idle' || u.state === 'move'));
1114     if (free.length < size + (T < 200 ? 0 : 2)) return;
1115     const squad = free.slice(0, size);
1116     for (const u of squad) {
1117       u.role = 'cap';
1118       u.capPoint = pt;
1119       u.capSince = T;
1120     }
1121     g.orderMove(squad, pt.cell, true);
1122   }

1139   announce(units, target) {

1157   launch(units, target, announced = false) {

1207       r.units = r.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.role === 'raid');
1208       if (!r.units.length) {
1209         this.raid = null;
1210         return;
1211       }
1212       const st = g.cells[r.stage];
1213       const ready = r.units.filter((u) => u.mover === 'sea' || g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 3).length;
1214       // No sale mientras su aviso de ataque espera turno (el límite de mensajes es de 20 s).
1215       const warning = this.p.pendingSay && this.p.pendingSay.opts.queue === 3;
1216       if ((ready >= r.units.length * 0.8 && !warning) || g.time - r.start > 25) {
1217         // Las rezagadas (a más de 5 casillas) se quedan en casa: nadie llega solo al combate.
1218         const go = r.units.filter((u) => u.mover !== 'land' || g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 5);
1219         for (const u of r.units) if (!go.includes(u)) u.role = 'home';
1220         this.raid = null;
1221         if (go.length < 3) {
1222           for (const u of go) u.role = 'home';

1225         }

1227         const near = land.filter((u) => g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 4).length;

1235     if (this.tac.focus && g.time > 900 && g.time >= this.nextWaveAt) {
1236       const home = army.filter((u) => u.role === 'home');
1237       if (home.length >= 12) {

  66     this.renderer.setPixelRatio(q === 'high' ? Math.min(dpr, 2) : 1);
  67     this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled = q === 'high';
  68     this.renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate = true;
  69     // Más fluido: sin la luz de ambiente del cielo y la mitad de partículas.
  70     if (this.scene) this.scene.environment = q === 'high' && ENV_MAP ? ENV_MAP : null;
  71     if (this.fxs) this.fxs.scale = q === 'high' ? 1 : 0.5;
  72     // v0.9: Más fluido usa materiales Lambert (más livianos) y Alta un reflejo del cielo algo más fuerte.
  73     FAST_MATS = q !== 'high';
  74     GLB_MAT.envMapIntensity = 0.68;
  75     if (this.scene) {
  76       this.scene.traverse((o) => {
  77         if (!o.material) return;
  78         if (o.isMesh) o.material = fastMat(o.material, FAST_MATS);
  79         o.material.needsUpdate = true;
  80       });
  81     }
  82     this.resize();
  83   }
  84 
  85   resize() {
  86     const w = this.canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
  87     const h = this.canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
  88     this.width = w;
  89     this.height = h;
  90     this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  91     if (this.camera) {
  92       this.camera.aspect = w / h;
  93       this.camera.fov = w < h ? 55 : 42;
  94       this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  95     }
  96     const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  97     this.overlay.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
  98     this.overlay.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
  99     this.octx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
 100     if (this.fxs && this.camera) {
 101       // Tamaño de las partículas en píxeles reales del dibujo.
 102       const hpx = h * this.renderer.getPixelRatio();
 103       this.fxs.setScale(hpx / (2 * Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360)));
 104     }
 105   }

 107   // ---------- terreno ----------
 108   // v0.9: vuelve el suelo de la v0.6 (colores lisos por terreno, sin texturas).
 109   buildTerrain() {
 110     const cells = this.game.cells;
 111     const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.985, 0.985, 1, 6, 1, false, Math.PI / 6);
 112     geo.translate(0, -0.5, 0);
 113     const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ flatShading: true, roughness: 0.95, metalness: 0 });
 114     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, cells.length);
 115     mesh.receiveShadow = true;
 116     const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 117     const rng = mulberry32(this.game.opts.seed + 5);
 118     this.baseColors = [];
 119     for (const c of cells) {
 120       const h = c.h;
 121       m.makeScale(1, h + 1.4, 1);
 122       m.setPosition(c.x, h, c.z);
 123       mesh.setMatrixAt(c.i, m);
 124       const col = new THREE.Color(terrainColor(this.game.map.kind, c.t));
 125       const v = (rng() - 0.5) * (TERRAIN[c.t].water ? 0.04 : 0.09);
 126       col.offsetHSL(0, 0, v);
 127       this.baseColors.push(col);
 128       mesh.setColorAt(c.i, col);
 129     }
 130     mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
 131     this.terrain = mesh;
 132     this.scene.add(mesh);
 133 
 134     const ocean = new THREE.Mesh(
 135       new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 600),
 136       new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x175a85, roughness: 0.6 }),
 137     );
 138     ocean.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
 139     ocean.position.y = -0.09;
 140     ocean.receiveShadow = true;
 141     this.scene.add(ocean);
 142   }

 144   tintTerritory() {
 145     const g = this.game;
 146     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 147     for (const c of g.cells) {
 148       tmp.copy(this.baseColors[c.i]);
 149       if (c.owner >= 0) tmp.lerp(new THREE.Color(PLAYER_COLORS[c.owner]), TERRAIN[c.t].water ? 0.1 : 0.16);
 150       this.terrain.setColorAt(c.i, tmp);
 151     }
 152     this.terrain.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
 153   }

 155   buildDecor() {
 156     const g = this.game;
 157     const rng = mulberry32(g.opts.seed + 9);
 158     const trees = [];
 159     const peaks = [];
 160     const golds = [];
 161     const oils = [];
 162     const rocks = [];
 163     for (const c of g.cells) {
 164       if (c.t === 'forest') {
 165         const k = 2 + Math.floor(rng() * 2);
 166         c.trees = [];
 167         for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 168           const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
 169           const r = 0.2 + rng() * 0.45;
 170           c.trees.push(trees.length);
 171           trees.push({ x: c.x + Math.cos(a) * r, y: c.h, z: c.z + Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.75 + rng() * 0.5, c: c.i });
 172         }
 173       } else if (c.t === 'mount') {
 174         peaks.push({ x: c.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.2, y: c.h, z: c.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.2, s: 0.85 + rng() * 0.35, c: c.i });
 175       } else if (c.t === 'gold') {
 176         c.golds = [];
 177         for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
 178           const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + rng();
 179           c.golds.push(golds.length);
 180           golds.push({ x: c.x + Math.cos(a) * 0.4, y: c.h + 0.1, z: c.z + Math.sin(a) * 0.4, s: 0.12 + rng() * 0.06, c: c.i });
 181         }
 182       } else if (c.t === 'oil') {
 183         c.oil = oils.length;
 184         oils.push({ x: c.x, y: c.h + 0.015, z: c.z, s: 0.62, c: c.i });
 185       } else if ((c.t === 'grass' || c.t === 'sand') && rng() < 0.07) {
 186         rocks.push({ x: c.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.1, y: c.h, z: c.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.1, s: 0.09 + rng() * 0.08, c: c.i });
 187       }
 188     }
 189     const inst = (geo, mat, list, place, shadow = true) => {
 190       const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, Math.max(1, list.length));
 191       mesh.count = list.length;
 192       const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 193       list.forEach((it, i) => mesh.setMatrixAt(i, place(it, m)));
 194       mesh.castShadow = shadow;
 195       mesh.receiveShadow = true;
 196       this.scene.add(mesh);
 197       return mesh;
 198     };
 199     const flat = (color, extra = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, flatShading: true, roughness: 0.9, ...extra });
 200     const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.06, 0.25, 5);
 201     trunkGeo.translate(0, 0.125, 0);
 202     const crownGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.26, 0.62, 6);
 203     crownGeo.translate(0, 0.52, 0);
 204     const placeTree = (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z);
 205     this.trees = trees;
 206     this.treeTrunks = inst(trunkGeo, flat(0x7a5232), trees, placeTree);
 207     this.treeCrowns = inst(crownGeo, flat(0x3f8a3a), trees, placeTree);
 208     const tc = new THREE.Color();
 209     trees.forEach((t, i) => {
 210       tc.set(0x3f8a3a).offsetHSL((rng() - 0.5) * 0.04, 0, (rng() - 0.5) * 0.12);
 211       this.treeCrowns.setColorAt(i, tc);
 212     });
 213 
 214     const peakGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.88, 1.5, 6);
 215     peakGeo.translate(0, 0.75, 0);
 216     const capGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.36, 0.6, 6);
 217     capGeo.translate(0, 1.21, 0);
 218     const placePeak = (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z);
 219     inst(peakGeo, flat(0x8f8a80), peaks, placePeak);
 220     inst(capGeo, flat(0xf4f6f8), peaks, placePeak);
 221 
 222     this.golds = golds;
 223     this.goldMesh = inst(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),
 224       flat(0xffcf3a, { emissive: 0x8a6400, emissiveIntensity: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 }), golds,
 225       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 1.5, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s, it.z));
 226     this.oils = oils;
 227     const oilGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 0.02, 10);
 228     this.oilMesh = inst(oilGeo, flat(0x161a20, { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.4 }), oils,
 229       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, 1, it.s * 0.8).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z), false);
 230     inst(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), flat(0x9a978f), rocks,
 231       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 0.7, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s * 0.4, it.z));
 232   }

 234   // Oculta árboles, oro y petróleo bajo los edificios.
 235   refreshDecor() {
 236     const g = this.game;
 237     const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 238     const zero = new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0);
 239     this.trees.forEach((t, i) => {
 240       const hidden = !!g.cells[t.c].bld;
 241       const mat = hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(t.s, t.s, t.s).setPosition(t.x, t.y, t.z);
 242       this.treeTrunks.setMatrixAt(i, mat);
 243       this.treeCrowns.setMatrixAt(i, mat);
 244     });
 245     this.treeTrunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
 246     this.treeCrowns.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
 247     this.golds.forEach((it, i) => {
 248       const hidden = !!g.cells[it.c].bld;
 249       this.goldMesh.setMatrixAt(i, hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 1.5, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s, it.z));
 250     });
 251     this.goldMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
 252     this.oils.forEach((it, i) => {
 253       const hidden = !!g.cells[it.c].bld;
 254       this.oilMesh.setMatrixAt(i, hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(it.s, 1, it.s * 0.8).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z));
 255     });
 256     this.oilMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
 257   }

 267   rebuildBorders() {
 268     const g = this.game;
 269     const pos = [];
 270     const col = [];
 271     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 272     for (const c of g.cells) {
 273       if (c.owner < 0) continue;
 274       tmp.set(PLAYER_COLORS[c.owner]);
 275       const y = Math.max(c.h, 0) + 0.035;
 276       for (const [dq, dr] of HEX_DIRS) {
 277         const n = g.map.get(c.q + dq, c.r + dr);
 278         if (n && n.owner === c.owner) continue;
 279         const w = hexToWorld(dq, dr);
 280         const a = Math.atan2(w.z, w.x);
 281         const a1 = a - Math.PI / 6;
 282         const a2 = a + Math.PI / 6;
 283         const o = 0.97;
 284         const i = 0.8;
 285         const p1 = [c.x + Math.cos(a1) * o, y, c.z + Math.sin(a1) * o];
 286         const p2 = [c.x + Math.cos(a2) * o, y, c.z + Math.sin(a2) * o];
 287         const p3 = [c.x + Math.cos(a2) * i, y, c.z + Math.sin(a2) * i];
 288         const p4 = [c.x + Math.cos(a1) * i, y, c.z + Math.sin(a1) * i];
 289         pos.push(...p1, ...p3, ...p2, ...p1, ...p4, ...p3);
 290         for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) col.push(tmp.r, tmp.g, tmp.b);
 291       }
 292     }
 293     const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 294     geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
 295     geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
 296     this.borderMesh.geometry.dispose();
 297     this.borderMesh.geometry = geo;
 298   }

 344       new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.45, depthWrite: false }));

 367   // ¿Cae en el agua? Entonces salpica.
 368   overWater(x, z) {
 369     const h = worldToHex(x, z);
 370     const c = this.game.map.get(h.q, h.r);
 371     return !!(c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld);

 374   spawnBoom(x, y, z, s, small, bld) {
 375     if (small) {
 376       if (this.overWater(x, z)) this.fxs.splash(x, z, s);
 377       else this.fxs.impact(x, y, z, s);
 378     } else {
 379       this.fxs.explosion(x, y, z, s, bld);
 380       if (this.overWater(x, z)) this.fxs.splash(x, z, s * 1.2);
 381     }
 382   }

 384   // Láser del Núcleo (punto 17): un rayo ámbar brillante que dura un instante.
 385   spawnLaser(f) {
 386     if (!this.lasers) {
 387       this.lasers = [];
 388       this.laserGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8, 1, true).rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
 389     }
 390     let L = this.lasers.find((l) => l.t >= l.dur);
 391     if (!L) {
 392       if (this.lasers.length >= 12) return;
 393       const outer = new THREE.Mesh(this.laserGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
 394       const inner = new THREE.Mesh(this.laserGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfff4d6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, depthWrite: false }));
 395       const grp = new THREE.Group();
 396       grp.add(outer);
 397       grp.add(inner);
 398       this.scene.add(grp);
 399       L = { grp, outer, inner, t: 1, dur: 0.18 };
 400       this.lasers.push(L);
 401     }
 402     const a = new THREE.Vector3(f.x1, f.y1, f.z1);
 403     const b = new THREE.Vector3(f.x2, f.y2, f.z2);
 404     const len = a.distanceTo(b);
 405     L.grp.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
 406     L.grp.lookAt(b);
 407     L.outer.scale.set(0.09, 0.09, len);
 408     L.inner.scale.set(0.035, 0.035, len);
 409     L.grp.visible = true;
 410     L.t = 0;
 411   }
 412 
 413   updateLasers(dt) {
 414     if (!this.lasers) return;
 415     for (const L of this.lasers) {
 416       if (L.t >= L.dur) { L.grp.visible = false; continue; }
 417       L.t += dt;
 418       const k = 1 - L.t / L.dur;
 419       L.outer.material.opacity = 0.6 * k;
 420       L.inner.material.opacity = 0.95 * k;
 421     }
 422     this.laserCount = this.lasers.filter((L) => L.t < L.dur).length;
 423   }

 429   // Explosión del misil nuclear: destello enorme, bola de fuego y columna de humo (sin nada violento).
 430   spawnNuke(x, y, z) {
 431     this.fxs.flash(x, y + 1, z, 9);
 432     this.fxs.explosion(x, y + 0.3, z, 4, true);
 433     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
 434       const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
 435       this.fxs.explosion(x + Math.cos(a) * 3.5, y + 0.2, z + Math.sin(a) * 3.5, 1.6, true);
 436     }
 437     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) this.fxs.smoke(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, y + i * 0.35, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, 2.6);
 438     this.nukeFlashT = 1.2;
 439   }

 441   // Radiación (v1.0): fuego y humo sueltos dentro de la zona mientras dura.
 442   spawnRadBurn(f) {
 443     const n = this.quality === 'high' ? 3 : 1;
 444     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 445       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
 446       const d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * f.r * 0.85;
 447       const x = f.x + Math.cos(a) * d;
 448       const z = f.z + Math.sin(a) * d;
 449       if (Math.random() < 0.45) this.fxs.explosion(x, f.y + 0.15, z, 0.45, false);
 450       this.fxs.smoke(x, f.y + 0.4, z, 1.2);
 451     }
 452   }
