 454   // Disco verde de la zona de radiación, que late y se apaga al final.
 455   updateRadZones(time) {
 456     const g = this.game;
 457     const zones = g.radZones || [];
 458     if (!this.radMeshes) this.radMeshes = new Map();
 459     for (const [z, m] of this.radMeshes) {
 460       if (!zones.includes(z)) {
 461         this.scene.remove(m);
 462         m.material.dispose();
 463         this.radMeshes.delete(z);
 464       }
 465     }
 466     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
 467     for (const z of zones) {
 468       let m = this.radMeshes.get(z);
 469       if (!m) {
 470         if (!this.radGeo) {
 471           this.radGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 40);
 472           this.radGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
 473         }
 474         m = new THREE.Mesh(this.radGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x7cff4a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
 475         m.scale.setScalar(R);
 476         m.position.set(z.x, z.y + 0.08, z.z);
 477         m.renderOrder = 3;
 478         this.scene.add(m);
 479         this.radMeshes.set(z, m);
 480       }
 481       const left = Math.max(0, z.until - g.time);
 482       const fade = Math.min(1, left / 8);
 483       m.material.opacity = (0.16 + 0.1 * Math.sin(time * 3)) * fade;
 484     }
 485   }
 486 
 487   consumeFx() {
 488     const g = this.game;
 489     for (const f of g.fx) {
 490       if (f.k === 'laser') this.spawnLaser(f);
 491       else if (f.k === 'tracer') {
 492         if (this.tracers.length < this.MAXT) this.tracers.push({ ...f, t: 0, dur: f.heavy ? 0.12 : 0.07 });
 493         // Fogonazo en el cañón y chispa donde pega.
 494         if (f.heavy || Math.random() < 0.6) this.fxs.flash(f.x1, f.y1, f.z1, f.heavy ? 0.36 : 0.24);
 495         if (Math.random() < 0.35) this.fxs.sparks(f.x2, f.y2, f.z2, 0.4, 1);
 496       } else if (f.k === 'boom') this.spawnBoom(f.x, f.y, f.z, f.s, f.small, f.bld);
 497       else if (f.k === 'spark') this.fxs.sparks(f.x, f.y, f.z, f.s, 2);
 498       else if (f.k === 'heal') this.spawnHeal(f.x, f.y, f.z);
 499       else if (f.k === 'flare') {
 500         // Bengalas del Apache: chispas brillantes hacia los lados.
 501         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.fxs.sparks(f.x, f.y, f.z, 1.2, 4);
 502         this.fxs.flash(f.x, f.y, f.z, 0.6);
 503       } else if (f.k === 'nuke') this.spawnNuke(f.x, f.y, f.z);
 504       else if (f.k === 'rad') this.spawnRadBurn(f);
 505     }
 506     g.fx.length = 0;
 507   }
 508 
 509   updateFx(dt) {
 510     // Trazadoras
 511     let n = 0;
 512     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 513     this.tracers = this.tracers.filter((t) => (t.t += dt) < t.dur);
 514     for (const t of this.tracers) {
 515       tmp.set(t.color).lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 0.55);
 516       const o = n * 6;
 517       this.tracerPos[o] = t.x1; this.tracerPos[o + 1] = t.y1; this.tracerPos[o + 2] = t.z1;
 518       this.tracerPos[o + 3] = t.x2; this.tracerPos[o + 4] = t.y2; this.tracerPos[o + 5] = t.z2;
 519       for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
 520         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3] = tmp.r;
 521         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3 + 1] = tmp.g;
 522         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3 + 2] = tmp.b;
 523       }
 524       n++;
 525     }
 526     this.tracerLines.geometry.setDrawRange(0, n * 2);
 527     this.tracerLines.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
 528     this.tracerLines.geometry.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true;
 529 
 530     this.fxs.update(dt);
 531 
 532     // Proyectiles
 533     const used = { rocket: 0, shell: 0, torpedo: 0, missile: 0, bomb: 0, nuke: 0 };
 534     for (const p of this.game.projectiles) {
 535       const list = this.projMeshes[p.kind];
 536       if (!list) continue;
 537       let mesh = list[used[p.kind]];
 538       if (!mesh) {
 539         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(this.projGeo[p.kind], this.projMat[p.kind]);
 540         this.scene.add(mesh);
 541         list.push(mesh);
 542       }
 543       used[p.kind]++;
 544       const k = Math.min(1, p.time / p.dur);
 545       const arc = p.kind === 'shell' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 1.1 : p.kind === 'rocket' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.35
 546         : p.kind === 'missile' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 2.6 : p.kind === 'nuke' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 14 : 0;
 547       const y = p.kind === 'torpedo' ? -0.02 : p.sy + (p.ty - p.sy) * k + arc;
 548       mesh.position.set(p.sx + (p.tx - p.sx) * k, y, p.sz + (p.tz - p.sz) * k);
 549       mesh.lookAt(p.tx, p.kind === 'torpedo' ? -0.02 : p.ty, p.tz);
 550       mesh.visible = true;
 551       // Estela de humo detrás de cohetes y misiles (más gruesa en el misil nuclear).
 552       if ((p.kind === 'rocket' || p.kind === 'missile') && Math.random() < dt * 45 * this.fxs.scale) {
 553         this.fxs.trail(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z);
 554       }
 555       if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
 556         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.fxs.trail(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z);
 557         this.fxs.flash(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z, 0.5);
 558       }
 559     }
 560     for (const kind of Object.keys(this.projMeshes)) {
 561       const list = this.projMeshes[kind];
 562       for (let i = used[kind]; i < list.length; i++) list[i].visible = false;
 563     }
 564 
 565     this.markers = this.markers.filter((mk) => {
 566       mk.t += dt;
 567       const k = mk.t / 0.6;
 568       if (k >= 1) {
 569         this.scene.remove(mk.mesh);
 570         return false;
 571       }
 572       mk.mesh.scale.setScalar(1.6 - k);
 573       mk.mesh.material.opacity = 1 - k;
 574       return true;
 575     });
 576   }

 614   buildShields() {
 615     this.shieldVis = this.game.players.map((p) => {
 616       const r = DOME.range * SQ3 + 0.5;
 617       const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 32, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
 618         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4aa8ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08, depthWrite: false }));
 619       const rim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(r, 0.05, 6, 48).rotateX(Math.PI / 2),
 620         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4aa8ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false }));
 621       dome.add(rim);
 622       dome.renderOrder = 6;
 623       dome.visible = false;
 624       const bubble = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.7, 24, 14),
 625         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, depthWrite: false }));
 626       bubble.renderOrder = 6;
 627       bubble.visible = false;
 628       this.scene.add(dome);
 629       this.scene.add(bubble);
 630       return { dome, rim, bubble };
 631     });

 634   updateShields(time) {
 635     const g = this.game;
 636     g.players.forEach((p, i) => {
 637       const v = this.shieldVis[i];
 638       const core = p.core;
 639       const domeOn = p.alive && core.alive && p.dome && p.dome.hp > 0;
 640       v.dome.visible = !!domeOn;
 641       if (domeOn) {
 642         const k = p.dome.hp / p.dome.maxHp;
 643         const col = k > 0.6 ? 0x4aa8ff : k > 0.3 ? 0xf2c94c : 0xef5350;
 644         v.dome.material.color.set(col);
 645         v.rim.material.color.set(col);
 646         const hit = g.time - p.dome.lastHit < 0.25;
 647         v.dome.material.opacity = hit ? 0.22 : 0.08;
 648         v.dome.position.set(core.x, core.y, core.z);
 649       }
 650       const shield = p.alive && core.alive && core.shieldUntil > g.time;
 651       v.bubble.visible = !!shield;
 652       if (shield) {
 653         v.bubble.position.set(core.x, core.y + 0.6, core.z);
 654         v.bubble.material.opacity = 0.22 + Math.sin(time * 6) * 0.08;
 655       }
 656     });
 657   }

 659   // ---------- vista previa de construcción ----------
 660   setGhost(type, ci, rot, valid) {
 661     if (this.ghost && (this.ghost.type !== type)) {
 662       this.scene.remove(this.ghost.group);
 663       this.ghost = null;
 664     }
 665     if (!type || ci < 0) {
 666       if (this.ghost) this.ghost.group.visible = false;
 667       return;
 668     }
 669     if (!this.ghost) {
 670       const m = getModel(type === 'wall' && GLB.wall_post ? 'wall_post' : type, PLAYER_COLORS[0]);
 671       // Holograma ámbar (documento pág. 7); rojo cuando no se puede.
 672       const okMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
 673       const badMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff5a5a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
 674       const group = new THREE.Group();
 675       const parts = [];
 676       const pp = m.partPos || {};
 677       for (const key of ['main', 'turret', 'rotor', 'rocker', 'blades', 'crystal']) {
 678         if (!m[key]) continue;
 679         const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(m[key], okMat);
 680         if (pp[key]) mesh.position.copy(pp[key]);
 681         else if (key === 'turret') mesh.position.set(0, m.turretY || 0, m.turretZ || 0);
 682         else if (key === 'rocker') mesh.position.set(0, m.rockerY, m.rockerZ || 0);
 683         else if (key === 'blades') mesh.position.set(0, m.bladesY, m.bladesZ);
 684         else if (key === 'crystal') mesh.position.y = m.crystalY;
 685         mesh.renderOrder = 7;
 686         group.add(mesh);
 687         parts.push(mesh);
 688       }
 689       this.scene.add(group);
 690       this.ghost = { type, group, parts, okMat, badMat };
 691     }
 692     const c = this.game.cells[ci];
 693     const gh = this.ghost;
 694     gh.group.visible = true;
 695     gh.group.position.set(c.x, c.h, c.z);
 696     gh.group.rotation.y = rot;
 697     for (const mesh of gh.parts) mesh.material = valid ? gh.okMat : gh.badMat;
 698     this.hoverMesh.material.color.set(valid ? 0x8dffb0 : 0xff6b6b);
 699     this.setHover(ci);
 700   }

 702   // Aspecto equipado en el Inventario: solo para tus tropas y tu Núcleo.
 703   lookFor(e) {
 704     const looks = this.game.opts.looks;
 705     if (!looks || e.owner !== 0) return null;
 706     return looks[skinSlotOf(e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : 'unit', e.type)] || null;
 707   }

 709   // ---------- entidades ----------
 710   syncEntities(dt, time) {
 711     const g = this.game;
 712     let smoking = 0;
 713     for (const e of g.removed) {
 714       const v = this.vis.get(e.id);
 715       if (v) {
 716         this.scene.remove(v.group);
 717         this.vis.delete(e.id);
 718       }
 719     }
 720     g.removed.length = 0;
 721 
 722     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
 723     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 724       // Núcleo, Torreta y Enfermería tienen un modelo distinto por nivel.
 725       const mkey = GLB[b.type + '_' + b.level] ? b.type + '_' + b.level : b.type;
 726       let v = this.vis.get(b.id);
 727       if (v && v.mkey !== mkey) {
 728         this.scene.remove(v.group);
 729         this.vis.delete(b.id);
 730         v = null;
 731       }
 732       if (!v) {
 733         v = b.type === 'wall' ? this.createWall(b) : createVisual(mkey, PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], this.lookFor(b));
 734         v.mkey = mkey;
 735         v.group.rotation.y = b.type === 'wall' ? 0 : b.rot;
 736         v.group.position.set(b.x, b.y, b.z);
 737         this.scene.add(v.group);
 738         this.vis.set(b.id, v);
 739       }
 740       if (b.type === 'wall') this.updateWall(b, v);
 741       // Humo de daño: un edificio con menos del 40 % de vida echa humo hasta que lo reparan.
 742       if (b.built && b.hp < b.maxHp * 0.4) {
 743         smoking++;
 744         v.smokeT = (v.smokeT || 0) - dt;
 745         if (v.smokeT <= 0) {
 746           v.smokeT = this.quality === 'high' ? 0.32 : 0.65;
 747           this.fxs.smoke(b.x, b.y + (b.type === 'core' ? 1.1 : 0.6), b.z, b.type === 'core' ? 0.8 : 0.55);
 748         }
 749       }
 750       const k = b.built ? 1 : 0.2 + 0.8 * b.progress;
 751       v.main.scale.y = k;
 752       // Andamio mientras se construye o se mejora.
 753       const working = !b.built || !!b.upgrading;
 754       if (working && !v.scaffold && GLB.scaffold) {
 755         v.scaffold = new THREE.Mesh(getModel('scaffold', PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]).main, fastMat(GLB_MAT, FAST_MATS));
 756         v.scaffold.rotation.y = -v.group.rotation.y;
 757         if (b.type === 'core') v.scaffold.scale.set(1.35, 1.6, 1.35);
 758         v.group.add(v.scaffold);
 759       }
 760       if (v.scaffold) v.scaffold.visible = working;
 761       if (v.turret) {
 762         v.turret.position.y = v.turretBaseY * k;
 763         v.turret.rotation.y = b.aimYaw - b.rot;
 764       }
 765       if (v.blades && b.built) {
 766         if (b.type === 'hydro') v.blades.rotation.x += dt * 1.6;
 767         else v.blades.rotation.z += dt * 2.2;
 768       }
 769       if (v.rocker) {
 770         v.rocker.visible = b.built;
 771         v.rocker.rotation.x = b.built ? Math.sin(time * 2.2 + b.id) * (b.type === 'wave' ? 0.12 : 0.28) : 0;
 772       }
 773       if (v.rotor && b.built) v.rotor.rotation.y += dt * 1.6;
 774       if (v.crystal) {
 775         v.crystal.rotation.y = time * 0.8;
 776         v.crystal.position.y = (v.crystalBaseY || 1.35) + Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 0.08;
 777         // v1.5: aro de luz del color del jugador que gira alrededor del cristal del Núcleo.
 778         if (b.type === 'core') {
 779           if (!v.halo) {
 780             const hm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], transparent: true, opacity: 0.75, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
 781             v.halo = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.36 + 0.05 * b.level, 0.022, 6, 32), hm);
 782             v.halo2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.3 + 0.05 * b.level, 0.016, 6, 32), hm);
 783             v.group.add(v.halo, v.halo2);
 784           }
 785           v.halo.position.y = v.crystal.position.y;
 786           v.halo2.position.y = v.crystal.position.y;
 787           v.halo.rotation.set(1.15, time * 1.4, 0);
 788           v.halo2.rotation.set(-1.0, -time * 1.1, 0.4);
 789         }
 790       }
 791     }
 792     this.smokingCount = smoking;
 793     // Movimiento de CMU solo en Alta calidad y con hasta 120 soldados a la vista (si no, balanceo simple).
 794     const gaitFull = !!CMU_GAIT && this.quality === 'high' && (this.soldiersSeen || 0) <= 120;
 795     let soldiers = 0;
 796     for (const u of g.units) {
 797       let v = this.vis.get(u.id);
 798       if (!v) {
 799         v = createVisual(u.type, PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner], this.lookFor(u));
 800         this.scene.add(v.group);
 801         this.vis.set(u.id, v);
 802       }
 803       const seen = !u.inside && (u.visible || g.players[u.owner].team === myTeam);
 804       v.group.visible = seen;
 805       if (!seen) continue;
 806       let y = u.y;
 807       if (u.mover === 'sea') y += Math.sin(time * 2.2 + u.id) * 0.025;
 808       if (u.mover === 'air') y += Math.sin(time * 1.7 + u.id) * 0.06;
 809       if (u.def.plane) {
 810         this.updatePlane(u, v, dt, time, y);
 811       } else {
 812         v.group.position.set(u.x, y, u.z);
 813         v.group.rotation.y = u.yaw;
 814         if (u.mover === 'air') v.group.rotation.x = u.moving ? 0.12 : 0;
 815       }
 816       if (v.turret) {
 817         const aiming = u.autoTarget && u.autoTarget.alive;
 818         const want = aiming ? u.aimYaw - u.yaw : 0;
 819         v.turret.rotation.y = lerpAngle(v.turret.rotation.y, want, Math.min(1, dt * 6));
 820       }
 821       if (v.rotor) v.rotor.rotation.y += dt * 22;
 822       if (v.legl) {
 823         soldiers++;
 824         this.animateLegs(u, v, dt, time, gaitFull);
 825         // v1.0: el constructor martilla mientras trabaja en la obra.
 826         if (u.workingAt !== undefined && g.time - u.workingAt < 0.25) v.main.rotation.x = 0.08 + Math.sin(time * 11 + u.id) * 0.12;
 827       }
 828     }
 829     this.soldiersSeen = soldiers;
 830     this.updateUnitShields(time);
 831     this.updateSkyBeams(time);
 832   }
 833 
 834   // Aviones (v1.0): quietos no flotan en el aire, dan vueltas sobre su punto; se inclinan al girar
 835   // y dejan estela. Es solo la vista: la posición del juego sigue siendo el centro de la vuelta.
 836   updatePlane(u, v, dt, time, y) {
 837     const k = Math.min(1, dt * 1.5);
 838     v.orbitA = (v.orbitA || 0) + ((u.moving ? 0 : 1) - (v.orbitA || 0)) * k;
 839     const R = 0.75 * v.orbitA;
 840     const a = time * 0.8 + u.id * 1.7;
 841     const x = u.x + Math.cos(a) * R;
 842     const z = u.z + Math.sin(a) * R;
 843     // Rumbo: el de la vuelta cuando está quieto, el de su marcha cuando vuela a un destino.
 844     const orbitYaw = Math.atan2(-Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a));
 845     const yaw = v.orbitA > 0.5 ? orbitYaw : u.yaw;
 846     const prev = v.lastYaw === undefined ? yaw : v.lastYaw;
 847     let turn = yaw - prev;
 848     while (turn > Math.PI) turn -= Math.PI * 2;
 849     while (turn < -Math.PI) turn += Math.PI * 2;
 850     v.lastYaw = yaw;
 851     const wantBank = clamp(-(turn / Math.max(dt, 1e-3)) * 0.35, -0.6, 0.6);
 852     v.bank = (v.bank || 0) + (wantBank - (v.bank || 0)) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
 853     v.group.position.set(x, y + 0.15, z);
 854     v.group.rotation.set(u.moving ? 0.06 : 0, yaw, v.bank);
 855     // Estela detrás de las toberas.
 856     v.trailT = (v.trailT || 0) - dt;
 857     if (v.trailT <= 0) {
 858       v.trailT = this.quality === 'high' ? 0.05 : 0.15;
 859       const s = v.group.scale.x || 1;
 860       this.fxs.trail(x - Math.sin(yaw) * 0.55 * s, y + 0.3 * s, z - Math.cos(yaw) * 0.55 * s);
 861     }
 862   }
 863 
 864   // Piernas de los soldados. Alta calidad: ciclo de caminar o correr de CMU (cadera, rodilla,
 865   // inclinación y rebote), al ritmo de la velocidad real para que los pies no patinen.
 866   // Más fluido o muchísimas tropas: el balanceo simple de antes.
 867   animateLegs(u, v, dt, time, full) {
 868     const moving = u.moving && !u.inside;
 869     const k = Math.min(1, dt * 8);
 870     v.gaitA = (v.gaitA || 0) + ((moving ? 1 : 0) - (v.gaitA || 0)) * k;
 871     const a = v.gaitA;
 872     if (!full || !v.shinl) {
 873       const sw = moving ? Math.sin(time * 10 + u.id) * 0.55 : 0;
 874       v.legl.rotation.x += (sw - v.legl.rotation.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
 875       v.legr.rotation.x = -v.legl.rotation.x;
 876       if (v.shinl) { v.shinl.rotation.x = 0; v.shinr.rotation.x = 0; }
 877       v.main.rotation.x = 0;
 878       v.main.position.y = 0;
 879       v.gaitClip = null;
 880       return;
 881     }
 882     const cell = this.game.cells[u.cell];
 883     const slow = TERRAIN[cell.t].slow || 1;
 884     // Constructores, Ingenieros y el bosque: caminan. Las tropas de combate corren.
 885     const clip = u.def.builds || slow > 1 ? CMU_GAIT.walk : CMU_GAIT.run;
 886     v.gaitClip = clip === CMU_GAIT.walk ? 'walk' : 'run';
 887     const leg = 0.19 * (v.group.scale.x || 1);
 888     if (moving) {
 889       const speed = (u.def.speed * SQ3) / slow;
 890       v.gaitPhase = ((v.gaitPhase === undefined ? (u.id * 0.37) % 1 : v.gaitPhase) + dt * (speed / (clip.stride * leg))) % 1;
 891     }
 892     const n = clip.hipL.length;
 893     const t = (v.gaitPhase || 0) * n;
 894     const i0 = Math.floor(t) % n;
 895     const i1 = (i0 + 1) % n;
 896     const f = t - Math.floor(t);
 897     const at = (arr) => arr[i0] + (arr[i1] - arr[i0]) * f;
 898     v.legl.rotation.x = -at(clip.hipL) * a;
 899     v.legr.rotation.x = -at(clip.hipR) * a;
 900     v.shinl.rotation.x = at(clip.kneeL) * a;
 901     v.shinr.rotation.x = at(clip.kneeR) * a;
 902     v.main.rotation.x = at(clip.pitch) * a;
 903     // Rebote al paso; quieto, respira despacio.
 904     v.group.position.y += at(clip.bob) * leg * a;
 905     v.main.position.y = Math.sin(time * 2.4 + u.id) * 0.004 * (1 - a);
 906   }
 907 
 908   // ---------- muralla: torreón + tramos hacia los muros vecinos ----------
 909   createWall(b) {
 910     const color = PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner];
 911     const v = createVisual(GLB.wall_post ? 'wall_post' : 'wall', color);
 912     v.segs = new THREE.Group();
 913     v.group.add(v.segs);
 914     v.mask = -1;
 915     return v;
 916   }

 918   updateWall(b, v) {
 919     const g = this.game;
 920     const c = g.cells[b.cell];
 921     let mask = 0;
 922     HEX_DIRS.forEach(([dq, dr], i) => {
 923       const n = g.map.get(c.q + dq, c.r + dr);
 924       if (n && n.bld && n.bld.alive && n.bld.type === 'wall' && n.bld.owner === b.owner) mask |= 1 << i;
 925     });
 926     if (mask === v.mask) return;
 927     v.mask = mask;
 928     while (v.segs.children.length) v.segs.remove(v.segs.children[0]);
 929     if (!GLB.wall_seg) return;
 930     const geo = getModel('wall_seg', PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]).main;
 931     HEX_DIRS.forEach(([dq, dr], i) => {
 932       if (!(mask & (1 << i))) return;
 933       const w = hexToWorld(dq, dr);
 934       const seg = new THREE.Mesh(geo, fastMat(GLB_MAT, FAST_MATS));
 935       seg.castShadow = true;
 936       seg.receiveShadow = true;
 937       seg.rotation.y = Math.atan2(w.x, w.z);
 938       v.segs.add(seg);
 939     });
 940   }

 943   updateUnitShields(time) {
 944     const g = this.game;
 945     if (!this.shieldMesh) {
 946       const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1);
 947       const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.26, wireframe: true, depthWrite: false });
 948       this.shieldMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, 200);
 949       this._shCol = new THREE.Color();
 950       this.shieldMesh.count = 0;
 951       this.shieldMesh.renderOrder = 6;
 952       this.shieldMesh.frustumCulled = false;
 953       this.scene.add(this.shieldMesh);
 954     }
 955     const m = new THREE.Matrix4();

 957     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
 958     for (const u of g.units) {
 959       if (n >= 200) break;
 960       if (!u.alive || u.inside || !(u.shield > 0)) continue;
 961       if (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam) continue;
 962       const s = (u.cls === 'inf' ? 0.42 : u.cls === 'ship' || u.cls === 'sub' ? 0.85 : 0.6) * (0.96 + Math.sin(time * 3 + u.id) * 0.04);
 963       m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(u.x, u.y + s * 0.6, u.z);
 964       this.shieldMesh.setColorAt(n, this._shCol.set(SHIELD_HEX(u.shield / u.shieldMax)));
 965       this.shieldMesh.setMatrixAt(n++, m);
 966     }

 973   // ---------- rayo ámbar al cielo sobre cada Núcleo (documento pág. 13) ----------
 974   // ---------- v1.5: de quién es cada cosa y qué nivel tiene ----------
 975   // Banderín del color del jugador y marcas de nivel (doradas) en cada edificio; anillo del color del
 976   // jugador bajo cada tropa. Todo con mallas instanciadas: pocas llamadas de dibujo aunque haya cientos.
 977   buildMarks() {
 978     const N = 700;
 979     const pole = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.018, 0.022, 0.66, 5);
 980     pole.translate(0, 0.33, 0);
 981     this.flagPoles = new THREE.InstancedMesh(pole, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x59616b }), N);
 982     const flag = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.3, 0.18, 3, 1);
 983     flag.translate(0.15, 0.55, 0);
 984     this.flags = new THREE.InstancedMesh(flag, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), N);
 985     const pip = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.075, 0);
 986     pip.scale(1, 0.6, 1);
 987     this.levelPips = new THREE.InstancedMesh(pip, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffcf3a, emissive: 0x4a3200 }), N * 2);
 988     const ring = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.74, 1, 22);
 989     ring.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
 990     this.unitRings = new THREE.InstancedMesh(ring, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false }), 1200);
 991     this.unitRings.renderOrder = 2;
 992     // El color por instancia se crea con el tamaño que tiene la malla en ese momento: antes de vaciarla.
 993     this.flags.setColorAt(0, new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1));
 994     this.unitRings.setColorAt(0, new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1));
 995     for (const m of [this.flagPoles, this.flags, this.levelPips, this.unitRings]) {
 996       m.frustumCulled = false;
 997       m.count = 0;
 998       this.scene.add(m);
 999     }
1000     this.flags.castShadow = true;
1001     this.markColor = new THREE.Color();
1002     this.markMat = new THREE.Matrix4();
1003     this.markQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
1004     this.markPos = new THREE.Vector3();
1005     this.markScale = new THREE.Vector3();
1006     this.markEuler = new THREE.Euler();
1007   }
1008 
1009   updateMarks(time) {
1010     if (!this.flags) this.buildMarks();
1011     const g = this.game;
1012     const M = this.markMat;
1013     const Q = this.markQuat;
1014     const P = this.markPos;
1015     const S = this.markScale;
1016     const E = this.markEuler;
1017     const col = this.markColor;
1018     let nf = 0;
1019     let np = 0;
1020     for (const b of g.buildings) {
1021       if (!b.alive || b.type === 'wall' || b.type === 'core') continue;
1022       const v = this.vis.get(b.id);
1023       if (!v || !v.group.visible) continue;
1024       if (nf >= 700) break;
1025       // Esquina de la casilla (detrás y a la derecha, mirando desde la cámara de siempre).
1026       const a = Math.PI / 6 + Math.PI / 3 * 4;
1027       const cx = b.x + Math.sin(a) * 0.74;
1028       const cz = b.z + Math.cos(a) * 0.74;
1029       const k = b.built ? 1 : 0.6;
1030       P.set(cx, b.y, cz);
1031       S.set(1, k, 1);
1032       Q.identity();
1033       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1034       this.flagPoles.setMatrixAt(nf, M);
1035       E.set(0, 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 2.6 + b.id) * 0.18, 0);
1036       Q.setFromEuler(E);
1037       S.set(1, k, 1);
1038       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1039       this.flags.setMatrixAt(nf, M);
1040       col.setHex(PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]);
1041       this.flags.setColorAt(nf, col);
1042       nf++;
1043       // Marcas de nivel: una por nivel, al pie del banderín (solo en lo que se puede mejorar).
1044       if (b.def.maxLevel > 1 && b.built) {
1045         for (let i = 0; i < b.level && np < 1400; i++) {
1046           const aa = a - 0.42 - i * 0.2;
1047           P.set(b.x + Math.sin(aa) * 0.8, b.y + 0.07, b.z + Math.cos(aa) * 0.8);
1048           E.set(0, time * 0.8 + i, 0);
1049           Q.setFromEuler(E);
1050           S.set(1, 1, 1);
1051           M.compose(P, Q, S);
1052           this.levelPips.setMatrixAt(np++, M);
1053         }
1054       }
1055     }
1056     this.flagPoles.count = nf;
1057     this.flags.count = nf;
1058     this.levelPips.count = np;
1059     this.flagPoles.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1060     this.flags.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1061     if (this.flags.instanceColor) this.flags.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
1062     this.levelPips.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1063     // Anillo del color del jugador bajo cada tropa (los aviones, en el suelo debajo de ellos).
1064     let nr = 0;
1065     Q.identity();
1066     for (const u of g.units) {
1067       if (!u.alive || u.inside || nr >= 1200) continue;
1068       const v = this.vis.get(u.id);
1069       if (!v || !v.group.visible) continue;
1070       const r = u.cls === 'inf' ? 0.27 : u.mover === 'sea' ? 0.56 : u.mover === 'air' ? 0.36 : 0.44;
1071       const c = g.cells[u.cell];
1072       const gy = u.mover === 'sea' ? 0.04 : u.mover === 'air' ? (c ? Math.max(0.04, c.h + 0.03) : 0.04) : (c ? c.h + 0.03 : u.y + 0.03);
1073       const x = u.def.plane ? v.group.position.x : u.x;
1074       const z = u.def.plane ? v.group.position.z : u.z;
1075       P.set(x, gy, z);
1076       S.set(r, 1, r);
1077       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1078       this.unitRings.setMatrixAt(nr, M);
1079       col.setHex(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1080       this.unitRings.setColorAt(nr, col);
1081       nr++;
1082     }
1083     this.unitRings.count = nr;
1084     this.unitRings.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1085     if (this.unitRings.instanceColor) this.unitRings.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
1086     this.marksShown = { flags: nf, pips: np, rings: nr };
1087   }

1089   // v1.5: icono del tipo de tropa cuando la cámara está lejos (las tropas se ven chicas).
1090   drawUnitIcons(ctx) {
1091     const g = this.game;
1092     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1093     let n = 0;
1094     for (const u of g.units) {
1095       if (!u.alive || u.inside || n >= 260) continue;
1096       if (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam) continue;
1097       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + (u.mover === 'air' ? 0.9 : 0.75), u.z);
1098       if (!s.ok || s.x < -12 || s.y < -12 || s.x > this.width + 12 || s.y > this.height + 12) continue;
1099       n++;
1100       const x = s.x;
1101       const y = s.y;
1102       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1103       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.85)';
1104       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1105       ctx.beginPath();
1106       ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1107       ctx.fill();
1108       ctx.stroke();
1109       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
1110       ctx.beginPath();
1111       if (u.cls === 'inf') {
1112         ctx.arc(x, y - 2.6, 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1113         ctx.rect(x - 1.6, y - 0.6, 3.2, 4.2);
1114       } else if (u.mover === 'air') {
1115         ctx.moveTo(x, y - 4.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 4.5, y + 2); ctx.lineTo(x, y + 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x - 4.5, y + 2); ctx.closePath();
1116       } else if (u.mover === 'sea') {
1117         ctx.moveTo(x - 4.5, y - 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 4.5, y - 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 2.8, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x - 2.8, y + 3); ctx.closePath();
1118         ctx.rect(x - 1, y - 3.5, 2.5, 3);
1119       } else {
1120         ctx.rect(x - 3.8, y - 1.2, 7.6, 3.8);
1121         ctx.rect(x - 1.6, y - 3.6, 3.2, 2.4);
1122         ctx.rect(x + 1.6, y - 2.9, 3.4, 1.1);
1123       }
1124       ctx.fill();
1125     }
1126     this.unitIcons = n;
1127   }

1158   updateSelectionRings(selection) {
1159     const items = selection.filter((e) => e.alive);
1160     while (this.rings.length < items.length) {
1161       const r = new THREE.Mesh(this.ringGeo, this.ringMatOwn);
1162       r.renderOrder = 5;
1163       this.scene.add(r);
1164       this.rings.push(r);
1165     }
1166     this.rings.forEach((r, i) => {
1167       const e = items[i];
1168       if (!e) {
1169         r.visible = false;
1170         return;
1171       }
1172       r.visible = true;
1173       r.material = e.owner === 0 || (e.kind === 'point' && e.owner < 0) ? this.ringMatOwn : this.ringMatEnemy;
1174       const s = e.kind === 'bld' || e.kind === 'point' ? 1.85 : e.cls === 'inf' ? 0.75 : e.cls === 'ship' || e.cls === 'sub' ? 1.4 : 1.1;
1175       r.scale.setScalar(s);
1176       const y = e.kind === 'bld' || e.kind === 'point' ? e.y + 0.05 : e.mover === 'air' ? Math.max(this.game.cells[e.cell].h, 0) + 0.05 : Math.max(e.y, 0) + 0.04;
1177       r.position.set(e.x, y, e.z);
1178     });
1179     // Círculo de alcance de la tropa o defensa seleccionada.
1180     const one = items.length === 1 ? items[0] : null;
1181     const w = one && one.def && one.def.weapon;
1182     if (w && !one.inside) {
1183       const R = w.range * SQ3 + (one.kind === 'bld' ? 0.75 : 0.35);
1184       this.rangeRing.visible = true;
1185       this.rangeRing.scale.setScalar(R);
1186       this.rangeRing.userData.radius = R;
1187       const gy = one.kind === 'bld' ? one.y : Math.max(this.game.cells[one.cell].h, 0);
1188       this.rangeRing.position.set(one.x, gy + 0.06, one.z);
1189       this.rangeRing.material.color.set(one.owner === 0 ? 0xffffff : 0xff7070);
1190     } else {
1191       this.rangeRing.visible = false;
1192     }
1193     const b = items.length === 1 && items[0].kind === 'bld' && items[0].owner === 0 ? items[0] : null;
1194     if (b && b.rally >= 0) {
1195       const c = this.game.cells[b.rally];
1196       this.rallyFlag.visible = true;
1197       this.rallyFlag.position.set(c.x, Math.max(c.h, 0), c.z);
1198     } else this.rallyFlag.visible = false;
1199   }

1225   // ---------- cámara ----------
1226   updateCamera() {
1227     const c = this.cam;
1228     const R = this.game.map.R * 1.5;
1229     const len = Math.hypot(c.tx, c.tz);
1230     if (len > R) {
1231       c.tx *= R / len;
1232       c.tz *= R / len;
1233     }
1234     c.dist = clamp(c.dist, 9, 70);
1235     const zt = (c.dist - 9) / 61;
1236     c.pitch = 0.78 + zt * 0.42;
1237     const cp = Math.cos(c.pitch);
1238     this.camera.position.set(
1239       c.tx + Math.sin(c.yaw) * cp * c.dist,
1240       Math.sin(c.pitch) * c.dist,
1241       c.tz + Math.cos(c.yaw) * cp * c.dist,
1242     );
1243     this.camera.lookAt(c.tx, 0, c.tz);
1244     this.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
1245     this.sun.position.set(c.tx - 16, 34, c.tz + 10);
1246     this.sun.target.position.set(c.tx, 0, c.tz);
1247     const span = clamp(c.dist * 1.1, 22, 60);
1248     const sc = this.sun.shadow.camera;
1249     if (Math.abs(sc.right - span) > 2) {
1250       sc.left = -span; sc.right = span; sc.top = span; sc.bottom = -span;
1251       sc.updateProjectionMatrix();
1252     }
1253   }
1254 
1255   screenToWorld(sx, sy, planeY = 0) {
1256     this._ndc.set((sx / this.width) * 2 - 1, -(sy / this.height) * 2 + 1);
1257     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this._ndc, this.camera);
1258     this._plane.constant = -planeY;
1259     const hit = this.raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(this._plane, this._p);
1260     return hit ? { x: hit.x, z: hit.z } : null;
1261   }
1262 
1263   pickCell(sx, sy) {
1264     const map = this.game.map;
1265     let p = this.screenToWorld(sx, sy, 0.3);
1266     if (!p) return null;
1267     let c = map.atWorld(p.x, p.z);
1268     if (!c) return null;
1269     p = this.screenToWorld(sx, sy, Math.max(c.h, 0));
1270     const c2 = p && map.atWorld(p.x, p.z);
1271     return c2 || c;
1272   }
1273 
1274   project(x, y, z) {
1275     this._p.set(x, y, z).project(this.camera);
1276     return { x: (this._p.x + 1) * 0.5 * this.width, y: (1 - this._p.y) * 0.5 * this.height, ok: this._p.z < 1 && this._p.z > -1 };
1277   }
1278 
1279   pickUnit(sx, sy, filter) {
1280     let best = null;
1281     let bd = Math.max(16, 520 / this.cam.dist);
1282     for (const u of this.game.units) {
1283       if (!u.alive || u.inside || (filter && !filter(u))) continue;
1284       if (!u.visible && this.game.players[u.owner].team !== this.game.players[0].team) continue;
1285       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + 0.25, u.z);
1286       if (!s.ok) continue;
1287       const d = Math.hypot(s.x - sx, s.y - sy);
1288       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = u; }
1289     }
1290     return best;
1291   }
1292 
1293   // v1.2: tocar el cuerpo o el techo de un edificio también lo elige (antes solo valía su casilla del suelo).
1294   // Solo cuenta la zona entre la base y el techo, para no robar los toques al suelo de delante.
1295   pickBuilding(sx, sy) {
1296     let best = null;
1297     let bd = Infinity;
1298     const half = Math.max(16, 380 / this.cam.dist);
1299     for (const b of this.game.buildings) {
1300       if (!b.alive) continue;
1301       const base = this.project(b.x, b.y, b.z);
1302       const top = this.project(b.x, b.y + (b.type === 'wall' ? 0.6 : 1.15), b.z);
1303       if (!base.ok || !top.ok) continue;
1304       if (sy > base.y + 4 || sy < top.y - 8 || Math.abs(sx - base.x) > half) continue;
1305       const d = Math.abs(sx - base.x) + Math.abs(sy - (base.y + top.y) / 2) * 0.5;
1306       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; }
1307     }
1308     return best;
1309   }
1310 
1311   unitsInRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, filter) {
1312     const lx = Math.min(x1, x2);
1313     const hx = Math.max(x1, x2);
1314     const ly = Math.min(y1, y2);
1315     const hy = Math.max(y1, y2);
1316     return this.game.units.filter((u) => {
1317       if (!u.alive || u.inside || (filter && !filter(u))) return false;
1318       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + 0.2, u.z);
1319       return s.ok && s.x >= lx && s.x <= hx && s.y >= ly && s.y <= hy;
1320     });
1321   }

1323   // ---------- capa 2D: barras de vida ----------
1324   drawOverlay(selection) {
1325     const ctx = this.octx;
1326     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
1327     const g = this.game;
1328     const sel = new Set(selection);
1329     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1330     this.upBars = 0;
1331     const bar = (e, w, hTop) => {
1332       const s = this.project(e.x, e.y + hTop, e.z);
1333       if (!s.ok || s.x < -40 || s.y < -40 || s.x > this.width + 40 || s.y > this.height + 40) return;
1334       const x = Math.round(s.x - w / 2);
1335       const y = Math.round(s.y);
1336       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.75)';
1337       ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, w + 2, 6);
1338       if (e.kind === 'bld' && !e.built) {
1339         ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c542';
1340         ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * e.progress, 4);
1341         return;
1342       }
1343       // v1.5: barra de la mejora (celeste) debajo de la de vida.
1344       if (e.kind === 'bld' && e.upgrading) {
1345         this.upBars++;
1346         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.75)';
1347         ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y + 5, w + 2, 4);
1348         ctx.fillStyle = '#7dd3ff';
1349         ctx.fillRect(x, y + 6, w * clamp(e.upgrading.progress, 0, 1), 2);
1350       }
1351       const k = clamp(e.hp / e.maxHp, 0, 1);
1352       ctx.fillStyle = k > 0.55 ? '#5ee07a' : k > 0.28 ? '#f2c94c' : '#ef5350';
1353       ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * k, 4);
1354       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[e.owner]);
1355       ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, 3, 6);
1356       // Escudo (v0.9): barra encima en azul (bien), amarillo (a medias) o rojo (débil).
1357       if (e.shieldMax > 0) {
1358         const ks = clamp(e.shield / e.shieldMax, 0, 1);
1359         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.75)';
1360         ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 5, w + 2, 4);
1361         ctx.fillStyle = SHIELD_CSS(ks);
1362         ctx.fillRect(x, y - 4, w * ks, 2);
1363       }
1364       // v1.4: estrellas de las tropas veteranas, encima de la barra.
1365       if (e.vet) {
1366         ctx.font = '700 10px system-ui, sans-serif';
1367         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1368         ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
1369         const txt = '★'.repeat(e.vet);
1370         const ty = y - (e.shieldMax > 0 ? 6 : 2);
1371         ctx.lineWidth = 3;
1372         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.85)';
1373         ctx.strokeText(txt, s.x, ty);
1374         ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36a';
1375         ctx.fillText(txt, s.x, ty);
1376         ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
1377       }
1378     };
1379     // Progreso de captura sobre el Faro y las Banderas.
1380     for (const pt of g.points) {
1381       const busy = pt.contested || (pt.prog > 0 && pt.prog < 1) || (pt.owner >= 0 && pt.prog < 1);
1382       if (!busy && !sel.has(pt)) continue;
1383       const s = this.project(pt.x, pt.y + (pt.type === 'faro' ? 3.3 : 1.7), pt.z);
1384       if (!s.ok) continue;
1385       const R = pt.type === 'faro' ? 15 : 12;
1386       ctx.lineWidth = 4;
1387       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.7)';
1388       ctx.beginPath();
1389       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1390       ctx.stroke();
1391       const capColor = pt.owner >= 0 ? PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner]
1392         : pt.capTeam >= 0 ? PLAYER_COLORS[g.players.findIndex((p) => p.team === pt.capTeam)] : NEUTRAL;
1393       ctx.strokeStyle = hexColor(capColor);
1394       ctx.beginPath();
1395       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, R, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * clamp(pt.prog, 0, 1));
1396       ctx.stroke();
1397       if (pt.contested) {
1398         ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36a';
1399         ctx.font = '600 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
1400         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1401         ctx.fillText('En disputa', s.x, s.y + R + 14);
1402       }
1403     }
1404     // Constructor en camino (v0.9): línea punteada desde él hasta su obra.
1405     ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
1406     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1407     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(245,197,66,0.85)';
1408     for (const u of g.units) {
1409       const b = u.buildTarget;
1410       if (!u.alive || u.owner !== 0 || u.state !== 'build' || !b || !b.alive) continue;
1411       const near = Math.hypot(u.x - b.x, u.z - b.z) < 2.2;
1412       if (near) continue;
1413       const a = this.project(u.x, u.y + 0.3, u.z);
1414       const c = this.project(b.x, b.y + 0.3, b.z);
1415       if (!a.ok || !c.ok) continue;
1416       ctx.beginPath();
1417       ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
1418       ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y);
1419       ctx.stroke();
1420     }
1421     ctx.setLineDash([]);
1422     // Radiación (v1.0): cartel con la cuenta regresiva sobre cada zona.
1423     for (const z of g.radZones || []) {
1424       const s = this.project(z.x, z.y + 0.9, z.z);
1425       if (!s.ok || s.x < -60 || s.y < -30 || s.x > this.width + 60 || s.y > this.height + 30) continue;
1426       const left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(z.until - g.time));
1427       const text = `☢ Radiación · ${Math.floor(left / 60)}:${String(left % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
1428       ctx.font = '700 12px system-ui, sans-serif';
1429       const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + 16;
1430       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,22,10,0.85)';
1431       ctx.fillRect(s.x - w / 2, s.y - 20, w, 20);
1432       ctx.fillStyle = '#7cff4a';
1433       ctx.fillRect(s.x - w / 2, s.y - 3, w * clamp(left / NUKE.rad.time, 0, 1), 3);
1434       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1435       ctx.fillStyle = '#c9ffb0';
1436       ctx.fillText(text, s.x, s.y - 7);
1437     }
1438     // AIR DEFENSE (v0.9): el radar marca la aeronave que sigue (amarillo) y la que ya fijó (rojo).
1439     // Si un radar enemigo fija una aeronave tuya, aparece un aro rojo de alerta sobre ella.
1440     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1441       const t = bl.lockOn;
1442       if (!bl.alive || !t || !t.alive || t.cls !== 'air' || !bl.def.weapon || !bl.def.weapon.lock) continue;
1443       const mine = bl.owner === 0;
1444       if (!mine && t.owner !== 0) continue;
1445       if (!g.inRange(bl, g.weaponOf(bl), t)) continue;
1446       const s = this.project(t.x, t.y + 0.2, t.z);
1447       if (!s.ok || s.x < -30 || s.y < -30 || s.x > this.width + 30 || s.y > this.height + 30) continue;
1448       const locked = bl.lockT <= 0;
1449       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1450       if (mine) {
1451         const r = locked ? 13 : 13 + Math.max(0, bl.lockT) * 30;
1452         ctx.strokeStyle = locked ? '#ef5350' : '#f2c94c';
1453         for (const [sx, sy] of [[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]]) {
1454           ctx.beginPath();
1455           ctx.moveTo(s.x + sx * r, s.y + sy * (r - 6));
1456           ctx.lineTo(s.x + sx * r, s.y + sy * r);
1457           ctx.lineTo(s.x + sx * (r - 6), s.y + sy * r);
1458           ctx.stroke();
1459         }
1460       } else {
1461         const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g.time * 12);
1462         ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(239,83,80,${0.45 + pulse * 0.5})`;
1463         ctx.beginPath();
1464         ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 15 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1465         ctx.stroke();
1466       }
1467       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
1468     }
1469     // Obras: «En construcción» o «Mejorando», con progreso y aviso si no hay constructor.
1470     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1471       if (!bl.alive || g.players[bl.owner].team !== myTeam) continue;
1472       const working = !bl.built || bl.upgrading;
1473       if (!working && bl.level < 2) continue;
1474       const s = this.project(bl.x, bl.y + (bl.type === 'core' ? 2.4 : 1.45), bl.z);
1475       if (!s.ok || s.x < -60 || s.y < -30 || s.x > this.width + 60 || s.y > this.height + 30) continue;
1476       if (working) {
1477         const k = bl.upgrading ? bl.upgrading.progress : bl.progress;
1478         const idle = g.time - bl.lastWork > 1.5 && bl.type !== 'outpost';
1479         // v0.9: «Esperando constructor» mientras nadie trabaja; «Construyendo» cuando llega.
1480         const coming = idle && g.units.some((u) => u.alive && u.buildTarget === bl && u.state === 'build');
1481         const verb = bl.upgrading ? `Mejorando a nivel ${bl.upgrading.level}` : idle ? 'Esperando constructor' : 'Construyendo';
1482         const text = `${verb} · ${Math.floor(k * 100)} %`;
1483         const note = coming ? 'Constructor en camino' : 'Sin constructor';
1484         ctx.font = '600 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
1485         const w = Math.max(ctx.measureText(text).width, idle ? ctx.measureText(note).width : 0) + 14;
1486         const h = idle ? 32 : 20;
1487         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.85)';
1488         ctx.fillRect(s.x - w / 2, s.y - h, w, h);
1489         ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ab38';
1490         ctx.fillRect(s.x - w / 2, s.y - 3, w * clamp(k, 0, 1), 3);
1491         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1492         ctx.fillStyle = '#edf3f7';
1493         ctx.fillText(text, s.x, s.y - h + 13);
1494         if (idle) {
1495           ctx.fillStyle = coming ? '#f5c542' : '#ff9a9b';
1496           ctx.fillText(note, s.x, s.y - h + 26);
1497         }
1498       } else if (bl.owner === 0) {
1499         // Nivel 2 o 3: marcas doradas.
1500         for (let i = 0; i < bl.level - 1; i++) {
1501           const x = s.x - (bl.level - 2) * 5 + i * 10;
1502           ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ab38';
1503           ctx.beginPath();
1504           ctx.moveTo(x, s.y - 12);
1505           ctx.lineTo(x + 4, s.y - 8);
1506           ctx.lineTo(x, s.y - 4);
1507           ctx.lineTo(x - 4, s.y - 8);
1508           ctx.closePath();
1509           ctx.fill();
1510         }
1511       }
1512     }
1513     // Icono de combate donde hay peleas.
1514     for (const f of g.fights) {
1515       const age = g.time - f.t;
1516       if (age > 1.6) continue;
1517       const s = this.project(f.x, (f.y || 0) + 1.1, f.z);
1518       if (!s.ok) continue;
1519       const c = g.cells[f.cell];
1520       if (g.fog && c && c.owner !== 0 && !g.units.some((u) => u.owner === 0 && Math.hypot(u.x - f.x, u.z - f.z) < 7)) continue;
1521       const r = 8 + Math.sin(age * 12) * 1.5;
1522       ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - age / 1.6;
1523       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a30';
1524       ctx.beginPath();
1525       for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
1526         const a = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
1527         const rr = i % 2 ? r * 0.45 : r;
1528         ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, s.y + Math.sin(a) * rr);
1529       }
1530       ctx.closePath();
1531       ctx.fill();
1532       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
1533       ctx.beginPath();
1534       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1535       ctx.fill();
1536       ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
1537     }
1538     this.fightIcons = g.fights.filter((f) => g.time - f.t <= 1.6).length;
1539     // Producción a la vista: progreso y cola sobre tus edificios que entrenan.
1540     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1541       if (!bl.alive || bl.owner !== 0 || !bl.queue.length) continue;
1542       const s = this.project(bl.x, bl.y + 1.55, bl.z);
1543       if (!s.ok || s.x < -30 || s.y < -30 || s.x > this.width + 30 || s.y > this.height + 30) continue;
1544       const q = bl.queue[0];
1545       const k = clamp(q.t / UNITS[q.type].build, 0, 1);
1546       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.82)';
1547       ctx.beginPath();
1548       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1549       ctx.fill();
1550       ctx.lineWidth = 3;
1551       ctx.strokeStyle = '#f2ab38';
1552       ctx.beginPath();
1553       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 11, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * k);
1554       ctx.stroke();
1555       ctx.fillStyle = '#edf3f7';
1556       ctx.font = '600 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
1557       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1558       ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
1559       ctx.fillText(String(bl.queue.length), s.x, s.y + 0.5);
1560       ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
1561     }
1562     this.prodBadges = g.buildings.filter((bl) => bl.alive && bl.owner === 0 && bl.queue.length).length;
1563     // v1.5: aviso de «parado» sobre tus edificios que entrenan y llevan un rato sin nada en cola.
1564     let idle = 0;
1565     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1566       const idleMap = this.idleSince || (this.idleSince = new Map());
1567       if (!bl.alive || bl.owner !== 0 || bl.type === 'core' || !bl.def.produces || !bl.built || bl.queue.length || bl.loop) { idleMap.delete(bl.id); continue; }
1568       if (!idleMap.has(bl.id)) idleMap.set(bl.id, g.time);
1569       if (g.time - idleMap.get(bl.id) < 6) continue;
1570       const s = this.project(bl.x, bl.y + 1.55, bl.z);
1571       if (!s.ok || s.x < -30 || s.y < -30 || s.x > this.width + 30 || s.y > this.height + 30) continue;
1572       idle++;
1573       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.78)';
1574       ctx.beginPath();
1575       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1576       ctx.fill();
1577       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
1578       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1579       ctx.stroke();
1580       ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8e0';
1581       ctx.font = '700 9px system-ui, sans-serif';
1582       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
1583       ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
1584       ctx.fillText('z', s.x - 3, s.y + 2);
1585       ctx.font = '700 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
1586       ctx.fillText('z', s.x + 2.5, s.y - 2);
1587       ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
1588     }
1589     this.idleBadges = idle;
1590     const recent = g.time - 4;
1591     for (const b of g.buildings) {
1592       if (!b.alive) continue;
1593       if (b.hp < b.maxHp || !b.built || b.upgrading || sel.has(b) || b.lastHit > recent || b.shield < b.shieldMax) bar(b, b.type === 'core' ? 56 : 40, b.type === 'core' ? 1.75 + 0.3 * b.level : 1.15);
1594     }
1595     for (const u of g.units) {
1596       if (!u.alive || u.inside) continue;
1597       if (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam) continue;
1598       if (u.hp < u.maxHp || sel.has(u) || u.vet || (u.shieldMax > 0 && u.shield < u.shieldMax)) bar(u, u.cls === 'inf' ? 22 : 30, u.mover === 'air' ? 0.7 : u.cls === 'inf' ? 0.8 : 0.75);
1599       // Helicópteros y aviones (v0.9): icono mientras disparan o lanzan misiles.
1600       if (u.mover === 'air' && g.time - (u.lastShot || -99) < 0.6) {
1601         const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + 1.15, u.z);
1602         if (!s.ok) continue;
1603         const missile = u.lastShotKind === 'missile' || u.lastShotKind === 'rocket' || u.lastShotKind === 'bomb';
1604         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.8)';
1605         ctx.beginPath();
1606         ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1607         ctx.fill();
1608         ctx.strokeStyle = missile ? '#ffb63a' : '#ff6b6b';
1609         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1610         ctx.beginPath();
1611         if (missile) {
1612           ctx.moveTo(s.x - 5, s.y + 4); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 5, s.y - 4); ctx.moveTo(s.x + 1, s.y - 5); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 5, s.y - 4); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y);
1613         } else {
1614           ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1615           ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 8, s.y); ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 8); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 8);
1616         }
1617         ctx.stroke();
1618         this.airShotIcons = (this.airShotIcons || 0) + 1;
1619       }
1620     }
1621     // v1.5: con la cámara lejos, un icono por tropa (persona, vehículo, barco o avión) con su color.
1622     this.unitIcons = 0;
1623     if (this.cam.dist >= UNIT_ICON_DIST) this.drawUnitIcons(ctx);
1624     if (this.nukeFlashT > 0) {
1625       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,248,225,${Math.min(0.75, this.nukeFlashT * 0.6).toFixed(3)})`;
1626       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
1627     }
1628   }

1630   // ---------- minimapa ----------
1631   minimapTransform(size) {
1632     const R = this.game.map.R;
1633     const ext = SQ3 * R + 1.2;
1634     const s = size / (ext * 2);
1635     return { s, ox: size / 2, oz: size / 2 };
1636   }
1637 
1638   drawMinimap(canvas) {
1639     const g = this.game;
1640     const size = canvas.width;
1641     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
1642     const T = this.minimapTransform(size);
1643     if (!this.miniBase || this.miniBase.width !== size || this.miniDirty) {
1644       this.miniDirty = false;
1645       const base = this.miniBase && this.miniBase.width === size ? this.miniBase : document.createElement('canvas');
1646       base.width = size;
1647       base.height = size;
1648       const b = base.getContext('2d');
1649       b.fillStyle = '#16405a';
1650       b.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
1651       const r = T.s * 1.02;
1652       const tmp = new THREE.Color();
1653       for (const c of g.cells) {
1654         tmp.set(terrainColor(this.game.map.kind, c.t));
1655         if (c.t === 'deep') continue;
1656         if (c.owner >= 0) tmp.lerp(new THREE.Color(PLAYER_COLORS[c.owner]), TERRAIN[c.t].water ? 0.35 : 0.45);
1657         b.fillStyle = '#' + tmp.getHexString();
1658         const cx = T.ox + c.x * T.s;
1659         const cy = T.oz + c.z * T.s;
1660         b.beginPath();
1661         for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
1662           const a = (k * Math.PI) / 3;
1663           const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
1664           const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
1665           if (k === 0) b.moveTo(px, py);
1666           else b.lineTo(px, py);
1667         }
1668         b.fill();
1669       }
1670       this.miniBase = base;
1671     }
1672     ctx.drawImage(this.miniBase, 0, 0);
1673     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1674     for (const pt of g.points) {
1675       const x = T.ox + pt.x * T.s;
1676       const y = T.oz + pt.z * T.s;
1677       ctx.fillStyle = pt.owner >= 0 ? hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner]) : '#e6e8ea';
1678       ctx.strokeStyle = pt.type === 'faro' ? '#ffb63a' : '#1b2630';
1679       ctx.lineWidth = pt.type === 'faro' ? 2 : 1;
1680       ctx.beginPath();
1681       ctx.moveTo(x, y - 5);
1682       ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y);
1683       ctx.lineTo(x, y + 5);
1684       ctx.lineTo(x - 4, y);
1685       ctx.closePath();
1686       ctx.fill();
1687       ctx.stroke();
1688     }
1689     // v1.4: con «Colores para daltonismo», cada jugador tiene además su forma (Núcleo y tropas).
1690     const cvd = !!(window.FARO && window.FARO.cvd);
1691     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1692       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[bl.owner]);
1693       const x = T.ox + bl.x * T.s;
1694       const y = T.oz + bl.z * T.s;
1695       if (cvd && bl.type === 'core') {
1696         ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
1697         ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1698         minimapShape(ctx, PLAYER_SHAPES[bl.owner], x, y, 6.5);
1699         continue;
1700       }
1701       const s = bl.type === 'core' ? 7 : 4;
1702       ctx.fillRect(x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
1703       if (bl.type === 'core') {
1704         ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
1705         ctx.lineWidth = 1;
1706         ctx.strokeRect(x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
1707       }
1708     }
1709     for (const u of g.units) {
1710       if (u.inside || (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam)) continue;
1711       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1712       if (cvd) {
1713         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,0.8)';
1714         ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
1715         minimapShape(ctx, PLAYER_SHAPES[u.owner], T.ox + u.x * T.s, T.oz + u.z * T.s, 2.6);
1716         continue;
1717       }
1718       ctx.beginPath();
1719       ctx.arc(T.ox + u.x * T.s, T.oz + u.z * T.s, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1720       ctx.fill();
1721     }
1722     // Pulsos de alerta
1723     const now = performance.now();
1724     this.pings = this.pings.filter((pg) => now - pg.t < 5000);
1725     for (const pg of this.pings) {
1726       const k = ((now - pg.t) % 1000) / 1000;
1727       ctx.strokeStyle = pg.kind === 'bad' ? `rgba(255,90,90,${1 - k})` : `rgba(242,171,56,${1 - k})`;
1728       ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
1729       ctx.beginPath();
1730       ctx.arc(T.ox + pg.x * T.s, T.oz + pg.z * T.s, 4 + k * 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1731       ctx.stroke();
1732     }
1733     // Vista de la cámara
1734     const corners = [[0, 0], [this.width, 0], [this.width, this.height], [0, this.height]];
1735     const pts = corners.map(([x, y]) => this.screenToWorld(x, y, 0));
1736     if (pts.every(Boolean)) {
1737       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
1738       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
1739       ctx.beginPath();
1740       pts.forEach((p, i) => {
1741         const x = T.ox + p.x * T.s;
1742         const y = T.oz + p.z * T.s;
1743         if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
1744         else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
1745       });
1746       ctx.closePath();
1747       ctx.stroke();
1748     }
1749   }
1750 
1751   worldToMinimap(canvas, x, z) {
1752     const T = this.minimapTransform(canvas.width);
1753     const k = canvas.width / canvas.clientWidth;
1754     return { x: (x * T.s + T.ox) / k, y: (z * T.s + T.oz) / k };
1755   }
1756 
1757   minimapToWorld(canvas, mx, my) {
1758     const T = this.minimapTransform(canvas.width);
1759     const k = canvas.width / canvas.clientWidth;
1760     return { x: (mx * k - T.ox) / T.s, z: (my * k - T.oz) / T.s };
1761   }
1762 
1763   dispose() {
1764     if (this.fxs) this.fxs.dispose();
1765     this.scene.traverse((o) => {
1766       if (o.isInstancedMesh || o === this.borderMesh || o === this.tracerLines) {
1767         if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose();
1768         if (o.material && o.material !== MODEL_MAT) o.material.dispose();
1769       }
1770     });
1771   }
1772 
1773   // ---------- cuadro ----------
1774   frame(dt, time, selection) {
1775     const g = this.game;
1776     if (this.nukeFlashT > 0) this.nukeFlashT -= dt;
1777     if (g.territoryVersion !== this.lastTerritory) {
1778       this.lastTerritory = g.territoryVersion;
1779       this.tintTerritory();
1780       this.rebuildBorders();
1781       this.miniDirty = true;
1782     }
1783     const bkey = g.buildings.length * 1e6 + (g.buildings.length ? g.buildings[g.buildings.length - 1].id : 0);
1784     if (bkey !== this.lastBuildCount) {
1785       this.lastBuildCount = bkey;
1786       this.refreshDecor();
1787     }
1788     if (this.placeMesh.count) this.placeMesh.material.opacity = 0.32 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.14;
1789     this.consumeFx();
1790     this.syncEntities(dt, time);
1791     this.updateMarks(time);
1792     this.updateFx(dt);
1793     this.updateLasers(dt);
1794     this.updatePoints(time);
1795     this.updateShields(time);
1796     this.updateRadZones(time);
1797     this.updateSelectionRings(selection);
1798     this.updateCamera();
1799     this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
1800     // Con muchas tropas, las barras de vida y los iconos se dibujan un cuadro sí y otro no.
1801     this.ovFrame = (this.ovFrame || 0) + 1;
1802     // v0.9: en Más fluido las barras y avisos se dibujan cada dos cuadros con más de 40 tropas.
1803     this.overlayHalf = g.units.length > (this.quality === 'high' ? 120 : 40);
1804     if (!this.overlayHalf || this.ovFrame % 2 === 0) this.drawOverlay(selection);
1805   }
1806 }

1808 // v1.4: forma de cada jugador en el minimapa (modo para daltonismo).
1809 function minimapShape(ctx, shape, x, y, r) {
1810   ctx.beginPath();
1811   if (shape === 'square') ctx.rect(x - r * 0.85, y - r * 0.85, r * 1.7, r * 1.7);
1812   else if (shape === 'triangle') { ctx.moveTo(x, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + r * 0.8); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y + r * 0.8); ctx.closePath(); }
1813   else if (shape === 'diamond') { ctx.moveTo(x, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y); ctx.closePath(); }
1814   else if (shape === 'star') {
1815     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
1816       const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI) / 5;
1817       const rr = i % 2 ? r * 0.45 : r;
1818       if (i) ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr); else ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr);
1819     }
1820     ctx.closePath();
1821   } else if (shape === 'cross') {
1822     const t = r * 0.38;
1823     ctx.moveTo(x - t, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + t);
1824     ctx.lineTo(x + t, y + t); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y + t); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y + t);
1825     ctx.lineTo(x - r, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y - t); ctx.closePath();
1826   } else ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1827   ctx.fill();
1828   ctx.stroke();
1829 }

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Efectos con partículas (v0.6): fuego, humo, restos, chispas, fogonazos, estelas y salpicaduras.
  3 // Todas las partículas de un tipo de mezcla se dibujan en una sola pasada (THREE.Points), con un
  4 // tope fijo: cuando se llena, la partícula más vieja se reutiliza. Así los efectos no ponen lento
  5 // al iPad aunque haya muchas peleas.
  6 
  7 const FX_VERT = `
  8 attribute float psize;
  9 attribute float palpha;
 10 attribute vec3 pcolor;
 11 uniform float scale;
 12 varying vec3 vColor;
 13 varying float vAlpha;
 14 void main() {
 15   vColor = pcolor;
 16   vAlpha = palpha;
 17   vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
 18   gl_PointSize = psize * scale / max(0.1, -mv.z);
 19   gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
 20 }`;
 21 
 22 const FX_FRAG = `
 23 varying vec3 vColor;
 24 varying float vAlpha;
 25 void main() {
 26   vec2 c = gl_PointCoord - 0.5;
 27   float d = length(c);
 28   if (d > 0.5) discard;
 29   gl_FragColor = vec4(vColor, vAlpha * smoothstep(0.5, 0.12, d));
 30 }`;
 31 
 32 class Particles {
 33   constructor(scene, max, additive) {
 34     this.max = max;
 35     this.head = 0;
 36     this.count = 0;
 37     this.pos = new Float32Array(max * 3);
 38     this.col = new Float32Array(max * 3);
 39     this.alpha = new Float32Array(max);
 40     this.size = new Float32Array(max);
 41     const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 42     g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.pos, 3));
 43     g.setAttribute('pcolor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.col, 3));
 44     g.setAttribute('palpha', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.alpha, 1));
 45     g.setAttribute('psize', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.size, 1));
 46     g.setDrawRange(0, 0);
 47     this.mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 48       uniforms: { scale: { value: 400 } },
 49       vertexShader: FX_VERT,
 50       fragmentShader: FX_FRAG,
 51       transparent: true,
 52       depthWrite: false,
 53       blending: additive ? THREE.AdditiveBlending : THREE.NormalBlending,
 54     });
 55     this.points = new THREE.Points(g, this.mat);
 56     this.points.frustumCulled = false;
 57     this.points.renderOrder = additive ? 9 : 8;
 58     scene.add(this.points);
 59     this.p = [];
 60     for (let i = 0; i < max; i++) {
 61       this.p.push({ t: 1, life: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, s0: 0, s1: 0, r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1, grav: 0, drag: 0, fade: 1 });
 62     }
 63   }
 64 
 65   spawn(o) {
 66     const p = this.p[this.head];
 67     this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.max;
 68     p.t = 0;
 69     p.life = o.life;
 70     p.x = o.x; p.y = o.y; p.z = o.z;
 71     p.vx = o.vx || 0; p.vy = o.vy || 0; p.vz = o.vz || 0;
 72     p.s0 = o.s0; p.s1 = o.s1 === undefined ? o.s0 : o.s1;
 73     p.r = o.r; p.g = o.g; p.b = o.b;
 74     p.a = o.a === undefined ? 1 : o.a;
 75     p.grav = o.grav || 0;
 76     p.drag = o.drag || 0;
 77     p.fade = o.fade || 1;
 78   }
 79 
 80   update(dt) {
 81     let n = 0;
 82     for (const p of this.p) {
 83       if (p.t >= p.life) continue;
 84       p.t += dt;
 85       if (p.t >= p.life) continue;
 86       p.vy -= p.grav * dt;
 87       if (p.drag) {
 88         const k = Math.max(0, 1 - p.drag * dt);
 89         p.vx *= k; p.vy *= k; p.vz *= k;
 90       }
 91       p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.z += p.vz * dt;
 92       if (p.grav && p.y < 0) { p.y = 0; p.vy *= -0.3; p.vx *= 0.5; p.vz *= 0.5; }
 93       const k = p.t / p.life;
 94       const o = n * 3;
 95       this.pos[o] = p.x; this.pos[o + 1] = p.y; this.pos[o + 2] = p.z;
 96       this.col[o] = p.r; this.col[o + 1] = p.g; this.col[o + 2] = p.b;
 97       this.size[n] = p.s0 + (p.s1 - p.s0) * k;
 98       this.alpha[n] = p.a * Math.pow(1 - k, p.fade);
 99       n++;
100     }
101     this.count = n;
102     const g = this.points.geometry;
103     g.setDrawRange(0, n);
104     if (n) {
105       g.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
106       g.attributes.pcolor.needsUpdate = true;
107       g.attributes.palpha.needsUpdate = true;
108       g.attributes.psize.needsUpdate = true;
109     }
110   }
111 
112   setScale(px) {
113     this.mat.uniforms.scale.value = px;
114   }
115 
116   dispose() {
117     this.points.geometry.dispose();
118     this.mat.dispose();
119   }
120 }
121 
122 const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
123 
124 // Efectos compuestos. glow = mezcla aditiva (fuego, fogonazo, chispas); soft = normal (humo, restos, agua).
125 class FxSystem {
126   constructor(scene) {
127     this.glow = new Particles(scene, 520, true);
128     this.soft = new Particles(scene, 720, false);
129     this.scale = 1; // 0,5 en «Más fluido»: la mitad de partículas.
130     this.spawned = 0;
131   }
132 
133   n(k) {
134     // Cantidad según la calidad: en «Más fluido» se reparte la mitad (redondeando al azar).
135     const v = k * this.scale;
136     return Math.floor(v) + (Math.random() < v - Math.floor(v) ? 1 : 0);
137   }
138 
139   add(sys, o) {
140     sys.spawn(o);
141     this.spawned++;
142   }
143 
144   explosion(x, y, z, s, bld) {
145     const big = bld ? 1.3 : 1;
146     this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y + 0.1, z, life: 0.16, s0: s * 1.4 * big, s1: s * 1.9 * big, r: 1, g: 0.95, b: 0.75, a: 1 });
147     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 10 : 6); i > 0; i--) {
148       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
149       const sp = rnd(0.4, 1.4) * s;
150       this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y + rnd(0, 0.3) * s, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(0.4, 1.2) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, drag: 3,
151         life: rnd(0.35, 0.6), s0: s * rnd(0.5, 0.8) * big, s1: s * rnd(0.9, 1.3) * big, r: 1, g: rnd(0.45, 0.7), b: 0.15, a: 0.95, fade: 1.4 });
152     }
153     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 9 : 4); i > 0; i--) {
154       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
155       this.add(this.soft, { x: x + Math.cos(a) * 0.2 * s, y: y + 0.2, z: z + Math.sin(a) * 0.2 * s, vx: Math.cos(a) * 0.25, vy: rnd(0.5, 1.1), vz: Math.sin(a) * 0.25,
156         drag: 0.8, life: rnd(1.4, 2.4), s0: s * 0.55 * big, s1: s * 1.35 * big, r: 0.3, g: 0.31, b: 0.33, a: 0.5, fade: 1.2 });
157     }
158     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 12 : 6); i > 0; i--) {
159       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
160       const sp = rnd(1.2, 2.8) * s;
161       this.add(this.soft, { x, y: y + 0.2, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(1.5, 3.2) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 6,
162         life: rnd(0.7, 1.2), s0: rnd(0.07, 0.13) * big, r: 0.16, g: 0.15, b: 0.14, a: 1, fade: 0.4 });
163     }
164     this.sparks(x, y + 0.2, z, s, bld ? 8 : 5);
165   }
166 
167   sparks(x, y, z, s, k = 4) {
168     for (let i = this.n(k); i > 0; i--) {
169       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
170       const sp = rnd(1.5, 3.5) * Math.max(0.5, s);
171       this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(0.8, 2.6), vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 7,
172         life: rnd(0.2, 0.42), s0: 0.08, s1: 0.03, r: 1, g: 0.85, b: 0.4, a: 1 });
173     }
174   }
175 
176   flash(x, y, z, s = 0.28) {
177     this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, life: 0.07, s0: s, s1: s * 1.4, r: 1, g: 0.9, b: 0.55, a: 1 });
178   }
179 
180   impact(x, y, z, s) {
181     this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, life: 0.22, s0: s * 1.2, s1: s * 1.8, r: 1, g: 0.75, b: 0.3, a: 0.9 });
182     this.sparks(x, y, z, s, 3);
183     if (this.n(1)) this.add(this.soft, { x, y, z, vy: 0.5, life: 0.9, s0: s * 0.7, s1: s * 1.6, r: 0.35, g: 0.35, b: 0.37, a: 0.5 });
184   }
185 
186   splash(x, z, s) {
187     for (let i = this.n(9); i > 0; i--) {
188       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
189       const sp = rnd(0.3, 1.1) * s;
190       this.add(this.soft, { x, y: 0.02, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(2, 3.6) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 8,
191         life: rnd(0.5, 0.8), s0: rnd(0.1, 0.18), s1: 0.05, r: 0.86, g: 0.95, b: 1, a: 0.9, fade: 0.6 });
192     }
193     this.add(this.soft, { x, y: 0.03, z, life: 0.6, s0: s * 0.6, s1: s * 1.8, r: 0.9, g: 0.97, b: 1, a: 0.55 });
194   }
195 
196   trail(x, y, z) {
197     this.add(this.soft, { x, y, z, vy: 0.15, life: 0.55, s0: 0.1, s1: 0.32, r: 0.78, g: 0.78, b: 0.8, a: 0.55, drag: 1 });
198   }
199 
200   smoke(x, y, z, s) {
201     this.add(this.soft, { x: x + rnd(-0.12, 0.12), y, z: z + rnd(-0.12, 0.12), vx: rnd(-0.1, 0.1), vy: rnd(0.45, 0.8), vz: rnd(-0.1, 0.1),
202       drag: 0.4, life: rnd(1.8, 2.8), s0: s * 0.5, s1: s * 1.9, r: 0.24, g: 0.25, b: 0.27, a: 0.5, fade: 1.3 });
203     if (this.n(0.5)) this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y - 0.05, z, vy: 0.3, life: 0.4, s0: s * 0.45, s1: s * 0.2, r: 1, g: 0.5, b: 0.12, a: 0.7 });
204   }

208   }

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Controles: toque (iPad/celular), ratón y teclado.
  3 // Un dedo arrastra el mapa, dos dedos hacen zoom y giran, un toque selecciona u ordena.
  4 
  5 class Input {
  6   constructor(app) {
  7     this.app = app;
  8     this.canvas = app.canvas;
  9     this.pointers = new Map();
 10     this.drag = null;
 11     this.keys = new Set();
 12     this.boxMode = false;
 13     this.amoveArm = false; // «Avanzar atacando»: el siguiente toque en el mapa da la orden
 14     this.placement = null;
 15     this.lastTap = { t: 0, x: 0, y: 0, id: -1 };
 16     this.lastRot = {};
 17     this.bind();
 18   }
 19 
 20   get game() {
 21     return this.app.game;
 22   }
 23 
 24   get r() {
 25     return this.app.renderer;
 26   }
 27 
 28   bind() {
 29     const c = this.canvas;
 30     c.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => this.onDown(e));
 31     c.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => this.onMove(e));
 32     c.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => this.onUp(e));
 33     c.addEventListener('pointercancel', (e) => this.onUp(e, true));
 34     c.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!this.pointers.size && this.r) this.r.setHover(-1); });
 35     c.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => this.onWheel(e), { passive: false });
 36     c.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());
 37     window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => this.onKey(e, true));
 38     window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => this.onKey(e, false));
 39     window.addEventListener('blur', () => this.keys.clear());
 40   }
 41 
 42   active() {
 43     return this.app.state === 'play' && this.game && this.r;
 44   }
 45 
 46   pos(e) {
 47     const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 48     return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
 49   }
 50 
 51   onDown(e) {
 52     if (!this.active()) return;
 53     e.preventDefault();
 54     try { this.canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* sin captura */ }
 55     const p = this.pos(e);
 56     this.pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
 57     const cam = this.r.cam;
 58     if (this.pointers.size === 1) {
 59       this.drag = {
 60         mode: null, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, x: p.x, y: p.y, moved: false,
 61         right: e.button === 2, shift: e.shiftKey, grab: this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0),
 62       };
 63       // v1.2: mantener pulsado el mapa (sin moverse) abre la rueda de selección del ejército.
 64       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
 65       if (e.button !== 2 && !this.placement && !this.amoveArm && !this.boxMode && !e.shiftKey) {
 66         const d0 = this.drag;
 67         this.holdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
 68           if (this.drag === d0 && !d0.moved && this.pointers.size === 1) {
 69             d0.mode = 'wheel';
 70             d0.wheelAt = performance.now();
 71             this.app.ui.showWheel(d0.sx, d0.sy);
 72           }
 73         }, WHEEL_HOLD_MS);
 74       }
 75     } else if (this.pointers.size === 2) {
 76       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
 77       const [a, b] = [...this.pointers.values()];
 78       const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
 79       this.drag = {
 80         mode: 'pinch', moved: true, d0: Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1,
 81         ang0: Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x), dist0: cam.dist, yaw0: cam.yaw,
 82         grab: this.r.screenToWorld(mid.x, mid.y, 0),
 83       };
 84       this.app.ui.hideBox();
 85     }
 86   }
 87 
 88   onMove(e) {
 89     if (!this.active()) return;
 90     const p = this.pos(e);
 91     if (!this.pointers.has(e.pointerId)) {
 92       if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && this.placement) this.hover(p.x, p.y);
 93       return;
 94     }
 95     this.pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
 96     const d = this.drag;
 97     if (!d) return;
 98     const cam = this.r.cam;
 99     if (d.mode === 'pinch' && this.pointers.size >= 2) {
100       const [a, b] = [...this.pointers.values()];
101       const dist = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
102       const ang = Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x);
103       cam.dist = clamp(d.dist0 * (d.d0 / dist), 9, 70);
104       cam.yaw = d.yaw0 + (ang - d.ang0);
105       this.r.updateCamera();
106       const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
107       const w = this.r.screenToWorld(mid.x, mid.y, 0);
108       if (w && d.grab) {
109         cam.tx += d.grab.x - w.x;
110         cam.tz += d.grab.z - w.z;
111         this.r.updateCamera();
112       }
113       return;
114     }
115     if (this.pointers.size !== 1) return;
116     if (d.mode === 'wheel') {
117       // Si el dedo ya se movía antes de que se abriera la rueda (el aviso llegó tarde en un cuadro lento),
118       // era un arrastre del mapa: se cierra la rueda y se sigue moviendo la cámara.
119       const early = d.wheelAt && e.timeStamp && e.timeStamp < d.wheelAt;
120       if (early && Math.hypot(p.x - d.sx, p.y - d.sy) > 9) {
121         this.app.ui.hideWheel();
122         d.mode = null;
123       } else {
124         this.app.ui.hoverWheel(p.x, p.y);
125         return;
126       }
127     }
128     if (!d.moved && Math.hypot(p.x - d.sx, p.y - d.sy) > 9) {
129       d.moved = true;
130       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
131       d.mode = this.boxMode || d.shift ? 'box' : 'pan';
132     }
133     if (d.mode === 'pan') {
134       const w = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
135       if (w && d.grab) {
136         cam.tx += d.grab.x - w.x;
137         cam.tz += d.grab.z - w.z;
138         this.r.updateCamera();
139       }
140     } else if (d.mode === 'box') {
141       this.app.ui.showBox(d.sx, d.sy, p.x, p.y);
142     }
143     d.x = p.x;
144     d.y = p.y;
145     if (this.placement && e.pointerType === 'mouse') this.hover(p.x, p.y);
146   }

148   onUp(e, cancelled = false) {
149     if (!this.pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
150     const p = this.pos(e);
151     this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
152     const d = this.drag;
153     if (!d) return;
154     if (d.mode === 'pinch') {
155       if (this.pointers.size === 0) this.drag = null;
156       else {
157         const [rest] = [...this.pointers.values()];
158         this.drag = { mode: 'pan', sx: rest.x, sy: rest.y, moved: true, grab: this.r.screenToWorld(rest.x, rest.y, 0) };
159       }
160       return;
161     }
162     if (this.pointers.size) return;
163     this.drag = null;
164     clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
165     if (d.mode === 'wheel') {
166       // Si suelta el dedo sobre una opción, la elige; si no, la rueda queda abierta para tocar.
167       if (!cancelled) this.app.ui.releaseWheel(p.x, p.y);
168       return;
169     }
170     if (cancelled || !this.active()) return;
171     if (d.mode === 'box') {
172       this.app.ui.hideBox();
173       const list = this.r.unitsInRect(d.sx, d.sy, p.x, p.y, (u) => u.owner === 0);
174       this.app.setSelection(list);
175       if (!list.length) this.app.ui.toast('No hay tropas tuyas en el recuadro');
176       return;
177     }
178     if (!d.moved) this.tap(p.x, p.y, d.right);
179   }

181   onWheel(e) {
182     if (!this.active()) return;
183     e.preventDefault();
184     const cam = this.r.cam;
185     const p = this.pos(e);
186     const before = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
187     cam.dist = clamp(cam.dist * (1 + clamp(e.deltaY, -120, 120) * 0.0012), 9, 70);
188     this.r.updateCamera();
189     const after = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
190     if (before && after) {
191       cam.tx += before.x - after.x;
192       cam.tz += before.z - after.z;
193     }
194   }

196   onKey(e, down) {
197     if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
198     const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
199     if (down) this.keys.add(k);
200     else this.keys.delete(k);
201     if (!down || !this.active()) return;
202     // Grupos (v0.7): número elige; Ctrl, Cmd o Mayús + número guarda. Se usa e.code para que
203     // Mayús + 1 funcione aunque el teclado escriba «!».
204     const digit = /^Digit([1-3])$/.exec(e.code || '');
205     if (digit) {
206       const n = Number(digit[1]);
207       if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) {
208         e.preventDefault();
209         this.app.saveGroup(n);
210       } else {
211         this.app.selectGroup(n);
212       }
213       return;
214     }
215     if (k === 'tab') {
216       e.preventDefault();
217       if (this.app.ui.wheelOpen()) this.app.ui.hideWheel();
218       else this.app.ui.showWheel(this.r.width / 2, this.r.height / 2);
219       return;
220     }
221     if (k === 'escape' && this.app.ui.wheelOpen()) {
222       this.app.ui.hideWheel();
223       return;
224     }
225     if (k === 'escape') {
226       if (this.amoveArm) this.disarmAttackMove();
227       else if (this.placement) this.cancelPlacement();
228       else if (this.app.selection.length) this.app.setSelection([]);
229       else this.app.togglePause(true);
230     } else if (k === 'r' && this.placement && this.placement.kind === 'build') this.rotatePlacement();
231     else if (k === 'enter' && this.placement && this.placement.kind === 'build') this.confirmPlacement();
232     else if (k === 'b') this.app.ui.toggleBuild();
233     else if (k === ' ') {
234       e.preventDefault();
235       this.app.focusCore();
236     } else if (k === 'delete' || k === 'backspace') {
237       const s = this.app.selection;
238       if (s.length === 1 && s[0].kind === 'bld' && s[0].owner === 0) this.app.ui.demolishSelected();
239     } else if (k === 't') this.app.quickSelect('army');
240     else if (k === 'p') this.app.togglePause(true);
241     else if (k === 'f') this.armAttackMove();
242     else if (k === 'c') this.app.selectBuilders();
243   }
244 
245   update(dt) {
246     if (!this.active()) return;
247     const cam = this.r.cam;
248     const sp = cam.dist * 1.1 * dt;
249     let fx = 0;
250     let fz = 0;
251     if (this.keys.has('w') || this.keys.has('arrowup')) fz -= 1;
252     if (this.keys.has('s') || this.keys.has('arrowdown')) fz += 1;
253     if (this.keys.has('a') || this.keys.has('arrowleft')) fx -= 1;
254     if (this.keys.has('d') || this.keys.has('arrowright')) fx += 1;
255     if (fx || fz) {
256       const s = Math.sin(cam.yaw);
257       const c = Math.cos(cam.yaw);
258       cam.tx += (fx * c + fz * s) * sp;
259       cam.tz += (-fx * s + fz * c) * sp;
260     }
261     if (this.keys.has('q')) cam.yaw += dt * 1.6;
262     if (this.keys.has('e')) cam.yaw -= dt * 1.6;
263   }
264 
265   hover(x, y) {
266     const c = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
267     this.r.setHover(c ? c.i : -1);
268   }
