270   // ---------- avanzar atacando ----------
271   // mode: true = «Avanzar atacando»; 'patrol' = «Patrullar» (v1.4).
272   armAttackMove(mode = true) {
273     const armed = this.app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.owner === 0 && e.alive && e.def.weapon);
274     if (!armed.length) {
275       this.app.ui.toast('Elige primero tropas que puedan pelear', 'bad');
276       return false;
277     }
278     this.amoveArm = mode;
279     this.app.ui.selSig = '';
280     this.app.ui.toast(mode === 'patrol' ? 'Toca el otro punto: irán y volverán entre aquí y allí, peleando en el camino'
281       : 'Toca el destino: avanzarán peleando con todo lo que encuentren');
282     return true;
283   }
284 
285   disarmAttackMove() {
286     if (!this.amoveArm) return;
287     this.amoveArm = false;
288     if (this.app.ui) this.app.ui.selSig = '';
289   }

291   // ---------- toques ----------
292   tap(x, y, right) {
293     const g = this.game;
294     const app = this.app;
295     if (this.placement && !right) {
296       this.placementTap(x, y);
297       return;
298     }
299     const amove = this.amoveArm;
300     this.disarmAttackMove();
301     const mine = app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.owner === 0 && e.alive);
302     const unit = this.r.pickUnit(x, y);
303     const cell = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
304     const bld = cell && cell.bld && cell.bld.alive ? cell.bld : (!unit ? this.r.pickBuilding(x, y) : null);
305     const point = !unit && !bld && cell && cell.point ? cell.point : null;
306     const target = unit || bld;
307     const now = performance.now();
308     const dbl = now - this.lastTap.t < 330 && Math.hypot(x - this.lastTap.x, y - this.lastTap.y) < 30;
309     this.lastTap = { t: now, x, y, id: target ? target.id : -1 };
310 
311     // Avanzar atacando: a ese lugar, peleando en el camino (sobre un enemigo, se ataca directo).
312     if (amove === 'patrol' && mine.length && cell) {
313       const n = g.orderPatrol(mine, cell.i);
314       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffd166);
315       app.ui.toast(n ? `${n === 1 ? 'Patrulla' : `${n} tropas patrullan`} entre aquí y allí` : 'Esas tropas no pueden patrullar', n ? 'info' : 'bad');
316       app.sound.play('order');
317       return;
318     }
319     if (amove && mine.length && cell && !(target && g.isEnemy(target.owner, 0))) {
320       g.orderMove(mine, cell.i, true, app.formation);
321       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff6060);
322       app.ui.toast(`${mine.length === 1 ? 'Avanza' : `${mine.length} tropas avanzan`} atacando`);
323       app.sound.play('order');
324       return;
325     }
326 
327     if (target && g.isEnemy(target.owner, 0)) {
328       if (mine.length) {
329         const armed = mine.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && g.canAttack(u, u.def.weapon, target));
330         if (armed.length) {
331           g.orderAttack(armed, target);
332           this.r.addMoveMarker(target.kind === 'bld' ? target.cell : target.cell, 0xff6060);
333           app.sound.play('order');
334           const rest = mine.filter((u) => !armed.includes(u));
335           if (rest.length) g.orderMove(rest, target.cell);
336         } else {
337           app.ui.toast('Tus tropas seleccionadas no pueden atacar eso', 'bad');
338         }
339         return;
340       }
341       app.setSelection([target]);
342       return;
343     }
344     if (right) {
345       if (mine.length && cell) this.moveTo(mine, cell.i);
346       return;
347     }
348     // Constructores seleccionados + toque en una obra tuya = construir o mejorar.
349     if (bld && bld.owner === 0 && g.needsWork(bld)) {
350       const workers = mine.filter((u) => g.canBuildSite(u, bld));
351       if (workers.length) {
352         g.orderBuild(workers, bld);
353         this.r.addMoveMarker(bld.cell, 0xf2ab38);
354         app.ui.toast(`${workers.length === 1 ? 'Construyendo' : `${workers.length} constructores en`} ${bld.def.name}`);
355         app.sound.play('order');
356         return;
357       }
358     }
359     // Ingeniero seleccionado + toque en un edificio tuyo dañado = reparar.
360     if (bld && bld.owner === 0 && bld.hp < bld.maxHp && bld.built) {
361       const fixers = mine.filter((u) => u.def.repairs);
362       if (fixers.length) {
363         g.orderRepair(fixers, bld);
364         const rest = mine.filter((u) => !u.def.repairs);
365         if (rest.length) g.orderMove(rest, bld.cell);
366         this.r.addMoveMarker(bld.cell, 0x6dff8a);
367         app.ui.toast(`Reparando ${bld.def.name}`);
368         app.sound.play('order');
369         return;
370       }
371     }
372     // Toque en el Faro o una Bandera: con tropas seleccionadas, ir a capturarlo.
373     if (point) {
374       if (mine.length) {
375         g.orderMove(mine, cell.i, true);
376         this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffb63a);
377         const inf = mine.some((u) => u.cls === 'inf');
378         app.ui.toast(inf ? 'Quédate junto al punto sin enemigos cerca para capturarlo'
379           : 'Solo la infantería captura puntos', inf ? 'info' : 'bad');
380         app.sound.play('order');
381       } else {
382         app.setSelection([point]);
383         app.sound.play('click');
384       }
385       return;
386     }
387     // Tropas seleccionadas + toque en tu transporte (Barcaza, Lancha, Jeep, Transporte, Portaaviones) = subir.
388     if (target && target.owner === 0 && (target.def.capacity || target.def.hangar)) {
389       const landers = mine.filter((u) => g.canBoard(u, target));
390       if (landers.length) {
391         g.orderBoard(landers, target);
392         this.r.addMoveMarker(target.cell, 0x7dd3ff);
393         app.ui.toast(`Subiendo ${landers.length} ${landers.length === 1 ? 'tropa' : 'tropas'} a ${target.def.name}`);
394         app.sound.play('order');
395         return;
396       }
397     }
398     if (target && target.owner === 0) {
399       if (target.kind === 'unit' && dbl) {
400         const same = this.r.unitsInRect(0, 0, this.r.width, this.r.height, (u) => u.owner === 0 && u.type === target.type);
401         app.setSelection(same.length ? same : [target]);
402       } else {
403         app.setSelection([target]);
404       }
405       app.sound.play('click');
406       return;
407     }
408     if (target) {
409       app.setSelection([target]);
410       return;
411     }
412     if (mine.length && cell) {
413       this.moveTo(mine, cell.i);
414       return;
415     }
416     app.setSelection([]);
417   }

419   moveTo(units, ci) {
420     const g = this.game;
421     const founders = units.filter((u) => u.state === 'found');
422     g.orderMove(units, ci, false, this.app.formation);
423     for (const u of founders) u.foundCell = -1;
424     this.r.addMoveMarker(ci);
425     this.app.sound.play('order');
426   }

428   // ---------- colocación ----------
429   startPlacement(p) {
430     if (p.kind === 'build') {
431       p.rot = this.lastRot[p.btype] || 0;
432       p.cell = -1;
433       p.err = null;
434       p.placed = 0;
435     }
436     this.placement = p;
437     this.refreshPlacement();
438     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
439   }
440 
441   previewAt(ci) {
442     const p = this.placement;
443     p.cell = ci;
444     p.err = this.game.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, ci);
445     this.r.setGhost(p.btype, ci, p.rot, !p.err);
446     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
447   }
448 
449   rotatePlacement() {
450     const p = this.placement;
451     if (!p || p.kind !== 'build') return;
452     p.rot = (p.rot + Math.PI / 3) % (Math.PI * 2);
453     this.lastRot[p.btype] = p.rot;
454     if (p.cell >= 0) this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, !p.err);
455     this.app.sound.play('click');
456   }

458   // «Construir» (v1.0): tocar una casilla solo muestra la obra fantasma; este botón la pone.
459   // Después se puede elegir otra casilla y volver a construir; «Terminar» sale.
460   confirmPlacement() {
461     const p = this.placement;
462     if (!p || p.kind !== 'build') return;
463     if (p.cell < 0) {
464       this.app.ui.toast('Toca primero una casilla dorada', 'bad');
465       this.app.sound.play('error');
466       return;
467     }
468     this.buildAt(p.cell);
469   }
470 
471   // Pone la obra en la casilla elegida y sigue en modo construir para poner más.
472   buildAt(ci) {
473     const g = this.game;
474     const p = this.placement;
475     p.cell = ci;
476     const err = g.place(0, p.btype, p.cell, p.rot);
477     if (err) {
478       p.err = err;
479       this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, false);
480       this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
481       this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
482       this.app.sound.play('error');
483       return;
484     }
485     this.lastRot[p.btype] = p.rot;
486     this.r.addMoveMarker(p.cell, 0xf5c542);
487     this.app.ui.refreshBuild(true);
488     p.placed++;
489     p.cell = -1;
490     p.err = null;
491     this.r.setGhost(null, -1);
492     this.r.setHover(-1);
493     this.refreshPlacement();
494     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
495   }
496 
497   refreshPlacement() {
498     const p = this.placement;
499     if (!p || !this.game) return;
500     const g = this.game;
501     let cells = [];
502     if (p.kind === 'build') {
503       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, c.i, true)).map((c) => c.i);
504     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
505       const u = p.unit;
506       const comp = g.cells[u.cell].comp;
507       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.foundInvalid(0, c.i, u.def.founds) &&
508         (u.mover !== 'land' || c.comp === comp)).map((c) => c.i);
509     } else if (p.kind === 'rally' || p.kind === 'bombzone' || p.kind === 'allyattack') {
510       cells = [];
511     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
512       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.nukeInvalid(p.building, c.i) && g.map.dist(c, g.cells[p.building.cell]) <= NUKE.range).map((c) => c.i);
513     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
514       const silos = g.readySilos(0).slice(0, 3);
515       cells = silos.length < 3 || g.salvoInvalid(0) ? [] : g.cells.filter((c) => silos.every((b) => !g.nukeInvalid(b, c.i))).map((c) => c.i);
516     }
517     p.valid = new Set(cells);
518     this.r.setPlacement(cells);
519     if (p.kind === 'build' && p.cell >= 0) {
520       const err = g.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, p.cell);
521       if (err !== p.err) {
522         p.err = err;
523         this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, !err);
524         this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
525       }
526     }
527   }
528 
529   cancelPlacement() {
530     this.placement = null;
531     if (this.r) {
532       this.r.setPlacement(null);
533       this.r.setGhost(null, -1);
534       this.r.hoverMesh.material.color.set(0xffffff);
535       this.r.setHover(-1);
536     }
537     this.app.ui.hidePlaceBar();
538   }
539 
540   placementTap(x, y) {
541     const g = this.game;
542     const p = this.placement;
543     const cell = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
544     if (!cell) return;
545     if (p.kind === 'build') {
546       this.previewAt(cell.i);
547       this.app.sound.play('click');
548     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
549       if (!p.unit.alive) {
550         this.cancelPlacement();
551         return;
552       }
553       const err = g.orderFound(p.unit, cell.i);
554       if (err) {
555         this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
556         this.app.sound.play('error');
557         return;
558       }
559       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xf5c542);
560       this.app.ui.toast('El ingeniero va en camino (cuesta 800 al llegar)');
561       this.cancelPlacement();
562     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
563       const err = g.launchNuke(p.building, cell.i);
564       if (err) {
565         this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
566         this.app.sound.play('error');
567         return;
568       }
569       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
570       this.cancelPlacement();
571     } else if (p.kind === 'allyattack') {
572       // El rival es el dueño de lo que tocaste: edificio, tropa cercana o territorio.
573       let pid = cell.bld && cell.bld.alive ? cell.bld.owner : -1;
574       if (pid < 0) {
575         const u = g.units.find((x) => x.alive && Math.hypot(x.x - cell.x, x.z - cell.z) < 1.2 && g.isEnemy(0, x.owner));
576         if (u) pid = u.owner;
577       }
578       if (pid < 0 && cell.owner >= 0) pid = cell.owner;
579       if (pid < 0 || !g.isEnemy(0, pid)) {
580         this.app.ui.toast('Toca algo de un rival', 'bad');
581         this.app.sound.play('error');
582         return;
583       }
584       const bots = g.bots.filter((b) => b.p.alive && b.p.team === g.players[0].team && b.pid !== 0);
585       const n = bots.reduce((a, b) => a + b.answerAttack(pid), 0);
586       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
587       this.app.ui.toast(`Tus aliados atacan a ${g.players[pid].name}${n ? ` con ${n} tropas` : ''}`, 'good');
588       this.app.sound.play('order');
589       this.cancelPlacement();
590     } else if (p.kind === 'bombzone') {
591       const bombers = p.units.filter((u) => u.alive);
592       if (bombers.length) {
593         g.orderMove(bombers, cell.i, true);
594         this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
595         this.app.ui.toast(`${bombers.length === 1 ? 'El Bombardero va' : 'Los Bombarderos van'} a bombardear la zona`, 'info');
596         this.app.sound.play('order');
597       }
598       this.cancelPlacement();
599     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
600       const res = g.launchSalvo(0, cell.i);
601       if (typeof res === 'string') {
602         this.app.ui.toast(res, 'bad');
603         this.app.sound.play('error');
604         return;
605       }
606       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
607       this.app.ui.toast(`¡${res} misiles nucleares lanzados a la vez!`, 'info');
608       this.cancelPlacement();
609     } else if (p.kind === 'rally') {
610       p.building.rally = cell.i;
611       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffffff);
612       this.cancelPlacement();
613       this.app.ui.toast('Punto de reunión fijado');
614     }
615   }

  19   formation: '<path d="M4 8h3M10.5 8h3M17 8h3M4 15h3M10.5 15h3M17 15h3"/>',
  20   stop: '<rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="1.5"/>',
  21   // v1.3: «Más detalles» (lista) y «Menos» (flecha arriba).
  22   more: '<path d="M5 7h14M5 12h14M5 17h9"/>',
  23   // v1.4: patrullar (ida y vuelta), mantener posición (ancla), reparar, siempre (bucle).
  24   patrol: '<path d="M4 9h13l-3-3M20 15H7l3 3"/>',
  25   hold: '<circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2"/><path d="M12 7v13M6 14a6 6 0 0 0 12 0M4 12h3M17 12h3"/>',
  26   wrench: '<path d="M14.5 5.5a4 4 0 0 0-5 5L4 16l4 4 5.5-5.5a4 4 0 0 0 5-5l-2.5 2.5-2.5-.5-.5-2.5z"/>',
  27   less: '<path d="M6 15l6-6 6 6"/>',
  28   upgrade: '<path d="M12 19V6M6 11l6-6 6 6"/><path d="M6 20h12"/>',
  29   demolish: '<path d="M5 5l14 14M19 5 5 19"/>',
  30   rally: '<path d="M6 21V4M6 4h11l-2.5 4L17 12H6"/>',
  31   repeat: '<path d="M4 12a8 8 0 0 1 13.7-5.6M20 4v5h-5M20 12a8 8 0 0 1-13.7 5.6M4 20v-5h5"/>',
  32   group: '<path d="M7 3h10v18l-5-4-5 4z"/>',
  33   unload: '<path d="M12 4v11M7 10l5 5 5-5M5 20h14"/>',
  34   found: '<path d="M6 21V4h10l-2 3.5L16 11H6M18 15v6M15 18h6"/>',
  35   dome: '<path d="M3 18a9 9 0 0 1 18 0zM2 18h20"/>',
  36 };
  37 const bi = (k) => `<span class="bi" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${BTN_ICON[k]}</svg></span>`;
  38 
  39 function esc(s) {
  40   return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
  41 }

  57   showScreen(name) {

  60     $('pause').hidden = true;
  61     $('end').hidden = true;
  62     $('brief').hidden = true;

  64     if (this.app.lobby) {

  66       if (name === 'menu') this.app.lobby.render();

  76   // ---------- campaña ----------
  77   // Historia y metas al empezar una misión. La partida espera en pausa hasta «¡A jugar!».
  78   showBrief() {
  79     const app = this.app;
  80     const m = Campaign.def(app.game.camp.id);
  81     app.paused = true;
  82     const el = $('brief');
  83     el.innerHTML = `<div class="dialog panel wide brief" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="brief-title">
  84       <small class="lbl">Campaña · Misión ${m.id} de ${CAMPAIGN.length}</small>
  85       <h2 id="brief-title">${esc(m.name)}</h2>
  86       <p class="story">${esc(m.story)}</p>
  87       <div class="brief-grid">
  88         <div><h3 class="lbl">Meta</h3><p><b>${esc(Campaign.goalText(m))}</b></p></div>
  89         <div><h3 class="lbl">Estrellas</h3><ul class="starlist"><li><b>★ Termina la misión</b></li>
  90           ${m.stars.map((s) => `<li><b>★ ${esc(Campaign.starText(s))}</b></li>`).join('')}</ul></div>
  91       </div>
  92       <p class="tip"><b>Consejo:</b> ${esc(m.tip)}</p>
  93       <div class="row brief-go"><button class="btn gold" type="button" id="btn-brief-go">¡A jugar!</button>
  94         <button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-brief-menu">Vestíbulo</button></div>
  95     </div>`;
  96     el.hidden = false;
  97     $('btn-brief-go').addEventListener('click', () => {
  98       app.sound.unlock();
  99       app.sound.play('click');
 100       this.hideBrief();
 101     });
 102     $('btn-brief-menu').addEventListener('click', () => {

 114   // Panel de la misión: meta con su progreso y las estrellas (con su estado en vivo).
 115   renderMission(force) {
 116     const g = this.app.game;
 117     if (!g || !g.camp) return;
 118     const lines = Campaign.goalLines(g).map((l) => `<li class="${l.done ? 'done' : ''}">${esc(l.text)}</li>`);
 119     const stars = Campaign.stars(g).slice(1).map((s) =>
 120       `<li class="star ${s.live ? '' : 'lost'}"><span>${esc(s.text)}<small>${esc(s.live ? s.now : 'ya no se puede')}</small></span></li>`);
 121     const html = lines.join('') + stars.join('');
 122     if (!force && html === this.missionSig) return;
 123     this.missionSig = html;
 124     $('objlist').innerHTML = html;

 127   // ---------- HUD ----------
 128   initHud() {
 129     const app = this.app;
 130     $('btn-pause').addEventListener('click', () => app.togglePause(true));
 131     $('btn-resume').addEventListener('click', () => app.togglePause(false));

 136     $('btn-quit').addEventListener('click', () => app.toMenu());
 137     $('btn-fps').addEventListener('click', () => app.toggleFps());

 144       b.addEventListener('click', () => { app.sound.unlock(); app.music.setLevel(Number(b.dataset.music)); this.updateMusicBtns(); });

 183     });
 184     $('btn-home').addEventListener('click', () => app.focusCore());
 185     $('btn-box').addEventListener('click', () => {
 186       app.input.boxMode = !app.input.boxMode;
 187       $('btn-box').classList.toggle('on', app.input.boxMode);
 188       if (app.input.boxMode) this.toast('Arrastra para seleccionar varias tropas');
 189     });

 192     });
 193     document.querySelectorAll('[data-group]').forEach((b) => {

 195     });
 196     $('btn-builders').addEventListener('click', () => app.selectBuilders());
 197     $('prodbar').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 198       const b = e.target.closest('[data-prod]');
 199       if (!b || !app.game) return;
 200       const bld = app.game.buildings.find((x) => x.id === Number(b.dataset.prod) && x.alive);
 201       if (!bld) return;
 202       app.sound.play('click');
 203       app.setSelection([bld]);
 204       app.focusAt(bld.x, bld.z);

 207     $('btabs').innerHTML = BUILD_TABS.map((t) =>
 208       `<button class="tab" role="tab" type="button" data-tab="${t.id}" aria-selected="${t.id === this.tab}">${esc(t.name)}</button>`).join('');
 209     $('btabs').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 210       const b = e.target.closest('[data-tab]');
 211       if (!b) return;
 212       this.tab = b.dataset.tab;
 213       $('btabs').querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach((x) => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(x.dataset.tab === this.tab)));
 214       this.renderBuildList();

 216     $('blist').addEventListener('click', (e) => {

 222       const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 223       if (def.limit && g.count(0, type) >= def.limit) {
 224         this.toast(`Límite alcanzado (${def.limit})`, 'bad');
 225         return;

 232     $('selpanel').addEventListener('click', (e) => this.onSelClick(e));
 233     // Fichas de unidad: mantener pulsada una tarjeta (o pasar el ratón) muestra sus datos.
 234     const sp = $('selpanel');
 235     sp.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
 236       const card = e.target.closest('.card[data-type]');
 237       if (!card) return;
 238       clearTimeout(this.pressT);
 239       this.suppressClick = false;
 240       this.pressT = setTimeout(() => {
 241         this.suppressClick = true;
 242         this.showCardInfo(card.dataset.type);
 243       }, 450);
 244     });
 245     const endPress = () => clearTimeout(this.pressT);
 246     sp.addEventListener('pointerup', endPress);
 247     sp.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPress);
 248     sp.addEventListener('pointerover', (e) => {
 249       if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
 250       const card = e.target.closest('.card[data-type]');
 251       if (card) this.showCardInfo(card.dataset.type);
 252     });
 253     sp.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => { if (e.target.closest('.card')) e.preventDefault(); });
 254     // Desglose de economía y marcador.
 255     document.querySelectorAll('[data-econ]').forEach((el) => {
 256       const open = () => this.togglePop('econ', el.dataset.econ);
 257       el.addEventListener('click', open);
 258       el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open(); } });
 259     });
 260     $('players').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePop('score'));
 261     $('players').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); this.togglePop('score'); } });
 262     for (const id of ['econ', 'score', 'chatpop']) {
 263       $(id).addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 264         if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) this.togglePop(null);
 265         const ab = e.target.closest('[data-ally]');
 266         if (ab) this.allyAction(ab.dataset.ally, Number(ab.dataset.pid));
 267         const ct = e.target.closest('[data-chattab]');
 268         if (ct) { this.chatTab = ct.dataset.chattab; this.chatKey = null; this.renderPop(); }
 269         const qm = e.target.closest('[data-qmsg]');
 270         if (qm) this.quickMsg(qm.dataset.qmsg);
 271         if (e.target.closest('[data-openchat]')) { this.chatKey = null; this.togglePop('chat'); }
 272       });
 273     }
 274 
 275     const mm = $('minimap');
 276     const moveCam = (e) => {
 277       if (!app.renderer || app.state !== 'play') return;
 278       const rect = mm.getBoundingClientRect();
 279       const w = app.renderer.minimapToWorld(mm, e.clientX - rect.left, e.clientY - rect.top);
 280       app.renderer.cam.tx = w.x;
 281       app.renderer.cam.tz = w.z;
 282     };
 283     mm.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
 284       e.preventDefault();
 285       try { mm.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* sin captura */ }
 286       this.mmDrag = true;
 287       moveCam(e);
 288     });
 289     mm.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (this.mmDrag) moveCam(e); });
 290     mm.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { this.mmDrag = false; });
 291     mm.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { this.mmDrag = false; });
 292   }

 323   startHud() {
 324     this.selSig = '';
 325     this.buildSig = '';
 326     this.playersSig = '';
 327     $('toasts').innerHTML = '';
 328     $('objectives').hidden = false;
 329     const camp = this.app.game.camp;

 331     const small = window.innerWidth <= 860 || window.innerHeight <= 520;

 337     if (camp) this.renderMission(true);
 338     else $('objlist').innerHTML = this.objList().map((o) => `<li data-obj="${o.id}" class="${this.app.game.objDone[o.id] ? 'done' : ''}">${esc(o.text)}</li>`).join('');
 339     $('btn-box').classList.remove('on');
 340     this.groupsSig = '';
 341     this.renderGroups(true);
 342     this.prodSig = '';
 343     for (const a of this.edgeAlerts || []) if (a.el) a.el.remove();
 344     this.edgeAlerts = [];
 345     $('king').hidden = !this.app.game.mode.king;
 346     $('feed').innerHTML = '';
 347     this.togglePop(null);
 348     this.cardInfoType = null;

 368   // Tarjeta «Qué mejoró» (v0.9): sale al terminar cada mejora de un edificio tuyo.
 369   upgradeCard(b, level, lines) {
 370     const box = $('toasts');
 371     const el = document.createElement('div');
 372     el.className = 'toast upcard good';
 373     const name = b.def.levelNames ? b.def.levelNames[level] : `${b.def.name} · nivel ${level}`;
 374     el.innerHTML = `<b>${ICON_UP} ${esc(name)}: qué mejoró</b><ul>${lines.map((l) => `<li>${esc(l)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
 375     el.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
 376     el.addEventListener('click', () => el.remove());
 377     box.appendChild(el);
 378     while (box.children.length > 3) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
 379     setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 7000);
 380   }
 381 
 382   toast(text, kind = 'info', at = null) {
 383     const now = performance.now();
 384     if (this.lastToast[text] && now - this.lastToast[text] < 1200) return;
 385     this.lastToast[text] = now;
 386     const box = $('toasts');
 387     const el = document.createElement('div');
 388     el.className = 'toast ' + kind;
 389     const span = document.createElement('span');
 390     span.textContent = text;
 391     el.appendChild(span);
 392     if (at && at.x !== undefined) {
 393       el.classList.add('has-btn');
 394       const b = document.createElement('button');
 395       b.type = 'button';
 396       b.className = 'mini-btn';
 397       b.textContent = 'Ver';
 398       b.addEventListener('click', () => {
 399         this.app.focusAt(at.x, at.z);
 400         el.remove();
 401       });
 402       el.appendChild(b);
 403     }
 404     box.appendChild(el);
 405     while (box.children.length > 3) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
 406     setTimeout(() => el.remove(), at ? 5000 : 2800);
 407   }
 408 
 409   // Mensaje de un bot: al panel de mensajes (pantallas anchas) o como aviso (estrechas).
 410   chat(msg) {
 411     const g = this.app.game;
 412     if (!msg.toMe && !msg.ally && !msg.public) return;
 413     const p = g.players[msg.pid];
 414     const who = msg.ally ? `${p.name} (aliado)` : p.name;
 415     const at = msg.x !== undefined ? { x: msg.x, z: msg.z } : null;
 416     const feed = $('feed');
 417     const wide = feed.offsetParent !== null;
 418     if (wide) {
 419       const el = document.createElement('div');
 420       el.className = 'msg' + (msg.toMe ? ' bad' : '');
 421       el.innerHTML = `<i style="background:${hexColor(p.color)}"></i><div><b>${esc(who)}:</b> ${esc(msg.text)}</div>`;
 422       if (at) {
 423         const b = document.createElement('button');
 424         b.type = 'button';
 425         b.className = 'mini-btn';
 426         b.textContent = 'Ver';
 427         b.addEventListener('click', () => this.app.focusAt(at.x, at.z));
 428         el.appendChild(b);
 429       }
 430       feed.appendChild(el);
 431       while (feed.children.length > 4) feed.removeChild(feed.firstChild);
 432       setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('old'), 15000);
 433       setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 40000);
 434     }
 435     if (msg.toMe || !wide) this.toast(`${who}: ${msg.text}`, msg.toMe ? 'bad' : 'info', msg.toMe ? at : null);
 436     if (msg.toMe) this.app.sound.play('alarm');
 437   }
 438 
 439   // ---------- tutorial que señala qué tocar (v1.2) ----------
 440   // Si sigues en modo construir (la obra ya está puesta y el modo sigue para poner más), primero se sale de él:
 441   // si no, tocar un edificio o una tropa no la elige.
 442   coachStep(g) {
 443     const step = this.coachStepRaw(g);
 444     const p = this.app.input.placement;
 445     if (step && p && !step.place) {
 446       return { sel: '#btn-place-cancel', text: p.placed ? 'Toca «Terminar» para salir del modo construir' : 'Toca «Cancelar» para salir de este modo' };
 447     }
 448     return step;
 449   }
 450 
 451   coachStepRaw(g) {
 452     const app = this.app;
 453     const me = g.players[0];
 454     const mine = g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive);
 455     const blds = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.alive);
 456     const sel = app.selection;
 457     const core = me.core;
 458     const p = app.input.placement;
 459     const bp = $('buildpanel');
 460     // (offsetParent no sirve con paneles «position: fixed»; se mira si ocupa lugar en la pantalla.)
 461     const shown = (el) => !!el && el.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden';
 462     const panelOpen = shown(bp) && !bp.classList.contains('min') && (window.innerWidth > 860 || bp.classList.contains('open'));
 463     const buildFlow = (tab, type, name, tabName) => {
 464       if (p && p.kind === 'build' && p.btype === type) {
 465         if (p.cell < 0) {
 466           const c = [...(p.valid || [])].map((i) => g.cells[i]).sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(a, g.cells[core.cell]) - g.map.dist(b, g.cells[core.cell]))[0];
 467           return c ? { world: { x: c.x, y: c.h, z: c.z }, text: 'Toca una casilla dorada (por ejemplo, esta)', place: true } : { text: 'No quedan casillas libres', place: true };
 468         }
 469         return { sel: '#btn-place-ok', text: 'Toca «Construir» para poner la obra', place: true };
 470       }
 471       if (!panelOpen) return { sel: '#btn-build', text: 'Abre «Construir»' };
 472       if (this.tab !== tab) return { sel: `#btabs [data-tab="${tab}"]`, text: `Abre la pestaña «${tabName}»` };
 473       return { sel: `.bitem[data-b="${type}"]`, text: `Elige «${name}»` };
 474     };
 475     const hasBuilder = mine.some((u) => u.def.builds) || core.queue.some((q) => q.type === 'builder');
 476     if (!hasBuilder) {
 477       if (!(sel.length === 1 && sel[0] === core)) return { world: { x: core.x, y: core.y + 1, z: core.z }, text: 'Toca tu Núcleo' };
 478       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="builder"]', text: 'Entrena un Constructor' };
 479     }
 480     // v1.3: los 3 pasos de tu documento. 1 Construí: otra Granja y una energía.
 481     const at = (e, dy = 0.5) => ({ x: e.x, y: (e.y || 0) + dy, z: e.z });
 482     const isSel = (e) => sel.length === 1 && sel[0] === e;
 483     if (blds.filter((b) => b.type === 'farm').length < 2) return buildFlow('eco', 'farm', 'Granja', 'Economía');
 484     if (!blds.some((b) => ['solar', 'wind', 'hydro', 'tidal', 'wave'].includes(b.type))) return buildFlow('energy', 'solar', 'Solar', 'Energía');
 485     // 2 Producí: un Cuartel y 3 soldados.
 486     const bar = blds.find((b) => b.type === 'barracks');
 487     if (!bar) return buildFlow('prod', 'barracks', 'Cuartel', 'Producción');
 488     const soldiers = mine.filter((u) => u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon);
 489     const inQueue = bar.queue.filter((q) => UNITS[q.type].cls === 'inf' && UNITS[q.type].weapon).length;
 490     if (soldiers.length + inQueue < 3) {
 491       if (!bar.built) return { world: at(bar), text: 'El Constructor va a la obra: espera a que termine el Cuartel' };
 492       if (!isSel(bar)) return { world: at(bar), text: 'Toca tu Cuartel' };
 493       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="rifle"]', text: `Entrena Artilleros (tienes ${soldiers.length + inQueue} de 3)` };
 494     }
 495     // 3 Atacá: Puerto, Barcaza, subir a los soldados, cruzar y tomar la isla del bot.
 496     const foe = g.players.find((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && q.core && q.core.alive);
 497     if (!foe) return null;
 498     const foeComp = g.cells[foe.core.cell].comp;
 499     const landed = soldiers.filter((u) => !u.inside && g.cells[u.cell].comp === foeComp);
 500     if (landed.length) {
 501       if (!sel.some((u) => u.kind === 'unit' && u.def.weapon)) return { sel: '[data-quick="army"]', text: 'Toca «Ejército» para elegir a tus soldados' };
 502       return { world: at(foe.core, 1), text: 'Toca el Núcleo del bot para tomar su isla' };
 503     }
 504     const harbor = blds.find((b) => b.type === 'harbor');
 505     if (!harbor) return buildFlow('prod', 'harbor', 'Puerto', 'Producción');
 506     const barge = mine.find((u) => u.type === 'barge');
 507     if (!barge) {
 508       if (!harbor.built) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'El Constructor va a la obra: espera a que termine el Puerto' };
 509       if (harbor.queue.some((q) => q.type === 'barge')) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'El Puerto fabrica la Barcaza: espera' };
 510       if (!isSel(harbor)) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'Toca tu Puerto' };
 511       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="barge"]', text: 'Entrena una Barcaza: lleva tropas por el mar' };
 512     }
 513     const ashore = soldiers.filter((u) => !u.inside);
 514     if (soldiers.length < 3) return { world: at(bar), text: `Espera a tus soldados (${soldiers.length} de 3)` };
 515     if (ashore.length) {
 516       if (ashore.every((u) => u.state === 'board')) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Los soldados suben a la Barcaza: espera' };
 517       if (!sel.some((u) => u.kind === 'unit' && u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon)) return { sel: '[data-quick="army"]', text: 'Toca «Ejército» para elegir a tus soldados' };
 518       return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca la Barcaza para subirlos' };
 519     }
 520     // Todos a bordo: llevar la Barcaza junto a la isla del bot y desembarcar.
 521     const c0 = g.cells[barge.cell];
 522     const nearFoe = g.cells.some((c) => c.comp === foeComp && TERRAIN[c.t].land && g.map.dist(c, c0) <= 2);
 523     if (!nearFoe) {
 524       if (barge.path && barge.pathI < barge.path.length) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'La Barcaza navega hacia la isla del bot: espera' };
 525       if (!isSel(barge)) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca tu Barcaza' };
 526       const dest = this.landingCell(g, foe, foeComp);
 527       return dest ? { world: { x: dest.x, y: 0.1, z: dest.z }, text: 'Toca el mar junto a la isla del bot para llevarla' } : { text: 'No hay costa libre junto a la isla del bot' };
 528     }
 529     if (!isSel(barge)) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca tu Barcaza' };
 530     return { sel: '[data-act="unload"]', text: 'Toca «Desembarcar»' };
 531   }
 532 
 533   // Casilla de mar junto a la isla del bot, lo más cerca posible de su Núcleo.
 534   landingCell(g, foe, foeComp) {
 535     if (this._landing && this._landing.g === g && this._landing.pid === foe.id) return this._landing.c;
 536     const core = g.cells[foe.core.cell];
 537     const c = g.cells.filter((x) => TERRAIN[x.t].water && !x.bld && x.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === foeComp && TERRAIN[g.cells[ni].t].land))
 538       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(a, core) - g.map.dist(b, core))[0] || null;
 539     this._landing = { g, pid: foe.id, c };
 540     return c;
 541   }

 543   updateCoach() {
 544     const app = this.app;
 545     const g = app.game;
 546     let el = $('coach');
 547     const step = g && g.mode.tutorial && !g.over && app.state === 'play' && !app.paused ? this.coachStep(g) : null;
 548     if (!step) {
 549       if (el) el.hidden = true;
 550       return;
 551     }
 552     if (!el) {
 553       el = document.createElement('div');
 554       el.id = 'coach';
 555       el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
 556       el.innerHTML = '<div class="coach-ring"></div><div class="coach-tip"></div>';
 557       document.body.appendChild(el);
 558       this._tipKey = null;
 559     }
 560     let rect = null;
 561     let text = step.text;
 562     if (step.sel) {
 563       const t = document.querySelector(step.sel);
 564       if (t && t.getClientRects().length > 0) {
 565         const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
 566         rect = { x: r.left - 6, y: r.top - 6, w: r.width + 12, h: r.height + 12 };
 567       }
 568     } else if (step.world && app.renderer) {
 569       const sp = app.renderer.project(step.world.x, step.world.y, step.world.z);
 570       const onScreen = sp.ok && sp.x > 24 && sp.x < window.innerWidth - 24 && sp.y > 24 && sp.y < window.innerHeight - 24;
 571       // ¿Lo tapa un panel? (por ejemplo, el de «Construir»): tocar ahí tocaría el panel, no el mapa.
 572       const top = onScreen ? document.elementFromPoint(sp.x, sp.y) : null;
 573       const covered = onScreen && !!top && top.id !== 'gl' && top.id !== 'overlay';
 574       if (onScreen && !covered) rect = { x: sp.x - 30, y: sp.y - 30, w: 60, h: 60, round: true };
 575       else {
 576         // Fuera de la pantalla: el aro señala ese lugar en el minimapa (tocarlo lleva la cámara allí).
 577         const mm = $('minimap');
 578         if (mm && mm.getClientRects().length > 0) {
 579           const r = mm.getBoundingClientRect();
 580           const m = app.renderer.worldToMinimap(mm, step.world.x, step.world.z);
 581           rect = { x: r.left + clamp(m.x, 0, r.width) - 16, y: r.top + clamp(m.y, 0, r.height) - 16, w: 32, h: 32, round: true };
 582           text = covered ? 'Lo tapa un panel: toca este punto del minimapa para centrarlo'
 583             : 'Está fuera de la pantalla: toca este punto del minimapa para ir allí';
 584         }
 585       }
 586     }
 587     el.hidden = false;
 588     const ring = el.querySelector('.coach-ring');
 589     const tip = el.querySelector('.coach-tip');
 590     ring.hidden = !rect;
 591     if (rect) Object.assign(ring.style, { left: `${rect.x}px`, top: `${rect.y}px`, width: `${rect.w}px`, height: `${rect.h}px`, borderRadius: rect.round ? '50%' : '12px' });
 592     // v1.4: se mide el texto de verdad (con «Letra grande» es más ancho y más alto).
 593     const tipKey = text + document.body.classList.contains('bigtext');
 594     if (this._tipKey !== tipKey || tip.textContent !== text) {
 595       tip.textContent = text;
 596       this._tipKey = tipKey;
 597       this._tipSize = { w: tip.offsetWidth || 220, h: tip.offsetHeight || 44 };
 598     }
 599     const { w: tw, h: th } = this._tipSize;
 600     const W = window.innerWidth;
 601     const Hh = window.innerHeight;
 602     const tx = rect ? clamp(rect.x + rect.w / 2 - tw / 2, 8, W - tw - 8) : W / 2 - tw / 2;
 603     const below = rect ? rect.y + rect.h + 8 : 120;
 604     const ty = clamp(rect && below + th + 8 > Hh ? rect.y - th - 8 : below, 8, Math.max(8, Hh - th - 8));
 605     Object.assign(tip.style, { left: `${tx}px`, top: `${ty}px` });
 606     this.coachText = text;
 607   }

 609   // ---------- rueda de selección del ejército (v1.2) ----------
 610   wheelOpen() {
 611     return !!this.wheel;

 614   showWheel(x, y) {
 615     this.hideWheel();
 616     const app = this.app;
 617     const g = app.game;
 618     if (!g || app.state !== 'play') return;
 619     const count = (f) => g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && !u.inside && f(u)).length;
 620     const opts = [
 621       { k: 'army', label: 'Tierra', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'land') },
 622       { k: 'sea', label: 'Mar', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'sea') },
 623       { k: 'air', label: 'Aire', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'air') },
 624       { k: 'all', label: 'Todo', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon) },
 625       { k: 'builders', label: 'Constructores', n: count((u) => u.def.builds === 'land') },
 626       { k: 'g1', label: 'Grupo 1', n: (app.groups[1] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 627       { k: 'g2', label: 'Grupo 2', n: (app.groups[2] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 628       { k: 'g3', label: 'Grupo 3', n: (app.groups[3] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 629     ];
 630     // Radio para que las 8 opciones (84 px de ancho) no se pisen entre sí.
 631     const R = 122;
 632     const cx = clamp(x, R + 50, window.innerWidth - R - 50);
 633     const cy = clamp(y, R + 40, window.innerHeight - R - 40);
 634     const el = document.createElement('div');
 635     el.id = 'wheel';
 636     el.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
 637     el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Rueda de selección');
 638     el.innerHTML = `<div class="wheel-hub" style="left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px">Elegir</div>` + opts.map((o, i) => {
 639       const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / opts.length) * Math.PI * 2;
 640       return `<button type="button" role="menuitem" class="wheel-opt" data-wk="${o.k}" style="left:${cx + Math.cos(a) * R}px;top:${cy + Math.sin(a) * R}px" ${o.n ? '' : 'disabled'}>
 641         <b>${o.label}</b><small>${o.n}</small></button>`;
 642     }).join('');
 643     el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 644       const b = e.target.closest('[data-wk]');
 645       if (b && !b.disabled) this.pickWheel(b.dataset.wk);
 646       else if (!e.target.closest('.wheel-opt')) this.hideWheel();
 647     });
 648     document.body.appendChild(el);
 649     this.wheel = el;
 650     app.sound.play('click');
 651   }
 652 
 653   hoverWheel(x, y) {
 654     if (!this.wheel) return;
 655     const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
 656     this.wheel.querySelectorAll('.wheel-opt').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('hot', b === (hit && hit.closest('.wheel-opt'))));
 657   }
 658 
 659   releaseWheel(x, y) {
 660     if (!this.wheel) return;
 661     const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
 662     const b = hit && hit.closest('.wheel-opt');
 663     if (b && !b.disabled) this.pickWheel(b.dataset.wk);
 664   }

 679   // ---------- alianzas y órdenes a los aliados (v1.1) ----------
 680   allyAction(kind, pid) {
 681     const app = this.app;
 682     const g = app.game;
 683     if (!g) return;
 684     if (kind === 'ask') {
 685       const res = g.proposeAlliance(0, pid);
 686       this.toast(res.text, res.ok ? 'good' : 'bad');
 687       app.sound.play(res.ok ? 'ready' : 'error');
 688     } else if (kind === 'break') {
 689       if (this.breakArm !== pid) {
 690         this.breakArm = pid;
 691         this.toast(`¿Romper la alianza con ${g.players[pid].name}? Toca «Romper» otra vez`, 'bad');
 692         setTimeout(() => { if (this.breakArm === pid) this.breakArm = null; }, 4000);
 693         return;
 694       }
 695       this.breakArm = null;
 696       const err = g.breakAlliance(0);
 697       if (err) this.toast(err, 'bad');
 698       else {
 699         g.say(pid, 'Rompiste la alianza. Ahora somos rivales otra vez.', { force: true, toMe: true });
 700         this.toast(`Ya no eres aliado de ${g.players[pid].name}`, 'info');
 701       }
 702     } else if (kind === 'help' || kind === 'attack') {
 703       this.allyOrder(kind);
 704       return;
 705     }
 706     this.renderPop();
 707   }

 709   // ---------- mensajes (v1.2): pestañas Todos / Aliados y mensajes rápidos ----------
 710   chatHtml(g) {
 711     const tab = this.chatTab || 'all';
 712     const me = g.players[0];
 713     const list = g.chat.filter((m) => (tab === 'ally' ? m.ally : (m.ally || m.toMe || m.public))).slice(-30);
 714     const rows = list.length ? list.map((m) => {
 715       const p = g.players[m.pid];
 716       const who = m.mine ? 'Tú' : p.name + (m.ally ? ' (aliado)' : '');
 717       return `<p class="${m.mine ? 'mine' : ''}"><i style="background:${hexColor(p.color)}"></i><b>${esc(who)}:</b> ${esc(m.text)}<small>${fmtTime(m.time)}</small></p>`;
 718     }).join('') : `<p>${tab === 'ally' ? 'Todavía no hay mensajes de aliados.' : 'Todavía no hay mensajes.'}</p>`;
 719     const hasAllies = g.players.some((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && !q.human && q.team === me.team) && me.alive;
 720     const quick = hasAllies ? `<div class="quickmsgs">${['¡Gracias!', '¡Bien hecho!', '¡Cuidado!'].map((t) => `<button class="btn mini" type="button" data-qmsg="${t}">${t}</button>`).join('')}
 721       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="help" data-pid="0">¡Ayuda!</button>
 722       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="attack" data-pid="0">¡Ataquemos!</button></div>`
 723       : '<p class="allyhint">Cuando tengas aliados, aquí puedes mandarles mensajes rápidos.</p>';
 724     return `<header><h4>Mensajes</h4><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">${ICON.close}</button></header>
 725       <div class="chattabs" role="tablist"><button class="btn mini" type="button" role="tab" data-chattab="all" aria-selected="${tab === 'all'}">Todos</button>
 726       <button class="btn mini" type="button" role="tab" data-chattab="ally" aria-selected="${tab === 'ally'}">Aliados</button></div>
 727       <div class="chatlog" id="chatlog">${rows}</div>${quick}`;
 728   }

 742   allyOrder(kind) {

 746     if (!bots.length) return;

 750       app.sound.play('order');

 758   togglePop(which, sub) {
 759     const same = this.pop === which && this.popSub === sub;
 760     this.pop = same ? null : which;
 761     this.popSub = sub;
 762     $('econ').hidden = this.pop !== 'econ';

 768   renderPop() {
 769     const g = this.app.game;
 770     if (!g || !this.pop) return;
 771     if (this.pop === 'econ') $('econ').innerHTML = this.popSub === 'energy' ? this.energyHtml(g) : this.econHtml(g);
 772     else if (this.pop === 'chat') {
 773       // Solo se vuelve a dibujar si llegó un mensaje nuevo (para no cortar el desplazamiento).
 774       const key = `${g.chat.length}:${g.chat.length ? g.chat[g.chat.length - 1].time : 0}:${this.chatTab}`;
 775       if (key !== this.chatKey) { this.chatKey = key; $('chatpop').innerHTML = this.chatHtml(g); }
 776     } else $('score').innerHTML = this.scoreHtml(g);

 779   econHtml(g) {
 780     const p = g.players[0];
 781     const rows = [];
 782     const groups = new Map();
 783     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 784       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== 0 || !b.built || !b.def.income) continue;
 785       const k = groups.get(b.type) || { n: 0, sum: 0 };
 786       k.n++;
 787       k.sum += b.def.income;
 788       groups.set(b.type, k);
 789     }
 790     for (const [type, k] of groups) rows.push([`${BUILDINGS[type].name}${k.n > 1 ? ` ×${k.n}` : ''}`, k.sum]);
 791     const flags = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.owner === 0 && pt.def.income);
 792     if (flags.length) rows.push([`Banderas ×${flags.length}`, flags.reduce((s, pt) => s + pt.def.income, 0)]);
 793     rows.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
 794     const bonus = p.income - p.baseIncome;
 795     let html = '<header><h4>Monedas por minuto</h4><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">' + ICON.close + '</button></header><table><tbody>';
 796     html += rows.map(([n, v]) => `<tr><td>${esc(n)}</td><td class="n">+${fmt(v)}</td></tr>`).join('');
 797     if (bonus > 0) {
 798       html += `<tr><td>Subtotal</td><td class="n">${fmt(p.baseIncome)}</td></tr><tr><td>Faro (+${Math.round(p.bonus * 100)} %)</td><td class="n">+${fmt(bonus)}</td></tr>`;
 799     }
 800     html += `<tr class="total"><td>Total</td><td class="n" id="econ-total">+${fmt(p.income)}</td></tr></tbody></table>`;
 801     if (!groups.has('farm') && !groups.has('mine')) html += '<p class="hint-press" style="margin:0">Construye Granjas y Minas para ganar más.</p>';
 802     return html;
 803   }
 804 
 805   energyHtml(g) {
 806     const p = g.players[0];
 807     const groups = new Map();
 808     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 809       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== 0 || !b.built || !b.def.energy) continue;
 810       const k = groups.get(b.type) || { n: 0, sum: 0 };
 811       k.n++;
 812       k.sum += g.bEnergy(b);
 813       groups.set(b.type, k);
 814     }
 815     let html = '<header><h4>Energía</h4><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">' + ICON.close + '</button></header><table><tbody>';
 816     if (!groups.size) html += '<tr><td>Sin energías</td><td class="n">+0 / 10 s</td></tr>';
 817     for (const [type, k] of groups) html += `<tr><td>${esc(BUILDINGS[type].name)} ×${k.n}</td><td class="n">+${k.sum} / 10 s</td></tr>`;
 818     html += `<tr class="total"><td>Disponible</td><td class="n">${fmt(p.energy)}</td></tr></tbody></table>`;
 819     html += '<p class="hint-press" style="margin:0">La producen Solar, Eólica, Hidráulica, Mareomotriz y Undimotriz. La gastan vehículos, buques de guerra, helicópteros, la Fábrica y el Helipuerto.</p>';
 820     return html;
 821   }
 822 
 823   scoreHtml(g) {
 824     const land = g.cells.filter((c) => TERRAIN[c.t].land).length || 1;
 825     const terr = new Map();
 826     for (const c of g.cells) if (c.owner >= 0 && TERRAIN[c.t].land) terr.set(c.owner, (terr.get(c.owner) || 0) + 1);
 827     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
 828     const rows = g.players.map((p) => {
 829       const army = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === p.id && u.def.weapon).length;
 830       const blds = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === p.id).length;
 831       const pts = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.owner === p.id).length;
 832       const role = p.human ? '—' : PERSONALITIES[p.persona].name;
 833       const rel = p.id === 0 ? '' : p.team === myTeam ? ' · aliado' : '';
 834       // v1.1: alianzas en los modos de todos contra todos.
 835       const canAlly = g.alliancesAllowed() && p.id !== 0 && p.alive && g.players[0].alive;
 836       const allyBtn = !canAlly ? '' : p.team === myTeam
 837         ? `<button class="btn mini danger" type="button" data-ally="break" data-pid="${p.id}">Romper</button>`
 838         : `<button class="btn mini" type="button" data-ally="ask" data-pid="${p.id}">Aliarse</button>`;
 839       return `<tr class="${p.alive ? '' : 'dead'}" data-pid="${p.id}"><td><i class="dot" style="background:${hexColor(p.color)}"></i>${esc(p.name)}</td>
 840         <td>${esc(role)}${rel}${allyBtn}</td><td class="n">${Math.round(((terr.get(p.id) || 0) / land) * 100)} %</td>
 841         <td class="n">${army}</td><td class="n">${blds}</td><td class="n">${p.alive ? '+' + fmt(p.income) : '—'}</td><td class="n">${pts}</td></tr>`;
 842     }).join('');
 843     const hasAllies = g.players.some((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && !q.human && q.team === myTeam) && g.players[0].alive;
 844     const orders = hasAllies ? `<div class="allyorders"><span>A tus aliados:</span>
 845       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="help" data-pid="0" id="btn-ally-help">¡Ayuda!</button>
 846       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="attack" data-pid="0" id="btn-ally-attack">¡Ataquemos!</button></div>` : '';
 847     const hint = g.alliancesAllowed() ? '<p class="allyhint">Toca «Aliarse» para proponer una alianza: los aliados no se atacan y comparten lo que ven. Al final solo puede ganar uno.</p>' : '';
 848     return `<header><h4>Marcador · ${fmtTime(g.time)}</h4><span class="row" style="gap:6px"><button class="btn mini" type="button" data-openchat id="btn-open-chat">Mensajes</button><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">${ICON.close}</button></span></header>${orders}${hint}
 849       <div class="wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Imperio</th><th>Estilo</th><th>Territorio</th><th>Ejército</th><th>Edificios</th><th>Monedas/min</th><th>Puntos</th></tr></thead>
 850       <tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div>`;
 851   }

 861   planeHtml(planes) {

 872       if (type === 'fighter') {
 873         cells.push(`<span>Misiles aire-aire</span><b>${w.dmg} · ×${w.mult.air} a aviones</b>`, `<span>Alcance</span><b>${w.range} casillas</b>`);
 874       } else {

 876         const seen = g.time - (u.lastShot || -99) < 3;

 878           `<span>Furtivo</span><b class="${seen ? 'radar-lock' : ''}">${seen ? 'Visible (acaba de soltar bombas)' : 'Oculto: solo se ve a 3 casillas'}</b>`);

 881         <div><div class="radar-status"><b>${esc(d.name)}</b>${list.length > 1 ? ` ×${list.length}` : ''}</div><div class="numbers">${cells.join('')}</div></div></div>`);

 907   radarHtml(b) {

 915     const t = b.lockOn && b.lockOn.alive && g.inRange(b, w, b.lockOn) ? b.lockOn : b.autoTarget && b.autoTarget.alive ? b.autoTarget : null;
 916     let status = '<b class="radar-idle">Sin blancos</b>';
 917     if (t) {

 919       const locking = w.lock && b.lockOn === t && b.lockT > 0;
 920       status = `<b class="${locking ? 'radar-track' : 'radar-lock'}">${locking ? 'Siguiendo' : 'Fijado'}: ${esc(name)}</b>`;
 921     }
 922     return `<div class="radar"><div class="radar-scope" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div>
 923       <div class="radar-body"><div class="radar-status">Radar · ${status}</div><div class="numbers">${rows.join('')}</div></div></div>`;

 927   // v1.5: «la próxima en 3 s · todo en 12 s» (o por qué no avanza).
 928   queueTimeText(b) {
 929     const g = this.app.game;
 930     if (!b.queue.length) return '';
 931     const rate = g.prodRate(b);
 932     if (!(rate > 0)) return 'parada: falta energía';
 933     const q = b.queue[0];
 934     const first = Math.max(0, (UNITS[q.type].build - q.t) / rate);
 935     let total = first;
 936     for (let i = 1; i < b.queue.length; i++) total += UNITS[b.queue[i].type].build / rate;
 937     const f = (x) => (x < 60 ? `${Math.ceil(x)} s` : fmtTime(x));
 938     return b.queue.length > 1 ? `la próxima en ${f(first)} · todas en ${f(total)}` : `lista en ${f(first)}`;
 939   }

 941   // v1.5: ficha de una tropa: vida, daño, alcance, velocidad y contra qué es buena o mala.
 942   unitTilesHtml(u) {
 943     const d = u.def;
 944     const w = d.weapon;
 945     const tiles = [['Vida máxima', fmt(u.maxHp), u.vet ? 'gold' : '']];
 946     if (w) {
 947       const mult = 1 + (u.vet || 0) * VETERAN.dmg;
 948       tiles.push(['Daño/s', fmt((w.dmg * mult) / w.cd), u.vet ? 'gold' : '']);
 949       tiles.push(['Alcance', `${w.range} casillas`, '']);
 950     }
 951     tiles.push(['Velocidad', d.speed.toLocaleString('es-ES'), '']);
 952     let html = `<div class="coretiles unittiles">${tiles.map(([k, v, c]) => `<div class="ctile ${c}"><small>${k}</small><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
 953     if (w) {
 954       const cls = ['inf', 'veh', 'ship', 'sub', 'air', 'bld'];
 955       const strong = cls.filter((c) => (w.mult[c] || 0) >= 1.2).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
 956       const weak = cls.filter((c) => w.mult[c] > 0 && w.mult[c] <= 0.5).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
 957       const none = cls.filter((c) => !(w.mult[c] > 0)).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
 958       const line = [];
 959       if (strong.length) line.push(`<span class="vs good">Fuerte contra: <b>${strong.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
 960       if (weak.length) line.push(`<span class="vs bad">Débil contra: <b>${weak.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
 961       if (none.length) line.push(`<span class="vs muted">No ataca a: <b>${none.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
 962       if (line.length) html += `<div class="vsline">${line.join('')}</div>`;
 963     }
 964     return html;
 965   }

1011   showPlaceBar(p) {
1012     let text = '';
1013     const isBuild = p.kind === 'build';
1014     $('btn-place-rot').hidden = !isBuild;
1015     $('btn-place-ok').hidden = !isBuild;
1016     $('btn-place-cancel').hidden = false;
1017     $('btn-place-cancel').textContent = isBuild && p.placed ? 'Terminar' : 'Cancelar';
1018     if (isBuild) {
1019       // v1.0: tocar una casilla muestra la obra; «Construir» la pone; «Terminar» sale.
1020       const d = BUILDINGS[p.btype];
1021       const price = `<span class="cost">${fmt(d.cost)}</span>${d.energyCost ? ` <span class="ecost">${ICON.bolt}${d.energyCost}</span>` : ''}`;
1022       const placed = p.placed ? ` · <b>${p.placed}</b> ${p.placed === 1 ? 'puesta' : 'puestas'}` : '';
1023       if (p.err && p.cell >= 0) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · <span class="err">${esc(p.err)}</span>${placed}`;
1024       else if (p.cell >= 0) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${price} · Toca «Construir» para poner la obra aquí${placed}`;
1025       else if (p.valid && p.valid.size) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${price} · Toca una casilla dorada y luego «Construir»${placed}`;
1026       else text = `No quedan casillas para ${esc(d.name)} en tu territorio${placed}. ${esc(d.desc)}`;
1027       $('btn-place-ok').disabled = p.cell < 0 || !!p.err;
1028       $('btn-place-rot').disabled = false;
1029     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
1030       text = p.valid && p.valid.size
1031         ? 'Toca dónde fundar el <b>Puesto avanzado</b> · <span class="cost">800</span> al llegar'
1032         : 'No hay sitio alcanzable para fundar un puesto';
1033     } else if (p.kind === 'rally') {
1034       text = 'Toca el <b>punto de reunión</b> para las tropas nuevas';
1035     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
1036       text = `Toca el blanco del <b>misil nuclear</b> · <span class="cost">${fmt(NUKE.cost)}</span> · llega en ${NUKE.flight} s`;
1037     } else if (p.kind === 'allyattack') {
1038       text = 'Toca un edificio, una tropa o el territorio del <b>rival</b> que quieres atacar con tus aliados';
1039     } else if (p.kind === 'bombzone') {
1040       text = `Toca la <b>zona a bombardear</b>: ${p.units.length} ${p.units.length === 1 ? 'Bombardero va' : 'Bombarderos van'} atacando los edificios que encuentren`;
1041     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
1042       text = `Toca el blanco de los <b>3 misiles nucleares</b> · <span class="cost">${fmt(NUKE.cost * 3)}</span> · llegan en ${NUKE.flight} s`;
1043     }
1044     $('placetext').innerHTML = text;
1045     $('placebar').hidden = false;
1046     $('selpanel').hidden = true;

1069   refreshBuild(force) {
1070     const g = this.app.game;
1071     if (!g) return;
1072     const p = g.players[0];
1073     const placing = this.app.input.placement;
1074     const items = $('blist').querySelectorAll('[data-b]');
1075     let sig = '';
1076     const states = [];
1077     items.forEach((el) => {
1078       const k = el.dataset.b;
1079       const d = BUILDINGS[k];
1080       const n = g.count(0, k);
1081       const poor = p.coins < d.cost;
1082       const poorE = !!d.energyCost && p.energy < d.energyCost;
1083       const limit = g.limitFor(0, k);
1084       const maxed = limit && n >= limit;
1085       const act = placing && placing.kind === 'build' && placing.btype === k;
1086       states.push([el, k, d, n, poor, maxed, act, poorE, limit]);
1087       sig += `${k}${n}${poor}${maxed}${act}${poorE}${limit}|`;
1088     });
1089     if (!force && sig === this.buildSig) return;
1090     this.buildSig = sig;
1091     for (const [el, k, d, n, poor, maxed, act, poorE, limit] of states) {
1092       el.classList.toggle('poor', poor);
1093       el.classList.toggle('poorE', poorE);
1094       el.classList.toggle('maxed', !!maxed);
1095       el.classList.toggle('active', !!act);
1096       const cnt = el.querySelector(`[data-count="${k}"]`);
1097       if (cnt) cnt.textContent = limit ? ` (${n}/${limit})` : n ? ` (${n})` : '';
1098     }
1099   }
1100 
1101   // ---------- panel de selección ----------
1102   renderSel(force) {
1103     const app = this.app;
1104     const g = app.game;
1105     const panel = $('selpanel');
1106     const sel = app.selection.filter((e) => e.alive);
1107     if (!sel.length || app.input.placement) {
1108       panel.hidden = true;
1109       this.selSig = '';
1110       return;
1111     }
1112     const p = g.players[0];
1113     let sig = sel.map((e) => e.id).join(',');
1114     const first = sel[0];
1115     if (first.kind === 'point') {
1116       sig += `|${first.owner}|${first.contested}|${Math.round(first.prog * 20)}`;
1117     } else if (first.kind === 'bld') {
1118       sig += `|${first.built}|${first.queue.map((q) => q.type).join('.')}|${first.rally >= 0}|${this.demolishArm}|${first.level}` +
1119         `|${first.upgrading ? first.upgrading.level + ':' + Math.floor(first.upgrading.progress * 20) : ''}|${first.built ? '' : Math.floor(first.progress * 20)}` +
1120         `|${g.time - first.lastWork > 1.5}|${first.lastType || ''}|${first.loop ? 1 : 0}${first.loopWait || ''}`;
1121       if (first.def.produces) {
1122         sig += '|' + first.def.produces.map((t) => p.coins >= UNITS[t].cost && p.energy >= (UNITS[t].energy || 0)).join('');
1123       }
1124       const uc = g.upgradeCost(first);
1125       if (uc) sig += '|u' + (p.coins >= uc);
1126       if (first.type === 'airport') sig += '|p' + g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === 0 && u.cls === 'air' && Math.hypot(u.x - first.x, u.z - first.z) < 4.5).map((u) => u.id + ':' + Math.floor((u.hp / u.maxHp) * 10)).join(',') + g.units.filter((u) => u.def.plane && u.owner === 0).length;
1127       if (first.type === 'aadef' || first.type === 'turret') sig += `|r${first.lockOn && first.lockOn.alive ? first.lockOn.id + (first.lockT > 0 ? 't' : 'l') : first.autoTarget && first.autoTarget.alive ? 'a' + first.autoTarget.id : '-'}`;
1128       if (first.type === 'aadef' || first.type === 'antinuke') sig += `|n${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (first.nukeReadyAt || first.chargeAt || 0) - g.time))}${p.coins >= NUKE.cost}${first.type === 'aadef' && first.level >= 4 ? g.salvoInvalid(0) : ''}`;
1129       if (first.type === 'core' && first.owner === 0) {
1130         const d = p.dome;
1131         sig += `|d${d ? d.level + ':' + (d.hp > 0 ? Math.ceil((d.hp / d.maxHp) * 10) : 'x') : ''}${p.coins >= g.domeCost(0)}|e${p.emergencyUsed}${first.shieldUntil > g.time}`;
1132         if (first.level >= AUTO_UP.coreLevel) {
1133           const cand = g.upgradeCandidates(0);
1134           sig += `|a${p.autoUpgrade ? 1 : 0}:${cand.length}:${cand.filter((x) => g.upgradeCost(x) <= p.coins).length}`;
1135         }
1136       }
1137     } else {
1138       sig += '|' + sel.map((u) => u.state === 'found').join('') + (p.coins >= 800) +
1139         sel.map((u) => (u.cargo ? u.cargo.length : '')).join('') + `|${this.app.formation}|${this.app.input.amoveArm}` +
1140         `|${sel.map((u) => `${u.patrol ? 'p' : ''}${u.hold ? 'h' : ''}${u.vet || 0}:${u.kills || 0}`).join(',')}|${g.players[0].autoRepair !== false}`;
1141       // Aviones (v1.0): estado, bombas y si el bombardero está oculto.
1142       for (const u of sel) if (u.def.plane) sig += `|${this.planeState(u)}${u.type === 'bomber' ? Math.ceil(Math.max(0, u.cd || 0)) + (g.time - (u.lastShot || -99) < 3 ? 'v' : 'o') : ''}`;
1143     }
1144     if (force || sig !== this.selSig) {
1145       this.selSig = sig;
1146       panel.hidden = false;
1147       panel.classList.toggle('more', !!this.selMore);
1148       if (first.kind === 'point') panel.innerHTML = this.pointHtml(first);
1149       else if (first.kind === 'bld') panel.innerHTML = this.buildingHtml(first);
1150       else if (first.owner === 0) panel.innerHTML = this.unitsHtml(sel);
1151       else panel.innerHTML = this.inspectHtml(first);
1152     }
1153     this.updateSelLive(sel);
1154   }

1156   head(type, color, title, sub, hpId = true) {
1157     return `<div class="selhead">
1158       <img class="thumb" src="${Thumbs.get(type, color)}" alt="">
1159       <div style="min-width:0"><h3>${title}</h3><p class="sec">${sub}</p>
1160         ${hpId ? '<div class="hp" id="sel-hpbar"><i id="sel-hp"></i></div><div class="hptext" id="sel-hptext"></div>' : ''}
1161       </div>
1162       <div class="headbtns"><button class="btn seltoggle" type="button" data-act="seldetails" id="btn-seldetails" aria-expanded="${!!this.selMore}">${this.selMore ? `${bi('less')}Menos` : `${bi('more')}Más detalles`}</button>
1163       <button class="btn icon" type="button" data-act="close" aria-label="Cerrar">${ICON.close}</button></div>
1164     </div>`;
1165   }

1167   buildingHtml(b) {
1168     const g = this.app.game;
1169     const own = b.owner === 0;
1170     const d = b.def;
1171     const extra = [];
1172     const inc = g.bIncome(b);
1173     if (inc) extra.push(`+${fmt(inc * g.incomeMult(g.players[b.owner]))} monedas/min`);
1174     if (g.bPop(b)) extra.push(`+${g.bPop(b)} de población`);
1175     if (d.energy) extra.push(`+${g.bEnergy(b)} energía cada 10 s`);
1176     if (d.healLevels) extra.push(`${d.healLevels[b.level].name}: cura ${Math.round(d.healLevels[b.level].pct * 100)} %/s`);
1177     if (d.minigun) extra.push(b.level > 1 ? `${b.level - 1} minigun${b.level > 2 ? 's' : ''}` : 'sin minigun');
1178     const sub = (own ? '' : `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner])}">${esc(g.players[b.owner].name)}</b> · `) +
1179       esc(d.desc) + (extra.length ? ' · ' + extra.join(' · ') : '');
1180     const maxLv = d.maxLevel;
1181     const lv = maxLv > 1
1182       ? ` <span class="lvtag">Nivel ${b.level}</span><span class="levels" title="Nivel ${b.level} de ${maxLv}">${Array.from({ length: maxLv }, (_, i) => `<i class="${i < b.level ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</span>` : '';
1183     const mkey = GLB[b.type + '_' + b.level] ? b.type + '_' + b.level : b.type;
1184     let html = this.head(mkey, PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], esc(d.levelNames ? d.levelNames[b.level] : d.name) + lv, sub);
1185     if (!own) return html + (g.isEnemy(b.owner, 0) ? this.counterHtml(b) : '');
1186     // Obra o mejora en curso.
1187     if (!b.built || b.upgrading) {
1188       const k = b.upgrading ? b.upgrading.progress : b.progress;
1189       const idle = g.time - b.lastWork > 1.5 && b.type !== 'outpost';
1190       const by = d.builtBy === 'sea' ? 'un Barco constructor' : d.builtBy === 'engineer' ? 'un Ingeniero' : 'un Constructor o Ingeniero';
1191       html += `<div class="queue"><b>${b.upgrading ? `Mejorando a nivel ${b.upgrading.level}` : 'En construcción'}</b> · ${Math.floor(k * 100)} % · ` +
1192         (idle ? `<span style="color:#ffb4b5">Sin constructor: selecciona ${by} y toca la obra.</span>` : 'Un constructor está trabajando.') + '</div>';
1193     }
1194     if (b.type === 'core') {
1195       const p = g.players[0];
1196       const dome = p.dome;
1197       // v0.9: el estado del Núcleo en casillas claras.
1198       const L = d.levels[b.level];
1199       const emer = p.emergencyUsed
1200         ? (b.shieldUntil > g.time ? ['Activo', 'gold'] : ['Usado', 'muted']) : ['Listo', 'good'];
1201       const tiles = [
1202         ['Monedas', `+${fmt(g.bIncome(b) * g.incomeMult(p))}/min`, ''],
1203         ['Comunidad', `+${g.bPop(b)}`, ''],
1204         ['Láser', `${L.laser.beams > 1 ? '2 × ' : ''}${L.laser.dmg} · ${L.laser.range} cas.`, ''],
1205         ['Emergencia', emer[0], emer[1]],
1206         ['Cúpula', dome ? (dome.hp > 0 ? `Nivel ${dome.level} · ${Math.round((dome.hp / dome.maxHp) * 100)} %`
1207           : `Rota · ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(DOME.recover - (g.time - dome.brokenAt)))} s`) : (b.level < 3 ? 'Núcleo nivel 3' : 'Disponible'),
1208         dome ? (dome.hp > 0 ? 'good' : 'bad') : 'muted'],
1209       ];
1210       html += `<div class="coretiles sec">${tiles.map(([k, v, c]) => `<div class="ctile ${c}"><small>${k}</small><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
1211       if (dome && dome.level >= 3 && dome.hp > 0) html += '<div class="queue sec">La Cúpula nivel 3 da escudo a tus tropas mientras están dentro de ella.</div>';
1212       const derr = g.domeInvalid(0);
1213       // v1.0: con el Núcleo en nivel 3, mejorar todo de un clic o dejar las mejoras automáticas.
1214       if (b.level >= AUTO_UP.coreLevel) {
1215         const cand = g.upgradeCandidates(0);
1216         let total = 0;
1217         let can = 0;
1218         let left = p.coins;
1219         for (const x of cand) {
1220           const c = g.upgradeCost(x);
1221           total += c;
1222           if (c <= left) { left -= c; can++; }
1223         }
1224         const auto = !!p.autoUpgrade;
1225         html += `<div class="upall"><div class="actions">
1226           <button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="upall" id="btn-upall" ${can ? '' : 'disabled'}>${bi('upgrade')}Mejorar todo · ${can} de ${cand.length}</button>
1227           <button class="btn ${auto ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="autoup" id="btn-autoup" aria-pressed="${auto}">${bi('repeat')}Mejoras automáticas: ${auto ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button></div>
1228           <span class="queue sec">${cand.length ? `Quedan ${cand.length} mejoras (${fmt(total)} en total). «Mejorar todo» pone a mejorar las que alcanza tu dinero; las automáticas siguen hasta el máximo y guardan ${fmt(AUTO_UP.reserve)} para tropas.` : 'Todo está al máximo.'}</span></div>`;
1229       }
1230       if (!dome || dome.level < 3) {
1231         const next = dome ? dome.level + 1 : 1;
1232         const label = dome ? `Mejorar Cúpula a nivel ${next}` : 'Comprar Cúpula';
1233         const why = b.level < 3 ? 'Necesita el Núcleo en nivel 3.' : next === 3 ? 'Nivel 3: escudo personal para todas tus tropas.'
1234           : `Absorbe el daño de barcos, aeronaves y Lanzamisiles a ${DOME_LEVELS[next].range} casillas del Núcleo.`;
1235         html += `<div class="actions"><button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="dome" ${derr && b.level < 3 ? 'disabled' : ''}>${bi('dome')}${label} · ${fmt(g.domeCost(0))}</button>
1236           <span class="queue sec" style="flex:1 1 200px">${why}</span></div>`;
1237       }
1238     }
1239     if (d.produces && b.built) {
1240       const pl = g.players[0];
1241       html += '<div class="cards">' + d.produces.map((t) => {
1242         const u = UNITS[t];
1243         const poor = pl.coins < u.cost || pl.energy < (u.energy || 0);
1244         return `<button class="card ${poor ? 'poor' : ''}" type="button" data-act="train" data-type="${t}" title="${esc(u.desc)}">
1245           <img src="${Thumbs.get(t, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">
1246           <b>${esc(u.name)}</b>
1247           <div class="meta"><span class="cost">${fmt(u.cost)}</span>${u.energy ? `<span class="ecost">${ICON.bolt}${u.energy}</span>` : ''}<span>${ICON.pop}${u.pop}</span></div>
1248         </button>`;
1249       }).join('') + '</div>';
1250       if (b.lastType && d.produces.includes(b.lastType)) {
1251         // Repetir (v0.7): vuelve a poner la última tropa entrenada, una o cinco veces.
1252         const lu = UNITS[b.lastType];
1253         html += `<div class="actions repeat"><span class="queue">Última: <b>${esc(lu.name)}</b></span>
1254           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="repeat" data-n="1" id="btn-repeat">${bi('repeat')}Repetir · ${fmt(lu.cost)}</button>
1255           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="repeat" data-n="5" id="btn-repeat5">${bi('repeat')}×5 · ${fmt(lu.cost * 5)}</button>
1256           <button class="btn ${b.loop ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="loop" id="btn-loop" aria-pressed="${!!b.loop}" title="Sigue entrenando la última tropa mientras alcance el dinero y la comunidad">${bi('repeat')}Siempre: ${b.loop ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button></div>`;
1257         if (b.loop && b.loopWait && !b.queue.length) html += `<div class="queue" id="loop-wait">Esperando: ${esc(b.loopWait)}</div>`;
1258       }
1259       const info = this.cardInfoType && d.produces.includes(this.cardInfoType) ? this.statsHtml(this.cardInfoType) : '';
1260       html += `<div class="cardinfo" id="cardinfo" ${info ? '' : 'hidden'}>${info}</div>`;
1261       // v1.5: la cola dice cuánto falta y cada tropa tiene su «×» para quitarla (devuelve el dinero).
1262       html += `<div class="queue ${b.queue.length ? '' : 'sec'}" id="sel-queue">` + (b.queue.length
1263         ? `<span class="qhead">En cola · <b id="sel-qtime">${this.queueTimeText(b)}</b></span>` + b.queue.map((q, i) => `<button class="qitem" type="button" data-act="cancel" data-idx="${i}" title="Quitar ${esc(UNITS[q.type].name)} (te devuelve ${fmt(UNITS[q.type].cost)})" aria-label="Quitar ${esc(UNITS[q.type].name)}">
1264             <img src="${Thumbs.get(q.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt=""><i style="width:0"></i><span class="qx" aria-hidden="true">×</span></button>`).join('') +
1265           '<span class="qnote">Toca una para quitarla: te devuelve el dinero.</span>'
1266         : 'Toca una tropa para entrenarla; mantenla pulsada para ver su ficha.') + '</div>';
1267     }
1268     if (b.built && d.weapon && (b.type === 'aadef' || b.type === 'turret')) html += this.radarHtml(b);
1269     if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.built && b.level >= 4) {
1270       // Misil nuclear (v0.9): muy caro, recarga de 3 min.
1271       const why = g.nukeInvalid(b);
1272       const wait = g.time < (b.nukeReadyAt || 0);
1273       html += `<div class="actions nukebox"><button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="nuke" id="btn-nuke" ${why ? 'disabled' : ''}>☢ Misil nuclear · ${fmt(NUKE.cost)}</button>
1274         <span class="queue" style="flex:1 1 200px">${wait ? `Recargando: ${Math.ceil(b.nukeReadyAt - g.time)} s` : why || `Listo. Daña todo en ${NUKE.radius} casillas y deja ${NUKE.rad.time} s de radiación; un Escudo antimisiles lo puede derribar.`}</span></div>`;
1275       // v1.0: los 3 a la vez (un Escudo antimisiles solo derriba uno por carga).
1276       const why3 = g.salvoInvalid(0);
1277       html += `<div class="actions nukebox"><button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="nuke3" id="btn-nuke3" ${why3 ? 'disabled' : ''}>☢☢☢ Lanzar los 3 · ${fmt(NUKE.cost * 3)}</button>
1278         <span class="queue" style="flex:1 1 200px">${why3 || 'Tus 3 AIR DEFENSE de nivel 4 disparan juntos al mismo blanco: un Escudo antimisiles solo puede derribar uno.'}</span></div>`;
1279     } else if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.built) {
1280       html += `<div class="queue">Nivel 4 (solo 3 de tus AIR DEFENSE): lanza el misil nuclear.</div>`;
1281     }
1282     if (b.type === 'airport' && b.built) html += this.airportHtml(b);
1283     if (b.type === 'antinuke' && b.built) {
1284       const ready = g.time >= (b.chargeAt || 0);
1285       html += `<div class="queue">${ready ? '<b style="color:var(--good)">Carga lista</b>: derriba un misil nuclear que caiga a 7 casillas.' : `Recargando: ${Math.ceil(b.chargeAt - g.time)} s`}</div>`;
1286       html += `<div class="queue">Defensa de punto: derriba misiles y cohetes enemigos a ${b.def.pointDefense.range} casillas · derribados: <b>${b.pdKills || 0}</b></div>`;
1287     }
1288     const acts = [];
1289     if (own && b.built && !b.upgrading && b.level < maxLv) {
1290       // v0.9: antes de pagar, qué vas a ganar con la mejora.
1291       const prev = g.upgradePreview(b).map((t) => t.replace(/^Ahora es /, 'Pasa a ser '));
1292       if (prev.length) html += `<div class="nextup"><small>Nivel ${b.level} → ${d.levelNames ? esc(d.levelNames[b.level + 1]) : `nivel ${b.level + 1}`}</small>${prev.map((t) => `<span>${esc(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;
1293     }
1294     if (b.built && !b.upgrading && b.level < maxLv) {
1295       const nextName = d.levelNames ? d.levelNames[b.level + 1] : `nivel ${b.level + 1}`;
1296       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="upgrade">${bi('upgrade')}Mejorar a ${nextName} · ${fmt(g.upgradeCost(b))}</button>`);
1297     }
1298     if (d.produces && b.built) acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="rally">${bi('rally')}${b.rally >= 0 ? 'Mover punto de reunión' : 'Punto de reunión'}</button>`);
1299     if (b.type !== 'core') {
1300       acts.push(`<button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="demolish">${bi('demolish')}${this.demolishArm === b.id ? '¿Seguro? Toca otra vez' : 'Demoler'}</button>`);
1301     }
1302     if (acts.length) html += `<div class="actions mainacts">${acts.join('')}</div>`;
1303     return html;
1304   }
