1306   unitsHtml(sel) {
1307     const counts = new Map();
1308     for (const u of sel) counts.set(u.type, (counts.get(u.type) || 0) + 1);
1309     const first = sel[0];
1310     const stars = (u) => (u.vet ? ` <span class="vetstars" title="Veterana: ${u.kills} eliminaciones">${'★'.repeat(u.vet)}</span>` : '');
1311     const vets = sel.filter((u) => u.vet).length;
1312     const title = sel.length === 1 ? esc(first.def.name) + stars(first) : `${sel.length} tropas${vets ? ` <span class="vetstars">★ ${vets}</span>` : ''}`;
1313     const sub = sel.length === 1 ? esc(first.def.desc) + (first.def.weapon ? ` · ${first.kills || 0} eliminaciones${first.vet < 3 ? ` (próxima estrella con ${VETERAN.kills[first.vet || 0]})` : ''}` : '') : 'Toca un destino para moverlas o un enemigo para atacarlo.';
1314     let html = this.head(first.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0], title, sub);
1315     if (sel.length === 1) html += this.unitTilesHtml(first);
1316     if (counts.size > 1) {
1317       // v1.5: tocar un tipo deja elegidas solo esas tropas.
1318       html += '<div class="chips">' + [...counts.entries()].map(([t, n]) =>
1319         `<button class="chip" type="button" data-act="seltype" data-type="${t}" title="Elegir solo ${esc(UNITS[t].name)}"><img src="${Thumbs.get(t, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">${n}× ${esc(UNITS[t].name)}</button>`).join('') + '</div>';
1320     }
1321     const acts = [];
1322     // Transportes (Barcaza, Lancha, Jeep, Transporte blindado) y hangar del Portaaviones.
1323     const ship = sel.length === 1 && (first.def.capacity || first.def.hangar) ? first : null;
1324     if (ship) {
1325       const g = this.app.game;
1326       const hangar = !!ship.def.hangar;
1327       const cap = ship.def.capacity || ship.def.hangar;
1328       const how = hangar ? 'Selecciona Cazas y toca el Portaaviones para guardarlos.'
1329         : ship.def.carries === 'inf' ? `Selecciona soldados y toca el ${ship.def.name} para subirlos.`
1330           : `Selecciona tropas de tierra y toca la ${ship.def.name} para subirlas.`;
1331       html += `<div class="queue">${hangar ? 'Hangar' : 'Carga'}: ${g.cargoSlots(ship)}/${cap}` +
1332         (ship.cargo.length ? ' · ' + ship.cargo.map((u) => `<img class="qitem" style="cursor:default" src="${Thumbs.get(u.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="${esc(u.def.name)}">`).join('')
1333           : ' · ' + how) + '</div>';
1334       const label = hangar ? 'Lanzar Cazas' : ship.mover === 'sea' ? 'Desembarcar' : 'Bajar soldados';
1335       if (ship.cargo.length) acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="unload">${bi('unload')}${label}</button>`);
1336     }
1337     const planes = sel.filter((u) => u.def.plane);
1338     if (planes.length) {
1339       html += this.planeHtml(planes);
1340       if (planes.some((u) => u.type === 'bomber')) {
1341         acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="bombzone" id="btn-bombzone">${bi('amove')}Bombardear zona</button>`);
1342       }
1343     }
1344     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.builds)) {
1345       html += `<div class="queue">Construye solo las obras pendientes. Tócalo y luego una obra para mandarlo; toca un edificio dañado para repararlo.</div>`;
1346     }
1347     const founder = sel.find((u) => u.def.founds);
1348     if (founder) {
1349       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="found">${bi('found')}Fundar puesto · 800</button>`);
1350     }
1351     const app = this.app;
1352     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.weapon)) {
1353       const arm = app.input.amoveArm;
1354       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${arm === true ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="amove" id="btn-amove" title="Avanzar atacando (F)">${bi('amove')}${arm === true ? 'Toca el destino…' : 'Avanzar atacando'}</button>`);
1355       // v1.4: patrullar y mantener posición.
1356       const patrolling = sel.some((u) => u.patrol);
1357       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${arm === 'patrol' || patrolling ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="patrol" id="btn-patrol" title="Van y vuelven entre aquí y el punto que toques, peleando en el camino">${bi('patrol')}${arm === 'patrol' ? 'Toca el otro punto…' : patrolling ? 'Patrullando' : 'Patrullar'}</button>`);
1358       const holding = sel.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).every((u) => u.hold);
1359       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${holding ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="hold" id="btn-hold" aria-pressed="${holding}" title="Se quedan quietas y solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro">${bi('hold')}Mantener posición: ${holding ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button>`);
1360     }
1361     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.repairs)) {
1362       // v1.4: los Constructores e Ingenieros libres reparan solos lo dañado cerca.
1363       const on = this.app.game.players[0].autoRepair !== false;
1364       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${on ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="autorep" id="btn-autorep" aria-pressed="${on}" title="Los Constructores e Ingenieros sin trabajo reparan solos los edificios dañados a ${AUTO_REPAIR.range} casillas">${bi('wrench')}Reparación sola: ${on ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button>`);
1365     }
1366     if (sel.length > 1) {
1367       acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="formation" id="btn-formation" title="Bloque: juntas · Línea: una al lado de otra, de frente al destino">${bi('formation')}Formación: ${app.formation === 'line' ? 'línea' : 'bloque'}</button>`);
1368     }
1369     acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="stop">${bi('stop')}Detener</button>`);
1370     html += `<div class="actions mainacts">${acts.join('')}</div>`;
1371     html += `<div class="actions groupsave"><span class="queue">${bi('group')}Guardar en</span>${[1, 2, 3].map((n) =>
1372       `<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="savegrp" data-v="${n}" title="Guardar en el grupo ${n} (Ctrl o Mayús + ${n})">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
1373     return html;
1374   }

1376   pointHtml(pt) {
1377     const g = this.app.game;
1378     const ownerTxt = pt.owner >= 0
1379       ? `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner])}">${esc(g.players[pt.owner].name)}</b>` : 'Sin dueño';
1380     const state = pt.contested ? 'En disputa: hay tropas de varios equipos cerca'
1381       : pt.owner < 0 && pt.prog > 0 ? `Capturando… ${Math.floor(pt.prog * 100)} %`
1382         : `Para capturarlo: infantería a 1 casilla y sin enemigos a ${CAPTURE.clear} casillas durante ${CAPTURE.time} s.`;
1383     let html = this.head(pt.type, pt.owner >= 0 ? PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner] : NEUTRAL, esc(pt.def.name),
1384       `${ownerTxt} · ${esc(pt.def.desc)}`, false);
1385     html += `<div class="queue">${state}</div>`;
1386     if (g.mode.king && pt.type === 'faro') {
1387       const parts = Object.entries(g.kingTime).map(([team, t]) => {
1388         const pid = g.players.findIndex((p) => String(p.team) === team);
1389         return `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pid])}">${esc(g.players[pid].name)}</b> ${fmtTime(t)}`;
1390       });
1391       html += `<div class="queue">Rey del Faro (meta ${fmtTime(KING_TIME)}): ${parts.join(' · ') || 'nadie lo ha controlado aún'}</div>`;
1392     }
1393     return html;
1394   }

1396   inspectHtml(e) {
1397     const g = this.app.game;
1398     const owner = g.players[e.owner];
1399     const rel = g.isEnemy(e.owner, 0) ? 'Enemigo' : 'Aliado';
1400     const sub = `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[e.owner])}">${esc(owner.name)}</b> · ${rel} · ${esc(e.def.desc)}`;
1401     return this.head(e.type, PLAYER_COLORS[e.owner], esc(e.def.name), sub) + (g.isEnemy(e.owner, 0) ? this.counterHtml(e) : '');
1402   }

1404   // Ficha del enemigo (v0.8): vida, nivel, contra qué es fuerte y qué conviene usar contra él.
1405   counterHtml(e) {
1406     const g = this.app.game;
1407     const cls = e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : e.cls;
1408     const w = e.kind === 'bld' ? g.weaponOf(e) : e.def.weapon;
1409     const rows = [`<span>Vida</span><b id="enemy-hp">${fmt(Math.max(0, e.hp))} / ${fmt(e.maxHp)} (${Math.round((Math.max(0, e.hp) / e.maxHp) * 100)} %)</b>`];
1410     if (e.kind === 'bld' && e.def.maxLevel > 1) rows.push(`<span>Nivel</span><b>${e.level} de ${e.def.maxLevel}</b>`);
1411     if (w && w.mult) {
1412       const strong = Object.entries(w.mult).filter(([k, v]) => v >= 1.2 && CAT_NAMES[k]).map(([k]) => CAT_NAMES[k]);
1413       const cant = Object.entries(w.mult).filter(([k, v]) => v === 0 && CAT_NAMES[k]).map(([k]) => CAT_NAMES[k]);
1414       rows.push(`<span>Fuerte contra</span><b>${strong.length ? strong.join(', ') : 'nada en especial'}</b>`);
1415       if (cant.length) rows.push(`<span>No ataca a</span><b>${cant.join(', ')}</b>`);
1416     } else {
1417       rows.push('<span>Ataque</span><b>no dispara</b>');
1418     }
1419     rows.push(`<span>Usa</span><b>${this.countersFor(cls).join(', ')}</b>`);
1420     return `<div class="cardinfo enemycard" id="enemycard">${rows.join('')}</div>`;
1421   }
1422 
1423   // Las 3 tropas que más daño hacen a esa clase por cada moneda (daño por segundo × multiplicador).
1424   countersFor(cls) {
1425     return Object.entries(UNITS)
1426       .filter(([, d]) => d.weapon && (d.weapon.mult[cls] || 0) > 0 && !d.limit)
1427       .map(([t, d]) => [t, ((d.weapon.dmg / d.weapon.cd) * d.weapon.mult[cls]) / Math.sqrt(d.cost)])
1428       .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 3).map(([t]) => UNITS[t].name);
1429   }

1464   onSelClick(e) {
1465     const btn = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
1466     if (!btn) return;
1467     const app = this.app;
1468     const g = app.game;
1469     const sel = app.selection.filter((x) => x.alive);
1470     const act = btn.dataset.act;
1471     if (act === 'train' && this.suppressClick) {
1472       this.suppressClick = false;
1473       return;
1474     }
1475     app.sound.play('click');
1476     if (act === 'seldetails') {
1477       // v1.3: las partes largas del panel se pliegan; este botón las muestra u oculta.
1478       this.selMore = !this.selMore;
1479       this.renderSel(true);
1480       return;
1481     }
1482     if (act === 'close') {
1483       app.setSelection([]);
1484       return;
1485     }
1486     if (!sel.length) return;
1487     const b = sel[0];
1488     if (act === 'train') {
1489       const err = g.enqueue(b, btn.dataset.type);
1490       if (err) {
1491         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1492         app.sound.play('error');
1493       }
1494       this.renderSel(true);
1495     } else if (act === 'seltype') {
1496       const keep = this.app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.type === btn.dataset.type);
1497       if (keep.length) this.app.setSelection(keep);
1498     } else if (act === 'cancel') {
1499       g.cancelQueue(b, Number(btn.dataset.idx));
1500       this.renderSel(true);
1501     } else if (act === 'rally') {
1502       app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'rally', building: b });
1503     } else if (act === 'demolish') {
1504       this.demolishSelected();
1505     } else if (act === 'found') {
1506       const u = sel.find((x) => x.def.founds);
1507       if (u) {
1508         app.setSelection([u]);
1509         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'found', unit: u });
1510       }
1511     } else if (act === 'upgrade') {
1512       const res = g.upgrade(b);
1513       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1514         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1515         app.sound.play('error');
1516       } else {
1517         app.setSelection([res]);
1518         this.toast(`Mejora de ${res.def.name} pagada: un constructor la hará`, 'good');
1519       }
1520     } else if (act === 'upall') {
1521       const res = g.upgradeAll(0);
1522       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1523         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1524         app.sound.play('error');
1525       } else if (!res.n) {
1526         this.toast('No alcanza el dinero para ninguna mejora', 'bad');
1527         app.sound.play('error');
1528       } else {
1529         this.toast(`Mejorando ${res.n} ${res.n === 1 ? 'edificio' : 'edificios'} (−${fmt(res.spent)}): tus constructores van a cada obra`, 'good');
1530       }
1531       this.renderSel(true);
1532     } else if (act === 'autoup') {
1533       const pl = g.players[0];
1534       pl.autoUpgrade = !pl.autoUpgrade;
1535       this.toast(pl.autoUpgrade ? 'Mejoras automáticas encendidas: se mejora solo hasta el máximo' : 'Mejoras automáticas apagadas', pl.autoUpgrade ? 'good' : 'info');
1536       this.renderSel(true);
1537     } else if (act === 'dome') {
1538       const err = g.buyDome(0);
1539       if (err) {
1540         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1541         app.sound.play('error');
1542       } else {
1543         this.toast(`Cúpula nivel ${g.players[0].dome.level}`, 'good');
1544       }
1545       this.renderSel(true);
1546     } else if (act === 'unload') {
1547       const res = g.unload(b);
1548       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1549         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1550         app.sound.play('error');
1551       } else {
1552         app.setSelection(res);
1553       }
1554     } else if (act === 'stop') {
1555       g.orderStop(sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit'));
1556     } else if (act === 'nuke') {
1557       const err = g.nukeInvalid(b);
1558       if (err) {
1559         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1560         app.sound.play('error');
1561       } else {
1562         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'nuke', building: b });
1563       }
1564     } else if (act === 'bombzone') {
1565       const bombers = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.type === 'bomber');
1566       if (bombers.length) app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'bombzone', units: bombers });
1567     } else if (act === 'nuke3') {
1568       const err = g.salvoInvalid(0);
1569       if (err) {
1570         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1571         app.sound.play('error');
1572       } else {
1573         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'nuke3', building: b });
1574       }
1575     } else if (act === 'repeat') {
1576       const n = Number(btn.dataset.n) || 1;
1577       let added = 0;
1578       let err = null;
1579       for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
1580         err = g.enqueue(b, b.lastType);
1581         if (err) break;
1582         added++;
1583       }
1584       if (!added) {
1585         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1586         app.sound.play('error');
1587       } else if (added < n) {
1588         this.toast(`${added} en cola · ${err}`, 'bad');
1589       }
1590       this.renderSel(true);
1591     } else if (act === 'amove') {
1592       if (app.input.amoveArm === true) app.input.disarmAttackMove();
1593       else app.input.armAttackMove();
1594       this.renderSel(true);
1595     } else if (act === 'patrol') {
1596       const us = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.def.weapon);
1597       if (app.input.amoveArm === 'patrol') app.input.disarmAttackMove();
1598       else if (us.some((u) => u.patrol)) { g.orderStop(us); this.toast('Dejaron de patrullar'); }
1599       else app.input.armAttackMove('patrol');
1600       this.renderSel(true);
1601     } else if (act === 'hold') {
1602       const us = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.def.weapon);
1603       const on = !us.every((u) => u.hold);
1604       g.setHold(us, on);
1605       this.toast(on ? 'Mantienen la posición: solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro' : 'Vuelven a perseguir a los enemigos cercanos');
1606       this.renderSel(true);
1607     } else if (act === 'autorep') {
1608       const p = g.players[0];
1609       p.autoRepair = p.autoRepair === false;
1610       this.toast(p.autoRepair ? 'Los constructores libres repararán solos' : 'Reparación sola apagada');
1611       this.renderSel(true);
1612     } else if (act === 'loop') {
1613       b.loop = !b.loop;
1614       b.loopT = 0;
1615       if (b.loop) this.toast(`${b.def.name}: sigue entrenando ${UNITS[b.lastType].name} mientras alcance el dinero`, 'good');
1616       this.renderSel(true);
1617     } else if (act === 'formation') {
1618       app.toggleFormation();
1619       this.renderSel(true);
1620     } else if (act === 'savegrp') {
1621       app.saveGroup(Number(btn.dataset.v));
1622     }
1623   }

1625   // ---------- v0.8: barra de producción ----------

1634       .sort((a, b) => order[a.type] - order[b.type] || a.id - b.id);
1635     const sig = list.map((b) => `${b.id}:${b.queue.length}:${b.queue[0] ? b.queue[0].type : ''}`).join(',');
1636     el.hidden = list.length < 2;

1640       this.prodSig = sig;
1641       el.innerHTML = '<span class="lbl">Producción</span>' + list.map((b) => {
1642         const idle = !b.queue.length && b.type !== 'core';
1643         const q = b.queue[0];
1644         const tip = `${b.def.name}: ${q ? `entrenando ${UNITS[q.type].name}${b.queue.length > 1 ? ` (+${b.queue.length - 1})` : ''}` : 'parado'}`;
1645         return `<button class="pitem ${idle ? 'idle' : ''}" type="button" data-prod="${b.id}" title="${esc(tip)}" aria-label="${esc(tip)}">
1646           <img src="${Thumbs.get(q ? q.type : b.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">${b.queue.length ? `<em>${b.queue.length}</em>` : ''}<i><s data-pbar="${b.id}"></s></i></button>`;
1647       }).join('');
1648     }
1649     for (const b of list) {
1650       const bar = el.querySelector(`[data-pbar="${b.id}"]`);
1651       const q = b.queue[0];

1653     }

1656   // ---------- v0.8: avisos en el borde ----------
1657   // Si atacan algo tuyo fuera de la pantalla, una flecha en el borde apunta hacia allá.
1658   addEdgeAlert(text, x, z) {
1659     const now = performance.now();
1660     let label = text.replace(/^Atacan tu /, '').replace(/^Perdiste: /, 'Perdiste ').replace(/^Perdiste /, 'Perdiste ');
1661     if (/Núcleo/.test(text)) label = 'Núcleo';
1662     else if (/tropas/i.test(text)) label = 'Tropas';
1663     if (label.length > 18) label = label.slice(0, 17) + '…';
1664     const near = this.edgeAlerts.find((a) => Math.hypot(a.x - x, a.z - z) < 5);
1665     if (near) {
1666       near.until = now + 8000;
1667       near.label = label;
1668       near.x = x;
1669       near.z = z;
1670       if (near.el) near.el.querySelector('span').textContent = label;
1671       return;
1672     }
1673     this.edgeAlerts.push({ x, z, label, until: now + 8000, el: null });
1674     if (this.edgeAlerts.length > 4) {
1675       const old = this.edgeAlerts.shift();
1676       if (old.el) old.el.remove();
1677     }
1678   }
1679 
1680   updateEdges() {
1681     const r = this.app.renderer;
1682     if (!r) return;
1683     const now = performance.now();
1684     const box = $('edges');
1685     for (const a of this.edgeAlerts) {
1686       if (a.until > now) continue;
1687       if (a.el) a.el.remove();
1688       a.el = null;
1689     }
1690     this.edgeAlerts = this.edgeAlerts.filter((a) => a.until > now);
1691     const W = r.width;
1692     const H = r.height;
1693     const m = 34;
1694     for (const a of this.edgeAlerts) {
1695       if (!a.el) {
1696         a.el = document.createElement('button');
1697         a.el.type = 'button';
1698         a.el.className = 'edge';
1699         a.el.innerHTML = `<i>${ICON.arrow}</i><span></span>`;
1700         a.el.querySelector('span').textContent = a.label;
1701         a.el.addEventListener('click', () => {
1702           this.app.focusAt(a.x, a.z);
1703           a.until = 0;
1704         });
1705         box.appendChild(a.el);
1706       }
1707       const s = r.project(a.x, 0.3, a.z);
1708       const inside = s.ok && s.x > m && s.x < W - m && s.y > 70 && s.y < H - m;
1709       a.el.hidden = inside;
1710       if (inside) continue;
1711       let dx = s.x - W / 2;
1712       let dy = s.y - H / 2;
1713       if (!s.ok) { dx = -dx; dy = -dy; }
1714       const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
1715       const hw = W / 2 - m - 40;
1716       const hh = H / 2 - m - 40;
1717       const c = Math.cos(ang);
1718       const sn = Math.sin(ang);
1719       const t = Math.min(Math.abs(c) > 1e-6 ? hw / Math.abs(c) : 1e9, Math.abs(sn) > 1e-6 ? hh / Math.abs(sn) : 1e9);
1720       a.el.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(W / 2 + c * t)}px, ${Math.round(H / 2 + sn * t)}px) translate(-50%, -50%)`;
1721       a.el.querySelector('i').style.transform = `rotate(${ang}rad)`;
1722     }
1723   }

1725   // Botones de grupo y de Constructores junto al minimapa: cuántas tropas tiene cada uno.
1726   renderGroups(force) {

1730     const counts = [1, 2, 3].map((n) => app.groupUnits(n).length);
1731     const builders = g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && u.def.builds === 'land');
1732     const idle = builders.filter((u) => u.state === 'idle' && !u.inside).length;
1733     const sig = counts.join(',') + '|' + idle + '/' + builders.length;
1734     if (!force && sig === this.groupsSig) return;
1735     this.groupsSig = sig;
1736     counts.forEach((k, i) => {
1737       const el = $('grp' + (i + 1));
1738       el.textContent = k ? String(k) : '—';
1739       el.parentElement.classList.toggle('has', k > 0);
1740     });
1741     $('bld-idle').textContent = builders.length ? `${idle}/${builders.length}` : '0';
1742     $('btn-builders').classList.toggle('alert', idle > 0);
1743   }

1766   // ---------- barra superior ----------
1767   updateTop() {
1768     const g = this.app.game;
1769     const p = g.players[0];
1770     $('coins').textContent = fmt(p.coins);
1771     $('income').textContent = `+${fmt(p.income)}/min`;
1772     $('pop').textContent = `${p.popUsed}/${p.popCap}`;
1773     $('energy').textContent = fmt(p.energy);
1774     $('energyRate').textContent = `+${p.energyRate}/10 s`;
1775     if (g.mode.king) {
1776       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
1777       const ownerTeam = faro && faro.owner >= 0 ? g.players[faro.owner].team : -1;
1778       const myT = g.kingTime[p.team] || 0;
1779       let best = -1;
1780       let bestT = 0;
1781       for (const [team, t] of Object.entries(g.kingTime)) {
1782         if (Number(team) !== p.team && t > bestT) { bestT = t; best = Number(team); }
1783       }
1784       const rival = best >= 0 ? g.players.findIndex((pl) => pl.team === best) : -1;
1785       const bar = (t, color) => `<span class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.min(100, (t / KING_TIME) * 100)}%;background:${color}"></i></span>`;
1786       $('king').innerHTML = `Faro: ${ownerTeam < 0 ? 'libre' : esc(g.players[faro.owner].name)} · Tú ${bar(myT, hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[0]))}` +
1787         (rival >= 0 ? ` ${esc(g.players[rival].name)} ${bar(bestT, hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[rival]))}` : '');
1788     }
1789     $('stat-pop').classList.toggle('full', p.popUsed >= p.popCap);
1790     $('clock').textContent = fmtTime(g.time);
1791     // v1.3: también cambia con las alianzas (equipos), no solo cuando alguien cae.
1792     const sig = g.players.map((pl) => `${pl.alive}:${pl.team}`).join(',');
1793     if (sig !== this.playersSig) {
1794       this.playersSig = sig;
1795       const myTeam = p.team;
1796       $('players').innerHTML = g.players.map((pl) => {
1797         const tag = pl.id === 0 ? '' : pl.team === myTeam ? '<em>aliado</em>' : '';
1798         const style = pl.human ? '' : ` · ${PERSONALITIES[pl.persona].name}`;
1799         return `<div class="pchip ${pl.alive ? '' : 'dead'}" title="${esc(pl.name + style)}"><i style="background:${hexColor(pl.color)}"></i><span>${esc(pl.name)}</span>${tag}</div>`;
1800       }).join('');
1801     }
1802   }

1838   // Gráficas del final: línea vertical y valores del momento al pasar el dedo o el ratón.
1839   bindHistory(g) {
1840     const H = g.history || [];
1841     document.querySelectorAll('#enddialog .histchart').forEach((fig) => {
1842       const key = fig.dataset.key;
1843       const svg = fig.querySelector('svg');
1844       const tip = fig.querySelector('.histtip');
1845       const cross = fig.querySelector('.hcross');
1846       const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
1847       const L = 40;
1848       const R = 64;
1849       const tMax = Math.max(H[H.length - 1].t, 1);
1850       const show = (ev) => {
1851         const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
1852         const sx = ((ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * vb.width;
1853         const t = clamp((sx - L) / (vb.width - L - R), 0, 1) * tMax;
1854         let best = H[0];
1855         for (const h of H) if (Math.abs(h.t - t) < Math.abs(best.t - t)) best = h;
1856         const cx = L + (best.t / tMax) * (vb.width - L - R);
1857         cross.setAttribute('x1', cx);
1858         cross.setAttribute('x2', cx);
1859         cross.setAttribute('visibility', 'visible');
1860         const rows = g.players.map((p) => ({ p, v: best[key][p.id] })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v);
1861         tip.innerHTML = `<b>${fmtTime(best.t)}</b>` + rows.map((x) => `<span><i style="background:${cssColor(x.p.color)}"></i>${esc(x.p.name)}<em>${fmt(x.v)}</em></span>`).join('');
1862         tip.hidden = false;
1863         const px = (cx / vb.width) * r.width;
1864         tip.style.left = `${Math.min(r.width - 150, Math.max(0, px + 10))}px`;
1865       };
1866       const hide = () => { tip.hidden = true; cross.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden'); };
1867       svg.addEventListener('pointermove', show);
1868       svg.addEventListener('pointerdown', show);
1869       svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', hide);
1870     });
1871   }
1872 }

1874 // Sonido sintetizado con Web Audio (sin archivos externos).
1875 class Sound {
1876   constructor() {
1877     this.ctx = null;
1878     this.on = true;
1879     this.last = {};
1880     try {
1881       this.on = localStorage.getItem('faro-sound') !== 'off';
1882     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
1883   }
1884 
1885   unlock() {
1886     if (!this.ctx) {
1887       try {
1888         const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
1889         if (AC) {
1890           this.ctx = new AC();
1891           const len = this.ctx.sampleRate;
1892           this.noise = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, len, this.ctx.sampleRate);
1893           const d = this.noise.getChannelData(0);
1894           for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
1895           this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
1896           this.master.gain.value = 0.6;
1897           this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
1898         }
1899       } catch (err) {
1900         this.ctx = null;
1901       }
1902     }
1903     if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
1904     if (this.ctx && !this.unlocked) {
1905       this.unlocked = true;
1906       if (this.onUnlock && this.on) this.onUnlock();
1907     }
1908   }
1909 
1910   toggle() {
1911     this.on = !this.on;
1912     try {
1913       localStorage.setItem('faro-sound', this.on ? 'on' : 'off');
1914     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
1915     if (this.on) this.unlock();
1916     if (this.onToggle) this.onToggle();
1917   }
1918 
1919   // Límite de voces: si ya suenan muchas, los sonidos nuevos menos importantes se saltan.
1920   voice(dur) {
1921     const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
1922     this.ends = (this.ends || []).filter((t) => t > now);
1923     if (this.ends.length >= 24) return false;
1924     this.ends.push(now + dur);
1925     this.voices = (this.voices || 0) + 1;
1926     return true;
1927   }
1928 
1929   tone(freq, dur, type = 'sine', vol = 0.08, slide = 0, delay = 0) {
1930     const c = this.ctx;
1931     const t0 = c.currentTime + delay;
1932     const o = c.createOscillator();
1933     const g = c.createGain();
1934     o.type = type;
1935     o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
1936     if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, freq + slide), t0 + dur);
1937     g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
1938     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
1939     o.connect(g);
1940     g.connect(this.master);
1941     o.start(t0);
1942     o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
1943   }
1944 
1945   // Ruido filtrado; sweep cambia la frecuencia del filtro durante el sonido (zumbido de misil).
1946   burst(dur, filterType, freq, vol, delay = 0, sweep = 0, q = 0.8) {
1947     const c = this.ctx;
1948     const t0 = c.currentTime + delay;
1949     const src = c.createBufferSource();
1950     src.buffer = this.noise;
1951     const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
1952     f.type = filterType;
1953     f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
1954     if (sweep) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, freq + sweep), t0 + dur);
1955     f.Q.value = q;
1956     const g = c.createGain();
1957     g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
1958     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + Math.min(0.012, dur * 0.2));
1959     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
1960     src.connect(f);
1961     f.connect(g);
1962     g.connect(this.master);
1963     src.start(t0, Math.random() * 0.5);
1964     src.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
1965   }
1966 
1967   play(name, vol = 1) {
1968     if (!this.on || !this.ctx || this.ctx.state !== 'running') return;
1969     const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
1970     const gap = { bullet: 0.07, minigun: 0.05, flak: 0.08, bolt: 0.12, laser: 0.14, hit: 0.08, boom: 0.09, bigboom: 0.25,
1971       rocket: 0.1, missile: 0.2, shell: 0.12, torpedo: 0.2, build: 0.22, heal: 0.4 }[name] || 0.04;
1972     if (this.last[name] && now - this.last[name] < gap) return;
1973     const ui = ['click', 'order', 'place', 'done', 'ready', 'error', 'alarm', 'capture'].includes(name);
1974     if (!ui && !this.voice(0.4)) return;
1975     this.last[name] = now;
1976     const v = vol;
1977     switch (name) {
1978       case 'bullet': this.burst(0.06, 'highpass', 2400, 0.06 * v); this.tone(180, 0.04, 'square', 0.02 * v, -80); break;
1979       case 'minigun':
1980         for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.burst(0.03, 'bandpass', 2600 + i * 120, 0.045 * v, i * 0.028, 0, 2);
1981         break;
1982       case 'flak': this.burst(0.09, 'bandpass', 1400, 0.07 * v); this.tone(240, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.03 * v, -120); break;
1983       case 'bolt': this.tone(520, 0.12, 'sawtooth', 0.04 * v, -300); break;
1984       case 'laser':
1985         this.tone(1500, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 0.025 * v, -1100);
1986         this.tone(760, 0.18, 'square', 0.018 * v, -500);
1987         this.burst(0.1, 'highpass', 5000, 0.02 * v);
1988         break;
1989       case 'rocket': this.burst(0.22, 'bandpass', 700, 0.07 * v, 0, 900, 1.2); this.tone(130, 0.12, 'sine', 0.05 * v, -50); break;
1990       case 'missile': this.burst(0.5, 'bandpass', 500, 0.07 * v, 0, 1400, 1.5); this.tone(90, 0.25, 'sine', 0.06 * v, -40); break;
1991       case 'shell':
1992         this.tone(110, 0.22, 'sine', 0.15 * v, -70);
1993         this.burst(0.1, 'lowpass', 1100, 0.07 * v);
1994         this.burst(0.35, 'lowpass', 300, 0.04 * v, 0.05);
1995         break;
1996       case 'torpedo': this.burst(0.35, 'lowpass', 420, 0.06 * v, 0, -200); break;
1997       case 'hit': this.burst(0.08, 'bandpass', 600, 0.05 * v); break;
1998       case 'boom':
1999         this.burst(0.55, 'lowpass', 520, 0.24 * v);
2000         this.tone(70, 0.4, 'sine', 0.12 * v, -40);
2001         this.burst(0.25, 'bandpass', 1800, 0.03 * v, 0.08, 0, 1.5);
2002         break;
2003       case 'bigboom':
2004         this.burst(1.1, 'lowpass', 380, 0.3 * v);
2005         this.tone(52, 0.9, 'sine', 0.18 * v, -22);
2006         this.burst(0.6, 'bandpass', 1500, 0.04 * v, 0.12, -900, 1.2);
2007         this.burst(0.4, 'lowpass', 900, 0.08 * v, 0.3);
2008         break;
2009       case 'build': this.tone(900 + Math.random() * 140, 0.05, 'triangle', 0.035 * v, -300); this.burst(0.04, 'highpass', 3000, 0.02 * v); break;
2010       case 'heal': this.tone(660, 0.2, 'sine', 0.025 * v); this.tone(990, 0.25, 'sine', 0.02 * v, 0, 0.08); break;
2011       case 'capture':
2012         [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.05, 0, i * 0.09));
2013         break;
2014       case 'click': this.tone(880, 0.04, 'triangle', 0.04); break;
2015       case 'order': this.tone(520, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.05, 180); break;
2016       case 'place': this.tone(300, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.07, 140); this.burst(0.06, 'lowpass', 900, 0.04); break;
2017       case 'done': this.tone(660, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.06); this.tone(990, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.06, 0, 0.1); break;
2018       case 'ready': this.tone(740, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.045); break;
2019       case 'error': this.tone(200, 0.14, 'square', 0.04, -40); break;
2020       case 'alarm': this.tone(560, 0.15, 'square', 0.04); this.tone(420, 0.15, 'square', 0.04, 0, 0.18); break;
2021       default: break;
2022     }
2023   }
2024 }

 106 function mapThumb(kind, players = 6) {
 107   const key = kind + ':' + players;
 108   if (MAP_THUMBS[key]) return MAP_THUMBS[key];
 109   let url = '';
 110   try {
 111     const m = new GameMap(4321, kind, players, false);
 112     const S = 132;
 113     const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
 114     cv.width = S;
 115     cv.height = S;
 116     const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
 117     ctx.fillStyle = '#' + terrainColor(kind, 'deep').toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
 118     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
 119     const ext = Math.max(...m.cells.map((c) => Math.max(Math.abs(c.x), Math.abs(c.z)))) + 1;
 120     const k = (S / 2 - 3) / ext;
 121     for (const c of m.cells) {
 122       if (c.t === 'deep') continue;
 123       ctx.fillStyle = '#' + terrainColor(kind, c.t).toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
 124       ctx.beginPath();
 125       ctx.arc(S / 2 + c.x * k, S / 2 + c.z * k, k * 1.02, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 126       ctx.fill();
 127     }
 128     for (const hi of m.homes) {
 129       const c = m.cells[hi];
 130       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
 131       ctx.beginPath();
 132       ctx.arc(S / 2 + c.x * k, S / 2 + c.z * k, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 133       ctx.fill();
 134     }
 135     const f = m.cells[m.points[0].cell];
 136     ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ab38';
 137     ctx.beginPath();
 138     ctx.arc(S / 2 + f.x * k, S / 2 + f.z * k, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 139     ctx.fill();
 140     url = cv.toDataURL('image/png');
 141   } catch (err) {
 142     console.warn('[Vestíbulo] Sin miniatura de mapa:', err);
 143   }
 144   MAP_THUMBS[key] = url;
 145   return url;
 146 }

 159 function dayKey(d = new Date()) {
 160   return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 161 }

 163 function dayNum(key) {
 164   const [y, m, d] = key.split('-').map(Number);
 165   return Math.round(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d) / 86400000);
 166 }

 168 function keyOfDay(n) {
 169   const d = new Date(n * 86400000);
 170   return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 171 }

 173 // Semana que empieza el lunes (el 1 de enero de 1970 fue jueves).
 174 function weekKey(d = new Date()) {
 175   return 'w' + Math.floor((dayNum(dayKey(d)) + 3) / 7);
 176 }

 178 function hashStr(s) {
 179   let h = 2166136261;
 180   for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
 181   return h >>> 0;
 182 }

 194 // Trazo de cada imperio en las gráficas del final (además del color): Tú, línea continua.

 197 // Rangos (v1.3, como tu documento de juego v2): 6 rangos propios, solo en la Liga 3 vs 3 y desde el
 198 // nivel 10. Ganar suma 25 y perder resta 15. Almirante del Faro: en Roblox serán los 50 mejores; aquí,
 199 // sin servidores, desde 2.400 puntos.
 200 const RANKS = ['Recluta', 'Cabo', 'Sargento', 'Capitán', 'Comandante', 'Almirante del Faro'];
 201 const RANK_MIN = [0, 300, 700, 1200, 1800, 2400];
 202 const RANK_ICONS = ['R', 'C', 'S', 'Cp', 'Cm', 'A'];
 203 const RANK_WIN = 25;
 204 const RANK_LOSS = 15;
 205 const RANK_COLORS = ['#8a9aa6', '#b87333', '#c0c7cf', '#f2c94c', '#7fc8ff', '#f2ab38'];
 206 const RANKED_MODE = 'league';
 207 const RANKED_LEVEL = 10;
 208 // Temporadas (v1.3): de unos 2 meses. La 1 es noviembre-diciembre de 2026. Al empezar una nueva,
 209 // el pase vuelve a empezar y bajas 1 rango (no a cero).
 210 const SEASON_START = { y: 2026, m: 10 };
 211 const SEASON_MONTHS = 2;
 212 function seasonOf(d = new Date()) {
 213   const months = (d.getFullYear() - SEASON_START.y) * 12 + d.getMonth() - SEASON_START.m;
 214   const no = Math.max(0, Math.floor(months / SEASON_MONTHS)) + 1;
 215   const m0 = SEASON_START.m + (no - 1) * SEASON_MONTHS;
 216   const start = new Date(SEASON_START.y, m0, 1);
 217   const end = new Date(SEASON_START.y, m0 + SEASON_MONTHS, 1);
 218   return { no, start, end };
 219 }
 220 // Tabla de la Liga 3 vs 3 (v1.2): 20 comandantes bot con nombres propios. Sus puntos salen de tu
 221 // semilla y se mueven un poco con cada partida que juegas (no son jugadores reales).
 222 const LADDER_NAMES = ['Capitana Brisa', 'Coronel Basalto', 'Almirante Coral', 'Sargento Pino', 'Mariscal Ceniza', 'Teniente Ámbar',
 223   'Comandante Niebla', 'Capitán Granito', 'General Duna', 'Cabo Relámpago', 'Comodoro Marea', 'Brigadier Roble', 'Capitana Aurora',
 224   'Coronela Cobre', 'Mayor Tormenta', 'Teniente Alba', 'Almirante Faro', 'Sargenta Lava', 'General Escarcha', 'Capitán Bruma'];
 225 function ladderRows(P) {
 226   const rng = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 4242);
 227   const games = (P.ranked && P.ranked.games) || 0;
 228   const rows = LADDER_NAMES.map((name, i) => {
 229     const base = Math.round(60 + rng() * 2550);
 230     const drift = Math.round(Math.sin((games + 1) * 0.7 + i) * 18 + games * (rng() * 6 - 1));
 231     return { name, points: Math.max(0, base + drift), bot: true };
 232   });
 233   rows.push({ name: 'Tú', points: (P.ranked && P.ranked.points) || 0, me: true });
 234   return rows.sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points || (a.me ? -1 : 1)).map((r, i) => ({ ...r, pos: i + 1 }));
 235 }
 236 function rankIndex(points) {
 237   let i = 0;
 238   while (i + 1 < RANK_MIN.length && Math.max(0, points) >= RANK_MIN[i + 1]) i++;
 239   return i;
 240 }
 241 function rankName(points) {
 242   return RANKS[rankIndex(points)];
 243 }
 244 // Desde Sargento, los rivales de la Liga 3 vs 3 juegan en Difícil.
 245 function rankedDifficulty(points) {
 246   return rankIndex(points) >= 2 ? 'hard' : 'normal';
 247 }

 279 // v1.4: desafío semanal. Cambia los lunes; mapa, semilla y una regla fijos toda la semana.
 280 const WEEKLY_CHALLENGES = [
 281   { id: 'nofactory', name: 'Sin fábricas', desc: 'No puedes construir la Fábrica: gana con soldados, barcos y aeronaves.', mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'continent', difficulty: 'normal', rule: 'nofactory' },
 282   { id: 'noair', name: 'Cielo cerrado', desc: 'Sin Helipuerto ni Aeropuerto: todo se decide en tierra y mar.', mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'archipelago', difficulty: 'normal', rule: 'noair' },
 283   { id: 'poor', name: 'Bolsillos vacíos', desc: 'Empiezas con 800 monedas en vez de 2.000.', mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'mesa', difficulty: 'normal', startCoins: 800 },
 284   { id: 'fog', name: 'Niebla de guerra', desc: 'Niebla y bots en Difícil.', mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'bay', difficulty: 'hard', fog: true },
 285   { id: 'sea', name: 'Todo por mar', desc: 'Mar abierto: sin puentes, cada isla se toma por mar o por aire.', mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'open', difficulty: 'normal' },
 286   { id: 'duel', name: 'Duelo en las dunas', desc: 'Uno contra uno en Dunas Rojas, contra un bot en Difícil.', mode: 'duel', mapKind: 'dunes', difficulty: 'hard' },
 287 ];
 288 const WEEKLY_CRYSTALS = 150;
 289 function weekNumber(d = new Date()) {
 290   return Math.floor((dayNum(dayKey(d)) + 3) / 7);
 291 }
 292 function weeklyFor(d = new Date()) {
 293   const n = weekNumber(d);
 294   const ch = WEEKLY_CHALLENGES[n % WEEKLY_CHALLENGES.length];
 295   const next = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
 296   next.setDate(next.getDate() + ((8 - next.getDay()) % 7 || 7));
 297   return { ...ch, week: 'w' + n, seed: 90000 + n * 37, next };
 298 }

 300 // v1.4: Top jugadores (tu documento, pág. 20): tú y comandantes bot, por temporada.
 301 const TOP_PREFIX = ['Brisa', 'Coral', 'Roca', 'Marea', 'Ancla', 'Bruma', 'Duna', 'Ámbar', 'Lince', 'Ola'];
 302 const TOP_SUFFIX = ['Norte', 'Sur', 'Veloz', 'Real', 'Azul', 'Roja', 'Gris', 'Dorada', 'Firme', 'Alta'];
 303 function topRows(P, tab) {
 304   const S = seasonOf(Profile.now());
 305   const rng = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 777 + S.no * 13);
 306   const games = (P.ranked && P.ranked.games) || 0;
 307   const liga = ladderRows(P).filter((r) => r.bot);
 308   const extra = [];
 309   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
 310     const name = `${TOP_PREFIX[Math.floor(rng() * 10)]}${TOP_SUFFIX[Math.floor(rng() * 10)]}_${10 + Math.floor(rng() * 89)}`;
 311     extra.push({ name, points: Math.max(0, Math.round(40 + rng() * 2500 + Math.sin(games + i) * 15)), bot: true });
 312   }
 313   const bots = [...liga, ...extra].map((r, i) => {
 314     const r2 = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 91 + i * 7 + S.no);
 315     const pct = 0.42 + Math.min(0.32, r.points / 8000) + r2() * 0.06;
 316     const ranked = Math.round(20 + r.points / 9 + r2() * 30);
 317     return { name: r.name, bot: true, points: r.points, pct, wins: Math.round(ranked * pct + r2() * 120), islands: Math.round(r2() * 900 + r.points / 6) };
 318   });
 319   const R = P.ranked;
 320   const me = { name: 'Tú', me: true, points: R.points, pct: R.games ? R.wins / R.games : 0, wins: P.stats.wins, islands: P.stats.islands };
 321   const key = tab === 'wins' ? 'wins' : tab === 'islands' ? 'islands' : 'points';
 322   return [...bots, me].sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key] || (a.me ? -1 : 1)).map((r, i) => ({ ...r, pos: i + 1 }));
 323 }

 325 const Profile = {
 326   data: null,
 327   memoryOnly: false,
 328 
 329   defaults() {
 330     return {
 331       v: 1, seed: (Math.random() * 1e9) | 0, since: dayKey(), xp: 0, crystals: 0,
 332       stats: { games: 0, wins: 0, islands: 0, cores: 0, kills: 0, trained: 0, faro: 0 },
 333       achievements: {}, weekly: {},
 334       owned: {}, equipped: { inf: null, veh: null, sea: null, core: null }, badges: {},
 335       tutorialDone: false, pass: {}, daily: { idx: 0, last: null, lost: 0 }, codes: {},
 336       missions: { day: null, daily: [], rerolled: false, week: null, weekly: [] },
 337       chests: { pity: 0, opened: 0 },
 338       play: { mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'archipelago', difficulty: 'normal' },
 339       custom: { kind: 'conquest', players: 4, mapKind: 'archipelago', coins: START_COINS, difficulty: 'normal', teams: false, fog: false, turbo: false },
 340       creator: { on: true, instant: false },
 341       campaign: { done: {}, stars: {} },
 342       ranked: { points: 0, best: 0, games: 0, wins: 0, history: [], shield: false },
 343       fragments: 0, plans: {},
 344       season: { no: 0, passXp: 0, notice: null },
 345     };
 346   },
 347 
 348   load() {
 349     const d = this.defaults();
 350     try {
 351       const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PROFILE_KEY) || 'null');
 352       if (saved && saved.v === 1) {
 353         for (const k of Object.keys(saved)) {
 354           if (d[k] && typeof d[k] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(d[k]) && saved[k] && typeof saved[k] === 'object') Object.assign(d[k], saved[k]);
 355           else d[k] = saved[k];
 356         }
 357       }
 358     } catch (err) {
 359       this.memoryOnly = true;
 360     }
 361     // v1.4: logros; quien ya terminó el Tutorial tiene «Primer Faro».
 362     d.achievements = d.achievements || {};
 363     if (d.tutorialDone && !d.achievements.primer_faro) d.achievements.primer_faro = d.since || dayKey();
 364     // v1.3: la Clasificatoria aparte pasa a ser la Liga 3 vs 3.
 365     if (d.play.mode === 'ranked') d.play.mode = RANKED_MODE;
 366     if (!MODES[d.play.mode] || !MODES[d.play.mode].lobby) d.play.mode = 'conquest';
 367     if (!MAPS[d.play.mapKind]) d.play.mapKind = 'archipelago';
 368     if (!DIFFICULTY[d.play.difficulty]) d.play.difficulty = 'normal';
 369     this.data = d;
 370     this.refresh();
 371     return d;
 372   },
 373 
 374   save() {
 375     try {
 376       localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.data));
 377     } catch (err) {
 378       this.memoryOnly = true;
 379     }
 380   },
 381 
 382   level(xp = this.data.xp) {
 383     return 1 + Math.floor(xp / LEVEL_XP);
 384   },
 385 
 386   // v1.3: copia del progreso para llevarlo a otro iPad o navegador (sin servidores, no hay cuentas).
 387   // Código = «FARO1.» + suma de control + «.» + el perfil en base64.
 388   exportCode() {
 389     const json = JSON.stringify(this.data);
 390     const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
 391     let bin = '';
 392     for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
 393     return `FARO1.${hashStr(json).toString(36)}.${btoa(bin)}`;
 394   },
 395 
 396   importCode(code) {
 397     const m = String(code || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/^FARO1\.([0-9a-z]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/);
 398     if (!m) return { err: 'Ese texto no es una copia del progreso de Faro de Ámbar' };
 399     let json;
 400     try {
 401       const bin = atob(m[2]);
 402       const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
 403       for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
 404       json = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
 405     } catch (err) {
 406       return { err: 'La copia está incompleta: cópiala entera otra vez' };
 407     }
 408     if (hashStr(json).toString(36) !== m[1]) return { err: 'La copia está incompleta o cambiada: cópiala entera otra vez' };
 409     let data;
 410     try { data = JSON.parse(json); } catch (err) { return { err: 'La copia no se puede leer' }; }
 411     if (!data || data.v !== 1 || typeof data.xp !== 'number') return { err: 'La copia no es de este juego' };
 412     return { data };
 413   },
 414 
 415   restore(data) {
 416     try { localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data)); } catch (err) { this.memoryOnly = true; }
 417     if (this.memoryOnly) {
 418       this.data = data;
 419       return;
 420     }
 421     this.load();
 422   },
 423 
 424   // XP: el nivel cuenta toda la XP; el pase, solo la de esta temporada.
 425   addXp(n) {
 426     this.data.xp += n;
 427     this.data.season.passXp = (this.data.season.passXp || 0) + n;
 428   },
 429 
 430   now() {
 431     return new Date();
 432   },
 433 
 434   // Al empezar una temporada nueva: el pase vuelve a empezar y la Liga baja 1 rango (no a cero).
 435   checkSeason() {
 436     const P = this.data;
 437     const cur = seasonOf(this.now()).no;
 438     if (!P.season.no) {
 439       // Perfiles de antes de la v1.3: se quedan con lo que llevaban en el pase.
 440       P.season.no = cur;
 441       P.season.passXp = P.xp;
 442       return false;
 443     }
 444     if (P.season.no >= cur) return false;
 445     const R = P.ranked;
 446     const from = rankName(R.points);
 447     const idx = rankIndex(R.points);
 448     R.points = RANK_MIN[Math.max(0, idx - 1)];
 449     R.shield = false;
 450     P.pass = {};
 451     P.season.passXp = 0;
 452     P.season.notice = { no: cur, from, to: rankName(R.points) };
 453     P.season.no = cur;
 454     return true;
 455   },
 456 
 457   passTier() {
 458     return Math.min(PASS_TIERS, Math.floor((this.data.season.passXp || 0) / PASS_TIER_XP));
 459   },
 460 
 461   // Cambio de día o de semana: misiones nuevas y racha del premio diario.
 462   refresh() {
 463     const P = this.data;
 464     this.checkSeason();
 465     const today = dayKey();
 466     const M = P.missions;
 467     if (M.day !== today) {
 468       M.day = today;
 469       M.daily = this.pick(MISSIONS.daily, 3, 'd' + today).map((m) => ({ id: m.id, prog: 0, done: false }));
 470       M.rerolled = false;
 471     }
 472     const wk = weekKey();
 473     if (M.week !== wk) {
 474       M.week = wk;
 475       M.weekly = this.pick(MISSIONS.weekly, 3, wk).map((m) => ({ id: m.id, prog: 0, done: false }));
 476     }
 477     // Premio diario: si faltas un día, la racha baja 1 (por cada día que faltes).
 478     const D = P.daily;
 479     if (D.last) {
 480       const gap = dayNum(today) - dayNum(D.last);
 481       if (gap > 1) {
 482         const missed = gap - 1;
 483         D.lost = Math.min(D.idx, missed);
 484         D.idx = Math.max(0, D.idx - missed);
 485         D.last = keyOfDay(dayNum(today) - 1);
 486       }
 487     }
 488     this.save();
 489   },
 490 
 491   pick(pool, n, key) {
 492     const rng = mulberry32(hashStr(key) ^ this.data.seed);
 493     const list = pool.slice();
 494     for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 495       const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
 496       [list[i], list[j]] = [list[j], list[i]];
 497     }
 498     return list.slice(0, n);
 499   },
 500 
 501   rerollDaily(i) {
 502     const M = this.data.missions;
 503     const cur = M.daily[i];
 504     if (!cur || cur.done || M.rerolled) return false;
 505     const used = new Set(M.daily.map((m) => m.id));
 506     const options = MISSIONS.daily.filter((m) => !used.has(m.id));
 507     if (!options.length) return false;
 508     const next = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
 509     M.daily[i] = { id: next.id, prog: 0, done: false };
 510     M.rerolled = true;
 511     this.save();
 512     return true;
 513   },
 514 
 515   dailyClaimable() {
 516     return this.data.daily.last !== dayKey();
 517   },
 518 
 519   passClaimable() {
 520     let n = 0;
 521     for (let t = 1; t <= this.passTier(); t++) if (!this.data.pass[t]) n++;
 522     return n;
 523   },
 524 
 525   owns(id) {
 526     return !!this.data.owned[id] || (Creator.active() && !!SKIN_BY_ID[id]);
 527   },
 528 
 529   looks() {
 530     const out = {};
 531     for (const [slot, id] of Object.entries(this.data.equipped)) {
 532       if (id && SKIN_BY_ID[id] && this.owns(id)) out[slot] = SKIN_BY_ID[id].look;
 533     }
 534     return out;
 535   },
 536 };
 537 
 538 function passReward(t) {
 539   if (t % 10 === 0) return { chest: 'faro', text: 'Cofre del Faro' };
 540   if (t % 5 === 0) return { chest: 'isla', text: 'Cofre de Isla' };
 541   const n = 20 + 5 * Math.floor((t - 1) / 10);
 542   return { crystals: n, text: `${n} cristales` };
 543 }

 550   // La plataforma de Claude dice si quien abre el enlace es el dueño. Sin plataforma, nadie lo es.
 551   async detect() {
 552     try {
 553       if (window.claude && typeof window.claude.use === 'function') {
 554         const user = await window.claude.use('user');
 555         this.owner = !!(user && (await user.isOwner()));
 556       }
 557     } catch (err) {
 558       this.owner = false;
 559     }
 560     this.checked = true;
 561     return this.owner;
 562   },

 565     return this.owner && !!(Profile.data && Profile.data.creator.on);

 569 // ---------- vestíbulo ----------
 570 class Lobby {
 571   constructor(app) {
 572     this.app = app;
 573     this.view = 'play';
 574     this.sub = 'main';
 575     this.shopTab = 'skins';
 576     this.modal = null;
 577     $('lobby-tabs').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 578       const b = e.target.closest('[data-view]');
 579       if (!b) return;
 580       this.view = b.dataset.view;
 581       if (this.view === 'play') this.syncOpts();
 582       this.render();
 583     });
 584     $('menu').addEventListener('click', (e) => this.onClick(e));
 585     $('modal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 586       if (e.target === $('modal')) this.closeModal();
 587       else this.onClick(e);
 588     });
 589     $('modal').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
 590       if (e.target.id !== 'bk-filein' || !e.target.files || !e.target.files[0]) return;
 591       e.target.files[0].text().then((txt) => {
 592         const box = $('bk-in');
 593         if (box) box.value = txt.trim();
 594         this.loadBackup(txt, $('btn-bk-load'));
 595       });
 596     });
 597     $('modal').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
 598       e.preventDefault();
 599       if (e.target.id === 'code-form') this.redeem($('code-input').value);
 600     });
 601     this.syncOpts(true);
 602     this.render();
 603   }
 604 
 605   get P() {
 606     return Profile.data;
 607   }
 608 
 609   // Opciones de la partida según la vista (Jugar, Personalizado o Tutorial).
 610   optsFor(sub = this.sub) {
 611     const P = this.P;
 612     if (sub === 'weekly') {
 613       const W = weeklyFor(Profile.now());
 614       return { mode: W.mode, mapKind: W.mapKind, difficulty: W.difficulty, seed: W.seed, fog: !!W.fog, rule: W.rule || null, startCoins: W.startCoins || 0, weekly: W.week, weeklyName: W.name };
 615     }
 616     if (sub === 'custom') {
 617       const c = P.custom;
 618       return {
 619         mode: c.kind === 'king' ? 'king' : 'conquest', mapKind: c.mapKind, difficulty: c.difficulty,
 620         custom: { players: c.players, teams: c.teams, coins: c.coins, fog: c.fog, turbo: c.turbo, king: c.kind === 'king' },
 621       };
 622     }
 623     if (sub === 'tutorial') return { mode: 'tutorial', mapKind: 'open', difficulty: 'easy' };
 624     // Campaña: el fondo del vestíbulo sigue con la isla de «Jugar»; cada misión trae su propio mapa.
 625     // Liga 3 vs 3 (con rango): la dificultad la pone tu rango.
 626     if (MODES[P.play.mode] && MODES[P.play.mode].ranked) return { mode: P.play.mode, mapKind: P.play.mapKind, difficulty: rankedDifficulty(P.ranked.points) };
 627     return { mode: P.play.mode, mapKind: P.play.mapKind, difficulty: P.play.difficulty };
 628   }
 629 
 630   syncOpts(first) {
 631     const next = this.optsFor();
 632     const o = this.app.opts;
 633     const players = (x) => (x.custom ? x.custom.players + ':' + x.custom.teams : MODES[x.mode].players);
 634     const changed = first || o.mode !== next.mode || o.mapKind !== next.mapKind || players(o) !== players(next);
 635     // El desafío semanal trae su propia semilla (el mismo mapa toda la semana).
 636     this.app.opts = { ...next, seed: next.seed || o.seed || ((Math.random() * 1e9) | 0) };
 637     if (changed && !first && this.app.loaded) this.app.makePreview();
 638   }
 639 
 640   setPlay(key, value) {
 641     if (this.sub === 'custom') this.P.custom[key] = value;
 642     else this.P.play[key] = value;
 643     Profile.save();
 644     this.syncOpts();
 645     this.render();
 646   }

 648   // ---------- dibujo ----------
 649   render() {
 650     if (!Profile.data) return;
 651     const P = this.P;
 652     $('crystals').textContent = Creator.active() ? '∞' : fmt(P.crystals);
 653     $('lvl-badge').textContent = `Nivel ${Profile.level()}`;
 654     $('creator-badge').hidden = !Creator.active();
 655     document.querySelectorAll('#lobby-tabs [data-view]').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(b.dataset.view === this.view)));
 656     const body = $('lobby-body');
 657     body.classList.toggle('wide', this.view !== 'play');
 658     if (this.view === 'shop') body.innerHTML = this.shopHtml();
 659     else if (this.view === 'inv') body.innerHTML = this.invHtml();
 660     else body.innerHTML = this.leftHtml() + `<div class="lmain">${this.mainHtml()}</div>` + this.sideHtml();
 661     // v1.3: aviso (una vez) de que empezó una temporada nueva.
 662     const note = P.season && P.season.notice;
 663     if (note && !this.modal) {
 664       P.season.notice = null;
 665       Profile.save();
 666       this.openModal('info', { title: `Empieza la Temporada ${note.no}`,
 667         text: `El Pase del Faro vuelve a empezar desde el nivel 1. En la Liga 3 vs 3 bajas 1 rango: de ${note.from} a ${note.to}.` });
 668       return;
 669     }
 670     if (this.modal) this.renderModal();
 671   }

 673   leftHtml() {

 675     const off = (label) => `<button type="button" disabled title="Necesita servidores"><span class="lm-label">${label}</span><small>Roblox</small></button>`;
 676     return `<nav class="lmenu panel" aria-label="Menú del vestíbulo">
 677       ${item('main', 'Jugar')}
 678       ${item('campaign', 'Campaña', `${this.campaignStars()} de ${CAMPAIGN.length * 3} ★`)}
 679       ${item('custom', 'Personalizado', 'mitad de XP')}
 680       ${item('tutorial', 'Tutorial', this.P.tutorialDone ? 'hecho' : 'premio')}
 681       ${item('ranks', 'Rangos', rankName(this.P.ranked.points))}
 682       ${item('top', 'Top jugadores', `T. ${seasonOf(Profile.now()).no}`)}
 683       ${item('weekly', 'Desafío semanal', ((this.P.weekly || {})[weeklyFor(Profile.now()).week] || {}).won ? 'ganado' : 'nuevo')}${off('Servidores')}
 684     </nav>`;
 685   }

 687   resumeHtml() {

 693         <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="abandon">Abandonar</button></div></div>`;

 698         <div class="row"><button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="load">Continuar partida guardada</button>
 699         <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="abandon">Borrar</button></div></div>`;

 704   mainHtml() {
 705     const P = this.P;
 706     const resume = this.resumeHtml();
 707     if (this.sub === 'custom') return resume + this.customHtml();
 708     if (this.sub === 'tutorial') return resume + this.tutorialHtml();
 709     if (this.sub === 'campaign') return resume + this.campaignHtml();
 710     if (this.sub === 'ranks') return resume + this.ranksHtml();
 711     if (this.sub === 'top') return resume + this.topHtml();
 712     if (this.sub === 'weekly') return resume + this.weeklyHtml();
 713     const m = MODES[P.play.mode];
 714     const diffs = Object.entries(DIFFICULTY).map(([k, d]) => `<button type="button" data-act="diff" data-v="${k}" class="${P.play.difficulty === k ? 'on' : ''}">${d.name}</button>`).join('');
 715     const st = P.stats;
 716     const pct = st.games ? Math.round((st.wins / st.games) * 100) : 0;
 717     const cover = Thumbs.cover();
 718     const ranked = MODES[P.play.mode] && MODES[P.play.mode].ranked;
 719     const diffName = ranked ? DIFFICULTY[rankedDifficulty(P.ranked.points)].name : DIFFICULTY[P.play.difficulty].name;
 720     const mapName = MAPS[P.play.mapKind] ? MAPS[P.play.mapKind].name : '';
 721     const thumb = LOBBY_MAPS.includes(P.play.mapKind) ? mapThumb(P.play.mapKind, Math.max(2, m.players || 6)) : '';
 722     const tile = (n, label) => `<div><b>${n}</b><span>${label}</span></div>`;
 723     // v1.5: portada nueva: la imagen grande con JUGAR adentro, el modo con la miniatura del mapa y tus números en fichas.
 724     return `${resume}
 725       <section class="cover hero panel"${cover ? ` style="--cover:url('${cover}')"` : ''}>
 726         <div class="cover-img" aria-hidden="true"></div>
 727         <div class="cover-text">
 728           <div class="cover-brand"><svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M32 3 57 17.5v29L32 61 7 46.5v-29z" fill="#1a2834" stroke="#f2ab38" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M26 50h12l-2-24h-8z" fill="#eef1f3"/><path d="M27.2 40h9.6l.5 5h-10.6zM28 31h8l.4 4h-8.8z" fill="#c0392b"/><rect x="27" y="20" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#f2ab38"/><path d="M26 20l6-6 6 6z" fill="#eef1f3"/><path d="M37 21l15-6v10z" fill="#f2ab38" opacity=".55"/><path d="M27 21 12 15v10z" fill="#f2ab38" opacity=".35"/></svg>
 729             <small>Versión ${GAME_VERSION}</small></div>
 730           <h2>Faro de <span>Ámbar</span></h2>
 731           <p>Construye tu isla, arma tu ejército de tierra, mar y aire y toma el Faro.</p>
 732           <ul class="cover-news" aria-label="Novedades">${['Núcleo nuevo', 'Edificios con tu color', 'Fichas de tropas', 'Portada nueva', 'Errores arreglados'].map((t) => `<li>${t}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
 733         </div>
 734         <div class="hero-play">
 735           <button class="btn gold hero-btn" type="button" data-act="play" id="btn-play">${LOBBY_ICONS.play}<span>Jugar</span></button>
 736           <span class="hero-mode">${esc(m.name)} · ${esc(mapName)} · ${esc(diffName)}</span>
 737         </div>
 738       </section>
 739       <section class="lcard panel modecard">
 740         ${thumb ? `<img class="modethumb" alt="" src="${thumb}">` : ''}
 741         <div class="mode-now"><small>Modo</small><b>${esc(m.name)}</b><span>${esc(m.desc)}</span>
 742           <span>Mapa: <b>${esc(mapName)}</b></span></div>
 743         <div class="modebtns">
 744           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="modal" data-m="modes">${LOBBY_ICONS.modes}Cambiar modo</button>
 745           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="modal" data-m="maps">${LOBBY_ICONS.map}Mapa</button>
 746           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="reroll">${LOBBY_ICONS.dice}Otra isla</button>
 747         </div>
 748         ${ranked ? `<p class="queue modefoot">Liga 3 vs 3 · ${rankName(P.ranked.points)} · ${P.ranked.points} puntos. La dificultad la pone tu rango (${DIFFICULTY[rankedDifficulty(P.ranked.points)].name}).</p>`
 749           : `<div class="field modefoot"><label>Dificultad de los bots</label><div class="seg">${diffs}</div></div>`}
 750       </section>
 751       <section class="lcard panel">
 752         <h3>Tus números</h3>
 753         <div class="stattiles numbers">
 754           ${tile(st.games, 'Partidas')}${tile(st.wins, 'Victorias')}${tile(`${pct} %`, 'De victorias')}
 755           ${tile(st.islands, 'Islas tomadas')}${tile(st.cores, 'Núcleos destruidos')}${tile(prettyDate(P.since), 'Jugando desde')}
 756         </div>
 757       </section>`;
 758   }

'on' : ''}"><img alt="" src="${mapThumb(k, Math.max(2, c.players))}"><span>${esc(MAPS[k].name)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div></div>

 785   // Campaña «La ruta del Faro»: 6 misiones; cada una se abre al terminar la anterior.
 786   campaignHtml() {
 787     const P = this.P;
 788     const creator = Creator.active();
 789     const cards = CAMPAIGN.map((m) => {
 790       const open = Campaign.unlocked(m.id, P, creator);
 791       const got = P.campaign.stars[m.id] || 0;
 792       const done = !!P.campaign.done[m.id];
 793       const stars = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => `<i class="${k < got ? 'on' : ''}" aria-hidden="true">★</i>`).join('');
 794       const extra = m.stars.map((s) => Campaign.starText(s)).join(' · ');
 795       return `<article class="mcard ${open ? '' : 'locked'} ${done ? 'done' : ''}">
 796         <div class="mnum">${m.id}</div>
 797         <div class="mbody"><b>${esc(m.name)}</b><span>${esc(Campaign.goalText(m))}</span>
 798           <small>★ ${esc(extra)}</small></div>
 799         <div class="mside"><span class="mstars" title="${got} de 3 estrellas">${stars}</span>
 800           ${open ? `<button class="btn ${done ? '' : 'gold'}" type="button" data-act="mission" data-v="${m.id}" id="btn-mission-${m.id}">${done ? 'Repetir' : 'Jugar'}</button>`
 801             : `<span class="mlock">Termina la misión ${m.id - 1}</span>`}</div>
 802       </article>`;
 803     }).join('');
 804     return `<section class="lcard panel">
 805       <h2>La ruta del Faro</h2>
 806       <p>Seis misiones para volver a encender el Faro de Ámbar. Cada una se abre al terminar la anterior y da hasta 3 estrellas:
 807         una por terminarla y dos por las condiciones marcadas con ★.${creator ? ' Modo creador: todas abiertas.' : ''}</p>
 808       <div class="missions">${cards}</div>
 809       <p class="small-note">Premio la primera vez: cristales (50 a 250) y XP. Cada estrella nueva: +${CAMPAIGN_STAR_CRYSTALS} cristales. Tienes ${this.campaignStars()} de ${CAMPAIGN.length * 3} estrellas.</p>
 810     </section>`;
 811   }

 818       <ol class="steps">${TUTORIAL_STEPS.map((s) => `<li>${esc(s.text)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>

 829   // Rangos (v1.3): tu rango, los 6 rangos de tu documento, la temporada, la tabla y tus partidas.
 830   ranksHtml() {
 831     const P = this.P;
 832     const R = P.ranked;
 833     const idx = rankIndex(R.points);
 834     const top = idx === RANKS.length - 1;
 835     const lo = RANK_MIN[idx];
 836     const hi = top ? lo : RANK_MIN[idx + 1];
 837     const pct = top ? 100 : Math.round(((R.points - lo) / (hi - lo)) * 100);
 838     const ladder = RANKS.map((n, i) => `<li class="${i === idx ? 'on' : i < idx ? 'past' : ''}"><i style="background:${RANK_COLORS[i]}"></i>${n}<small>${fmt(RANK_MIN[i])}</small></li>`).join('');
 839     const hist = (R.history || []).slice(0, 8).map((h) => `<li class="${h.win ? 'win' : 'loss'}"><b>${h.win ? 'Victoria' : h.forfeit ? 'Abandono' : 'Derrota'}</b><span>${h.delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${h.delta}</span><small>${esc(h.rank)} · ${prettyDate(h.day)}</small></li>`).join('');
 840     const diff = DIFFICULTY[rankedDifficulty(R.points)].name;
 841     const S = seasonOf(Profile.now());
 842     const ends = `${S.end.getDate()} de ${MONTHS[S.end.getMonth()]}`;
 843     const lv = Profile.level();
 844     const locked = lv < RANKED_LEVEL && !Creator.active();
 845     return `<section class="lcard panel ranked">
 846         <div class="rankhead"><div class="rankbadge" style="--rk:${RANK_COLORS[idx]}"><b>${RANK_ICONS[idx]}</b></div>
 847           <div><small>Tu rango · Temporada ${S.no}</small><h2 id="rank-name">${RANKS[idx]}</h2><span>${fmt(R.points)} puntos · mejor: ${rankName(R.best || 0)}</span></div></div>
 848         <div class="rankbar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="${pct}"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
 849         <p class="queue">${top ? 'Estás en el rango más alto.' : `${fmt(hi - R.points)} puntos para ${RANKS[idx + 1]}.`} Solo cuentan las partidas de la Liga 3 vs 3 (aliados bots; rivales en ${diff}). Ganar: +${RANK_WIN} · perder o abandonar: −${RANK_LOSS}.</p>
 850         <p class="queue" id="rank-rules">${R.shield ? '<b>Protección activa:</b> acabas de subir, tu primera derrota no te baja de rango. ' : 'Recién llegado a un rango, la primera derrota no te baja. '}La temporada termina el ${ends}: entonces bajas 1 rango (no a cero) y el pase vuelve a empezar.</p>
 851         <div class="row"><button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="ranked" id="btn-ranked" ${locked ? 'aria-disabled="true"' : ''}>Jugar Liga 3 vs 3</button>${locked ? `<small class="lockmsg">Desde nivel ${RANKED_LEVEL} (tienes ${lv})</small>` : ''}</div>
 852       </section>
 853       <section class="lcard panel"><h3>Los 6 rangos</h3><ol class="ranklist">${ladder}</ol>
 854         <p class="queue">Almirante del Faro: en Roblox serán los 50 mejores; aquí, sin servidores, desde ${fmt(RANK_MIN[5])} puntos.</p></section>
 855       <section class="lcard panel"><h3>Tabla de la Liga 3 vs 3</h3>
 856         <p class="queue">Comandantes bot del juego (sin servidores no hay otros jugadores reales). Tu puesto cambia con tus puntos.</p>
 857         <ol class="ladder" id="ladder">${ladderRows(P).map((r) => `<li class="${r.me ? 'me' : ''}"><b>${r.pos}.º</b><span>${esc(r.name)}${r.bot ? ' <small>bot</small>' : ''}</span><i style="background:${RANK_COLORS[rankIndex(r.points)]}"></i><em>${rankName(r.points)}</em><strong>${r.points}</strong></li>`).join('')}</ol></section>
 858       <section class="lcard panel"><h3>Últimas partidas · ${R.wins || 0} de ${R.games || 0} ganadas</h3>${hist ? `<ul class="rankhist">${hist}</ul>` : '<p class="queue">Todavía no jugaste la Liga 3 vs 3.</p>'}</section>`;
 859   }

 861   sideHtml() {
 862     const P = this.P;
 863     const lv = Profile.level();

 865     const tier = Profile.passTier();

 870     return `<aside class="lside">
 871       <div class="lcard panel"><h3>Nivel ${lv}</h3><div class="xpbar"><i style="width:${(into / LEVEL_XP) * 100}%"></i></div>
 872         <p>${fmt(into)} / ${fmt(LEVEL_XP)} XP</p></div>
 873       ${btn('pass', LOBBY_ICONS.pass, 'Pase del Faro', `Nivel ${tier} de ${PASS_TIERS}`, passN || '')}
 874       ${btn('missions', LOBBY_ICONS.missions, 'Misiones', `${missionsLeft} por hacer`, '')}
 875       ${btn('daily', LOBBY_ICONS.daily, 'Premio diario', Profile.dailyClaimable() ? '¡Listo para reclamar!' : 'Vuelve mañana', Profile.dailyClaimable() ? '1' : '')}
 876       ${btn('codes', LOBBY_ICONS.codes, 'Códigos', 'Canjea un código', '')}

 878       ${Creator.owner ? btn('creator', LOBBY_ICONS.creator, 'Modo creador', Creator.active() ? 'Activado' : 'Apagado', '') : ''}

 882   shopHtml() {
 883     const P = this.P;
 884     const tabs = [['skins', 'Apariencias'], ['chests', 'Cofres'], ['workshop', 'Taller'], ['crystals', 'Cristales']]
 885       .map(([k, l]) => `<button type="button" data-act="shoptab" data-v="${k}" class="${this.shopTab === k ? 'on' : ''}">${l}</button>`).join('');
 886     let inner = '';
 887     if (this.shopTab === 'skins') {
 888       inner = `<p>Solo cambian cómo se ven tus tropas y tu Núcleo: vida, daño y velocidad = iguales.</p>
 889         <div class="shopgrid">${SKINS.filter((s) => !s.special).map((s) => {
 890     const own = Profile.owns(s.id);
 891     const price = RARITY[s.rar].price;
 892     return `<div class="item ${own ? 'owned' : ''}">
 893             <img alt="" src="${Thumbs.get(SKIN_SLOTS[s.slot].model, PLAYER_COLORS[0], s.look)}">
 894             <b>${esc(s.name)}</b><span class="rar ${s.rar}">${RARITY[s.rar].name}</span>
 895             ${own ? '<small>Ya es tuyo</small>' : `<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="buy" data-id="${s.id}" ${P.crystals < price ? 'disabled' : ''}>${fmt(price)} cristales</button>`}
 896           </div>`;
 897   }).join('')}</div>`;
 898     } else if (this.shopTab === 'chests') {
 899       inner = `<div class="mode-cards">${Object.entries(CHESTS).map(([k, C]) => `<div class="chest">
 900           <b>${C.name}</b>

 902           <button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="chest" data-v="${k}" ${P.crystals < C.cost && !Creator.active() ? 'disabled' : ''}>Abrir · ${fmt(C.cost)} cristales</button>
 903         </div>`).join('')}</div>
 904         <p>Cada cofre da un aspecto (${CHEST_SPLIT.skin} %), un plano (${CHEST_SPLIT.plan} %) o fragmentos (${100 - CHEST_SPLIT.skin - CHEST_SPLIT.plan} %). Garantía: 1 legendario cada ${CHEST_PITY} cofres (te faltan ${CHEST_PITY - P.chests.pity}). Un aspecto repetido se convierte en fragmentos (${Object.entries(FRAG_DUP).map(([r, n]) => `${RARITY[r].name} ${n}`).join(', ')}).</p>`;

 913         : '<p class="queue">Todavía no tienes planos: salen en los cofres.</p>'}`;

 941   // ---------- ventanas ----------
 942   // Descarga la copia como archivo. En el enlace publicado se usa el permiso de descargas del visor
 943   // (te pide confirmar); abierto como archivo suelto, la descarga normal del navegador.
 944   async saveBackupFile() {
 945     const filename = `faro-de-ambar-progreso-${dayKey()}.txt`;
 946     const data = Profile.exportCode();
 947     if (window.claude && typeof window.claude.use === 'function') {
 948       let dl = null;
 949       try { dl = await window.claude.use('downloads'); } catch (err) { dl = null; }
 950       if (!dl) {
 951         this.openModal('backup', { msg: 'Aquí no se puede descargar el archivo: usa «Copiar» y guarda el texto.' });
 952         return;
 953       }
 954       try {
 955         await dl.save({ filename, data });
 956         this.openModal('backup', { msg: 'Archivo guardado. En el otro iPad, usa «Elegir archivo».' });
 957       } catch (err) {
 958         const code = err && err.code;
 959         if (code === 'declined') return;
 960         this.openModal('backup', { msg: code === 'rate_limited' ? 'Espera un momento y vuelve a tocar «Descargar archivo».'
 961           : 'Aquí no se puede descargar el archivo: usa «Copiar» y guarda el texto.' });
 962       }
 963       return;
 964     }
 965     const a = document.createElement('a');
 966     a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], { type: 'text/plain' }));
 967     a.download = filename;
 968     document.body.appendChild(a);
 969     a.click();
 970     setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1000);
 971   }

1011         const locked = m.minLevel && lv < m.minLevel && !Creator.active();
1012         return `<button type="button" class="mode-card ${P.play.mode === k ? 'on' : ''}" data-act="pickmode" data-v="${k}" ${locked ? 'disabled' : ''}>
1013           <b>${esc(m.name)}</b><small>${esc(m.desc)}</small>${locked ? `<em>Desde nivel ${m.minLevel}</em>` : ''}</button>`;
1014       }).join('')}</div>`;

1105   // ---------- acciones ----------
1106   onClick(e) {
1107     const b = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
1108     if (!b || b.disabled) return;
1109     const P = this.P;
1110     const act = b.dataset.act;
1111     const app = this.app;
1112     app.sound.unlock();
1113     app.sound.play('click');
1114     if (act === 'sub') {
1115       this.sub = b.dataset.sub;
1116       this.syncOpts();
1117       this.render();
1118     } else if (act === 'play') {
1119       this.syncOpts();
1120       app.startGame();
1121     } else if (act === 'toptab') {
1122       this.topTab = b.dataset.v;
1123       this.render();
1124     } else if (act === 'weekly') {
1125       this.sub = 'weekly';
1126       this.syncOpts();
1127       app.startGame();
1128     } else if (act === 'ranked') {
1129       if (Profile.level() < RANKED_LEVEL && !Creator.active()) {
1130         this.openModal('info', { title: 'Liga 3 vs 3', text: `La Liga 3 vs 3 se abre en el nivel ${RANKED_LEVEL}. Ahora estás en el nivel ${Profile.level()}: juega otras partidas para subir.` });
1131         return;
1132       }
1133       this.P.play.mode = RANKED_MODE;
1134       Profile.save();
1135       this.sub = 'main';
1136       this.syncOpts();
1137       app.startGame();
1138     } else if (act === 'mission') {
1139       app.startMission(Number(b.dataset.v));
1140     } else if (act === 'reroll') {
1141       app.reroll();
1142     } else if (act === 'diff') {
1143       this.setPlay('difficulty', b.dataset.v);
1144     } else if (act === 'cset') {
1145       let v = b.dataset.v;
1146       if (v === 'true' || v === 'false') v = v === 'true';
1147       else if (/^\d+$/.test(v)) v = Number(v);
1148       this.setPlay(b.dataset.k, v);
1149     } else if (act === 'modal') {
1150       this.openModal(b.dataset.m);
1151     } else if (act === 'close') {
1152       this.closeModal();
1153     } else if (act === 'bk-copy') {
1154       const t = $('bk-out');
1155       t.select();
1156       const done = () => this.openModal('backup', { msg: 'Copiado. Pégalo en «Cargar» en el otro iPad o navegador.' });
1157       if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(t.value).then(done, () => { try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (err) { /* nada */ } done(); });
1158       else { try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (err) { /* nada */ } done(); }
1159     } else if (act === 'bk-file') {
1160       this.saveBackupFile();
1161     } else if (act === 'bk-load') {
1162       this.loadBackup($('bk-in').value, b);
1163     } else if (act === 'pickmode') {
1164       P.play.mode = b.dataset.v;
1165       Profile.save();
1166       this.closeModal();
1167       this.syncOpts();
1168       this.render();
1169     } else if (act === 'pickmap') {
1170       P.play.mapKind = b.dataset.v;
1171       Profile.save();
1172       this.closeModal();
1173       this.syncOpts();
1174       this.render();
1175     } else if (act === 'resume') {
1176       app.resumeGame();
1177     } else if (act === 'load') {
1178       app.loadSavedGame();
1179     } else if (act === 'abandon') {
1180       app.abandonGame();
1181     } else if (act === 'passclaim') {
1182       this.claimTier(Number(b.dataset.v));
1183     } else if (act === 'passall') {
1184       for (let t = 1; t <= Profile.passTier(); t++) if (!P.pass[t]) this.claimTier(t, true);
1185       this.render();
1186     } else if (act === 'reroll-m') {
1187       Profile.rerollDaily(Number(b.dataset.v));
1188       this.render();
1189     } else if (act === 'dailyclaim') {
1190       this.claimDaily();
1191     } else if (act === 'shoptab') {
1192       this.shopTab = b.dataset.v;
1193       this.view = 'shop';
1194       if (this.modal) this.closeModal();
1195       this.render();
1196     } else if (act === 'craft') {
1197       const err = this.craft(b.dataset.id);
1198       if (err) this.openModal('info', { title: 'Taller', text: err });
1199       else this.openModal('info', { title: 'Taller', text: `¡Fabricaste ${SKIN_BY_ID[b.dataset.id].name}! Ya está en tu Inventario.` });
1200       this.render();
1201     } else if (act === 'buy') {
1202       this.buySkin(b.dataset.id);
1203     } else if (act === 'chest') {
1204       this.openChest(b.dataset.v, false);
1205     } else if (act === 'equip') {
1206       P.equipped[b.dataset.slot] = b.dataset.id || null;
1207       Profile.save();
1208       if (this.modal === 'chestopen') this.closeModal();
1209       this.render();
1210     } else if (act === 'creator') {
1211       if (!Creator.owner) return;
1212       P.creator[b.dataset.k] = b.dataset.v === 'true';
1213       Profile.save();
1214       this.render();
1215     }
1216   }

1226   claimTier(t, quiet) {
1227     const P = this.P;
1228     if (t < 1 || t > Profile.passTier() || P.pass[t]) return;
1229     P.pass[t] = true;
1230     const r = passReward(t);
1231     if (r.chest) this.openChest(r.chest, true, quiet);
1232     else this.give(r);
1233     Profile.save();
1234     if (!quiet) this.render();
1235   }

1290   // Taller (v1.2): fabrica un aspecto con su plano y fragmentos.
1291   craft(id) {
1292     const P = this.P;
1293     const s = SKIN_BY_ID[id];
1294     if (!s || !(P.plans || {})[id]) return 'No tienes el plano de ese aspecto';
1295     if (P.owned[id]) return 'Ya tienes ese aspecto';
1296     const cost = FRAG_COST[s.rar];
1297     if ((P.fragments || 0) < cost) return `Te faltan ${cost - (P.fragments || 0)} fragmentos`;
1298     P.fragments -= cost;
1299     delete P.plans[id];
1300     P.owned[id] = true;
1301     Profile.save();
1302     return null;
