1305   openChest(kind, free, quiet) {
1306     const P = this.P;
1307     const C = CHESTS[kind];
1308     if (!C) return null;
1309     if (!free && !Creator.active()) {
1310       if (P.crystals < C.cost) return null;
1311       P.crystals -= C.cost;
1312     }
1313     P.chests.opened++;
1314     P.chests.pity++;
1315     let roll = Math.random() * 100;
1316     let rar = 'comun';
1317     for (const [r, pct] of Object.entries(C.odds)) {
1318       if (roll < pct) {
1319         rar = r;
1320         break;
1321       }
1322       roll -= pct;
1323     }
1324     // Garantía: si llevas 29 cofres sin legendario, el siguiente lo es.
1325     if (P.chests.pity >= CHEST_PITY) rar = 'legendario';
1326     if (rar === 'legendario') P.chests.pity = 0;
1327     const pool = SKINS.filter((s) => s.rar === rar && !s.special);
1328     const item = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
1329     // v1.2: aspecto, plano o fragmentos (la garantía del legendario siempre da el aspecto).
1330     P.fragments = P.fragments || 0;
1331     P.plans = P.plans || {};
1332     const split = rar === 'legendario' && P.chests.pity === 0 ? 0 : Math.random() * 100;
1333     let kindOut = split < CHEST_SPLIT.skin ? 'skin' : split < CHEST_SPLIT.skin + CHEST_SPLIT.plan ? 'plan' : 'frags';
1334     let planItem = null;
1335     if (kindOut === 'plan') {
1336       const cand = SKINS.filter((s) => !s.special && !P.owned[s.id] && !P.plans[s.id]);
1337       if (cand.length) planItem = cand[Math.floor(Math.random() * cand.length)];
1338       else kindOut = 'frags';
1339     }
1340     let frags = 0;
1341     let dup = false;
1342     if (kindOut === 'skin') {
1343       dup = !!P.owned[item.id];
1344       if (dup) frags = FRAG_DUP[rar];
1345       else P.owned[item.id] = true;
1346     } else if (kindOut === 'plan') {
1347       P.plans[planItem.id] = true;
1348     } else {
1349       frags = FRAG_PACK[0] + Math.floor(Math.random() * (FRAG_PACK[1] - FRAG_PACK[0] + 1));
1350     }
1351     P.fragments += frags;
1352     Profile.save();
1353     const result = { chest: C.name, item: kindOut === 'plan' ? planItem : item, dup, frags, kind: kindOut };
1354     if (!quiet) {
1355       this.openModal('chestopen', result);
1356       this.render();
1357     }
1358     return result;
1359   }

1427   // ---------- Liga 3 vs 3 (v1.3) ----------
1428   // Gana +25, pierde −15. Recién llegado a un rango, la primera derrota no te baja de él.
1429   rankedResult(win, forfeit = false) {
1430     const R = this.P.ranked;
1431     const before = R.points;
1432     const idx0 = rankIndex(before);
1433     let delta = win ? RANK_WIN : -Math.min(RANK_LOSS, before);
1434     let saved = false;
1435     if (!win && R.shield && rankIndex(before + delta) < idx0) {
1436       delta = RANK_MIN[idx0] - before;
1437       saved = true;
1438     }
1439     if (!win) R.shield = false;
1440     R.points = Math.max(0, before + delta);
1441     if (rankIndex(R.points) > idx0) R.shield = true;
1442     R.best = Math.max(R.best || 0, R.points);
1443     R.games = (R.games || 0) + 1;
1444     if (win) R.wins = (R.wins || 0) + 1;
1445     R.history = [{ day: dayKey(), win, delta, rank: rankName(R.points), forfeit }, ...(R.history || [])].slice(0, 12);
1446     Profile.save();
1447     return { before, after: R.points, delta, from: rankName(before), to: rankName(R.points), saved, forfeit };
1448   }
1449 
1450   rankedLine(r) {
1451     return `Liga 3 vs 3${r.forfeit ? ' (abandonada)' : ''}: ${r.delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${r.delta} puntos · ${r.from === r.to ? r.to : `${r.from} → ${r.to}`}${r.saved ? ' · protección de rango: no bajaste' : ''}`;
1452   }

1454   // Abandonar una partida de la Liga (o empezar otra encima) cuenta como derrota.
1455   forfeitRanked() {
1456     const r = this.rankedResult(false, true);
1457     this.app.ui.toast(this.rankedLine(r), 'bad');
1458     return r;
1459   }

1461   // ---------- final de partida ----------
1462   finish(game) {
1463     if (game.rewarded) return game.reward || null;
1464     game.rewarded = true;
1465     const P = this.P;
1466     const me = game.players[0];
1467     const win = game.result === 'victory';
1468     const out = { xp: 0, crystals: 0, lines: [], missions: [], levelUp: false, creator: !!game.creator, tutorial: null };
1469     if (game.creator) {
1470       game.reward = out;
1471       return out;
1472     }
1473     Profile.refresh();
1474     const lv0 = Profile.level();
1475     const half = game.opts.custom ? 0.5 : 1;
1476     const parts = [
1477       ['Jugar', XP_REWARD.play],
1478       ['Ganar', win ? XP_REWARD.win : 0],
1479       [`Islas tomadas (${me.stats.captures})`, me.stats.captures * XP_REWARD.island],
1480       [`Núcleos destruidos (${me.coresKilled})`, me.coresKilled * XP_REWARD.core],
1481     ];
1482     for (const [label, n] of parts) {
1483       const v = Math.round(n * half);
1484       if (v > 0) {
1485         out.xp += v;
1486         out.lines.push(`${label}: +${v} XP`);
1487       }
1488     }
1489     if (half < 1) out.lines.push('Personalizado: mitad de XP');
1490     out.crystals = Math.round((GAME_CRYSTALS.play + (win ? GAME_CRYSTALS.win : 0)) * half);
1491     // v1.2: fragmentos por jugar.
1492     out.frags = Math.round((FRAG_GAME.play + (win ? FRAG_GAME.win : 0)) * half);
1493     P.fragments = (P.fragments || 0) + out.frags;
1494     if (out.frags) out.lines.push(`Fragmentos: +${out.frags}`);
1495     P.stats.games++;
1496     if (win) P.stats.wins++;
1497     P.stats.islands += me.stats.captures;
1498     P.stats.cores += me.coresKilled;
1499     P.stats.kills += me.stats.kills;
1500     P.stats.trained = (P.stats.trained || 0) + me.stats.trained;
1501     P.stats.faro = (P.stats.faro || 0) + (me.stats.faro || 0);
1502     // v1.4: desafío semanal: mejor tiempo y premio la primera vez que lo ganas.
1503     if (game.opts.weekly) {
1504       const W = P.weekly[game.opts.weekly] || (P.weekly[game.opts.weekly] = { tries: 0, won: false, best: null });
1505       W.tries++;
1506       if (win) {
1507         if (!W.won) {
1508           out.crystals += WEEKLY_CRYSTALS;
1509           out.lines.push(`Desafío semanal ganado: +${WEEKLY_CRYSTALS} cristales`);
1510         }
1511         W.won = true;
1512         W.best = W.best === null ? Math.round(game.time) : Math.min(W.best, Math.round(game.time));
1513         out.weekly = W.best;
1514       }
1515     }
1516     // Misiones: suman lo que hiciste en esta partida.
1517     const delta = { games: 1, wins: win ? 1 : 0, built: me.stats.built, trained: me.stats.trained, captures: me.stats.captures,
1518       kills: me.stats.kills, upgrades: me.stats.upgrades, cores: me.coresKilled };
1519     for (const kind of ['daily', 'weekly']) {
1520       for (const m of P.missions[kind]) {
1521         if (m.done) continue;
1522         const d = MISSION_BY_ID[m.id];
1523         m.prog += delta[d.stat] || 0;
1524         if (m.prog >= d.goal) {
1525           m.done = true;
1526           out.xp += XP_REWARD.mission;
1527           out.crystals += MISSION_CRYSTALS[kind];
1528           out.missions.push(d.text);
1529         }
1530       }
1531     }
1532     // Tutorial: premio único al terminarlo por primera vez.
1533     if (game.mode.tutorial && win && !P.tutorialDone) {
1534       P.tutorialDone = true;
1535       P.badges.primerFaro = true;
1536       P.owned.dorado_inf = true;
1537       out.crystals += 150;
1538       out.tutorial = 'Insignia «Primer Faro», 150 cristales y el aspecto Soldado Dorado';
1539     }
1540     // Campaña: premio la primera vez que terminas la misión y cristales por cada estrella nueva.
1541     if (game.camp) {
1542       const m = Campaign.def(game.camp.id);
1543       const got = Campaign.stars(game).filter((s) => s.ok).length;
1544       const prev = P.campaign.stars[m.id] || 0;
1545       out.camp = { id: m.id, got, prev, first: 0, newStars: 0 };
1546       if (win && !P.campaign.done[m.id]) {
1547         P.campaign.done[m.id] = true;
1548         out.camp.first = m.crystals;
1549         out.crystals += m.crystals;
1550       }
1551       if (got > prev) {
1552         out.camp.newStars = got - prev;
1553         out.crystals += out.camp.newStars * CAMPAIGN_STAR_CRYSTALS;
1554         P.campaign.stars[m.id] = got;
1555       }
1556     }
1557     // Liga 3 vs 3: puntos y rango.
1558     if (game.mode.ranked && !game.opts.custom) {
1559       out.ranked = this.rankedResult(win);
1560       out.lines.push(this.rankedLine(out.ranked));
1561     }
1562     // v1.4: logros nuevos de esta partida.
1563     out.achievements = this.checkAchievements({ P, g: game, me, win });
1564     for (const a of out.achievements) {
1565       out.crystals += a.crystals;
1566       out.lines.push(`Logro: ${a.name}${a.crystals ? ` (+${a.crystals} cristales)` : ''}`);
1567     }
1568     Profile.addXp(out.xp);
1569     P.crystals += out.crystals;
1570     out.level = Profile.level();
1571     out.levelUp = out.level > lv0;
1572     Profile.save();
1573     game.reward = out;
1574     return out;
1575   }
1576 
1577   positions(game) {
1578     // Solo hay «Ganador» si queda un equipo (o en Rey del Faro); si siguen varios, todos «Seguía en pie».
1579     const aliveTeams = new Set(game.players.filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.team));
1580     const winTeam = game.kingWinner !== undefined ? game.kingWinner : aliveTeams.size === 1 ? [...aliveTeams][0] : -999;
1581     const alive = game.players.filter((p) => p.alive).sort((a, b) => (b.team === winTeam) - (a.team === winTeam));
1582     const list = [];
1583     let rank = 0;
1584     let lastWin = null;
1585     alive.forEach((p, i) => {
1586       const w = p.team === winTeam;
1587       if (!(w && lastWin)) rank = i + 1;
1588       lastWin = w;
1589       list.push({ p, rank, note: w ? 'Ganador' : 'Seguía en pie' });
1590     });
1591     for (let i = game.elimOrder.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
1592       const e = game.elimOrder[i];
1593       list.push({ p: game.players[e.pid], rank: list.length + 1, note: `Cayó a los ${fmtTime(e.time)}` });
1594     }
1595     return list;
1596   }

1598   advice(game) {
1599     const hb = game.players[0].stats.hitBy || {};
1600     const groups = {};
1601     for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(hb)) {
1602       const d = UNITS[k];
1603       const g = k === 'bld' ? 'bld' : !d ? 'other' : k === 'arty' ? 'arty' : d.cls === 'inf' ? 'inf' : d.cls === 'veh' ? 'veh' : d.cls === 'air' ? 'air' : 'sea';
1604       groups[g] = (groups[g] || 0) + v;
1605     }
1606     const top = Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
1607     const tips = {
1608       bld: 'Las torretas y defensas enemigas te hicieron mucho daño. Atácalas desde lejos con Tanques o Lanzamisiles.',
1609       inf: 'La infantería enemiga te desgastó. Prueba Escopeteros, Jeeps o Torretas mejoradas con miniguns.',
1610       veh: 'Los vehículos enemigos te superaron. Los Cazadores y Coheteros hacen más daño a tanques.',
1611       air: 'Te atacaron desde el aire. Construye AIR DEFENSE y Camiones antiaéreos cerca del Núcleo.',
1612       sea: 'Los barcos atacaron tu costa. Pon Torretas en la costa, ten Destructores y mejora el Núcleo para la Cúpula.',
1613       arty: 'Los Lanzamisiles te atacaron de lejos. Sube el Núcleo a nivel 3 y compra la Cúpula.',
1614     };
1615     if (top && tips[top[0]]) return tips[top[0]];
1616     return 'Entrena Constructores pronto y construye más Granjas y energía: con más monedas tendrás un ejército más grande.';
1617   }

1619   // Final de una misión: estrellas, por qué faltó cada una y «Siguiente misión».
1620   missionEndHtml(game) {
1621     const r = this.finish(game);
1622     const m = Campaign.def(game.camp.id);
1623     const me = game.players[0];
1624     const win = game.result === 'victory';
1625     const stars = Campaign.stars(game);
1626     if (!win) stars[0].why = 'Tu Núcleo cayó';
1627     const got = stars.filter((s) => s.ok).length;
1628     const next = Campaign.def(m.id + 1);
1629     const nextOpen = !!next && Campaign.unlocked(next.id, this.P, Creator.active());
1630     const c = r.camp;
1631     const opened = nextOpen && !!c && c.first > 0;
1632     const text = !win ? 'Tu Núcleo cayó. Puedes repetir la misión cuando quieras.'
1633       : next ? `Misión cumplida.${opened ? ` Se abrió la misión ${next.id}: ${next.name}.` : ''}`
1634         : '¡Terminaste la campaña! El Faro de Ámbar vuelve a brillar.';
1635     const why = c ? [c.first ? `Primera vez: ${c.first}` : '', c.newStars ? `${c.newStars === 1 ? '1 estrella nueva' : `${c.newStars} estrellas nuevas`}: ${c.newStars * CAMPAIGN_STAR_CRYSTALS}` : '',
1636       r.missions.length ? 'misiones' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') : '';
1637     const prizes = r.creator
1638       ? '<div><b>Modo creador</b><span>Sin XP ni cristales</span></div>'
1639       : `<div><b>+${fmt(r.xp)} XP</b><span>${r.lines.map(esc).join(' · ')}</span></div>
1640          <div><b>+${fmt(r.crystals)} cristales</b><span>${esc(why || 'Por jugar')}</span></div>
1641          <div><b>Nivel ${r.level}</b><span>${r.levelUp ? '¡Subiste de nivel!' : `${fmt(this.P.xp % LEVEL_XP)} / ${fmt(LEVEL_XP)} XP`}</span></div>`;
1642     const core = me.core;
1643     return `
1644       <div class="endhero"><div><small class="lbl">Campaña · Misión ${m.id} de ${CAMPAIGN.length}</small>
1645         <h2>${win ? '¡Misión cumplida!' : 'Misión fallida'}</h2><p>${esc(m.name)} · ${esc(text)}</p></div>
1646         <div class="bigstars" role="img" aria-label="${got} de 3 estrellas">${stars.map((s) => `<i class="${s.ok ? 'on' : ''}">★</i>`).join('')}</div></div>
1647       <ol class="starlist">${stars.map((s) => `<li class="${s.ok ? 'ok' : 'no'}"><b>${esc(s.text)}</b><span>${s.ok ? 'Conseguida' : esc(s.why)}</span></li>`).join('')}</ol>
1648       <div class="endstats">
1649         <div><b>${fmtTime(game.time)}</b><span>Tiempo</span></div>
1650         <div><b>${me.stats.lost}</b><span>Tropas perdidas</span></div>
1651         <div><b>${game.camp.lostBld}</b><span>Edificios perdidos</span></div>
1652         <div><b>${core.alive ? Math.round((core.hp / core.maxHp) * 100) : 0} %</b><span>Vida del Núcleo</span></div>
1653       </div>
1654       <h3 class="lbl">Premios</h3>
1655       <div class="prizes">${prizes}</div>
1656       ${r.missions.length ? `<div class="advice">Misiones completadas: ${r.missions.map(esc).join(', ')}</div>` : ''}
1657       ${win ? '' : `<div class="advice"><b>Consejo:</b> ${esc(m.tip)}</div>`}
1658       <div class="row">
1659         <button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-watch">Mirar el final</button>
1660         ${win && next ? `<button class="btn gold" type="button" id="btn-next" data-v="${next.id}">Siguiente misión</button>` : ''}
1661         <button class="btn ${win && next ? '' : 'gold'}" type="button" id="btn-again">Repetir</button>
1662         <button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-menu">Vestíbulo</button>
1663       </div>`;
1664   }
1665 
1666   // ---------- gráficas del final (v1.1) ----------
1667   // Dos gráficas (no un solo eje doble): monedas por minuto y tropas de combate de cada imperio.
1668   // Cada línea tiene el color de su imperio y además su propio trazo y su nombre al final.
1669   historyHtml(game) {
1670     const H = game.history || [];
1671     if (H.length < 2) return '';
1672     const ids = game.players.map((p) => p.id);
1673     return `<h3 class="lbl">Cómo fue la partida</h3>
1674       <div class="histcharts">${this.historyChart(game, 'inc', 'Monedas por minuto')}${this.historyChart(game, 'army', 'Tropas de combate')}</div>
1675       <div class="histlegend">${ids.map((i) => `<span><svg width="26" height="8" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="1" y1="4" x2="25" y2="4" stroke="${cssColor(game.players[i].color)}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="${HIST_DASH[i]}" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>${esc(game.players[i].name)}</span>`).join('')}</div>
1676       <details class="histtable"><summary>Ver como tabla</summary><table><thead><tr><th>Imperio</th><th>Monedas/min (final)</th><th>Monedas/min (máx.)</th><th>Tropas (máx.)</th></tr></thead><tbody>
1677         ${ids.map((i) => `<tr><td>${esc(game.players[i].name)}</td><td>${fmt(H[H.length - 1].inc[i])}</td><td>${fmt(Math.max(...H.map((h) => h.inc[i])))}</td><td>${Math.max(...H.map((h) => h.army[i]))}</td></tr>`).join('')}
1678       </tbody></table></details>`;
1679   }
1680 
1681   historyChart(game, key, title) {
1682     const H = game.history;
1683     const W = 560;
1684     const Ht = 170;
1685     const L = 40;
1686     const R = 64;
1687     const T = 10;
1688     const B = 22;
1689     const tMax = Math.max(H[H.length - 1].t, 1);
1690     const vMax = Math.max(1, ...H.map((h) => Math.max(...h[key])));
1691     const nice = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(vMax)));
1692     const yMax = Math.ceil(vMax / nice) * nice;
1693     const x = (t) => L + (t / tMax) * (W - L - R);
1694     const y = (v) => T + (1 - v / yMax) * (Ht - T - B);
1695     const grid = [0, 0.5, 1].map((k) => `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${y(yMax * k)}" y2="${y(yMax * k)}" class="hgrid"/>
1696       <text x="${L - 6}" y="${y(yMax * k) + 4}" text-anchor="end" class="haxis">${fmt(Math.round(yMax * k))}</text>`).join('');
1697     const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(tMax / 60));
1698     const step = mins > 20 ? 10 : mins > 8 ? 5 : mins > 3 ? 2 : 1;
1699     let xt = '';
1700     for (let m = 0; m * 60 <= tMax; m += step) xt += `<text x="${x(m * 60)}" y="${Ht - 6}" text-anchor="middle" class="haxis">${m} min</text>`;
1701     // Nombres al final de cada línea; si se tocan, se separan un poco.
1702     const ends = game.players.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, v: H[H.length - 1][key][p.id] })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v);
1703     let lastY = -99;
1704     const labels = ends.map((e) => {
1705       let ly = y(e.v) + 4;
1706       if (ly - lastY < 11) ly = lastY + 11;
1707       lastY = ly;
1708       return `<text x="${W - R + 6}" y="${ly}" class="hend">${esc(game.players[e.id].name)}</text>`;
1709     }).join('');
1710     const lines = game.players.map((p) => {
1711       const pts = H.map((h) => `${x(h.t).toFixed(1)},${y(h[key][p.id]).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
1712       return `<polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${cssColor(p.color)}" stroke-width="${p.id === 0 ? 2.5 : 2}" stroke-dasharray="${HIST_DASH[p.id]}" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
1713     }).join('');
1714     return `<figure class="histchart" data-key="${key}"><figcaption>${title}</figcaption>
1715       <div class="histwrap"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${Ht}" role="img" aria-label="${title} de cada imperio a lo largo de la partida">
1716         ${grid}${xt}${lines}${labels}<line class="hcross" x1="0" x2="0" y1="${T}" y2="${Ht - B}" visibility="hidden"/>
1717         <rect class="hhit" x="${L}" y="${T}" width="${W - L - R}" height="${Ht - T - B}" fill="transparent"/></svg>
1718         <div class="histtip" hidden></div></div></figure>`;
1719   }
1720 
1721   endHtml(game) {
1722     if (game.camp) return this.missionEndHtml(game);
1723     const r = this.finish(game);
1724     const me = game.players[0];
1725     const s = me.stats;
1726     const win = game.result === 'victory';
1727     const pos = this.positions(game);
1728     const winnerName = game.spectateWinner >= 0 && game.players[game.spectateWinner] ? game.players[game.spectateWinner].name : null;
1729     const text = game.kingWinner !== undefined
1730       ? (win ? `Tu equipo mantuvo el Faro ${fmtTime(KING_TIME)}.` : 'Otro imperio mantuvo el Faro el tiempo necesario.')
1731       : (win ? 'Todos los Núcleos rivales cayeron. El archipiélago es tuyo.' : winnerName ? `Tu Núcleo fue destruido. Seguiste mirando: ganó ${winnerName}.` : 'Tu Núcleo fue destruido.');
1732     const prizes = r.creator
1733       ? '<div><b>Modo creador</b><span>Sin XP ni cristales</span></div>'
1734       : `<div><b>+${fmt(r.xp)} XP</b><span>${r.lines.map(esc).join(' · ')}</span></div>
1735          <div><b>+${fmt(r.crystals)} cristales</b><span>${r.missions.length ? 'Incluye misiones' : 'Por jugar' + (win ? ' y ganar' : '')}</span></div>
1736          <div><b>Nivel ${r.level}</b><span>${r.levelUp ? '¡Subiste de nivel!' : `${fmt(this.P.xp % LEVEL_XP)} / ${fmt(LEVEL_XP)} XP`}</span></div>`;
1737     return `
1738       <div class="endhero"><div><h2>${win ? '¡Victoria!' : 'Derrota'}</h2><p>${esc(text)}</p></div></div>
1739       <div class="endstats">
1740         <div><b>${fmtTime(game.time)}</b><span>Tiempo</span></div>
1741         <div><b>${s.captures}</b><span>Islas tomadas</span></div>
1742         <div><b>${s.trained}</b><span>Tropas entrenadas</span></div>
1743         <div><b>${me.coresKilled}</b><span>Núcleos destruidos</span></div>
1744       </div>
1745       <h3 class="lbl">Posiciones</h3>
1746       <div class="positions">${pos.map((x) => `<div class="${x.p.id === 0 ? 'me' : ''}"><b>${x.rank}.º</b><i style="background:${cssColor(x.p.color)}"></i>
1747         <span>${esc(x.p.name)}</span><small>${esc(x.note)}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>
1748       <h3 class="lbl">Premios</h3>
1749       <div class="prizes">${prizes}</div>
1750       ${r.missions.length ? `<div class="advice">Misiones completadas: ${r.missions.map(esc).join(', ')}</div>` : ''}
1751       ${r.tutorial ? `<div class="advice">Premio del Tutorial: ${esc(r.tutorial)}</div>` : ''}
1752       ${win ? '' : `<div class="advice"><b>Consejo:</b> ${esc(this.advice(game))}</div>`}
1753       ${this.historyHtml(game)}
1754       <div class="row">
1755         ${game.canSpectate() ? '<button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-spectate">Seguir mirando</button>' : ''}
1756         <button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-watch">Mirar el mapa</button>
1757         <button class="btn gold" type="button" id="btn-again">Revancha</button>
1758         <button class="btn" type="button" id="btn-menu">Vestíbulo</button>
1759       </div>`;
1760   }
1761 }

faro/src/js/086-music.js · 190 líneas

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Música propia (v1.1): melodías generadas por el juego con Web Audio, sin archivos.
  3 // Vestíbulo: tranquila (acordes suaves y arpegio). Partida: más rápida, con bajo; cuando hay
  4 // combate se suman bombo, caja y platillos. Volumen guardado en el aparato.
  5 
  6 const MUSIC_THEMES = {
  7   // Acordes por compás (notas MIDI) y tempo.
  8   lobby: { bpm: 84, chords: [[57, 60, 64], [53, 57, 60], [48, 52, 55], [55, 59, 62]], bass: false, arp: [0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 1, 2, 1] },
  9   battle: { bpm: 112, chords: [[50, 53, 57], [46, 50, 53], [48, 52, 55], [45, 49, 52]], bass: true, arp: [0, 2, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1, 2] },
 10 };
 11 const MUSIC_LEVELS = [0, 0.3, 0.6, 1];
 12 
 13 class Music {
 14   constructor(sound) {
 15     this.sound = sound;
 16     this.theme = null;
 17     this.intensity = 0;
 18     this.step = 0;
 19     this.nextT = 0;
 20     this.timer = null;
 21     this.level = 0.6;
 22     try {
 23       const v = Number(localStorage.getItem('faro-music'));
 24       if (localStorage.getItem('faro-music') !== null && MUSIC_LEVELS.includes(v)) this.level = v;
 25     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 26     this.notes = 0;
 27   }
 28 
 29   get playing() {
 30     return !!this.timer;
 31   }
 32 
 33   setLevel(v) {
 34     this.level = v;
 35     try { localStorage.setItem('faro-music', String(v)); } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 36     if (this.gain) this.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.volume(), this.sound.ctx.currentTime, 0.2);
 37     if (v > 0 && this.theme && !this.timer) this.start(this.theme);
 38     if (v === 0) this.stop();
 39   }
 40 
 41   volume() {
 42     return this.sound.on ? this.level * 0.35 : 0;
 43   }
 44 
 45   // Elige la melodía (lobby o battle) y empieza si el audio ya está desbloqueado.
 46   play(theme) {
 47     this.theme = theme;
 48     if (!this.sound.ctx || this.level === 0) return;
 49     if (this.timer && this.current === theme) return;
 50     this.start(theme);
 51   }
 52 
 53   start(theme) {
 54     const c = this.sound.ctx;
 55     if (!c) return;
 56     if (!this.gain) {
 57       this.gain = c.createGain();
 58       this.gain.connect(this.sound.master);
 59     }
 60     this.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.volume(), c.currentTime, 0.3);
 61     this.current = theme;
 62     this.step = 0;
 63     this.nextT = c.currentTime + 0.1;
 64     clearInterval(this.timer);
 65     this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), 90);
 66   }
 67 
 68   stop() {
 69     clearInterval(this.timer);
 70     this.timer = null;
 71     this.current = null;
 72   }
 73 
 74   // 0 = calma, 1 = combate: suma percusión en la partida. Sube o baja con el tiempo real (no con los cuadros).
 75   setIntensity(k) {
 76     this.target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, k));
 77   }
 78 
 79   refreshVolume() {
 80     if (this.gain && this.sound.ctx) this.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.volume(), this.sound.ctx.currentTime, 0.2);
 81   }
 82 
 83   midi(n) {
 84     return 440 * Math.pow(2, (n - 69) / 12);
 85   }
 86 
 87   tick() {
 88     const c = this.sound.ctx;
 89     if (!c || !this.current) return;
 90     if (c.state !== 'running') return;
 91     this.intensity += ((this.target || 0) - this.intensity) * 0.12;
 92     const T = MUSIC_THEMES[this.current];
 93     const eighth = 60 / T.bpm / 2;
 94     while (this.nextT < c.currentTime + 0.35) {
 95       this.playStep(T, this.step, this.nextT, eighth);
 96       this.step = (this.step + 1) % 64;
 97       this.nextT += eighth;
 98     }
 99   }
100 
101   playStep(T, step, t, eighth) {
102     const bar = Math.floor(step / 16) % T.chords.length;
103     const inBar = step % 16;
104     const chord = T.chords[bar];
105     // Acorde de fondo al empezar cada compás.
106     if (inBar === 0) for (const n of chord) this.pad(this.midi(n), t, eighth * 16);
107     // Arpegio una octava arriba en corcheas.
108     if (inBar % 2 === 0 || this.current === 'battle') {
109       const n = chord[T.arp[inBar % 8]] + 12;
110       this.pluck(this.midi(n), t, eighth * 1.6, this.current === 'battle' ? 0.05 : 0.06);
111     }
112     if (T.bass && inBar % 4 === 0) this.bass(this.midi(chord[0] - 12), t, eighth * 3.2);
113     if (this.current === 'battle') {
114       const k = this.intensity;
115       if (k > 0.25 && inBar % 8 === 0) this.kick(t);
116       if (k > 0.25 && inBar % 8 === 4) this.snare(t);
117       if (k > 0.55 && inBar % 2 === 1) this.hat(t);
118     }
119   }
120 
121   env(t, a, d, peak) {
122     const c = this.sound.ctx;
123     const g = c.createGain();
124     g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
125     g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, t + a);
126     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + a + d);
127     g.connect(this.gain);
128     return g;
129   }
130 
131   osc(type, f, t, dur, g) {
132     const o = this.sound.ctx.createOscillator();
133     o.type = type;
134     o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t);
135     o.connect(g);
136     o.start(t);
137     o.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
138     this.notes++;
139     return o;
140   }
141 
142   pad(f, t, dur) {
143     const g = this.env(t, dur * 0.3, dur * 0.7, 0.035);
144     this.osc('triangle', f, t, dur, g);
145     this.osc('triangle', f * 1.004, t, dur, g);
146   }
147 
148   pluck(f, t, dur, vol) {
149     this.osc('sine', f, t, dur, this.env(t, 0.01, dur, vol));
150   }
151 
152   bass(f, t, dur) {
153     const c = this.sound.ctx;
154     const g = this.env(t, 0.02, dur, 0.09);
155     const lp = c.createBiquadFilter();
156     lp.type = 'lowpass';
157     lp.frequency.value = 420;
158     lp.connect(g);
159     this.osc('sawtooth', f, t, dur, lp);
160   }
161 
162   kick(t) {
163     this.drums = (this.drums || 0) + 1;
164     const g = this.env(t, 0.005, 0.25, 0.22);
165     const o = this.osc('sine', 120, t, 0.3, g);
166     o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(42, t + 0.22);
167   }
168 
169   noise(t, dur, type, freq, vol) {
170     const c = this.sound.ctx;
171     if (!this.sound.noise) return;
172     const src = c.createBufferSource();
173     src.buffer = this.sound.noise;
174     const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
175     f.type = type;
176     f.frequency.value = freq;
177     src.connect(f);
178     f.connect(this.env(t, 0.003, dur, vol));
179     src.start(t, Math.random() * 0.5, dur + 0.05);
180     this.notes++;
181   }
182 
183   snare(t) {
184     this.noise(t, 0.16, 'bandpass', 1800, 0.12);
185   }
186 
187   hat(t) {
188     this.noise(t, 0.05, 'highpass', 7000, 0.05);
189   }
190 }

faro/src/js/09-main.js · 595 líneas

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Arranque y bucle principal.
  3 
  4 const App = {
  5   state: 'menu',
  6   game: null,
  7   renderer: null,
  8   gl: null,
  9   input: null,
 10   ui: null,
 11   sound: null,
 12   selection: [],
 13   paused: false,
 14   quality: 'high', // calidad que se usa ahora: 'high' o 'low'
 15   qualityPref: 'auto', // la elegida en la pausa: 'auto', 'high' o 'low'
 16   showFps: false,
 17   fps: 0,
 18   fpsFrames: 0,
 19   fpsT: 0,
 20   lowFpsSecs: 0,
 21   opts: { mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'archipelago', difficulty: 'normal', seed: 0 },
 22   suspended: null,
 23   lobby: null,
 24   // Controles v0.7: grupos 1-3 (tropas guardadas) y formación al mover.
 25   groups: { 1: [], 2: [], 3: [] },
 26   groupTap: { n: 0, t: 0 },
 27   formation: 'block',
 28   // v1.3: guardado automático cada 60 s (antes 15) y al pausar, salir o cambiar de app.
 29   saveT: 60,
 30   last: 0,
 31   time: 0,
 32   miniT: 0,
 33   endTimer: null,
 34 
 35   init(hotData) {
 36     window.FARO = this;
 37     this.canvas = $('gl');
 38     this.overlay = $('overlay');
 39     try {
 40       const q = localStorage.getItem('faro-quality');
 41       if (q === 'high' || q === 'low' || q === 'auto') this.qualityPref = q;
 42       this.showFps = localStorage.getItem('faro-fps') === 'on';
 43       if (localStorage.getItem('faro-formation') === 'line') this.formation = 'line';
 44       // v1.4: ahorro de batería, colores para daltonismo y letra grande.
 45       this.battery = localStorage.getItem('faro-battery') === '1';
 46       this.cvd = localStorage.getItem('faro-cvd') === '1';
 47       this.bigText = localStorage.getItem('faro-bigtext') === '1';
 48       // v1.5: ya no hay decoraciones de temporada (Calabazas, Invierno).
 49       localStorage.removeItem('faro-season');
 50     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 51     applyPalette(this.cvd);
 52     document.body.classList.toggle('bigtext', !!this.bigText);
 53     Profile.load();
 54     this.quality = this.qualityPref === 'low' ? 'low' : 'high';
 55     if (hotData && hotData.opts && MODES[hotData.opts.mode]) Object.assign(this.opts, hotData.opts);
 56     this.opts.seed = (Math.random() * 1e9) | 0;
 57     // Al republicar la página, conserva las opciones elegidas en el menú.
 58     if (window.claude && window.claude.hot && window.claude.hot.snapshot) {
 59       window.claude.hot.snapshot(() => ({ opts: { ...this.opts } }));
 60     }
 61 
 62     try {
 63       this.gl = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: this.canvas, antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
 64     } catch (err) {
 65       document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
 66         '<div class="screen"><div class="dialog panel"><h2>Sin 3D</h2><p>Tu navegador no pudo iniciar WebGL. Prueba con Safari o Chrome actualizados.</p></div></div>');
 67       return;
 68     }
 69     Thumbs.init();
 70     this.sound = new Sound();
 71     // Música propia (v1.1): empieza con el primer toque (los navegadores no dejan antes).
 72     this.music = new Music(this.sound);
 73     this.sound.onUnlock = () => this.music.play(this.state === 'play' ? 'battle' : 'lobby');
 74     this.sound.onToggle = () => { if (this.sound.on) this.music.play(this.state === 'play' ? 'battle' : 'lobby'); else this.music.stop(); this.music.refreshVolume(); };
 75     // Primero los modelos de Blender; si fallan, se usan los modelos de código.
 76     this.ready = Promise.all([loadGLBModels().catch(() => 0), loadEnvMap(this.gl).catch(() => null)]).then(([n]) => {
 77       this.modelCount = n;
 78       this.ui = new UI(this);
 79       this.input = new Input(this);
 80       this.lobby = new Lobby(this);
 81       this.makePreview();
 82       this.ui.showScreen('menu');
 83       this.loaded = true;
 84       // Modo creador: solo si la plataforma confirma que quien abre el juego es su dueño.
 85       Creator.detect().then(() => this.lobby.render());
 86     });
 87 
 88     window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.renderer && this.renderer.resize());
 89     // Safari en iPad: evita que el gesto de pellizco haga zoom a toda la página.
 90     document.addEventListener('gesturestart', (e) => e.preventDefault());
 91     document.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => e.preventDefault());
 92     document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 93       if (document.hidden && this.state === 'play' && !this.game.over && !this.game.spectating) {
 94         this.togglePause(true);
 95         Save.write(this.game);
 96       }

484   drainEvents() {
485     const g = this.game;
486     for (const ev of g.events) {
487       if (ev.type === 'toast') {
488         this.ui.toast(ev.text, ev.kind, ev.x !== undefined ? { x: ev.x, z: ev.z } : null);
489         if (ev.kind === 'bad' && ev.x !== undefined) this.ui.addEdgeAlert(ev.text, ev.x, ev.z);
490       }
491       else if (ev.type === 'ping') this.renderer.addPing(ev.x, ev.z, ev.kind);
492       else if (ev.type === 'chat') {
493         this.ui.chat(ev.msg);
494         if (ev.msg.toMe && ev.msg.x !== undefined) this.renderer.addPing(ev.msg.x, ev.msg.z, 'bad');
495       }
496       else if (ev.type === 'sound') {
497         let vol = 1;
498         if (ev.x !== undefined && this.renderer) {
499           const d = Math.hypot(ev.x - this.renderer.cam.tx, ev.z - this.renderer.cam.tz);
500           const reach = this.renderer.cam.dist * 1.2;
501           if (d > reach) continue;
502           vol = 1 - d / reach;
503         }
504         if (ev.pid !== undefined && ev.pid !== 0) continue;
505         this.sound.play(ev.name, vol);
506       } else if (ev.type === 'objective') this.ui.markObjective(ev.id);
507       else if (ev.type === 'built' || ev.type === 'spawned') this.ui.selSig = '';
508       else if (ev.type === 'upgraded' && ev.lines && ev.lines.length) this.ui.upgradeCard(ev.b, ev.level, ev.lines);
509       else if (ev.type === 'over') {
510         document.body.classList.remove('spectating');
511         $('specbar').hidden = true;
512         Save.clear();
513         this.lobby.finish(g);
514         this.endTimer = setTimeout(() => this.ui.showEnd(ev.result), 1600);
515         this.sound.play(ev.result === 'victory' ? 'done' : 'alarm');
516       }
517     }
518     g.events.length = 0;
519   },
520 
521   loop(now) {
522     if (!this.loaded) {
523       this.last = now;
524       requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.loop(t));
525       return;
526     }
527     // v1.4: ahorro de batería: se salta cuadros para quedarse en unos 30 por segundo.
528     if (this.battery && now - (this.lastDraw || 0) < BATTERY.minFrameMs) {
529       requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.loop(t));
530       return;
531     }
532     this.lastDraw = now;
533     const raw = Math.max(0, (now - this.last) / 1000);
534     const dt = Math.min(0.1, raw);
535     this.last = now;
536     // Cuadros por segundo reales (para el contador y la calidad automática).
537     this.fpsFrames++;
538     this.fpsT += raw;
539     if (this.fpsT >= 1) {
540       this.autoQuality(Math.round(this.fpsFrames / this.fpsT));
541       this.fpsFrames = 0;
542       this.fpsT = 0;
543     }
544     this.time += dt;
545     try {
546       if (this.state === 'play' && this.game) {
547         if (!this.paused) this.game.update(dt);
548         this.drainEvents();
549         this.input.update(dt);
550         if (this.selection.some((e) => !e.alive || e.inside)) this.setSelection(this.selection);
551         if (this.input.placement && this.input.placement.kind === 'build') {
552           this.input.placeT = (this.input.placeT || 0) - dt;
553           if (this.input.placeT <= 0) {
554             this.input.placeT = 1;
555             this.input.refreshPlacement();
556           }
557         }
558         this.renderer.frame(this.paused ? 0 : dt, this.time, this.selection);
559         this.ui.updateEdges();
560         // Música: más intensa si te atacan o si tus tropas pelean.
561         this.musicT = (this.musicT || 0) - dt;
562         if (this.musicT <= 0 && this.music) {
563           this.musicT = 0.5;
564           const g = this.game;
565           const me = g.players[0];
566           const fighting = g.time - (me.underAttackAt ?? -99) < 8 || g.units.some((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && u.autoTarget && u.autoTarget.alive);
567           this.musicFight = fighting ? 1 : 0;
568         }
569         if (this.music) this.music.setIntensity(this.musicFight || 0);
570         // Guardado automático cada 15 s.
571         this.saveT -= dt;
572         if (this.saveT <= 0) {
573           this.saveT = 60;
574           if (!this.game.over && !this.game.spectating) Save.write(this.game);
575         }
576         this.ui.update(dt);
577         this.miniT -= dt;
578         if (this.miniT <= 0) {
579           this.miniT = 0.2;
580           this.renderer.drawMinimap($('minimap'));
581         }
582       } else if (this.renderer) {
583         this.renderer.cam.yaw += dt * 0.05;
584         this.renderer.frame(dt, this.time, []);
585       }
586     } catch (err) {
587       console.error('[Faro] Error en el bucle:', err);
588     }
589     requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.loop(t));
590   },
591 };

 1 // Une la plantilla HTML y los scripts de src/js en un único archivo jugable.
 2 // Uso: node faro/build.mjs [ruta-extra-sin-envoltorio.html]
 3 import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
 4 import { dirname, join } from 'path';
 5 import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

 7 const ROOT = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
 8 const JS_DIR = join(ROOT, 'src', 'js');

10 const files = readdirSync(JS_DIR).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js')).sort();
11 // Modelos 3D hechos con Blender (faro/blender/generate_models.py), incrustados en base64.
12 const MODEL_DIR = join(ROOT, 'assets', 'models');
13 let models = {};
14 try {
15   for (const f of readdirSync(MODEL_DIR).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.glb')).sort()) {

34   console.warn('[Faro] Sin animaciones de CMU:', err.message);
35 }
36 const modelJs = `// ---- modelos GLB (Blender) ----\nconst FARO_GLB = ${JSON.stringify(models)};\nconst FARO_ENV = ${JSON.stringify(envUri)};\n` +
37   `const FARO_ANIM = ${JSON.stringify(anim)};\n`;
38 const js = modelJs + files.map((f) => `// ---- ${f} ----\n${readFileSync(join(JS_DIR, f), 'utf8')}`).join('\n');
39 const template = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'src', 'index.template.html'), 'utf8');
40 if (!template.includes('/*__SCRIPTS__*/')) throw new Error('Falta el marcador /*__SCRIPTS__*/ en la plantilla');
41 // Función de reemplazo para que los "$" del código no se interpreten como patrones.
42 const body = template.replace('/*__SCRIPTS__*/', () => js);
43 
44 const full = [
45   '<!doctype html>',
46   '<html lang="es">',
47   '<head>',
48   '<meta charset="utf-8">',
49   '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">',
50   body,
51   '</html>',
52   '',
53 ].join('\n');
54 
55 writeFileSync(join(ROOT, 'faro.html'), full);
56 console.log(`[Faro] faro.html listo (${(full.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB, ${files.length} scripts, ${Object.keys(models).length} modelos)`);
57 
58 const extra = process.argv[2];
59 if (extra) {
60   writeFileSync(extra, body);
61   console.log(`[Faro] Versión sin envoltorio: ${extra}`);
62 }

faro/blender/cmu_gait.py · 125 líneas

  1 """Saca un ciclo de paso (caminar y correr) de la base de datos de captura de movimiento de CMU.
  2 
  3 Uso: python faro/blender/cmu_gait.py <carpeta_con_bvh> faro/assets/anim/cmu_gait.json
  4 
  5 Datos: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), conversión BVH de B. Hahne
  6 (cgspeed). Uso libre según su READMEFIRST. Archivos: 02_01 (caminar) y 35_17 (correr).
  7 
  8 Para cada cuadro se miden, en el plano de la marcha, los ángulos de cadera y rodilla de cada pierna,
  9 la inclinación del torso y la altura de la cadera. Se toma un ciclo completo (de un paso adelante de
 10 la pierna izquierda al siguiente) y se reparte en 24 muestras. Los ángulos van en radianes; el rebote
 11 y la zancada van en largos de pierna, para escalarlos a cualquier soldado.
 12 """
 13 import json
 14 import math
 15 import os
 16 import sys
 17 
 18 import bpy  # primero bpy: agrega la carpeta de módulos de Blender (addon_utils)
 19 import addon_utils  # noqa: E402
 20 from mathutils import Vector  # noqa: E402
 21 
 22 CLIPS = {'walk': '02_01.bvh', 'run': '35_17.bvh'}
 23 SAMPLES = 24
 24 
 25 
 26 def load(path):
 27     bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
 28     addon_utils.enable('io_anim_bvh', default_set=True)
 29     bpy.ops.import_anim.bvh(filepath=path, global_scale=1.0, rotate_mode='NATIVE', axis_forward='-Z', axis_up='Y',
 30                             update_scene_fps=True, update_scene_duration=True)
 31     arm = [o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type == 'ARMATURE'][0]
 32     return arm
 33 
 34 
 35 def joints(arm, frame):
 36     bpy.context.scene.frame_set(frame)
 37     mw = arm.matrix_world
 38     pb = arm.pose.bones
 39     head = lambda n: mw @ pb[n].head
 40     return {
 41         'hips': head('Hips'), 'chest': head('Spine1'),
 42         'hipL': head('LeftUpLeg'), 'kneeL': head('LeftLeg'), 'ankleL': head('LeftFoot'),
 43         'hipR': head('RightUpLeg'), 'kneeR': head('RightLeg'), 'ankleR': head('RightFoot'),
 44     }
 45 
 46 
 47 def angle_from_down(d, fwd, up):
 48     """Ángulo de un segmento respecto de la vertical, en el plano de la marcha (+ = hacia adelante)."""
 49     return math.atan2(d.dot(fwd), -d.dot(up))
 50 
 51 
 52 def extract(path):
 53     arm = load(path)
 54     scene = bpy.context.scene
 55     f0, f1 = int(scene.frame_start), int(scene.frame_end)
 56     frames = [joints(arm, f) for f in range(f0, f1 + 1)]
 57     up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
 58     move = frames[-1]['hips'] - frames[0]['hips']
 59     move.z = 0
 60     fwd = move.normalized()
 61     leg = sum(((j['hipL'] - j['kneeL']).length + (j['kneeL'] - j['ankleL']).length) for j in frames) / len(frames)
 62     rows = []
 63     for j in frames:
 64         r = {}
 65         for s in ('L', 'R'):
 66             th = angle_from_down(j['knee' + s] - j['hip' + s], fwd, up)
 67             sh = angle_from_down(j['ankle' + s] - j['knee' + s], fwd, up)
 68             r['hip' + s] = th
 69             r['knee' + s] = th - sh  # flexión de rodilla (+ = el pie va hacia atrás)
 70         # Inclinación del torso (+ = hacia adelante).
 71         r['pitch'] = math.atan2((j['chest'] - j['hips']).dot(fwd), (j['chest'] - j['hips']).dot(up))
 72         r['y'] = j['hips'].z
 73         r['h'] = j['hips'].dot(fwd)
 74         rows.append(r)
 75     # Ciclo: entre dos máximos seguidos del ángulo de la cadera izquierda (pierna más adelante).
 76     hl = [r['hipL'] for r in rows]
 77     # Máximo dentro de ±20 cuadros (1/6 s): así no se cuentan los temblores dentro de un mismo paso.
 78     W = 20
 79     peaks = [i for i in range(W, len(hl) - W) if hl[i] >= max(hl[i - W:i + W + 1])]
 80     clean = []
 81     for p in peaks:
 82         if not clean or p - clean[-1] > 30:
 83             clean.append(p)
 84     if len(clean) < 2:
 85         raise RuntimeError(f'No hay un ciclo completo en {path}: picos {clean}')
 86     a, b = clean[0], clean[1]
 87     fps = 1.0 / bpy.context.scene.render.fps_base * bpy.context.scene.render.fps
 88     frame_time = 1.0 / fps
 89     # El importador ajusta los fps de la escena al archivo; si no, se usa 120 (CMU).
 90     if abs(fps - 24) < 0.01:
 91         frame_time = 1.0 / 120
 92     out = {k: [] for k in ('hipL', 'kneeL', 'hipR', 'kneeR', 'pitch', 'bob')}
 93     ys = [rows[i]['y'] for i in range(a, b + 1)]
 94     ymean = sum(ys) / len(ys)
 95     pmean = sum(rows[i]['pitch'] for i in range(a, b + 1)) / (b - a + 1)
 96     for k in range(SAMPLES):
 97         t = a + (b - a) * k / SAMPLES
 98         i = int(t)
 99         f = t - i
100         lerp = lambda key: rows[i][key] * (1 - f) + rows[min(i + 1, len(rows) - 1)][key] * f
101         for key in ('hipL', 'kneeL', 'hipR', 'kneeR'):
102             out[key].append(round(lerp(key), 4))
103         out['pitch'].append(round(lerp('pitch') - pmean * 0.5, 4))
104         out['bob'].append(round((lerp('y') - ymean) / leg, 4))
105     stride = (rows[b]['h'] - rows[a]['h']) / leg
106     return {'dur': round((b - a) * frame_time, 4), 'stride': round(stride, 4), 'frames': [a, b], **out}
107 
108 
109 def main():
110     src, dst = sys.argv[-2], sys.argv[-1]
111     data = {'source': 'CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), conversión BVH de B. Hahne',
112             'files': CLIPS, 'samples': SAMPLES}
113     for name, f in CLIPS.items():
114         data[name] = extract(os.path.join(src, f))
115         d = data[name]
116         print(name, 'ciclo', d['frames'], 'dur', d['dur'], 's · zancada', d['stride'], 'piernas · cadera',
117               round(min(d['hipL']), 2), round(max(d['hipL']), 2), '· rodilla max', round(max(d['kneeL']), 2),
118               '· rebote', round(min(d['bob']), 3), round(max(d['bob']), 3))
119     os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
120     with open(dst, 'w') as fh:
121         json.dump(data, fh, separators=(',', ':'))
122     print('guardado', dst, os.path.getsize(dst), 'bytes')
123 
124 
125 main()

 96 def scaffold():
 97     """Andamio que rodea las obras en construcción."""
 98     m = Model('scaffold')
 99     R = 0.62
100     corners = [(-R, -R), (R, -R), (R, R), (-R, R)]
101     for (x, y) in corners:
102         m.box('madera_clara', (0.04, 0.04, 0.95), (x, y, 0), bevel=0.0)
103     for z in (0.32, 0.64, 0.92):
104         for i in range(4):
105             (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4]
106             mx, my = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2
107             rotz = 0 if y1 == y2 else H
108             m.box('madera', (2 * R, 0.03, 0.03), (mx, my, z), rot=(0, 0, rotz), bevel=0.0)
109     for i in range(4):
110         (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4]
111         mx, my = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2
112         rotz = 0 if y1 == y2 else H
113         m.box('madera', (2 * R * 1.1, 0.025, 0.025), (mx, my, 0.02), rot=(0.6, 0, rotz), bevel=0.0)
114         m.box('amarillo', (2 * R, 0.12, 0.02), (mx * 1.04, my * 1.04, 0.33), rot=(0, 0, rotz), bevel=0.0)
115     m.box('amarillo', (0.36, 0.012, 0.12), (0, -R - 0.02, 0.5), bevel=0.0)
116     m.box('negro', (0.06, 0.014, 0.12), (-0.1, -R - 0.03, 0.5), rot=(0, 0.6, 0), bevel=0.0)
117     m.box('negro', (0.06, 0.014, 0.12), (0.1, -R - 0.03, 0.5), rot=(0, 0.6, 0), bevel=0.0)
118     return m

faro/blender/lib.py · 215 líneas

  1 """Herramientas para modelar Faro de Ámbar con Python dentro de Blender.
  2 
  3 Cada modelo se arma con piezas simples (cajas biseladas, cilindros, conos, cascos de barco) que se
  4 agrupan en partes: 'main' y, si el modelo se anima, 'turret', 'rotor', 'blades', 'rocker' o
  5 'crystal'. Cada parte se exporta como un objeto con su origen en el pivote de giro.
  6 
  7 Convenciones (Blender, Z arriba): el frente del modelo mira hacia -Y, que en el juego (glTF, Y
  8 arriba) es +Z. Una casilla mide 1 de radio. Los materiales llamados EQUIPO y EQUIPO_OSC se pintan
  9 en el juego con el color de cada jugador.
 10 """
 11 import math
 12 
 13 import bmesh
 14 import bpy
 15 from mathutils import Euler, Matrix, Vector
 16 
 17 MATS = {}
 18 
 19 
 20 def mat(name, rgb, rough=0.75, metal=0.0):
 21     """Material con color base (valores 0-1 tal cual, como la paleta del juego)."""
 22     if name in MATS:
 23         return name
 24     m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
 25     m.use_nodes = True
 26     bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
 27     bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0)
 28     bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
 29     bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metal
 30     MATS[name] = m
 31     return name
 32 
 33 
 34 def hexrgb(h):
 35     return ((h >> 16 & 255) / 255, (h >> 8 & 255) / 255, (h & 255) / 255)
 36 
 37 
 38 # Paleta (misma familia de colores que el juego).
 39 P = {
 40     'EQUIPO': 0xffffff, 'EQUIPO_OSC': 0x888888,
 41     'piedra': 0x8f8b82, 'piedra_clara': 0xa9a59b, 'oscuro': 0x3b4048, 'metal': 0x6e7782,
 42     'metal_claro': 0x9aa3ad, 'madera': 0x8b5d3c, 'madera_clara': 0xb07d52, 'blanco': 0xefece4,
 43     'oliva': 0x5d6d3b, 'oliva_osc': 0x46532c, 'piel': 0xe0b089, 'amarillo': 0xf1c232, 'trigo': 0xc9a54b,
 44     'cultivo': 0x8dbf3d, 'ladrillo': 0xb3653b, 'rojo': 0xd94141, 'gris': 0x8b939c, 'negro': 0x24272c,
 45     'naranja': 0xf08a24, 'concreto': 0xb5b2aa, 'vidrio': 0x9fd6ee, 'oro': 0xffcf3a, 'agua': 0x4aa3c8,
 46     'panel': 0x1f3a63, 'arena': 0xc9b27a, 'tierra': 0x7a5a3a, 'goma': 0x1b1d20, 'cuerda': 0xc9b47a,
 47     'luz': 0xffd76a, 'camo': 0x2f3438, 'camo2': 0x4a5056, 'mascara': 0xf2c230, 'blanco_sucio': 0xd8d4c8,
 48 }
 49 
 50 
 51 def m_(name):
 52     return mat(name, hexrgb(P[name]), rough=0.45 if name in ('metal', 'metal_claro', 'vidrio') else 0.75,
 53                metal=0.3 if name in ('metal', 'metal_claro') else 0.0)
 54 
 55 
 56 class Model:
 57     def __init__(self, name):
 58         self.name = name
 59         self.parts = {}
 60         self.pivots = {}
 61         self.mats = {}
 62 
 63     def _bm(self, part):
 64         if part not in self.parts:
 65             self.parts[part] = bmesh.new()
 66             self.mats[part] = []
 67             self.pivots.setdefault(part, Vector((0, 0, 0)))
 68         return self.parts[part]
 69 
 70     def pivot(self, part, x, y, z):
 71         self.pivots[part] = Vector((x, y, z))
 72         self._bm(part)
 73 
 74     def _mi(self, part, matname):
 75         m_(matname) if matname in P else None
 76         lst = self.mats[part]
 77         if matname not in lst:
 78             lst.append(matname)
 79         return lst.index(matname)
 80 
 81     def _merge(self, part, src, matname, matrix, smooth):
 82         dst = self._bm(part)
 83         mi = self._mi(part, matname)
 84         piv = self.pivots[part]
 85         full = Matrix.Translation(-piv) @ matrix
 86         vmap = {}
 87         for v in src.verts:
 88             vmap[v] = dst.verts.new(full @ v.co)
 89         for f in src.faces:
 90             nf = dst.faces.new([vmap[v] for v in f.verts])
 91             nf.material_index = mi
 92             nf.smooth = smooth
 93         src.free()
 94 
 95     @staticmethod
 96     def _xf(loc, rot, scale=(1, 1, 1)):
 97         return Matrix.LocRotScale(Vector(loc), Euler(rot).to_quaternion(), Vector(scale))
 98 
 99     def box(self, matname, size, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), bevel=0.02, part='main', base=True):
100         """Caja biselada. Con base=True, loc[2] es la cara de abajo."""
101         sx, sy, sz = size
102         t = bmesh.new()
103         bmesh.ops.create_cube(t, size=1.0)
104         bmesh.ops.scale(t, vec=Vector((sx, sy, sz)), verts=t.verts)
105         b = min(bevel, sx * 0.45, sy * 0.45, sz * 0.45)
106         # Las piezas chicas van sin bisel: casi no se nota y el archivo pesa mucho menos.
107         if b > 0.001 and min(sx, sy, sz) >= 0.05:
108             bmesh.ops.bevel(t, geom=list(t.edges) + list(t.verts), offset=b, segments=1, affect='EDGES', profile=0.5)
109         x, y, z = loc
110         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf((x, y, z + (sz / 2 if base else 0)), rot), False)
111 
112     def cyl(self, matname, r, h, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), seg=16, r2=None, part='main', base=True, smooth=True):
113         """Cilindro (o tronco de cono con r2). Con base=True, loc[2] es la base."""
114         t = bmesh.new()
115         bmesh.ops.create_cone(t, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=seg, radius1=r,
116                               radius2=r if r2 is None else r2, depth=h)
117         x, y, z = loc
118         off = Matrix.Translation((0, 0, h / 2 if base else 0))
119         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf((x, y, z), rot) @ off, smooth)
120 
121     def cone(self, matname, r, h, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), seg=16, part='main', smooth=False):
122         self.cyl(matname, r, h, loc, rot, seg, r2=0.0001, part=part, smooth=smooth)
123 
124     def sphere(self, matname, r, loc=(0, 0, 0), scale=(1, 1, 1), part='main', seg=14):
125         t = bmesh.new()
126         bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(t, u_segments=seg, v_segments=max(6, seg // 2), radius=r)
127         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf(loc, (0, 0, 0), scale), True)
128 
129     def ico(self, matname, r, loc=(0, 0, 0), scale=(1, 1, 1), part='main', sub=1):
130         t = bmesh.new()
131         bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(t, subdivisions=sub, radius=r)
132         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf(loc, (0, 0, 0), scale), False)
133 
134     def hexprism(self, matname, r, h, loc=(0, 0, 0), part='main', bevel=0.02):
135         """Prisma hexagonal alineado con las casillas del juego."""
136         t = bmesh.new()
137         bmesh.ops.create_cone(t, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=6, radius1=r, radius2=r, depth=h)
138         if bevel > 0:
139             bmesh.ops.bevel(t, geom=list(t.edges) + list(t.verts), offset=bevel, segments=1, affect='EDGES', profile=0.5)
140         x, y, z = loc
141         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf((x, y, z + h / 2), (0, 0, math.pi / 6)), False)
142 
143     def wedge(self, matname, size, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), part='main'):
144         """Tejado a dos aguas: largo en X, ancho en Y, alto en Z, base en loc[2]."""
145         lx, ly, lz = size
146         t = bmesh.new()
147         hx, hy = lx / 2, ly / 2
148         vs = [t.verts.new(c) for c in [(-hx, -hy, 0), (hx, -hy, 0), (hx, hy, 0), (-hx, hy, 0), (-hx, 0, lz), (hx, 0, lz)]]
149         for f in [(0, 1, 2, 3), (0, 4, 5, 1), (3, 2, 5, 4), (0, 3, 4), (1, 5, 2)]:
150             t.faces.new([vs[i] for i in f])
151         bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(t, faces=t.faces)
152         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf(loc, rot), False)
153 
154     @staticmethod
155     def _between(p1, p2):
156         a, b = Vector(p1), Vector(p2)
157         d = b - a
158         q = Vector((0, 0, 1)).rotation_difference(d.normalized())
159         return (a + b) / 2, q, d.length
160 
161     def beam(self, matname, p1, p2, t=0.02, part='main'):
162         """Barra de sección cuadrada entre dos puntos (barandas, grúas, celosías, patines)."""
163         c, q, length = self._between(p1, p2)
164         tm = bmesh.new()
165         bmesh.ops.create_cube(tm, size=1.0)
166         bmesh.ops.scale(tm, vec=Vector((t, t, length)), verts=tm.verts)
167         self._merge(part, tm, matname, Matrix.LocRotScale(c, q, Vector((1, 1, 1))), False)
168 
169     def tube(self, matname, p1, p2, r=0.02, seg=10, part='main', r2=None):
170         """Cilindro entre dos puntos (tubos de lancha, antenas, cañones)."""
171         c, q, length = self._between(p1, p2)
172         tm = bmesh.new()
173         bmesh.ops.create_cone(tm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=seg, radius1=r,
174                               radius2=r if r2 is None else r2, depth=length)
175         self._merge(part, tm, matname, Matrix.LocRotScale(c, q, Vector((1, 1, 1))), True)
176 
177     def hull(self, matname, sections, loc=(0, 0, 0), part='main', smooth=False):
178         """Casco de barco a partir de secciones (y, medio_ancho_cubierta, medio_ancho_fondo, z_fondo, z_cubierta).
179 
180         Las secciones van de popa (y mayor) a proa (y menor, el frente)."""
181         t = bmesh.new()
182         rings = []
183         for (y, wt, wb, zb, zt) in sections:
184             rings.append([t.verts.new(c) for c in [(-wb, y, zb), (wb, y, zb), (wt, y, zt), (-wt, y, zt)]])
185         for a, b in zip(rings, rings[1:]):
186             for i in range(4):
187                 j = (i + 1) % 4
188                 try:
189                     t.faces.new([a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]])
190                 except ValueError:
191                     pass
192         t.faces.new(list(reversed(rings[0])))
193         t.faces.new(rings[-1])
194         bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(t, faces=t.faces)
195         self._merge(part, t, matname, self._xf(loc, (0, 0, 0)), smooth)
196 
197     # ---------- exportación ----------
198     def export(self, path):
199         for o in list(bpy.data.objects):
200             bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
201         for me in list(bpy.data.meshes):
202             bpy.data.meshes.remove(me)
203         scene = bpy.context.scene
204         for part, bm in self.parts.items():
205             me = bpy.data.meshes.new(f'{self.name}_{part}')
206             bm.to_mesh(me)
207             bm.free()
208             for mname in self.mats[part]:
209                 me.materials.append(MATS[mname])
210             ob = bpy.data.objects.new(part, me)
211             ob.location = self.pivots[part]
212             scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
213         bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=path, export_format='GLB', export_apply=True, export_yup=True,
214                                   use_selection=False, export_materials='EXPORT', export_texcoords=False,
215                                   export_normals=False, export_cameras=False, export_lights=False)

190     for (x, y) in positions:
191         m.cyl('goma', r, w, (x, y, r), rot=(0, H, 0), seg=16, base=False, part=part)
192         m.cyl('metal', r * 0.55, w + 0.01, (x, y, r), rot=(0, H, 0), seg=10, base=False, part=part)

195 def tracks(m, x, length=0.92, n=6, r=0.048):
196     for sx in (-1, 1):
197         m.box('goma', (0.13, length, 0.14), (sx * x, 0, 0.02), bevel=0.05)
198         for k in range(n):
199             m.cyl('metal', r, 0.135, (sx * x, -length * 0.4 + k * length * 0.8 / (n - 1), 0.075), rot=(0, H, 0),
200                   seg=12, base=False)

203 def launcher_face(m, cx, cy, cz, half_y, th, cols, rows, dx, dz, part):
204     """Celdas de misiles con una X blanca en la cara delantera de una caja inclinada th (rot X)."""
205     c, s = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
206 
207     def fp(x, zc, dy):
208         y0, z0 = -half_y - dy, zc
209         return (cx + x, cy + y0 * c - z0 * s, cz + y0 * s + z0 * c)
210     for ix in range(cols):
211         for iz in range(rows):
212             x = (ix - (cols - 1) / 2) * dx
213             z = (iz - (rows - 1) / 2) * dz
214             m.beam('oscuro', fp(x, z, -0.004), fp(x, z, 0.012), t=dx * 0.82, part=part)
215             for sgn in (-1, 1):
216                 m.beam('blanco', fp(x - dx * 0.28, z - sgn * dz * 0.28, 0.014), fp(x + dx * 0.28, z + sgn * dz * 0.28, 0.014),
217                        t=0.011, part=part)
218

443     m.tube('oscuro', (0, -0.6, 0.26), (0, -0.92, 0.27), r=0.022, seg=10, part='turret')

455     m.box('EQUIPO_OSC', (0.2, 0.22, 0.08), (0, 0.06, 0.33), bevel=0.03)
456     m.box('oscuro', (0.06, 0.08, 0.04), (0.08, 0.13, 0.4), bevel=0.01)
457     m.tube('EQUIPO_OSC', (0, 0.26, 0.24), (0, 0.84, 0.3), r=0.045, r2=0.024, seg=10)
458     m.box('EQUIPO_OSC', (0.02, 0.14, 0.18), (0, 0.82, 0.34), rot=(0.3, 0, 0), bevel=0.01)

472                    (x + math.cos(a) * 0.018, y - 0.22, z + math.sin(a) * 0.018), r=0.006, seg=6)
473         m.cyl('metal', 0.03, 0.015, (x, y - 0.2, z), rot=(H, 0, 0), seg=10, base=False)

476         for k in range(3):
477             a = k * 2 * PI / 3 + PI / 6
478             m.cyl('blanco', 0.01, 0.01, (sx * 0.2 + math.cos(a) * 0.017, -0.03, 0.135 + math.sin(a) * 0.017),
479                   rot=(H, 0, 0), seg=6, base=False)
480         m.box('negro', (0.012, 0.16, 0.13), (sx * 0.136, 0.08, 0.13), bevel=0.0)
481         m.box('oliva', (0.06, 0.06, 0.08), (sx * 0.1, 0.08, 0.14), bevel=0.015)
482         m.sphere('oliva', 0.032, (sx * 0.1, 0.08, 0.21), scale=(1, 1, 0.85))
483         m.box('piel', (0.03, 0.02, 0.025), (sx * 0.112, 0.06, 0.19), bevel=0.005)
484         m.tube('negro', (sx * 0.11, 0.06, 0.16), (sx * 0.22, 0.0, 0.13), r=0.008, seg=6)
485         m.box('oscuro', (0.03, 0.05, 0.03), (sx * 0.13, 0.06, 0.155), bevel=0.005)
486     m.box('luz', (0.03, 0.02, 0.02), (0, -0.36, 0.08), bevel=0.004)
487     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.035, 0.06, (0, 0.05, 0.41), seg=10)

498 def crystal(m, z, size=0.2):
499     m.pivot('crystal', 0, 0, z)
500     m.cone('EQUIPO', size, size * 1.35, (0, 0, z), seg=4, part='crystal')
501     m.cone('EQUIPO', size, size * 1.35, (0, 0, z), rot=(PI, 0, 0), seg=4, part='crystal')

504 def core(level):
505     """Núcleo: fortaleza hexagonal con muros, torres y el cristal ámbar en el centro."""
506     m = Model(f'core_{level}')
507     m.hexprism('oscuro', 0.98, 0.12)
508     m.hexprism('piedra', 0.92, 0.08, (0, 0, 0.12))
509     wall_h = (0.16, 0.22, 0.28)[level - 1]
510     rw = 0.76
511     z0 = 0.2
512     cs = [(math.cos(PI / 6 + k * PI / 3) * rw, math.sin(PI / 6 + k * PI / 3) * rw) for k in range(6)]
513     for k in range(6):
514         (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = cs[k], cs[(k + 1) % 6]
515         ang = math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)
516         gate = k in (3, 4)
517         pieces = [(0.0, 0.36), (0.64, 1.0)] if gate else [(0.0, 1.0)]
518         for (a, b) in pieces:
519             px1, py1 = x1 + (x2 - x1) * a, y1 + (y2 - y1) * a
520             px2, py2 = x1 + (x2 - x1) * b, y1 + (y2 - y1) * b
521             ln = math.hypot(px2 - px1, py2 - py1)
522             cx, cy = (px1 + px2) / 2, (py1 + py2) / 2
523             m.box('piedra_clara', (ln, 0.08, wall_h), (cx, cy, z0), rot=(0, 0, ang), bevel=0.012)
524             m.box('EQUIPO', (ln, 0.086, 0.03), (cx, cy, z0 + wall_h * 0.45), rot=(0, 0, ang), bevel=0.004)
525             n = max(1, int(ln / 0.09))
526             for i in range(n):
527                 t = (i + 0.5) / n
528                 mx, my = px1 + (px2 - px1) * t, py1 + (py2 - py1) * t
529                 if i % 2 == 0:
530                     m.box('piedra_clara', (0.045, 0.085, 0.04), (mx, my, z0 + wall_h), rot=(0, 0, ang), bevel=0.006)
531         if level == 3:
532             m.box('oro', (math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) * 0.98, 0.09, 0.015), ((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, z0 + wall_h - 0.015),
533                   rot=(0, 0, ang), bevel=0.0)
534     towers = [0, 2, 4] if level == 1 else range(6)
535     th = (0.32, 0.4, 0.52)[level - 1]
536     for k in towers:
537         x, y = cs[k]
538         m.cyl('piedra_clara', 0.12, th, (x, y, z0), seg=6, smooth=False)
539         m.cyl('oscuro', 0.135, 0.04, (x, y, z0 + th), seg=6, smooth=False)
540         if level == 3:
541             m.cone('EQUIPO', 0.15, 0.2, (x, y, z0 + th + 0.04), seg=6)
542         else:
543             for j in range(3):
544                 a = j * 2 * PI / 3
545                 m.box('piedra_clara', (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), (x + math.cos(a) * 0.09, y + math.sin(a) * 0.09, z0 + th + 0.04), bevel=0.006)
546         m.box('luz', (0.03, 0.012, 0.05), (x, y - 0.118, z0 + th * 0.6), bevel=0.0)
547     m.hexprism('oscuro', 0.44, 0.1, (0, 0, z0))
548     m.cyl('luz', 0.32, 0.012, (0, 0, z0 + 0.1), seg=6, smooth=False)
549     ped = (0.32, 0.55, 0.8)[level - 1]
550     m.cyl('EQUIPO_OSC', 0.2, ped, (0, 0, z0 + 0.11), seg=6, r2=0.14, smooth=False)
551     if level >= 2:
552         for k in range(3):
553             a = k * 2 * PI / 3 + PI / 6
554             m.beam('piedra_clara', (math.cos(a) * 0.3, math.sin(a) * 0.3, z0 + 0.1), (math.cos(a) * 0.12, math.sin(a) * 0.12, z0 + ped * 0.8), t=0.06)
555     if level == 3:
556         m.cyl('oro', 0.18, 0.04, (0, 0, z0 + ped * 0.55), seg=6, smooth=False)
557         m.cyl('oro', 0.16, 0.04, (0, 0, z0 + ped + 0.06), seg=6, smooth=False)
558     # v0.9: banderas del imperio en las torres y portón en la entrada.
559     for k in towers:
560         x, y = cs[k]
561         zt = z0 + th + (0.24 if level == 3 else 0.09)
562         m.beam('metal', (x, y, zt - 0.06), (x, y, zt + 0.16), t=0.012)
563         m.box('EQUIPO', (0.01, 0.11, 0.065), (x, y + 0.058, zt + 0.12), bevel=0.0)
564     (gx1, gy1), (gx2, gy2) = cs[3], cs[4]
565     gang = math.atan2(gy2 - gy1, gx2 - gx1)
566     m.box('madera', (0.2, 0.03, wall_h * 0.85), ((gx1 + gx2) / 2, (gy1 + gy2) / 2, z0), rot=(0, 0, gang), bevel=0.006)
567     m.box('metal', (0.21, 0.035, 0.018), ((gx1 + gx2) / 2, (gy1 + gy2) / 2, z0 + wall_h * 0.6), rot=(0, 0, gang), bevel=0.0)
568     size = (0.2, 0.24, 0.28)[level - 1]
569     crystal(m, z0 + ped + 0.11 + size * 1.35, size)
570     return m
571

573 def farm():
574     """Granja: establo rojo, silo y parcelas de trigo dentro de una cerca."""
575     m = Model('farm')
576     m.box('tierra', (1.2, 0.92, 0.04), (0.08, 0.12, 0), bevel=0.01)
577     for k in range(4):
578         m.box('trigo', (0.86, 0.12, 0.08), (0.14, -0.15 + k * 0.19, 0.04), bevel=0.035)
579     x1, x2, y1, y2 = -0.36, 0.64, -0.3, 0.6
580     posts = []
581     for i in range(7):
582         posts.append((x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 6, y1))
583         posts.append((x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 6, y2))
584     for i in range(1, 5):
585         posts.append((x2, y1 + (y2 - y1) * i / 5))
586         posts.append((x1, y1 + (y2 - y1) * i / 5))
587     for (x, y) in posts:
588         m.box('madera', (0.025, 0.025, 0.13), (x, y, 0.0), bevel=0.0)
589     for z in (0.06, 0.11):
590         m.beam('madera_clara', (x1, y1, z), (x2, y1, z), t=0.015)
591         m.beam('madera_clara', (x1, y2, z), (x2, y2, z), t=0.015)
592         m.beam('madera_clara', (x2, y1, z), (x2, y2, z), t=0.015)
593         m.beam('madera_clara', (x1, y1 + 0.2, z), (x1, y2, z), t=0.015)
594     m.box('rojo', (0.4, 0.44, 0.3), (-0.5, -0.42, 0), bevel=0.02)
595     m.wedge('EQUIPO', (0.46, 0.5, 0.2), (-0.5, -0.42, 0.3), rot=(0, 0, H))
596     m.box('blanco', (0.16, 0.012, 0.2), (-0.5, -0.642, 0.0), bevel=0.003)
597     m.box('oscuro', (0.12, 0.014, 0.17), (-0.5, -0.645, 0.0), bevel=0.003)
598     for sx in (-1, 1):
599         m.box('luz', (0.06, 0.012, 0.06), (-0.5 + sx * 0.13, -0.642, 0.15), bevel=0.002)
600     m.box('ladrillo', (0.06, 0.06, 0.14), (-0.42, -0.32, 0.38), bevel=0.006)
601     m.cyl('blanco', 0.11, 0.55, (-0.12, -0.54, 0), seg=14)
602     m.cone('EQUIPO_OSC', 0.12, 0.14, (-0.12, -0.54, 0.55), seg=14, smooth=True)
603     m.box('trigo', (0.12, 0.08, 0.08), (-0.25, -0.2, 0.0), bevel=0.02)
604     return m

635 def rig():
636     """Plataforma petrolera: patas, torre de perforación, grúas, helipuerto y módulo de vivienda."""
637     m = Model('rig')
638     legs = [(-0.42, -0.42), (0.42, -0.42), (-0.42, 0.42), (0.42, 0.42)]
639     for (x, y) in legs:
640         m.cyl('amarillo', 0.08, 0.76, (x, y, -0.36), seg=14)
641         m.cyl('blanco', 0.083, 0.05, (x, y, 0.0), seg=14)
642     for i in range(4):
643         (xa, ya), (xb, yb) = legs[[0, 1, 3, 2][i]], legs[[1, 3, 2, 0][i]]
644         m.beam('metal', (xa, ya, 0.12), (xb, yb, 0.12), t=0.03)
645         m.beam('metal', (xa, ya, -0.1), (xb, yb, 0.3), t=0.02)
646     m.box('metal', (1.18, 1.18, 0.1), (0, 0, 0.38), bevel=0.03)
647     m.box('oscuro', (1.2, 1.2, 0.03), (0, 0, 0.36), bevel=0.0)
648     bx, by, bz, top = -0.22, -0.18, 0.48, 1.42
649     base = [(bx - 0.15, by - 0.15), (bx + 0.15, by - 0.15), (bx + 0.15, by + 0.15), (bx - 0.15, by + 0.15)]
650     m.box('oscuro', (0.38, 0.38, 0.06), (bx, by, bz), bevel=0.01)
651     for (x, y) in base:
652         m.beam('metal_claro', (x, y, bz + 0.06), (bx + (x - bx) * 0.2, by + (y - by) * 0.2, top), t=0.024)
653     for z in (0.75, 1.0, 1.22):
654         k = 1 - (z - bz) / (top - bz) * 0.8
655         pts = [(bx + (x - bx) * k, by + (y - by) * k) for (x, y) in base]
656         for i in range(4):
657             (xa, ya), (xb, yb) = pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % 4]
658             m.beam('metal_claro', (xa, ya, z), (xb, yb, z), t=0.014)
659     m.box('EQUIPO', (0.1, 0.1, 0.06), (bx, by, top), bevel=0.01)
660     m.box('EQUIPO', (0.42, 0.34, 0.26), (0.28, 0.3, 0.48), bevel=0.03)
661     for z in (0.56, 0.66):
662         m.box('luz', (0.38, 0.012, 0.03), (0.28, 0.128, z), bevel=0.0)
663     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.21, 0.025, (0.28, 0.3, 0.74), seg=20)
664     m.box('blanco', (0.025, 0.14, 0.006), (0.23, 0.3, 0.765), bevel=0.0)
665     m.box('blanco', (0.025, 0.14, 0.006), (0.33, 0.3, 0.765), bevel=0.0)
666     m.box('blanco', (0.1, 0.025, 0.006), (0.28, 0.3, 0.765), bevel=0.0)
667     for (px, py, ex, ey) in [(0.46, -0.4, 0.8, -0.7), (-0.46, 0.42, -0.78, 0.72)]:
668         m.cyl('amarillo', 0.05, 0.22, (px, py, 0.48), seg=12)
669         m.tube('amarillo', (px, py, 0.68), (ex, ey, 1.0), r=0.02, seg=8)
670         m.tube('oscuro', (ex, ey, 1.0), (ex, ey, 0.62), r=0.004, seg=6)
671         m.box('metal', (0.05, 0.05, 0.04), (ex, ey, 0.58), bevel=0.008)
672     for (x, y, mat) in [(0.25, -0.38, 'EQUIPO_OSC'), (0.25, -0.22, 'blanco_sucio'), (-0.4, 0.15, 'EQUIPO')]:
673         m.box(mat, (0.14, 0.12, 0.1), (x, y, 0.48), bevel=0.01)
674     m.tube('metal', (0.55, 0.0, 0.5), (0.85, 0.0, 0.72), r=0.015, seg=6)
675     m.cone('naranja', 0.04, 0.12, (0.86, 0.0, 0.72), seg=8)
676     return m

679 def helipad():
680     """Helipuerto redondo con la H, anillo amarillo, marcas y baranda."""
681     m = Model('helipad')
682     m.cyl('concreto', 0.88, 0.06, (0, 0, 0), seg=32)
683     m.cyl('EQUIPO', 0.82, 0.055, (0, 0, 0.06), seg=32)
684     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.75, 0.06, (0, 0, 0.06), seg=32)
685     m.cyl('amarillo', 0.44, 0.008, (0, 0, 0.12), seg=32)
686     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.37, 0.01, (0, 0, 0.12), seg=32)
687     m.box('blanco', (0.06, 0.34, 0.006), (-0.11, 0, 0.13), bevel=0.0)
688     m.box('blanco', (0.06, 0.34, 0.006), (0.11, 0, 0.13), bevel=0.0)
689     m.box('blanco', (0.2, 0.06, 0.006), (0, 0, 0.13), bevel=0.0)
690     for k in range(10):
691         a = k * PI / 5 + 0.2
692         m.box('blanco', (0.16, 0.03, 0.006), (math.cos(a) * 0.58, math.sin(a) * 0.58, 0.12), rot=(0, 0, a + H), bevel=0.0)
693     n = 16
694     pts = [(math.cos(k * 2 * PI / n) * 0.85, math.sin(k * 2 * PI / n) * 0.85) for k in range(n)]
695     for k, (x, y) in enumerate(pts):
696         m.beam('EQUIPO_OSC', (x, y, 0.06), (x, y, 0.22), t=0.016)
697         if k in (12, 13):
698             continue
699         (x2, y2) = pts[(k + 1) % n]
700         m.beam('EQUIPO_OSC', (x, y, 0.22), (x2, y2, 0.22), t=0.014)
701         m.beam('metal_claro', (x, y, 0.14), (x2, y2, 0.14), t=0.008)
702     for k in range(8):
703         a = k * PI / 4 + PI / 8
704         m.sphere('luz', 0.022, (math.cos(a) * 0.79, math.sin(a) * 0.79, 0.125))
705     return m

708 def turret(level):
709     """Torreta tipo naval: base blindada, cañón largo y sensor arriba; miniguns en nivel 2 y 3."""
710     m = Model(f'turret_{level}')
711     m.hexprism('piedra', 0.5, 0.1)
712     hb = 0.22 + (level - 1) * 0.05
713     m.cyl('metal_claro', 0.42, hb, (0, 0, 0.1), seg=6, r2=0.36, rot=(0, 0, PI / 6), smooth=False)
714     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.37, 0.02, (0, 0, 0.1 + hb), seg=6, rot=(0, 0, PI / 6), smooth=False)
715     for sx in (-1, 1):

717         m.box('oscuro', (0.03, 0.014, 0.02), (sx * 0.09, -0.368, 0.14 + hb * 0.35), rot=(-0.2, 0, 0), bevel=0.0)
718     top = 0.12 + hb
719     m.pivot('turret', 0, 0, top)
720     m.box('metal_claro', (0.42, 0.46, 0.2), (0, 0.05, top), bevel=0.04, part='turret')
721     m.box('metal_claro', (0.36, 0.16, 0.16), (0, -0.2, top), rot=(0.5, 0, 0), bevel=0.03, part='turret')

729     m.box('vidrio', (0.08, 0.01, 0.06), (0, 0.064, top + 0.28), bevel=0.003, part='turret')
730     m.tube('oscuro', (0.05, 0.16, top + 0.36), (0.05, 0.16, top + 0.48), r=0.005, seg=6, part='turret')
731     sides = [1] if level == 2 else [1, -1] if level >= 3 else []
732     if level >= 4:

734         x, z = 0.0, top + 0.38

736         m.cyl('oscuro', 0.042, 0.08, (x, 0.02, z), rot=(H, 0, 0), seg=12, base=False, part='turret')
737         for k in range(6):

739             m.tube('negro', (x + math.cos(a) * 0.024, -0.06, z + math.sin(a) * 0.024),
740                    (x + math.cos(a) * 0.024, -0.4, z + math.sin(a) * 0.024), r=0.008, seg=6, part='turret')

 15 def sandbags(m, cx, cy, r, a0, a1, n, z=0.0, part='main'):
 16     """Fila de sacos de arena en arco (de a0 a a1 radianes)."""

 19         m.box('arena', (0.12, 0.07, 0.06), (cx + math.cos(a) * r, cy + math.sin(a) * r, z), rot=(0, 0, a + H), bevel=0.02, part=part)

378 def hospital(level):
379     """Enfermería: tienda (1), clínica (2) y hospital grande con helipuerto (3)."""
380     m = Model(f'hospital_{level}')
381     m.box('concreto', (1.0, 0.86, 0.04), (0, 0.02, 0), bevel=0.01)
382 
383     def cross(x, y, z, s, rot=0.0):
384         if rot:
385             m.box('rojo', (0.016, s, s * 0.34), (x, y, z), bevel=0.0)
386             m.box('rojo', (0.016, s * 0.34, s), (x, y, z - s * 0.33), bevel=0.0)
387         else:
388             m.box('rojo', (s, 0.016, s * 0.34), (x, y, z), bevel=0.0)
389             m.box('rojo', (s * 0.34, 0.016, s), (x, y, z - s * 0.33), bevel=0.0)
390     if level == 1:
391         m.wedge('blanco', (0.7, 0.5, 0.36), (0, 0.06, 0.04), rot=(0, 0, 0))
392         m.box('oscuro', (0.14, 0.012, 0.18), (-0.36, 0.06, 0.04), rot=(0, 0, H), bevel=0.0)
393         # Cruz roja apoyada en la lona inclinada (la cara delantera sube de y=-0,25 a la cumbrera).
394         t = math.atan2(0.25, 0.36)
395         cy, cz = -0.25 * (1 - 0.2 / 0.36) - 0.012 * math.cos(t), 0.04 + 0.2 + 0.012 * math.sin(t)
396         m.box('rojo', (0.22, 0.012, 0.07), (0, cy, cz), rot=(-t, 0, 0), bevel=0.0, base=False)
397         m.box('rojo', (0.07, 0.012, 0.22), (0, cy, cz), rot=(-t, 0, 0), bevel=0.0, base=False)
398         for (x, y) in [(0.3, -0.32), (0.18, -0.32)]:
399             m.box('blanco_sucio', (0.1, 0.18, 0.05), (x, y, 0.04), bevel=0.01)
400         flag(m, -0.4, -0.3, 0.04, 0.5)
401         return m
402     if level == 2:
403         m.box('blanco', (0.7, 0.5, 0.32), (0, 0.08, 0.04), bevel=0.02)
404         m.box('EQUIPO', (0.72, 0.52, 0.04), (0, 0.08, 0.36), bevel=0.0)
405         m.box('blanco_sucio', (0.3, 0.16, 0.04), (0, -0.24, 0.24), bevel=0.0)
406         m.beam('metal_claro', (-0.13, -0.3, 0.04), (-0.13, -0.3, 0.24), t=0.02)
407         m.beam('metal_claro', (0.13, -0.3, 0.04), (0.13, -0.3, 0.24), t=0.02)
408         m.box('vidrio', (0.16, 0.012, 0.18), (0, -0.172, 0.04), bevel=0.0)
409         for sx in (-1, 1):
410             m.box('luz', (0.12, 0.012, 0.1), (sx * 0.24, -0.172, 0.18), bevel=0.0)
411         m.box('blanco', (0.2, 0.02, 0.2), (0, -0.16, 0.38), bevel=0.0)
412         cross(0, -0.172, 0.53, 0.14)
413         return m
414     m.box('blanco', (0.86, 0.6, 0.5), (0, 0.08, 0.04), bevel=0.02)
415     m.box('EQUIPO', (0.88, 0.62, 0.035), (0, 0.08, 0.3), bevel=0.0)
416     m.box('EQUIPO', (0.88, 0.62, 0.04), (0, 0.08, 0.54), bevel=0.0)
417     for row in range(2):
418         for col in range(4):
419             if row == 0 and col in (1, 2):
420                 continue
421             m.box('luz', (0.12, 0.012, 0.1), (-0.3 + col * 0.2, -0.222, 0.12 + row * 0.24), bevel=0.0)
422     m.box('vidrio', (0.26, 0.012, 0.2), (0, -0.222, 0.04), bevel=0.0)
423     m.box('blanco_sucio', (0.4, 0.2, 0.03), (0, -0.32, 0.25), bevel=0.0)
424     for sx in (-1, 1):
425         m.beam('metal_claro', (sx * 0.18, -0.4, 0.04), (sx * 0.18, -0.4, 0.25), t=0.02)
426     m.box('blanco', (0.24, 0.02, 0.24), (-0.3, -0.21, 0.6), bevel=0.0)
427     cross(-0.3, -0.222, 0.76, 0.18)
428     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.22, 0.02, (0.12, 0.12, 0.58), seg=20)
429     m.cyl('amarillo', 0.2, 0.006, (0.12, 0.12, 0.6), seg=20)
430     m.cyl('oscuro', 0.17, 0.008, (0.12, 0.12, 0.6), seg=20)
431     m.box('blanco', (0.022, 0.12, 0.005), (0.08, 0.12, 0.605), bevel=0.0)
432     m.box('blanco', (0.022, 0.12, 0.005), (0.16, 0.12, 0.605), bevel=0.0)
433     m.box('blanco', (0.08, 0.022, 0.005), (0.12, 0.12, 0.605), bevel=0.0)
434     m.box('blanco', (0.2, 0.3, 0.12), (0.5, 0.22, 0.04), bevel=0.01)

  1 """Modelos de la v0.9 de Faro de Ámbar: vehículos y barcos nuevos, aviones, Aeropuerto, defensas y

  4 Convención: -Y es el frente, Z hacia arriba, 1 unidad ≈ una casilla. EQUIPO y EQUIPO_OSC toman el
  5 color del imperio en el juego.

110 def launcher():
111     """Lanzador de misiles de largo alcance: camión de ocho ejes con un contenedor enorme encima."""

113     xs = [-0.55, -0.4, -0.22, -0.07, 0.1, 0.25, 0.42, 0.57]

118         m.box('EQUIPO', (0.16, 0.22, 0.2), (sx * 0.1, -0.62, 0.15), bevel=0.03)
119         m.box('vidrio', (0.12, 0.02, 0.07), (sx * 0.1, -0.733, 0.27), rot=(-0.15, 0, 0), bevel=0.004)
120         m.box('luz', (0.04, 0.02, 0.025), (sx * 0.12, -0.735, 0.19), bevel=0.004)
121     m.box('EQUIPO_OSC', (0.42, 1.02, 0.08), (0, 0.12, 0.17), bevel=0.02)
122     # Contenedor del misil (tubo grande con tapa redonda adelante) y sus soportes.
123     m.pivot('turret', 0, 0.12, 0.25)
124     m.tube('EQUIPO', (0, 0.66, 0.36), (0, -0.48, 0.36), r=0.13, seg=16, part='turret')
125     m.sphere('EQUIPO_OSC', 0.13, (0, -0.48, 0.36), scale=(1, 0.55, 1), part='turret')

128     for y in (-0.25, 0.4):
129         m.beam('oscuro', (0, y, 0.21), (0, y, 0.25), t=0.08, part='turret')
130     return m

186 def carrier():

191     # Cubierta de vuelo (más ancha que el casco) y pista en ángulo.
192     m.box('oscuro', (0.7, 2.0, 0.025), (0.06, -0.02, 0.19), bevel=0.0)
193     m.box('oscuro', (0.36, 0.9, 0.025), (-0.17, 0.4, 0.19), rot=(0, 0, 0.16), bevel=0.0)
194     for k in range(9):
195         m.box('blanco', (0.012, 0.07, 0.004), (0.02, -0.85 + k * 0.17, 0.217), bevel=0.0)
196     m.box('blanco', (0.008, 0.8, 0.004), (0.33, -0.02, 0.217), bevel=0.0)
197     m.box('blanco', (0.008, 0.8, 0.004), (-0.28, -0.02, 0.217), bevel=0.0)
198     m.box('EQUIPO', (0.6, 0.06, 0.006), (0.06, -0.98, 0.217), bevel=0.0)
199     for sx in (-1, 1):
200         m.box('EQUIPO', (0.012, 1.7, 0.03), (sx * 0.335, 0.0, 0.13), rot=(0, 0, sx * 0.04), bevel=0.0)
201     # Isla (puente) a estribor con radar y mástil.

204     m.box('luz', (0.012, 0.22, 0.03), (0.226, 0.16, 0.49), bevel=0.0)

207     m.box('oscuro', (0.04, 0.16, 0.05), (0.28, 0.16, 0.66), bevel=0.0, part='rotor')

211         m.box('metal_claro', (0.16, 0.06, 0.008), (x, y + 0.02, 0.215), rot=(0, 0, a), bevel=0.0)
